name: Academ's Almalexia Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Almalexia.

name: Delver's Almalexia Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Almalexia.

name: Hero's Almalexia Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Almalexia.

name: Seeker's Almalexia Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck that tells the story of Almalexia.

name: Slayer's Almalexia Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Almalexia.

name: Bizarre Daedric Meat
description: The flesh of Oblivion creatures is often unusually colored, highly toxic, and strangely pungent. The perfect fodder to entice a Daedric steed into your service. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Anchorborn Welwa mount.

name: Fine Ebonsteel Chain
description: A lead capable of holding a gnashing Daedric beast without snapping. Strong materials won't help if it decides to turn on you, though. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Anchorborn Welwa mount.

name: Strengthened Welwa Muzzle
description: The jaws of a welwa are uniquely equipped to both tear flesh and crush bone. Requires a muzzle strong enough to keep its jaws closed tight, lest it devour its trainer. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Anchorborn Welwa mount

name: Delver's Ansei Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Ansei Frandar Hunding.

name: Diplomat's Ansei Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Ansei Frandar Hunding.

name: Geomancer's Ansei Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Ansei Frandar Hunding.

name: Hero's Ansei Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Ansei Frandar Hunding.

name: Slayer's Ansei Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Ansei Frandar Hunding.

name: Apple-Bobbing Aged Fetid Fish
description: This is one of seven parts of the Apple-Bobbing Cauldron Memento.

name: Apple-Bobbing Cold Iron Cauldron
description: This is one of seven parts of the Apple-Bobbing Cauldron Memento.

name: Apple-Bobbing Fenwood Ladle
description: This is one of seven parts of the Apple-Bobbing Cauldron Memento.

name: Apple-Bobbing Fresh Gorapples
description: This is one of seven parts of the Apple-Bobbing Cauldron Memento.

name: Apple-Bobbing Poise Guide
description: This is one of seven parts of the Apple-Bobbing Cauldron Memento.

name: Apple-Bobbing Stale Creek Water
description: This is one of seven parts of the Apple-Bobbing Cauldron Memento.

name: Apple-Bobbing Viscous Slime
description: This is one of seven parts of the Apple-Bobbing Cauldron Memento.

name: Berylglow Nix-Ox Steed
description: "Yes, Gemmy here glows. The Hlaalu of Balmora fed the first of its kind a rare mushroom, causing a reaction in its belly. The glow passed to its young. They're fast but feisty. Don't say I didn't warn you."—Cidius Sosia, Necrom Stablemaster

name: Carnaval Nix-Ox
description: The allure of Carnaval is enough to entice even the dourest Dark Elf to celebrate. Done with their characteristic attention to detail, they present the nix-oxen of Vvardenfell in stunning color and gilded saddles, perfect for a night of excess.

name: Chyle Seamed Nix-Ox Steed
description: First tamed by the Ahemmusa Ashland tribe, this lighter nix-ox steed only recently gained use by those outside the tribe. In fact, some riders who journeyed through Skyrim's winter noted that this nix-ox loves jumping around in snow.

name: Dagon Fel Nix-Ox Steed
description: Some scholars say the eerie blue markings on this nix-ox result from strange energies that once emanated from Mzuleft. Locals claim that no such energies exist these days and immediately speak of the steed's endurance and adaptability.

name: Firemoth Nix-Ox
description: After arriving on Firemoth Island, the slavers found and trained a flame-hued variant of the nix-ox steed. Its vibrant colors belie its fiery temperament, making it a suitable match for those seeking to ride into the midst of combat.

name: Lustrous Nix-Ox Fabricant Steed
description: Before Saints Llothis and Olms had to be confined in the Asylum Sanctorium, they used to ride through the Brass Fortress on holy days on these bizarre Fabricant mounts. But the parades are long gone, and the synthetic steeds have been repurposed.

name: Nix-Ox Fabricant Steed
description: Programmed for obedience and fabricated for endurance, these synthetic Nix-Ox Steeds are the perfect mounts for ranging out from the Brass Fortress across the dangerous Radius.

name: Nix-Ox War-Steed
description: It was the warlike Erabenimsun tribe of Ashlanders who first broke the wild Nix-Oxen of Vvardenfell to domestic use, and an ashkhan, the legendary Ashu-Ammu, who first rode one into battle.

name: Oasis-Strider Nix-Ox
description: Nix-oxen are incredibly adaptable, thriving across Tamriel. This subspecies developed bright markings to attract one another across the heat waves of the desert. Their long legs also allow them to cross the sands easily and stay cool in harsh conditions.

name: Rubyflare Torchnix
description: "Legends claim the Erabenimsun tamed these luminous creatures after Ashu-Ammu rode the first nix-ox into battle. While it's strange to choose a steed whose glow gives away your position, some warriors delight in added danger before battle."—Murdyn Athren

name: Summer's Herald Torchnix
description: Several theories circulate on the nature of the torchnix's light. Some scholars suggest the luminescence is a mating display, while others argue that it's a form of communication. Children in Ahemmusa tell each other the glow is bad food in the nix's gut.

name: Urshilaku Nix-Ox
description: Before these colorful creatures served as mounts for the Urshilaku, their shells were ground up for pigment. Seeing their potential as fast-moving steeds, handlers trained them for scouting missions, often hiding their bright colors with dried mud.

name: Aderene, Fargrave Dregs Dealer
description: Aderene is willing to trade items you don't need for useful materials. Some obscure Daedric contracts prohibit her from trading in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds. After she's summoned, you and your groupmates can use her services.

name: Allaria Erwen the Exporter
description: This free-spirited merchant is happy to join your adventures and take excess loot off your hands; however, Cyrodiil and Battlegrounds are too bloody for her liking. When summoned, she will purchase any non-stolen goods you or your groupmates offer her.

name: Baron Jangleplume, the Banker
description: This Blackfeather Court banker wants your shinies to keep them safe for you, of course! The chaos of Cyrodiil and Battlegrounds are murder on his plumage, so he won't visit you there. When summoned, his services can be used by you and your groupmates.

name: Cassus Andronicus the Mercenary
description: This severe mercenary is duty bound to guard your possessions with his life. Unless you're in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds—his contract explicitly excludes travel there. When summoned, his banking services are available to you and your groupmates.

name: Celia Tyde, Lost Fleet Bursar
description: Celia Tyde may be a pirate, but you can trust her to safeguard your valuables in the hold of her Lost Fleet vessel. Aetheric winds mean you can't summon her in Cyrodiil or on Battlegrounds, though you and your groupmates can use her services.

name: Drinweth, Valenwood Armorer
description: You and your groupmates can tend to the grove of your mind by summoning Drinweth, who will allow you to change and save builds outside of your home. A challenging past with various martial forces means she won't aid you in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds.

name: Eri, Barking Banker
description: Eri has been expertly trained by Nord beast tamers to act as a very good (such a good!) personal banker for you and your groupmates. He doesn't venture to Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds. Too much violence, not enough pets.

name: Ezabi the Banker
description: This Alfiq banker stands ready to fulfill your personal banking needs—except in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, which make her nervous. When summoned, her services can be used by you and your groupmates.

name: Factotum Commerce Delegate
description: Need to sell a few things? Do so with this shiny factotum—except in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, which initiate its retreat protocols. After it's summoned, you and your groupmates can use its services.

name: Factotum Property Steward
description: This factotum exists to serve as your personal banker—except in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, where it shuts down and vanishes to hyperogonal points unknown. After it's summoned, you and your groupmates can use its services.

name: Fezez the Merchant
description: This Alfiq merchant buys your non-stolen wares as often as you need him to—but not in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, which Fezez avoids due to "considerations of extreme danger." When summoned, his services can be used by you and your groupmates.

name: Ghrasharog, Armory Assistant
description: You and your groupmates can prepare for combat by summoning Ghrasharog to change and save builds outside of your home. He avoids Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, which he swears made him complacent after winning victory upon victory.

name: Giladil the Ragpicker
description: Giladil happily trades items you don't need for useful crafting materials! She doesn't ply her trade in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds because those areas aren't lucrative enough. After she's summoned, you and your groupmates can use her services.

name: Hoarfrost, Takubar Trader
description: Summoned from the fourth Sinus of Takubar, Hoarfrost will convey your goods (or the goods of your groupmates) to the cold-flame pits of Oblivion in exchange for mortal coins. Ancient bindings prevent them from appearing in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds.

name: Nuzhimeh the Merchant
description: This alert merchant is on hand whenever she's needed, and will buy any non-stolen goods you or your group offer her. She won't come to Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, though—too dangerous. When summoned, her services can be used by you and your groupmates.

name: Peddler of Prizes, the Merchant
description: This Blackfeather Court merchant can relieve you of shiny, non-illicit burdens. She avoids Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, describing them as "unprofitable" and "full of fat-legged giants." When summoned, her services can be used by you and your groupmates.

name: Pirharri the Smuggler
description: This Baandari Pedlar is on hand whenever she's needed (except in Cyrodiil and Battlegrounds), and will fence any of your goods for you—but she'll take a cut of the profits. When summoned, her services can only be used by you.

name: Pyroclast, Infernace Conservator
description: Hailing from the pocket realm of Infernace, Pyroclast will holdfast your items (or the items of your groupmates) in the fiery pits of Oblivion. Minor scorching may occur. Ancient bindings prevent them from appearing in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds.

name: Siluruz, Realm Craftsmaster
description: Fresh from their Daedric forge, Craftmaster Siluruz has the talent to see to the heart of the matter, and thereby reduce items to their components. They avoid Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, as mortal conflict bores them in their search for pure creations.

name: Terilorne, Dibellan Freetrader
description: Terilorne is a footloose merchant who seeks to spread the joy and beauty of Dibella in her wake. She will not enter Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, as the jarring vibrations of the conflicts there harshes her enjoyment of the world.

name: Tythis Andromo, the Banker
description: This aristocratic banker is on hand whenever he's needed, available for all personal banking services—except in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds, which are far too dangerous for this fellow. When summoned, his services can be used by you and your groupmates.

name: Tzozabrar, Dwarven Deconstructor
description: Tzozabrar will intake items you don't need, expelling useful materials no doubt scavenged from a Dwarven construct. Tonal interference makes it unusable in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds. After it's summoned, you and your groupmates can use its services.

name: Voko, Carnaval Weapondancer
description: You and your group can prep for sanguine slaughter by summoning Voko to change and save armory builds outside of your home. A lack of wine and dancing disinterests him from offering his services in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds.

name: Xyn, Planar Purveyor
description: Xyn travels the Daedric realms looking for profitable opportunities. They'll happily take your goods (or those of your groupmates) in exchange for common mortal coinage. Ancient bindings prevent them from appearing in Cyrodiil or Battlegrounds.

name: Zuqoth, Armory Advisor
description: You and your groupmates can prepare for combat by summoning Zuqoth to change and save builds outside of your home. Some obscure Daedric contracts prohibit her from offering her services in Cyrodiil or the Battlegrounds.

name: Aurelite Gryphon Feather
description: A gleaming golden gryphon feather. A component required to morph a Soulfire Dragon Illusion into the Aurielic Quasigriff mount.

name: Gilded Gryphon Barding
description: Gilded mount barding fitted for a quasigriff. A component required to morph a Soulfire Dragon Illusion into the Aurielic Quasigriff mount.

name: Sacred Seeds of Akatosh
description: Enchanted seeds fit for consumption as animal feed. A component required to morph a Soulfire Dragon Illusion into the Aurielic Quasigriff mount.

name: Akaviri Potentate Guar
description: "While I find the idea of 'Dark Elf assassins chasing Reman's loyalists in Morrowind on luminous Potentate guar steeds' to be laughably absurd, Mirannah's date of 2E 27 seems accurate for the first use of these ferocious mounts."—Honorata Ancrus, Eyevea

name: Alavelis Ringed Guar
description: Less fearsome than they look, the native guar of Alavelis have developed peculiar markings. Some believe they are a mimicry of the poisonous beasts of the Telvanni Peninsula, though the guar themselves have no such defense.

name: Ambergill Guar
description: "The amber glow of this Gill Guar marks its origin as Gideon. Gideon Glowgill Guar is a mouthful, yeah? That's why it's an Ambergill instead. Watching a herd of these race out from Gideon? Impressive, just like their riders!"—Ukaspa of Lilmoth

name: Antecedent Scholar's Guar
description: House Telvanni is renowned for the brutality of their scholarly infighting. In shadowy caves across the Inner Sea, a cult to Hermaeus Mora has grown up among those expelled from the House but still thirsting for knowledge, power, and one day revenge.

name: Ashmourning Vvardvark
description: Originally seen as a mistake by its creator, vvardvarks grew in popularity, compelling Telvanni magisters to expand its development. This dark-hued mount is perfectly suited to carry riders in funerary processions honoring revered ancient ancestors.

name: Baandari Pedlar Guar
description: For years, the Baandari Pedlars have traveled hither and yon, requiring them to train and equip mounts for both comfort and utility. Now you too can ride a colorful guar mount that has that Baandari style!

name: Bal Foyen Circus Guar
description: Like other reptilian creatures, Guar can be bred for bright, even gaudy colors. The Argonians of Dhalmora offer this entertaining variant, a popular performer in Tamriel's traveling shows.

name: Banded Guar Charger
description: A breed of guar bred for cavalry use, able to carry an armored warrior into battle.

name: Bull Kagouti Charger
description: That flash of orange and red before a bull kagouti attacks can cause anyone's heart to skip—unless you're riding this intimidating mount into battle! Embrace this creature's ferocity, but be prepared for its adorable cooing when you scratch its nose.

name: Buoyant Armiger Kagouti
description: "Vile mischief inflicted wounds upon the striped kagouti. 'Lord Vivec must know we have healed this creature who protected his servants. Remembered pain will lead to prevented pain.' And so it befriended the bear and spider."—Armiger Tharys's Journal

name: Carnaval Feathered Guar
description: Born and bred in remote reaches of Tamriel, these guar are the bestial stars of any Carnaval parade. Breeders of this variety feed them a rich diet to enhance their vibrant plumage before the festival.

name: Chalkhide Kagouti
description: With dappled skin perfectly matched to the white rock and marshy wetlands east of Bthanual, these Kagouti favor stealth and ambushes over brute force attacks. Ride one of these creatures and you'll be sure to turn heads in Mournhold.

name: Cinderstone Kagouti
description: "None can quench the life-fire blazing in this kagouti's heart. Night and day, we sing and dance amid magma rivers, fanning the spark of creation. If we're blessed, the magic takes and one of our number gains a devoted steed for life."—My Life Amid Flame

name: Cursebound Kagouti
description: This fell monstrosity inspired Maestro Efnort of the Bards College to write the poem "The Red-Eyed Terror of Zthenganaz." In truth, this steed most often chooses intimidation and flight tactics over direct confrontation.

name: Dark Brotherhood Kagouti
description: "Sithis teaches silence, yes, but stealth is not always the most important thing when you have enough speed and power on your side. That's why I choose to ride a kagouti. I find their ferocity more than makes up for the noise."—Dark Brother Bols Uveleth

name: Deadlands Guar
description: The blazing orange of its hide hints at both the origin and temperament of this guar mount. Though born from and shaped in the fiery Deadlands, you hold the power to temper it into a fierce but loyal mount.

name: Dragonscale Barded Guar
description: "This one doesn't sell many Guars here at the Riverhold Stables because Khajiit are folk who value their natural dignity and prefer not to ride so silly a beast. But a Guar in Dragonscale Bard is a thing of beauty!" — Master Groom Zarbi'dahuz

name: Dwarven Guar
description: Guar vamidiums, or Dwarven Guar Mounts, are most often associated with Dwemer sites in Morrowind—as might be expected, since that's where guar are most in use as pack and riding animals.

name: Flame Atronach Guar
description: Flame Atronachs are summoned from the Oblivion plane of Infernace, a realm so hot that molten rock flows across its surface, and its Daedra are creatures of living flame. Summoned to Tamriel, such atronachs can be given almost any shape, even a Guar!

name: Frost Atronach Kagouti
description: This kagouti-shaped frost atronach might just be the last thing an unfortunate apprentice warlock crafted before becoming its first victim. Perhaps you can tame this mount? If not, best have extra healing potions on hand for the inevitable bites.

name: Frostbane Guar
description: Since the Guar is native to warmer climates, the existence of the Frostbane Guar in Skyrim, theoretically protected from the cold by its dangling talismans, may be the strongest argument of those who say the Frostbane wards actually work.

name: Gloomspore Guar
description: "A Dunmer mage came by, shaking with rage, and tersely asked for my toughest mount. Though my Gloomspore Guars are a bit nippy, probably due to the extra bleeding crown I used to make them, they have thick fungal hide."—Mage Naleldil

name: Glowgill Guar
description: "These Glowgill Guar mounts come from a coastal tribe over near Archon. Handsome, are they not? I've been told they can breathe underwater through those gills, though personally, I have never tested this." —Ukaspa, Stablemaster of Lilmoth

name: Golden Eye Guar
description: A crossbreed of banded and wild guar, as fearsome as it is intelligent and difficult to control.

name: Goldscale Guar
description: "The glint of gold I glimpsed when I first spotted these guar made me think I'd found a vein of gold, but no. Instead I found something better—golden guar that match my exquisite taste. One nudged me to ride it, too! We're best friends."—Ganalyn Relvan

name: Green Narsis Guar
description: The robust Green Narsis is the standard mount and dray-beast of central Morrowind.

name: Grinning Terror Guar
description: "Croon to this guar, describing recent murder sprees, and you might win a place at this guar's side. Or capture its attention by emulating loud bodily functions. Either delights this creature."—Mother Regrets

name: Guar-Lizard Steed
description: "Some dryskins ask, 'Since a Guar is already a swamp reptile mount, why create Lizard-Steeds shaped like Guar? Isn't that somewhat redundant?' These dryskins are unusually perceptive!" —Ukaspa of Lilmoth

name: Hearthfire Kagouti
description: The Hearthfire Kagouti appears to be a sort of magical hybrid, a wizard's experimental melding of a carnivorous reptile and a flame atronach. The fact that they were first sighted in the Telvanni Grazelands lends this theory some credence.

name: Hist Guar
description: In Black Marsh this mount is called Scales-Seem-Daubed-with-Hist-Sap, but the rest of Tamriel just calls it the Hist Guar. It is the only subspecies of guar known to enjoy music.

name: Hivethief Vvardvark
description: "Look at that tongue! You can thank Spellwright Domavas for these bug-eating beauties, expanding on Magister Varkenel's work. I hear he first tried to give them feathers, failed, then came up with this gorgeous steed."—Cidius Sosia, Necrom Stablemaster

name: Hollowjack Rider Guar
description: The legend of Jaque o' the Hollow has spread even to the misty realms of eastern Tamriel where the Guar roam the woods and marshes, and during the dark nights of the Witches Festival reptile-riders may also find themselves haunted and headless!

name: Iron Atronach Guar
description: On a drunken dare, the mage Tarvyn Othren summoned the first known Iron Atronach Guar, which immediately killed his companions. Grieving, the mage sought redemption, riding only that guar as a reminder of his mistake.

name: Kagouti
description: Domesticating the savage Kagouti to serve as a mount is a recent endeavor, and to be frank, more than a little experimental. Do you have what it takes to stay in the saddle on one of these fierce, bipedal reptiles?

name: Kagouti Fabricant
description: Wheeled constructs and fabricants do just fine in most regions of the Clockwork City, but for traversing rough synthetic terrain, Seht's Apostles prefer the tough and capable Kagouti Fabricant mount.

name: Lavender Guar
description: Guar have long been at home in the Black Marsh, making them steady companions to the Argonians. It is not uncommon for Lavender Guar to bond deeply with their riders, standing watch while they sleep and affectionately nuzzling them.

name: Mnemoflare Kagouti Fabricant
description: "Clockwork fabricants possess keen intelligence, but their characters remain blank slates. Rumor has it that the Astronomer can import a dissected beast's memories directly into a fabricant's animo core, making for an enlightened mount."—Uleni Silarys

name: Nenalata Ayleid Guar
description: "While resting during their evacuation from Nenalata, guar mounts would voluntarily form a circle around the young and infirm, protecting them from danger. Their leader, Mafrelatta, set her calves amid them to share warmth."—Beredalmo the Signifier

name: New Moon Guar
description: "The eyes of this guar feel like they're reaching into my soul. As it turns out, that was a warning. It bit my hand soon after."—Jonnet of the Sunwalkers

name: Order of the Lamp Vvardvark
description: Though not the most fearsome mounts, these recent additions to the Lamp Knight stable are treasured for their loyalty, surefootedness, and tracking skills. Some mages claim they can smell magicka, making them invaluable to the Order of the Lamp.

name: Pale Velothi Guar
description: This stalwart mount comes from the ashlands downwind of the volcanoes of the Velothi Mountains, and is well adapted to surviving under the harshest of conditions.

name: Psijic Guar Exemplar
description: Psijic monks crossing the doubtful terrain of Black Marsh or southern Morrowind are more concerned with the practical matter of safe and sure riding than whether they look dignified and impressive. For these purposes, the Guar Exemplar is unequaled.

name: Ragebound Kagouti
description: "You're not hearing me. These were nothing like normal kagouti. Fury, froth, and carnage. And their riders, eyes wide with harnessed rage. That's what drew me in. That's why I joined them."—Medresi Guvron of Markarth

name: Reefborn Guar
description: "You'll find few wild guars wandering Abecean shores, but these coral beasts dance in the shallows nonetheless. Wherever they came from, they still exhibit the tamed guars' playful disposition."—Saissula, Stablemaster

name: Salamandrine Guar
description: "Boredom. Boredom and that accursed holiday in Stonefalls. That's why I used my considerable skills to merge a salamander and a guar. Hmm. The colors are striking. It was just a whim, but I'm pleased with the results."—Irastimil Direnni, Creature Creator

name: Scarlet War Pangrit
description: "These hard-headed creatures might seem empty-minded. Yet, somehow, they keep you alive when you've angered the ornaugs. Such is the nature of a loyal mount."—Saissula, Stablemaster

name: Shadowghost Guar
description: Blending in with the shifting gray ash clouds on the slopes of Red Mountain, the Shadowghost Guar are the only known nocturnal breed of the species, and thus are rarely seen, even by the native Dark Elves.

name: Silver-Limned Guar Charger
description: "My marshmates don't understand why I chose this beast. They say it is territorial and snappy. You just have to read the signs. Like right now. Its tail is twitching. You should move your hand if you like your fingers."—Skeeheieeus of Stormhold

name: Skeletal Guar
description: The naked, grisly smile on the broad skull of the Skeletal Guar mount may be enough to send lesser opponents fleeing in terror when you ride into battle on its creaking, bony frame. The Worm Cult, of course, will just be jealous.

name: Skyfire Guar
description: This colorful guar was once thought to be poisonous by many, but found to be relatively harmless by an adventuresome rider. Caution! Patience is needed to bring this obstinate mount to heed.

name: Soulrazer Guar
description: The crypts of High Isle are littered with walking suits of armor. Those who survive say that the armor protects treasures of old. But I suspect they haunt the black hallways, waiting for the dead to wake."—Grod, Castle Navire Crypt Keeper

name: Spellscar Kagouti
description: Driven to madness by the erratic magic around the Spellscar, these kagouti make surprisingly excellent pets. In comparison to their lucid and more aggressive kin, an insane kagouti is docile and picks up commands with ease.

name: Star-Born Guardian Guar
description: Legends in Fulstrom say that a star-studded guar brought the bastard child of King Vrage to their village one snowy night. No one heard or saw the pair arrive, until a child cried out for warmth. The guar disappeared before dawn.

name: Stonelore Guar
description: "This one adores the guar with its useless small arms and big round head. J'zurdru and the guar bonded over a love of belly rubs. Also napping on warm rocks and watching the clouds in the sky. Lazy but very relaxing, yes?"—Druid J'zurdru

name: Storm Atronach Guar
description: By modifying Koron's Peremptory Summons, the standard spell used to call atronachs from Oblivion, the conjurer can compel a Daedra to assume the form of a common Tamrielic mount—even a Guar, if so desired!

name: Striped War Pangrit
description: This pangrit's unassuming colors serve as combat camouflage. They can traverse coastal environments and rocky shorelines nearly unnoticed—a boon to riders looking to avoid attention.

name: Tessellated Guar
description: A sturdy, multi-purpose guar, at home anywhere from swamps to the ashlands.

name: Turquoise War Pangrit
description: "Some claim the Hadolids created the pangrits somehow. I suspect they simply tamed these spiky beasts. If they'd made them, they'd be smarter. If a pangrit wants something, they poke you. Learn quickly how to tell what they want!"—Saissula, Stablemaster

name: Umaril's Radiance Guar
description: "The marshfolk vexed the Unfeathered. 'They scatter to fight. But they fear so-named guar. Let us use that.' It took longer to acquire the needed guar than to ready them. May they forever hunt Umaril's foes."—Gandranya's Journal, Translated

name: Valorous Sovngarde Guar Strider
description: "Guar who fall in battle earn a place in Sovngarde. Some later walk among us, serving as faithful and courageous mounts to those who dedicate themselves to brave acts. They leap quickly into action when called."—Clever Woman Moritra

name: Wild Hunt Guar
description: Wild Hunt Guar are mounts that have reverted to the shapeshifting chaos of the Dawn Era. They have become part plant and part animal, as wonderful as they are abominable.

name: Wraithtide Guar
description: "The ghost of Ol' Brineburr herds glowing guar down trade roads, seeking buyers. Don't be put off by their appearance. Or, hmmm, maybe seeing your steed's skeleton is a bonus to you? Regardless, get one."—Initiate Rogeric

name: Abyssal Cephaliarch's Body Art
description: "In his name, I seek lost tomes and bring them home to Apocrypha. In his name, I remove words of power from the sight of knowledge seekers. And in his name, I bear markings of eyes and tentacles. Do you honor Hermaeus Mora as I do?"—Scrollseeker Thelmarn

name: Abyssal Embrace Body Markings
description: "Hermaeus Mora does not ask much, but those with the unending thirst for knowledge and secrets often wrap their bodies in his tentacles as a sign that they are pledged to Apocrypha."—Scholar Aia Laenius, Lillandril

name: Alftand Glacial Body Tattoos
description: Tattoos that replicate the distinctive iconography of Alftand, the only known Dwarven site built partially inside an active, moving glacier.

name: All-Maker's Body Art
description: "The art on my body reminds me that life flows from the All-Maker. Earth, sun, and water nurture our forests, where wolves fill the air we breathe with their nightly howls. Then life flows back to the All-Maker in an eternal cycle."—Skaal Shaman Rik

name: Alliance Viper Pit Body Marking
description: Veterans of the Three Banners War often get tattoos to represent their exploits in Cyrodiil. A new trend sees pit vipers of each faction viciously attacking each other—something many an alliance soldier can relate to.

name: Ancient Dragon Body Marks
description: After a tattooed Dragon Hunter has killed enough Dragons, an artist-adept adds to the markings, causing the color of its glow to shift to a golden hue.

name: Archival Access Body Tattoos
description: "We, the filers of the Infinite Archive, thank you for your service. As part of providing you access to the archive, you may now also adorn yourself with archive tattoos. A past assistant provided the art. We hope you like it."—Infinite Archive Filers

name: Aristocratic Astrologer Body Art
description: Nobles drawn to the study of stars may choose to have this passion etched on their skin using ink containing aetherial materials. These markings in particular not only showcase stars but frame them with decorous symbols.

name: Arrow Scars, including Knee
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Aurbical Symbols
description: Mystical body markings express your connection to the magicka essence of Nirn.

name: Automaton Body Tattoos
description: Some say the Mundus is naught but a great Mechanism, and we are but animunculi, like Dwarven automatons, turning like gears in some universal clockwork. But some mortals are just motorheads, you know? These machine-inspired body markings are for them.

name: Ayleid Body Ruinmarks
description: "Barra agea ry sou karan—wear lore as your armor. Say these words at a certain Ayleid gate under the Magician's light, and you may be blessed with light-blue markings reminiscent of that gate's design. Which gate? Soon I'll know."—Alfarmuth of Eyevea

name: Bards College Skald Body Marks
description: "A Skald is more than a musician. A song more than sound. Let this ink dance around your form and write the music of your soul upon the canvas of your skin. All who look upon you will hear the tempo of your heart."—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Battle-Scarred Body
description: "Mortals think they can fight Zazriz in Dredaza's area and return unscathed and alive? Zazriz laughs. The only mortals Zazriz respects are ones who bear proof of surviving battle. Come, fools, let Zazriz give you the scars of respect."—Zazriz, Gladiator

name: Bear-Claw Scars
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Bite Marks on Neck
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Limb-Bands
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Panther
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Sacrament Mass Body Marks
description: "Anoint yourselves in blood, my children. Rejoice in the silence that follows screams. You have earned the succor of the Night Mother. May she see your devotion and be pleased."—Benediction of the Brotherhood

name: Black Scarab Chest
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Strokes, Red Stitches
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Sun Paint Pauldrons
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black-Eared Puma
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Blackwood Carnaval Body Paint
description: Carnaval celebrants from the edge of Valenwood just love the swirling branches and twirling motifs—siren calls to Sanguine during Carnaval. It's said they create an almost hypnotic effect when the wearer is dancing.

name: Blessed Life-Tree Body Markings
description: The brilliant hue of the Ayleid life-tree glows upon those who sought knowledge from the Ayleids—and somehow gained the favor of one of their spirits. While its glow may not light your way in Ayleid ruins, it might win the favor of any lingering ghosts.

name: Blood Stripes Chest Paint
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Bloodrune Body Markings
description: The Bloodrune-marked Draugrkin graverobbers pride themselves on surviving and thriving in the deadliest tombs. Those who best them in combat have a chance to gain their distinctive red markings.

name: Bloody Chest Veil
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Blotchy Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Blue Skeleton Body Paint
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Blue Spider Daedra Paint
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Blue Stripes Chest Paint
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Body Art of the Five Companions
description: The bravery of the Five Companions lives on in the next generation of heroes. Those eager to embrace the courage of valiants such as Lyris Titanborn and Sai Sahan emblazon legendary deeds upon their bodies.

name: Body Imprint of the Psijic Order
description: Many monks of the Psijic Order proudly display their commitment to the Old Ways and the Eleven Forces with arcane body imprints.

name: Body Soul-Mark of the Sapiarchs
description: When a High Elf's use of magic strays beyond the comfort of the Sapiarchs, drastic measures are taken. These painful, twisting marks are etched into the skin. A measure to restore control, regardless of the cost.

name: Briarheart Body Scarification
description: Long before a warrior undergoes the ritual to become a Briarheart, some candidates undergo a marking ceremony. Scars shape ornate feathers and claws into their skin as a sign the Reach Hagravens chose them. These folk often lead others into battle.

name: Bright-Throat Algae Body Tattoo
description: Cheerful body daubings in the Bright-Throat style, in colorful green algae dye.

name: Bright-Throat Chalk Body Tattoo
description: Cheerful body daubings in the Bright-Throat style, in sharp white chalk dye.

name: Bright-Throat Woad Body Tattoo
description: Cheerful body daubings in the Bright-Throat style, in colorful blue woad dye.

name: Bright-Throat Yolk Body Tattoo
description: Cheerful body daubings in the Bright-Throat style, in colorful hackwing egg-yolk dye.

name: Broad Half-Body Ember Smear
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Broad Half-Body Smearing
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Bronze Serpent Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brown Radiant Blotches
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brown Radiant Strokes
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brown Spider Strokes
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Buoyant Armiger Body Tattoos
description: Proven warriors of Lord Vivec and the Tribunal are entitled to display these striking body tattoos from neck to ankle.

name: Burned Chest Scars
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Cathay Baandari Body Brand
description: "Cathay peddlers state that Baan Dar smiles upon those who undergo the Ritual of Pathkeeping to receive red and white brands. Know the Way of the Baandari, and you grasp the wandering litter's strengths and their challenges."—Ostarion the Storyteller

name: Chevron Slashmarks
description: Like standing waves in the flow of the River, the Chevron Slashmarks show where you stand in the current of life.

name: Chittering Chaurus Body Markings
description: Adventurers seeking poisons often hunt chauruses—enormous insects known for their venomous bite. Nord inkwrights add it to the ink for the markings known as the Chittering Chaurus, which they claim provides bearers with the tenacity of these insects.

name: Clockwork Apostle Body Imprints
description: The striking Imprint Tattoos some Clockwork Apostles display on their bodies are inspired by the mechanomagical circuitry of Sotha Sil's Fabricants and Factotums.

name: Concentric Dot Scars
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Copper Serpent Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Covenant Lion Dark Blue
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Covenant Lion Violet
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Covenant Warrior Body Tattoos
description: Proven warriors of the Daggerfall Covenant are entitled to display these striking body tattoos from neck to ankle.

name: Cracked Mud Tattoos
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Croco-Spots
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Cycle Behind the Stars Body Art
description: "When death-sorrow claws at your mind, look within. Reflect on the Sands Behind the Stars and know that, once there, true cats reside in splendor until the Next Pounce."—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Dagon's Aspirant Body Markings
description: Those who prove their loyalty to the Prince of Destruction, Mehrunes Dagon, are allowed the great honor of displaying his distinctive red markings on their body.

name: Dark Crescent Moons
description: Khajiiti who wear the Dark Moons tattoos may be displaying a preference for unrestrained behavior.

name: Dark Gray Lizard Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Dark Mottled Lizard Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Dark Red Pact Chest Dragon
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Dead-Water Blood Body Tattoos
description: When the fierce Dead-Water tribe goes to a formal declaration of conflict, the warriors daub themselves with red dye that resembles smears of blood.

name: Death Dealer Body Markings
description: "Each of these markings represents a victory over a worthy foe. Come, let us see your markings. Or have you not gained any yet, little one? Consider these, perhaps."—Margretha

name: Death Grin Body Tattoo
description: This grim design is often worn by members of groups usually in opposition to each other: necromancers such as the Worm Cult, and the priests of Divines who guide souls to the afterlife such as Arkay, Xarxes, and Tu'whacca.

name: Deep Dark Paint Gorget
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Deep Dark Red-Trim Gorget
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Defensive Rune Body Tattoos
description: The Scholar-priests of Skingrad fashioned these triangular markings to call on the knowledge of the God of Wisdom and Logic. Bearers of the markings say that their memory improved after completing the tattoos.

name: Dominion Warrior Body Tattoos
description: Proven warriors of the Aldmeri Dominion are entitled to display these striking body tattoos from neck to ankle.

name: Dotted Line Scar Chevrons
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Draco Aerius Body Markings
description: A key component of the Draco Aerius markings is ground Dragon scale, which body artists use in the ink.

name: Dragon Cult Body Tattoo
description: Skyrim's Dragon Cult was exterminated two eras ago, but its powerful symbology lives on in the banners of the Ebonheart Pact, and in these bold draconic tattoo sets.

name: Dragon Vassal Body Markings
description: In ancient times, mortals wishing to express their utter devotion and fealty to the Dovah were known to wear these Dragon Vassal Body Markings.

name: Dragon Wings Body Markings
description: The Dragon Cult of the ancient Nords is long gone and forgotten—or is it? These Body Markings show the wearer's devotion to the Dovah worship of old.

name: Dragonbone Chain Body Marking
description: The bones of the Dovah have a powerful symbolic significance to worshipers of the ancient Dragon Cult, who created this Dragonbone Chain tattoo set.

name: Dragondancer Body Markings
description: "Take the strength of those Dragons you've slain with your killing dance into your physical form, melding it with your mind to grow in your purpose. These markings? They represent this purpose." —Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Dragonsmoke Body Markings
description: "With these markings, it is as if you take the power of the Dragon within you, and let the smoke of its flames conceal you. Whether this is true is now up to you, yes?"—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Drakes and Daemons Duel Body Art
description: Your body is a canvas. Use it to show your devotion to the Battlegrounds!

name: Dreadhorn Body Tattoo
description: The Reachmen of the Dreadhorn clan revere Minotaurs for the brute strength and savagery, a regard evinced in their barbaric but strangely beautiful sets of tattoos.

name: Dreadsail Body Tattoo
description: "I fear not the billowing gales that threaten to tear the planks from my decks. Nor the raging storms that call forth sea serpents from the roiling sea. What's to fear? I carry them all within me."—Allonda, Boson of the Painted Ray

name: Dreamstrider Body Art
description: Vaermina dances in your dreams, beckoning you to join her on journeys of wonder and of woe. When you awake, you return changed in both body and mind. Will you show off your wondrous new body art or keep it to yourself?

name: Dremora Kyn Body Tattoo
description: When the Dremora go to war, the Kyn adopt special geometric body markings that display their commitment to victory over dishonor. With these tattoos, mortals can look just as fearsome as Dremora.

name: Druidic Knotwork Body Tattoos
description: To the druids, the repetition of one braid forming three-sided shapes is a symbol that all three druidic circles share the same goals. A reminder that unity eclipses the differences in how they revere Y'ffre.

name: Dwarven Centurion Body Tattoos
description: An impressive set of body markings inspired by that giant mechanical guardian of Dwemer ruins, the Dwarven Centurion!

name: Dwarven Geometry Body Markings
description: These repeating geometrical body markings emphasize the lost Dwemer's obsession with numerical precision, and make their wearer look as tough as a Dwarven mechanism.

name: Dwemer Body Markings
description: A golden Dwarven face dominates the wearer's back, lending its compelling aspect to their overall presence.

name: Eagle Plume Flurry Body Tattoo
description: The Eagle: symbol of the Aldmeri Dominion and totem of the High Elves, expressing their soaring ambition to be pre-eminent in whatever they choose to pursue. This flurry of eagle feathers displays one's allegiance to that ideal.

name: Ebon Dwemer Body Markings
description: The dark pigments used in this variant of a classic Dwemer marking adds a funereal—or even sinister—tone to already impressive body art.

name: Elder Dragon Body Marks
description: With its blue flair, this Dragon tattoo is a favorite among those who crave to feel the strength of this creature running through their blood.

name: Eldertide Body Ink
description: "The gauntlet at your back pushes you down the path toward Y'ffre. Sure strokes push paint into skin as they push outsiders from our shores. The Systres belong to druids and the tide of our wrath is ever flowing."—Archdruid Alix, Founder of Y'ffre's Path

name: Enchanting Cherry Blossom Marks
description: "Cherry blossoms in Auridon art symbolize perfection that defies time's erosion. But to paint their likeness? The temporary nature of paint and the artistry of the painting? I've never seen such a stunning display of elegance!"—Idawen, Art Historian

name: Enveloping Scales
description: A full body marking that emulates a near-complete second set of scaley-skinned armor.

name: Extensive Burn Scarring
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Eye of Shalidor Body Markings
description: "When you first joined the College, Shalidor's magic imprinted your body invisibly. As you passed trials, marks began to appear. Now, having mastered your curriculum, your body exhibits them all. Congratulations."—Mage Vignarth, College of Winterhold

name: Fargrave Soullattice Body Marks
description: Those who uphold the dictates of Fargrave's Stricture often adorn their bodies with this indigo latticework design. Now that they're available to those outside the Grasp, perhaps you, too, are interested in helping Fargrave maintain Daedric neutrality?

name: Feral Favor Body Tattoo
description: Hircine favors the bold, it is said. Hunters who wish to gain the Prince's favor have no need for camouflage, preferring instead to proudly tattoo their allegiance across their bodies. On occasion, the blood of their prey is used in place of ink.

name: Fire Cyclone Body Markings
description: Impress your friends and strike fear into your enemies with these dazzlingly vibrant body markings. Be warned! This look can only be pulled off by the most bold and daring adventurers in Tamriel.

name: Firesong Body Art
description: The Firesong of Y'ffelon smear their arms and legs with ash from the volcano, then draw intricate bolts of amber over the ash. Outsiders find it impossible to tell whether the bolts are lightning or roots. Which is just how the Firesong like it.

name: First Cat's Pride Tattoo
description: "Your body knows much it doesn't tell. With artistry, we can call forth the First Cat's Pride so that you may guide others in Alkosh's path. They will see the golden fire on your body and follow."—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Forsaken Sacrifice Body Markings
description: "Nord peace offerings to Giants bear markings similar to those the hulking folk wear, as a sign that they are free to take. The practice of tattooing exiles in this manner is still common among remote communities."—Fadile Senoril

name: Fortune's Anvil Body Markings
description: "Zenithar demands only one thing, my friend: effort. When the sweat pours from your brow and your muscles turn to jelly, these markings will remind you of your oath to the Divines." —Severio Helenus, Priest of Zenithar

name: Freckles and Moles
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Frigid Impact Body Marking
description: When pushed, your white-hot rage breaks free of the icy cage you set around it, smashing your foes. Warn others of your wrathful inclinations with these markings.

name: Frigid Ritual Body Markings
description: The power of the Icereach coven flows through your veins, and their symbols decorate your skin, marking you as one of them. You have become one with the coven, and all should fear your prowess.

name: Gargoyle Body Flair
description: When you cannot achieve the form of a gargoyle, decorating your body with spectacular gargoyle symbology can be your next best achievement. Exhibit this flair with pride and fierceness!

name: Geometric Placket Scarring
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Ghost Goblin Body War Paint
description: Certain Goblin tribes instill fierce recklessness in their warriors by encouraging them to think of themselves as already dead, chalking their forms before battle with what their adversaries refer to as Ghost Goblin War Paint.

name: Glenmoril Wyrd Body Markings
description: The symbols of tree spirits and more decorate those chosen as protectors by the Glenmoril Wyrd. Some claim that spriggans contribute sap to the ink, forming a tighter bond between nature and the one being marked.

name: Gloomlurker Body Markings
description: "Some ruin explorers calling themselves Gloomlurkers mark themselves with chalky-white line patterns after killing the creature that terrifies them most. You want these markings? Go find a beast worth slaying."—Gloor the Glowerer

name: Gold Dominion Chest Eagle
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Gold Stippled Tattoo Swirls
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Golden Ocean Geometry
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Golden Paisley
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Golden Wraparound Wyrm
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Grave Plunderer Bodypaint
description: "Exploring tombs is not for the faint of heart. Sometimes you run into something that's best left alone. That's when you get help from others like us. So, paint yourself up like me, and you'll know who your friends are."—Paurges Aline

name: Gray Lizard with Armbands
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Gray Pebbled Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Gray Serpent Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Green Pebbled Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Greenish Gray Lizard Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Heart-Cross Scars
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: High Isle Mariner's Body Tattoos
description: "Life on the waters calls for courage, calm, and canniness. Show all three while we're facing down Dreadsails or ornaug throngs, and we'll take you out for Gonfalon grog and tattoos like mine."—Germonde Baduoin, Sailor

name: Highmane's Hero Body Marks
description: "Ah, you have the strength and endurance of Alkosh at your side! This one can see it in your eye—the gleam of victory. Now, the Dragon King of Cats has claimed you as his own. It is an honor few can dream of." —Priest Adahni

name: Hircine's Chosen Body Marks
description: The hunt calls. Your prey fights, wounding you and leaving scars. In the still that follows, a Huntmaster marks you with ink crafted from your foe's viscera. A glorious end to a proud legend tells its tale upon your own hide.

name: Hircine's Hunt Body Markings
description: Hunters, when taking part in any of Hircine's challenges, must be brutal and cunning. After coming back victorious from one such contest, you now wear crimson markings in honor of the blood you spilled for the Huntsman.

name: Hoardwalker Body Marks
description: "Sometimes the most priceless treasure you can carry out of a forgotten hoard is that which gleams on your hide. After all, riches are easily spent, but skin or scale tends to stay with you your whole life."—Heknorr, Heistmaster

name: Horizontal Dotted Scar Lines
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Horror Within Body Markings
description: Hide the truth of yourself no longer! Stain your body as darkly as your soul for all the world to see, and tremble.

name: Hrokkibeg's Claw Body Marks
description: "You may meet the Mighty Bear, who is invoked as Hrokkibeg. He embodies the Totem of Claw and Fang, and comes seeking solitude, peace from labors, and renewal of the Burning Spirit Within. Beware, for if you rouse him you will be torn asunder."

name: Hunting Grounds Body Tattoo
description: When you wear the thorn and briar tattoo of the Hunting Grounds, you may be pursuer or prey, hunter or hunted, but either way you display your devotion to Lord Hircine, Master of the Great Hunt.

name: Inferno Ink Body Markings
description: Though once reserved for summoners of Flame Atronachs, these tattoos can now be worn by any adventurer bold enough to try their daring look.

name: Ink Pendant Neck and Arms
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Ink-Blot Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Inkwing Death Crow Body Tattoo
description: The fearsome Death Crow tattoo is a favorite of Reach clans, smugglers, pirates, and worshipers of Nocturnal.

name: Inky Chest Veil
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Intermittent Swirl Tattoos
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Jaguar Rosettes
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Karthwatch Guardian Body Tattoo
description: The Nords of Karthwatch's garrison are the first line of defense against incursions from the Reach. Many emblazon their bodies with the knotwork tower of their heraldry as a symbol of their bravery and a mark of pride.

name: Karthwolf Body Tattoo
description: Many of the Reach clans along the Karth River worship Hircine, the Father of Manbeasts, and take the savage Skyrim wolves as their totems. These tattoos evoke that heritage.

name: Ket Keptu Body Marks
description: Originally solid colors, the markings some Ket Keptu wore to signify their status as warrior-smiths later gained a gradient of hues. Scholars claim this occurred as these pre-Alessians furthered their knowledge of ore refinement and tattoo inks.

name: Knights of St. Pelin Body Marks
description: Saint Pelin's story is one of sacrifice. The Order of Saint Pelin honors his gift to this day. It's traditional for blood from a new knight to be mixed with tattoo ink and used to create this sword and wing iconography.

name: Lambent Guar Body Markings
description: Using the blood of an amberglow guar, tattoo artists of Murkmire set alight your skin with distinctive luminescent yellow markings. Once done, they state, the blessing of the land keeps the markings lit.

name: Legendary Dragon Body Marks
description: So many Dragons have died at your hands that the smell of Dragon blood has soaked into your very dreams. With great skill, the artist-adept has given you markings that reflect your experience, making them glow with an emerald hue.

name: Leopard Spots
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Light Blue Chest Wings
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Light Blue Covenant Lion
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Light Cheetah
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Light Gray Lizard Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Light Mottled Lizard Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Light Serval Spots
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Lunar Orbit Lattice
description: Acknowledge the rule of the Moons Jone and Jode over all things Khajiiti with the Lunar Lattice markings.

name: Maddening Mishap Body Markings
description: Explosive results might sound like a good thing, but when they're literally explosive and weren't meant to be, well, that's gonna leave a mark. Maybe two.

name: Magicka Everlasting Body Marks
description: "As a member of the Mages Guild, you learn techniques that help you channel magicka more efficiently. That experience changed my life. Now I have the unbound flow depicted on my body so that I'm reminded of that joy each time I trace the marks."—Fairwen

name: Medium Mottled Lizard Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Meridian Radiance Body Tattoos
description: "The Light of Meridia bursts into your chest and then seems to come alive, coiling and burning throughout your body and head, illuminating you from within." —The Sayings of Valasha

name: Meridian Sunburst Body Tattoos
description: Celebrate the brightest light of all the Lady's Infinite Energies with these glowing Meridian Sunburst Tattoos.

name: Meridian War Burst Body Markings
description: Before battle, warriors consecrated to Meridia often paint their bodies with these energetic "War Burst" markings.

name: Mirrormoor Memory Body Marking
description: Those who visit Mirrormoor often find themselves changed when they return. By who, or what, they cannot say. Only dim memories remain, like shards of glass scattered upon the ground.

name: Mirrorscribe Body Markings
description: Every choice has a consequence. Like revelatory words emblazoned on a page, the truth begs to burst forth once it's uncovered. Some who know these deeper secrets carry signs of their forbidden knowledge, inside and out.

name: Mirrorweb of Memories Body Art
description: "Even a fractured mind can retain subconscious memories. The echoes of past trauma are written in the fault lines of the soul, and when read correctly, the truth is revealed."—Mirror, Myth, and Memory: A Guide

name: Morag Tong Body Tattoo
description: Proven allies of the Morag Tong are entitled to display these striking body tattoos denoting their service to the group.

name: Morag Tong Writ Count Body Art
description: Notable kills are immortalized by the most zealous Morag Tong as scars across their bodies. Beware a Tong who hides their skin, for they may be hiding the true depth of their prowess.

name: Morthal Champion Body Markings
description: Featuring the Morthal triskelion, these ornate markings grace only the bodies of those who have heroically protected Morthal and its citizens.

name: Mycoturge Body Markings
description: Those who create structures using fungus often adorn their bodies with ornate markings featuring mushrooms. These mycoturges provide their own mycelial-based inks to the artist for their works of body art.

name: Mystic Geometries
description: As on the skin of the sky, so on the skin of the votary: display the Mystic Geometries on your own mortal worldskin.

name: Mystic Magicka Flow Body Tattoos
description: The mystic monks of the Psijic Order claim that Magicka flows through mortals in specific physical channels, and they can delineate these channels as tattoos to help mages focus their spellcasting.

name: Necrom Armiger Body Markings
description: Buoyant Armigers assigned to Necrom often meditate before their pilgrimage, reflecting on what they hope to achieve. Once there, if they accomplish their goals, a Dead Keeper body artist adorns their skin with Necrom symbology.

name: Necromantic Sigil Body Tattoos
description: Do you dare to wear the serpentine Necromantic Sigils that display your dedication to the arts of undeath?

name: Netchspot Abstraction Body Marks
description: "The calm of the netch infuses some folk. Yet their spirit burns bright with playful inner joy. For one such person, I created colorful tattoos inspired by golden, spotted netches I encountered long ago."—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: New Moon Cultist Body Tattoo
description: You've found what you're looking for in the Cult of the New Moon. And you want everyone to know whose side you're on. Let the flame symbology of this eye-catching tattoo show them.

name: Night Mother's Embrace Body Art
description: The Night Mother's countenance is not a warm or comforting thing. Her dark hands reach out from the shadows, born on a nightshade-scented breeze, grasping and searching, until the victim knows the sweet embrace of death.

name: Nightmare Nest Body Art
description: Some Vaermina cultists believe they can morph dreams into reality via an intricate series of rituals. The rites culminate in an incense-shrouded chamber wherein a recipient gains tattoos similar to the group's favorite Weaver of Dreams statue.

name: No Body Marking
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Nocturnal Outlaw Body Tattoo
description: The shadows are your friend, providing you with shelter and opportunity. As a Nocturnal Outlaw, you deserve a body tattoo that expresses your true nature.

name: Oak's Promise Body Marks
description: "The druids of old knew the oak's promise: stand strong, stay true, and shelter all. Some Stonelore Druids mark this promise into their skin even today. And they'll cudgel you into the dirt if you cut down a tree."—Globura of Gonfalon Bay

name: Ocean Geometry Full Body
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Ode to Clockwork Body Art
description: "A stunning veneration of the Tinkerer in traditional Dark Elf style. The artist's neo-classical interpretation of Tribunal decorative aesthetics is a tribute to ancient-meets-modern sensibilities."—Assistant Maren, Library of Vivec

name: Old Salt Body Tattoos
description: After seeing you stand firm in many an Abecean squall, some claim you have brine for blood. While you wish this were true, you chose the next best thing to express your love of sailing: intricate tattoos of ships and other aspects of life on the high seas!

name: Ominous Handprints
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Open-Front Dense Swirls
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Outline Chest Wyrm
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Oval Cheetah Spots
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Pact Dragon Chest
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Pact Warrior Body Tattoos
description: Proven warriors of the Ebonheart Pact are entitled to display these striking body tattoos from neck to ankle.

name: Painted Chevron Strokes
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Painted Coal and Blue Strokes
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Painted Coal and Embers
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Painted Coal and Green Strokes
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Painted Double Crosses
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Painted Rising Lines
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Painted Sacred Insect
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Painted Spider Strokes
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Painted Vertical Strokes
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Painted Zigzag Crosses
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Paisley Arms and Half Chest
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Path of Valor Body Markings
description: "You follow in the footsteps of valiant heroes, swearing to prove your bravery so that you may one day enter Sovngarde. Now carry these markings alongside your axe to embody your oath."—Gerda Swift-Sword

name: Plague Dragon Body Stains
description: Seeking to show your devotion to Peryite? These Dragon-shaped stains do just that! They're best paired with a cough or other visible illness.

name: Planemeld's Master Body Art
description: The chains of Coldharbour are symbols of fear and oppression. What does it say about those who would ink the dark anchors of Molag Bal upon their skin?

name: Pride of Alkosh Body Marks
description: "Once a ritual of the Pride of Alkosh, the marking ceremony places ornate designs upon an adherent's body, signifying reverence to the First Cat."—Mo'khu, Moon Priest

name: Prominent Pockmarks
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Puma Fur
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Radiant Blotches
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Radiant Lines and Dots
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Rajaska's Snarl Body Tattoos
description: The Bent Dance corrupts all who fall to its ceaseless drumming. The Rajaska are fueled by this corruption, growing as strong as the Ahz-m'Athra that snarls from the Dark Behind the World.

name: Reach Rebel Body Markings
description: Accents of red and white mark the bodies of those who have taken an oath to defend the Reach while under Arana's command. Her own hand traces the symbols while her witchery changes the skin's hue.

name: Red Caracal
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Diamond Body Stainwork
description: "The glass stained on my skin as it is in the temples of the Imperial city is a pledge. Not to a dream—fleeting and unattainable—but to the future that lays before us. An oath to see the empire restored!"—Garrus Congonius, Champion of the Heartlands

name: Red Skeleton Body Paint
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red-Gold Serpent Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Regal Eagle Wing Body Tattoos
description: The noble eagle is the symbol of both royal family of the High Elves and of the Aldmeri Dominion which they lead. Show your loyalty to this Alliance and its leaders with these eagle wing tattoos.

name: Riften Rogue Body Markings
description: The Riften Ratway contains many a ne'er-do-well, but that doesn't trouble you because you've earned a high place among this disreputable bunch—and these tattoos prove it! Though blades cross your chest, none in the Ratway of Riften dare cross you.

name: Right Shoulder Scar
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Rose of Tamriel Body Marks
description: The flora of Tamriel has long been a source of inspiration for artists. Tea lovers and provisioners in particular may appreciate the more subtle qualities of the rose, but the plant's striking appearance has a wide artistic appeal as well.

name: Ruddy Serpent Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Rusty Silver Serpent Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Rusty Steel Serpent Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Saint Kaladas Body Markings
description: Those who adore Saint Kaladas the Architect often display their devotion with this budding script that grows from the ground up to bloom across their shoulders.

name: Saliache Scholar Body Markings
description: A cadre of Ayleid scholars and explorers loved their studies of the Saliache Elves so much that they tattooed their bodies with "the door to greater knowledge." To join their ranks is an honor preserved for the best Ayleid lorekeepers of the time.

name: Sanguine's Indulgence Body Marks
description: "And as they etched each rose petal on his fur, S'razar felt lighter, more impulsive. Following the Path was an afterthought. What mattered was how much drink he had and the blood he'd spill for more of it."—S'razar, Carnaval Partygoer

name: Scrawl of the Arcanist Tattoos
description: "How can I find the right words when the One Who Knows wants them hidden? When I can't capture and keep them in my mind even in Apocrypha? Wait let my body be my parchment and my blood form the ink!"—Scrap from The Arcanist's Path

name: Scrying Eye Psijic Body Tattoo
description: The Psijic Order has its eye on you—literally! These tattoos show that Mysticism enables you to see beyond the mundane and into the arcane.

name: Senchal Brigand Body Tattoo
description: To survive in Senchal, you've learned how to make the most of a bad situation. These bold markings prove that you have what it takes to shake your fist in the face of adversity and deprivation.

name: Serpent Scale Body Marking
description: These ophidian tattoo markings are favored by those who revere Serpents, Dragons, and other mystical reptilians.

name: Serpentine Interlace Body Tattoo
description: This design symbolizing the intertwining of all life forms is popular with wyresses, Wardens, Y'ffre-worshipers, and all those who feel a special connection with Nature in Tamriel.

name: Shadow Striping
description: Body markings that resemble the mottled shadows of light filtering through the Elsweyr jungles.

name: Shadows of Blackwood Body Marks
description: "Rivers may flow in one direction, but paths can be traveled in two. When dedicating space on your body to something as encompassing as the Blackwood forest, be prepared for the forest itself to judge your worth."—Root Herald Iokish

name: Shagrath's Favor Body Marks
description: "I can see Shagrath's interest in you. The silver strands spun across your body speak volumes. My question is, will you traverse her weavings, or spin your own? Shagrath prefers the latter."—Selene

name: Shattered Chivalry Body Tattoo
description: The whispers of Oblivion slither through the halls of Red Petal Bastion—drawing its guardians ever deeper into the Daedra's embrace. These once-noble warriors forsook their oaths to pursue dark artifacts—but remain forever marked by their choice.

name: Shattered Mirror Maze Body Marks
description: Some labyrinths lack a solution. Those within can only mark time by the beating of their heart and the weakness in their body. Those who walk these endless caliginous mazes without purpose may be marked by the journey. If they ever make it out.

name: Sheogorat Body Branding
description: "I'm the rat. Sheogorath's rat. Sheogorat. I live amid the cheese. So much cheese. I have rats on me, too. In me. You can't have them. Get your own. Not even the butterflies can have my cheese. They want it, though."—Colmarion, also known as Sheogorat

name: Silver-Black Serpent Scales
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Skald's Body Branding
description: "I've learned that Nord vessels sailing the Sea of Ghosts prefer having a skald on board to lull the spirits haunting those waters into happier memories. These fish-knot markings indicate a master seafaring skald."—Sarion

name: Smoke Swirl Arm Tattoos
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Solid Wraparound Wyrm
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Soulburst Body Soulmarkings
description: The Soulburst was not merely a physical event, but a sundering of all the souls on Nirn. Such a catastrophe had never been felt on this plane before. The survivors were often changed, sometimes bearing an outward reminder of their own soul-deep struggle.

name: Spider Daedra Chest Paint
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Spore Savant Body Marks
description: There's always a celebration when a Telvanni spore savant's first structure reaches maturation. Some retain spore-ink artisans to decorate the architect's skin with mushrooms and claim the recipient receives visions of future projects during the process.

name: Square Spiral Fractal
description: Applying the Laws of the Hist to the chaotic life of the marsh is called Squaring the Spiral.

name: Stippled Tattoo Swirls
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Stone-Nest Orator Body Paint
description: Ancient markings upon your skin show your reverence for stone. For Tamriel's roots. For the gift of life itself.

name: Stonelore's Legend Body Paint
description: "Don't ask a Stonelore druid about their markings. They'll tell you a long tale about how one of their ancient practitioners went six days without sleep and saw the magic of Y'ffre swirling about him. What nonsense!"—The Final Correspondence of Lernynyas

name: Stormsurge Body Markings
description: "I inscribed my face with graceful waves to ward off the ocean's beckoning song. But I can't resist the ocean forever. One day, I'll sail into the horizon and be happily lost among the waves."—Alwoisse, Captain of the Sea's Mystery

name: Striated Tiger
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Cheetah
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Jaguar
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Leopard
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Pendant Neck and Arms
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Pockmarks
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Puma
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Red Caracal
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Serval
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Striated
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Swirl Tattoos
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Tiger
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Sul-Xan Prophet Body Markings
description: The Sul-Xan are renowned for their prowess in battle and their devotion to their cause. The prophet's red markings are worn only by those who are sworn to ensure the future of the tribe.

name: Sul-Xan Raider Body Markings
description: The Sul-Xan raider oathtaking ceremony includes tracing a marsh-green pattern upon hide and scale. The dye's acidic scent hints at the level of burning pain involved in this exaltation of chaos.

name: Swaying Skeleton Body Art
description: "On wicked nights when the wind flees grasping limbs, we weep lich-ink onto ourselves. Any who see us in their dreams take on our lich-bone symbols and step into lands of nightmare while sleeping and awake."—Nearly illegible snippet from Larul's Journal

name: Tenmar Leopard Body Marks
description: The leopards of Tenmar blend into their surroundings so well that those seeking to emulate them mark their bodies similarly to these creatures.

name: Tentacle Thistle Chest Ink
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: The Black Drake's Body Warpaint
description: Made by applying a thick layer of soot and ash to the body and then carving away the paint with the fingers, this warpaint embraces the volatile nature of battle. Durcorach reportedly saw the pattern in the flickering flame of his hearth.

name: Thorns of Ecstasy Body Marks
description: The Lord of Revelry's faithful often decorate each other with sacred, floral-based inks. The result? Beautifully rendered roses that bristle with thorns. This alluring design serves as a reminder of Sanguine's great gifts: both bliss and agony.

name: Thrall's Arterial Map Body Marks
description: Make the lives of those vampires around you easier by helping them see where your veins run. After all, the quicker they're sated, the quicker you can get back to what you were doing before you became dinner.

name: Threads of Mirrormoor Body Art
description: "The threads of fate live within us all, weaving all reality together in a terrible, beautiful tapestry. It is a gift to be bound within this complex existence. Do not try to fight it."—Cipher Ascien

name: Tiger Stripes
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Touch of the Draoife Body Marks
description: "Auguries. Through stone and starlight, fire and ash, the Draoife glimpse the future—and act. And they gave you such wondrous markings. Oh, my friend, what secrets will you find in the wilds?"—Scholar Thaegara

name: Triple Blue Chest Wings
description: One of the standard body markings available at every Tamrielic salon.
