description: Samsu the Sleek says "This season in Mistral we're tightening up the traditional billowing budi to give it a more streamlined silhouette, and shortening it the better to show off our breeze-catching galligaskin trousers. So comfy!"

name: Buoyant Gentility Ensemble
description: "I've woven some of Lord Vivec's austere elegance into this outfit, my tribute to the Tribune" says Voldsea Arvel. "Soiree tonight in St. Delyn Plaza? In your new Buoyant Gentility garb, you'll be a Vvardenfell vision!"

name: Carnaval Celebrant
description: Honor Sanguine with enthusiasm and vigor by dancing the night away in this scarlet-adorned outfit.

name: Carnaval Feathered Dancing Dress
description: The vibrant hues and plush feathers of this outfit cause the wearer to practically take flight on the dance floor. They must be careful to remain grounded, or the festivities may sweep them off their feet entirely.

name: Cavalier of the Sworn Oath
description: A mix of metal and leather melded with the hide of a great snow bear, fashioned to pay tribute to Malacath, the Furious One.

name: Celestial Robes
description: Celestial guardians themselves could not take issue with these robes. The gemstones reference the Warrior and Thief, while the elegant draping of fabric pays homage to the Mage. Wear this ensemble and you'll be sure to wow courtiers and scholars alike.

name: Centurion Dress Armor
description: This costume replicates the dress armor of an Imperial Centurion of the Legions of Cyrodiil.

name: Centurion Field Armor
description: This costume replicates the field armor of an Imperial Centurion, the outfit worn on the battlefield.

name: Chef
description: A high-end chef's outfit that indicates the wearer is a provisioner supreme.

name: City Isle Tunic Dress
description: Designer Diocletia says "For a true Imperial, simple does not mean unsophisticated. Our City Isle Tunic Dress is inspired by the elegant lines of Second Empire attire, but updated with a contemporary bias cut."

name: Classic Ordinator Armor
description: The classic dark-gold armor worn by Ordinators of the Tribunal while keeping the peace and combating heresy in Mournhold and its surrounding regions.

name: Claw Seer of Sithis
description: "Change cannot be denied. Yet some wish to thwart it, finding comfort in stasis. In stagnation. These I seek out in the way of seers so that ku-vastei may deal with them. Once they clear the path, needed change occurs."—Claw Seer Deelith-Xul

name: Clockwork Tinker
description: "You'd be forgiven for mistaking my piles of cogs and springs for wayward scraps from one machine or another. But a trained eye sees them for what they are. Seedlings. Kernels of ideas waiting to be given form and purpose. Why not give it a go?"—Hyacinth

name: Colovian Uniform
description: A leather uniform worn by Colovian soldiers in occupied Arenthia.

name: Corseted Riding Outfit
description: Lady Eloisse, the designer, says "A Breton woman likes to add a touch of feminine flair to her otherwise practical clothing. She wants her attire to say she's a lady, no matter what she's doing."

name: Courier Uniform
description: Supple robes worn by Gold Coast Mercenary couriers.

name: Court of Bedlam
description: The Court of Bedlam may be a cult of angry and vengeful Daedra worshipers, but there's no denying they have a certain sinister sense of style. Adopt their distinctive look with this ominous costume.

name: Courtly Traveling Attire
description: Fashionable nobles would never sully their fine court clothes with the dirt of travel. They wear simple—yet still elegant—robes while riding between castles, and display their wealth in the silver fastenings holding the robes together.

name: Covenant Scout
description: Brown and black leather armor topped with a black leather cowl, like that worn by Breton Skirmisher Scouts.

name: Crafty Lerisa's Thief Outfit
description: Lightweight thieving outfit of dark-gray padded cloth and leather, with a feature-concealing half-balaclava.

name: Crown Dishdasha
description: Casual garments worn by members of the Crown Fellowship in Bergama.

name: Crystal Tower Sapiarchs' Gown
description: Inspired by the elegant formal gowns of the Sapiarchs of the Crystal Tower, designer Estinwe Silkdancer says "Now you, too, can have the mysteries of the Dawn Era at your fingertips—or at least look like you do!"

name: Cumberland Anniversary Attire
description: High King Emeric ordered this dashing attire for the anniversary of his coronation. The first of the Cumberland Dynasty to ascend to the throne, Emeric seeks to rule the Daggerfall Covenant wisely. With this garb, he also leads with panache.

name: Cyrod Gentry's Town Gown
description: "Tailored from sheerest linen, this aristocratic gown is as daring as it is discreet" says the renowned Diocletia of Skingrad. "Whether you're dining or dancing, shopping or just showing off, this is for you."

name: Cyrod Patrician Formal Gown
description: You'll look every inch the aristocrat in this formal wrap gown from Diocletia of Skingrad, paired with a splendid gorget of hammered gold dripping with Imperial diamonds. Get haughty!

name: Daggerfall Paladin
description: "As I keep saying, this armor isn't just for show. I paid for it with blood, honor, and loyalty during Ranser's War. And I wasn't alone—we lost many to traitorous fools. Now, what's your story, paladin?"—Paladin Celice Foucher

name: Dar-m'Athra Stealth Outfit
description: The dar-m'Athra are the stealthiest of the dro-m'Athra, and therefore rarely seen, except for a final glimpse as one kills you.

name: Dark Eliminator's Garb
description: "The Black Hand may, at their discretion, choose Dark Brotherhood members to assist in the purification of a sanctuary. These eliminators don distinctive garb and hunt down any who seek to flee the purification."—Excerpt from The Will of Sithis

name: Dark Passions Regalia
description: There is no better bait for a trap than temptation and no better lure than seduction. This suggestive ensemble will enhance your allure and disarm your prey until it is far, far too late.

name: Dark Seducer
description: This guise enables its wearer to assume the grim aspect of a Dark Seducer.

name: Dark Shaman
description: Far from town, temple, and market, those of ill intent meet in secret conclave to importune the forces of darkness for power and mastery. Behold here the dire raiment they don for this fell purpose.

name: Day of Release Roisterer
description: Celebrate Aiden Direnni's victory against the Alessian Army on the Day of Release. Glenumbra's most ebullient celebrants don this festive garb, and you can too! Spend a memorable day dancing, drinking, and toasting alongside them!

name: Deepwoods Pod-Singer Tunic
description: Non-Wood Elves might think it strange that Bosmeri Pod-Singers, who magically persuade Valenwood trees to grow into houses, wear clothes entirely made of animal leather and quills, but such is the mandate of the Green Pact.

name: Desert Garden Gala Overdress
description: "We Redguards are a hardy people" says designer Sar'aq of Sentinel "and like to stage our ceremonies outside—regardless of the weather. With this elegant overdress, a lady can celebrate the most festive of occasions—even in a sandstorm!"

name: Do-m'Athra Battle Armor
description: When warrior-dos are "bent" into dro-m'Athra, they become that fearsome variety the Khajiit call a do-m'Athra.

name: Doeskin-and-Chamois Woods Wear
description: "Covering yourself from head to toe makes perfect sense" says Moneriel of Elden Root "if you're a Breton! Ha!" You'll feel free and easy in any social situation in this light doeskin-and-chamois affair accented with turquoise and sea-beads.

name: Dominion Scout
description: Forest wear of the Aldmeri Dominion Forward Scouts, featuring High Elf avian motifs and a gilt balaclava.

name: Dragon Priest
description: Once, it is said, a cult of Dragon-worshipers ruled all of northern Tamriel. Their leaders were Dragon Priests, cruel clerics of great power who hid their faces under magical masks. Now you can wear the semblance of these legendary magi.

name: Dragon Warrior
description: Tales have come down to us from the legendary time of the Dragons, when it was said that some Nords were born with Dragon blood in their veins. Now you can wear the look of these legendary Dragon Warriors.

name: Dremora Deceiver Duster
description: In the ceaseless wars of Oblivion, there will always be scoundrels. After rooking marks of goods and foes of lives, this rugged, Dremora-style coat lets you slink away, sounding no louder than a whisper.

name: Drifting Sand Tunic and Sash
description: Sar'aq of Sentinel presents a comfortable, casual linen outfit that's suitable for both town and country. This billowing tunic and breeches ensemble will "flow wherever you go" as the designer puts it. Includes a broad and colorful sash!

name: Dungeon Explorer
description: Ready to adventure in places filled with hideous monsters, traps, and other surprises? Dress appropriately with the Dungeon Explorer costume! Equipping this costume will hide your shield when stowed.

name: Dunmer Cultural Garb
description: This stylish Dark Elf clothing displays a variety of unique colors.

name: Dwemerdelve Scavenger
description: Early merchant-scavengers of the Zainab Tribe collected Dwarven pieces they found in nearby ruins. Instead of adding them to their wares, though, they worked the pieces into exploration garb, hoping for better protection against Dwarven constructs.

name: East Skyrim Scout Outfit
description: This costume replicates the armor worn by the scouts of Eastern Skyrim, in the holds of the Rift, Eastmarch, and Winterhold.

name: Egg-Sister Bias-Cut Casual Wear
description: "Simple yet stylish, most advantageous for displaying one's tattoos and markings" says Jaxa-Kel, who found these designs by her relative, the elusive Hermit, at a clothiers' bench near some Barsaebic ruins in Shadowfen.

name: Elder Council Tunic and Sash
description: Inspired by the majestic and imposing attire of the Imperial Elder Council, this tunic and sash ensemble by Diocletia of Skingrad is suitable for high-profile occasions from the formal to the celebratory. Show off the proud heritage of the Empire!

name: Elven Hero Armor
description: This costume pays tribute to a legendary High Elven hero of the Aldmeri Dominion. Now you can honor this nameless Altmer by adopting her epic appearance.

name: Emperor's Regalia
description: All hail his/her Imperial Majesty, Emperor of Cyrodiil!

name: Eternity Tunic with Pants
description: In Orsinium these days, even the busiest tusker likes some flair in his clothing—and nothing says "modern Orc" like a bias-cut-placket tunic from Borzighu at Coldsnap Clothiers. "This outfit" he says "is one for the ages!"

name: Eveli's Adventuring Leathers
description: Gear up in Wood Elf style! Fashioned after the garb of Eveli Sharp-Arrow, this outfit's supple leather provides protection while still allowing for astounding trick shots and dizzying acrobatics!

name: Evening Dress
description: A casual dress for evening wear, suitable for the marketplace, crafting center, or tavern.

name: Ever Auridon Sateen Gown
description: "The clean traditional lines of this gown evoke the wakes of Torinaan's ships when they first discovered Auridon" says designer Estinwe Silkdancer. "Its classic majesty is a reminder that even the lowest-ranked Altmer is still a High Elf."

name: Ever Damp Reed-Fiber Kilt
description: Now you can avoid the vexation of dry-scale thigh-chafing with the new "Ever Damp" kilt-of-reeds, available from Jaxa the Hermit in every Argonian's favorite color: mud-brown! (Though you may dye them else-wise, should such be your whim, egg-sibling.)

name: Evoker on Errantry
description: "Don't get me wrong, robes are wonderful. But in the field I need something more form-fitting and practical. Plus these boots are magnificent. And the detail on the buckle! Delightful!"—Mage Adelle Montagne

name: Falkreath Thane
description: This classic Nord kilted jerkin outfit projects the confidence and authority of a Falkreath fighting clan chief—complete with the traditional horned helmet!

name: Fargrave Relic Collector
description: The life of a relic collector takes a strange turn when they focus on Fargrave. This gear showcases some of the more unusual finds they've uncovered. It also provides full protection just in case any local traders take issue with a bargain.

name: Fashion Witch Ensemble
description: "Hold onto your crystals, fellow witches! Why eschew fashion for practicality, when we can have both? Wear my original design, and you can conjure a potent potion and the affections of everyone around the cauldron. Happy witching!" —Weavewitch Faetia

name: Fate Scryer
description: "Hermaeus Mora's Remnants act as his sword and shield, protecting important secrets. Those dressed as we are may be few these days, but that may change soon. Or it may change never."—Tyss of the Remnants

name: Fatemirror Evening Wear
description: "The tinkle of sparkling crystals on this flattering dress I 'acquired' from a Shardborn mage pleases me. The neckline's cut also frames my glorious body art. I almost want to wear this all day. Maybe tomorrow I will."—Falena Rothalor, Undaunted

name: Fighters Guild Combat Armor
description: This costume replicates the look of Fighters Guild combat armor.

name: Fighters Guild Cool-Weather Gear
description: This costume replicates the look of the Fighters Guild cool-weather uniform.

name: Fighters Guild Warm-Weather Gear
description: This costume replicates the look of the Fighters Guild warm-weather uniform.

name: Fire Drakes Outfit
description: Wear the Outfit of the Fire Drakes, those deadly draconic firebrands of the no-holds-barred Battlegrounds!

name: Fisherfolk Work Wear
description: You might think the profession of Fisher is one that's simple, slow, or easy. You'd change your mind fast the first time you hauled in a net full of slaughterfish!

name: Forebear Dishdasha
description: Finely trimmed garb worn by members of the Forebear Fellowship in Bergama.

name: Forge-Wife's Impervious Frock
description: "Look sharp while you hammer out that dagger!" says Orc-tailor Borzighu. "Our Forge-Wife's Frock, spun from non-flammable gray scathecraw fibers, protects you from cinders, soot, hot embers, and even spatters of molten metal. Hot!"

name: Fort Amol Guard Armor
description: Regulation armor worn by the guards of Fort Amol.

name: Frostbane Dragon Priest
description: "Dragon priests donned formidable masks and adorned their gear with hide knots to protect them from weather and enemies alike. These Atmorans may have found the bitter cold of Skyrim invigorating, but they still wore proper layers."—Zoellene Ruqueville

name: Frostedge Bandit Armor
description: Hardy armor worn by the Frostedge bandits on Bleakrock Isle.

name: Garb of Grinning Horrors
description: Face the world with a maniacal grin while wearing this fiendish garment. Whether you're capering during Jester's Festival or cavorting amid Daedric foes, none will forget the menacing terror of your presence.

name: Gem Prospector
description: If you love chipping away at rock until you reveal raw gemstone, garb yourself appropriately. Crafted from sturdy materials, this costume features pockets, pouches, and gear that allow you to better find and remove natural riches.

name: Glenmoril Witch Robes
description: The witches of the Glenmoril Wyrd covens worship natural laws and nature, mostly in its darker aspects—though some also celebrate life and fertility, particularly in the spring of the year. These robes are specially woven for that spring festival.

name: Golden Saint
description: The wearer of this guise looks exactly like one of Sheogorath's dreaded Golden Saints.

name: Graht-Climber's Active Wear
description: Stitchmaster Moneriel says "We all have days when we have to climb the graht-oak to clean the house-pod gutters. Does that mean you have to dress like a frump? Of course not! Look trim and stylish in my latest halter-and-skirt outfit from Elden Root!"

name: Graverobber
description: Decaying corpses? Rusty traps? You're bound to find worse in the tombs around here. Best make sure you have gear that can keep your shovel and other tools safe while you beat a hasty retreat from draugr, ghosts, and other nasty threats."—Paurges Aline

name: Grazelands Gentlemer Farmer
description: "Just because you're reclaiming the wastelands from the barbaric Ashlanders doesn't mean you have to dress like a savage" says designer Voldsea Arvel. "You're a proud House Dunmer, so why not look like one?"

name: Grim Harvester
description: Those doing darker deeds, such as practicing the art of Necromancy, might wish to have their attire reflect their interests. Dealing with the control and animation of the spirits and bodies of the deceased can take its toll on an average garment.

name: Grisly Mummy Wrap
description: Only you know what lies beneath your enshrouding bandages. Whether hero or horror, your presence imparts an unforgettable chilling dread.

name: Hakoshae Festival Attire
description: "I found an illustration for this garb in a founder's journal and made it for our second Proving Festival. I'm pleased with the result!"—Magnate Feina-Darak

name: Hand of Almalexia Uniform
description: The elite Ordinators who guard Mother Morrowind are the Hands of Almalexia, who wear distinctive armor of white and blue.

name: Harboursworn Occultist
description: "After the last time someone tried to hug me at a Dark Anchor, I designed this attire. It's particularly effective at staving off such shows of excessive and nonconsensual exuberance."—Pelynwe the Untouchable

name: High Rock Pioneer Outfit
description: "Even a rugged pioneer of the borderlands can show some distinctive Breton style" says Lady Eloisse of House Manteau. "Our traditional linen shirt is suitable for any occasion!"

name: High-Collared Coin Ball Gown
description: Bretons like to display their wealth through their apparel, as shown by the rich fabric and glistening ornamentation of this outfit designed by Lady Eloisse of House Manteau.

name: Holiday in Balmora Outfit
description: "With the growth of Balmora, sport hunting in Morrowind has a new capital" says designer Arvel. "Whether you're pursuing nix-oxen or hunting hive golems, dress for the chase in these luscious leathers!"

name: Hollow Moon Garb
description: Pragmatic garb worn by Hollow Moon thieves of Grahtwood.

name: Imperial Chancellor
description: When a member of the Elder Council must go to war, he or she dons the traditional armor of the Imperial Chancellor.

name: Imperial City Temple Tunic
description: "In this shimmering satin confection, you'll look your best while pouring out a libation to the Divines" says Diocletia of Skingrad "or just toasting your friends at the corner tavern. Class always tells!"

name: Imperial Guard Centurion Uniform
description: This splendid costume replicates the armor worn by a Centurion of the Imperial Guard, the Emperor's personal bodyguards.

name: Innkeeper
description: "If an innkeeper dresses like a soiled bar rag, imagine the state of the linens. You want to run a respectable establishment? Dress the part!"—Medresi Grulathil, Tailor

name: Jakarn's Ensemble
description: Jakarn is rugged, practical, and dashing. Dressing like him ensures that you never look like you're trying too hard. His well-tailored clothes always fetch the eyes of tavern beauties and never chafe when riding a stallion into the sunset.

name: Jaqspur
description: The outfit of the Jaqspurs, the legendary Bosmeri archers of Valenwood, made entirely of leather accented with bone.

name: Jarl Finery
description: When you're done wading into battle on behalf of your hold, celebrate your glorious victories in the jarl's mead hall! This rugged but stylish raiment is typically reserved for northern nobility—just more proof of your heroic stature!

name: Jarl's Deluxe Moot Regalia
description: "Someday East and West Skyrim will be reunited and the Jarls will gather in a Moot to select a new High King" says Jork of Windhelm. "But that day may be a long time coming, so you might as well wear this noble outfit now!"

name: Jarl's Justice Formal Frock
description: "We Nords tend to be an informal people at most times, but when a Jarl sits to decide a legal case, it's important that our system of law be honored with the proper attire!" —Jork, the Tailor-Thane of Windhelm

name: Jester's Daedroth Suit
description: "Feeling puny? Small? Afraid? Do what I do! Wear your Daedroth apparel and snarl at everyone you meet. No, you can't have my garb! But I can make you some for a price."—Jester-Apprentice Xat-Xot

name: Jo-m'Athra Spellcaster Suit
description: Possibly the most feared of the dro-m'Athra are their spellcasters, the jo-m'Athra, Khajiiti wizards who became "bent" into Lost Cats.

name: Kamali Akaviri Assassin Outfit
description: This costume represents the armor worn by the assassins who accompanied the Kamali Akaviri invasion.

name: Karthwatch Jarl Finery
description: Established to create an impregnable border between Skyrim and the Reach, Karthald Hold maintains a war footing year-round, and its jarl stands at the ready to leap to the defense of Skyrim in this regal mix of satin and steel.

name: Keeper's Garb
description: Practical garb worn by the Keepers of the Shell, tenders of Argonian eggs in Shadowfen.

name: King Emeric's Diamond Regalia
description: Originally designed for High King Emeric himself, this outfit features high-quality silks and fabrics, granting the wearer a chance to pass like a king through the streets of Wayrest.

name: Kinlord's Alinor Attire
description: Even if you're not a kinlord, every High Elf is a noble at heart, and wants something in his wardrobe suitable for attendance at Alinor's Royal Palace. This majestic Elven ensemble is just the thing!

name: Knight of the Flame
description: Plate and chainmail armor with red accents, topped by an armet helm with open visor, as worn by the Breton Knights of the Flame.

name: Liespinner's Vestments
description: Acolytes of Mephala spread falsehoods and disinformation to keep their secrets hidden. When they meet, they don these vestments to conceal their identities. Beware her whispers beneath the veil.

name: Lion Guard Elite
description: Plate and scale mail armor of whitened steel with golden accents, with a heavy close-helm, as seen on the Lion Guard Elite.

name: Lion Guard Knight
description: Full plate armor with blue-black accents, topped by an armet helm with open visor, as worn by the Lion Guard of the Covenant.

name: Lizardly Four-Fabric Skirt Set
description: "The Hermit presents the latest in silky swamp chic" says Jaxa-Kel "combining flax, feathers, alit-scales, and spun dank-cotton in contrasting layers of chevrons and lightning. So lizardly!"

name: Logger
description: Everything you need to brave the wilds of the forest and bring back some hard-won lumber is supplied in this robust kit, so hoist your trusty axe and get to chopping wood!

name: Mages Guild Formal Robes
description: This costume replicates the Mages Guild formal robes.

name: Mages Guild Leggings Uniform
description: This costume is an example of the Mages Guild uniform with leggings.

name: Mages Guild Research Robes
description: This costume replicates the Mages Guild research robes.

name: Mages Guildmaster Garb
description: Don these robes to invoke the gravitas of Guildmaster Vanus Galerion. And without all that tedious studying!

name: Magnifica's Sundas Wear
description: "In Hammerfell, our Crown nobility prefer clothing simple and traditional in cut, but rich and varied in material" says designer Sar'aq of Sentinel. "This ensemble is appropriate for both receiving noble guests and visiting others."

name: Majestic "Dune Rider" Ensemble
description: Sar'aq has outdone himself with this elegant outfit inspired by the legend of Prince Ahzzad the Dune Rider! Anyone would look princely in this ensemble of midnight linen and leather, accented with shining silver. Exquisite!

name: Mannimarco
description: One can sneer at lesser mortals when wearing this exact replica of the regalia of the King of Worms.

name: Marshlord Formal Bugshell Robes
description: For the Saxhleel who dares to scintillate, the reclusive Jaxa the Hermit presents this season's must-have formal-wear, the multi-layered Marshlord robe set, sewn with the shiny shells of thousands of tiny swamp insects!

name: Mask of Cheerful Slaughter
description: This Sheogorath-approved jester outfit displays the three faces of madness.

name: Master Field Cartographer
description: Whether you're climbing the snowiest peaks in Skyrim or slogging through the soggiest lowlands, these insulated leathers will protect you and your mapmaking supplies from Tamriel's harshest environments.

name: Merchant Lord's Formal Regalia
description: The merchant lords of Abah's Landing wear their most expensive finery to weddings, funerals, executions, and other public events attended by their peers.

name: Mercymother's Attire
description: This exquisite garb was created in honor of Almalexia's gentle grace and leadership over the centuries since Red Mountain. A devotional surrogate often wears this attire during the days-long observation called the Fast of Forebearance.

name: Midnight Union Garb
description: Dark-hued garments worn by the Midnight Union, a smuggling operation out of Stormhaven.

name: Moon-Sugar Festival Suit
description: "When the Moon-Sugar cane is ripe for harvest, and Jone and Jode are both waning crescents, it's time for the sweetest festival of the year" says designer Samsu the Sleek. "This Festival Suit blends five different silks so you'll look shiny and sharp!"

name: Moonlit Cove Sojourner's Wraps
description: Many moons ago, this elegant wrap served as the perfect garb for relaxing after soaking in the blessed sugar waters of Moonlit Cove. Given both its comfort and allure, Khajiit broadened its use and now wear it while traveling in style. Fragrant!

name: Morthal Jarl Finery
description: Let skalds wear silks! The stalwart rulers of Morthal require sturdier materials. These rustic, oiled leathers are lined with the down of waterfowl, providing warmth and comfort befitting royalty even in the damp, cold wetlands of Hjaalmarch.

name: Moth Priest
description: "The priests of the Ancestor Moth are devoted to veneration of those who came before us, for the wisdom of the ancestors can sing the future into the present. As such, we alone have the privilege of interpreting the Elder Scrolls." —Sister Terran Arminus

name: Naryu's Assassin's Armor
description: Black and gray armor of leather and boiled leather that won't interfere with mobility, as seen on agents of the Morag Tong.

name: Naryu's Morag Tong Costume
description: Naryu Virian the Morag Tong assassin is nothing if not practical, and her functional, low-profile leather armor provides vital protection without compromising her agile acrobatics.

name: Necrom Evening Attire
description: Honor your Redoran ancestors and your sense of style by donning this opulent evening wear! Perfect for midnight funeral ceremonies as well as starlit observances tailored to suit your beloved recently deceased.

name: Necrom Prelate Robes
description: After learning all the ceremonies and practices of the Keepers of the Dead in Necrom, some of their number take on the role and robes of the prelate. These worthies spend most of their hours in the Necropolis, maintaining its sanctity and traditions.

name: Nedic Duraki Armor
description: This costume replicates the armor of the warriors who followed the ancient Nedic king Durac.

name: Nedic Keptu Armor
description: This costume replicates the simple but sturdy armor worn by the warriors of the ancient Keptu tribe of Nedes.

name: Nedic Perena Armor
description: This costume replicates the full-helmed armor worn by the warriors of the ancient Perena tribe of Nedes.

name: Nereid's Seafoam Raiment
description: "I wrapped my body in the kelp and coral of a sea-bound Nereid and frolicked in the tidepools as I did in childhood. All should enjoy the freedom of Nereid attire as I have."—Oceanographic Society Director, Vaerwyeana

name: New Life Winter Storm Robes
description: Eldertide druids ready themselves for the chill of winter during their New Life stargazing session with these snug and cozy robes. If you wish to join them in their study of the stars, be sure to prepare with your own set of these festive robes!

name: New Moon Dragon Cult Garb
description: Dragons have ascended! And now you can show off your affiliation with them. After all, they are the most powerful creatures in Tamriel and deserve the reverence you give freely.

name: New Moons Cross-Sash Robe
description: "Two dark moons mean bad luck" says designer Samsu the Sleek "but a whole series of new moons says the opposite: that one has survived adversity, and even prospered! That's the message of this handsome new robe, in breathable cotton and linen."

name: Nibenese Noble's Shawled Robe
description: This versatile ensemble designed by Diocletia of Skingrad doubles as both active wear and an elegant evening gown.

name: Night Mother's Evangelist
description: "Whisper the words in your heart and call for an unworthy person's death. Or, if you possess the right skills, fulfill upon the sacrament on behalf of the Night Mother. I am the latter—as my robes proclaim. Care to know more?"—Night Mother Evangelist

name: Noble Clan-Chief
description: The clans of Anequina in Northern Elsweyr are largely nomadic, but they nonetheless have hereditary aristocracies that express their wealth and power through the splendor of their clothing.

name: Noble Dress
description: This elegant satin dress is the last word in aristocratic sophistication. Suitable for all occasions where refined splendor is required.

name: Noble Suit
description: Show some class with this opulent yet restrained aristocrat's ensemble for the high-toned and the haughty.

name: Nord Hero Armor
description: This costume pays tribute to a legendary Nord hero of the Ebonheart Pact. Now you can honor this nameless warrior by adopting his savage appearance.

name: Nordic Bather's Towel
description: This bathing costume keeps you modest in all climates, whether the Abecean Sea or a hot spring in Skyrim.

name: Nordic Knot Doublet and Breeches
description: "Nordic Knot designs symbolize the heritage of the people of Skyrim" says designer Jork of Windhelm. "This upscale ensemble pays tribute to that tradition, and looks good even on those not lucky enough to be Nords."

name: Northwind Disguise
description: Imposing armor worn by Reachfolk warriors who have taken over Northwind Mine in the Rift.

name: Oblivion Explorer Garb
description: There are too many realms to live out your life in just one. With excitement humming in your veins and a pack stuffed with scrawled Daedric maps on your back, step through every portal in your path and let adventure sweep you away.

name: Off-the-Shoulder Evening Dress
description: Lady Eloisse of House Manteau offers this traditional Breton evening dress. As she puts it "Ostentation is vulgar, but true elegance never goes out of style!"

name: Old Orsinium Sentry
description: A mix of metal and leather melded with the hide of a great black bear, fashioned in the ancient style of the Orsimer.

name: Orc Wise Woman's Vestment
description: "As the Wise Woman of your clan, or the Hunt-Wife on ceremonial days, you must project both grace and authority" says designer Borzighu the Tidy. "Count on my gilt-broidered vestment to provide that, and more!"

name: Orcish Scout Armor
description: This costume replicates the armor worn by Orcish mountain scouts in Skyrim and northern High Rock.

name: Ordinator Night-Raid Armor
description: When rounding up criminal scum or raiding hives of heresy in the dark of night, the Temple's Ordinators don this night-dark armor.

name: Pact Mother Elite Ensemble
description: "Today I don new robes, a symbol of my vow, my office. Blessed by Almalexia, may the Mother of Morrowind guide my hand. May she lend strength to me in times of conflict. For the Pact!"—Excerpt from Urona Hlaalu's Journal

name: Passion Dancer's Attire
description: Sing, dance, and engage in other artistic pursuits while wearing this Dibella-inspired ensemble. Let the influence of the Goddess of Beauty, Love, and Affection enchant your senses while you spark creativity in others by your very presence.

name: Pellitine Anniversary Drape
description: "It is rather elegant, no? This one was practically purring when she perfected the design. It is only by her great generosity that she shares it with the public now."—Pazatha the Impeccable

name: Pellitine Tea-Fete Gown
description: Originally worn during the ancient Pa'alatiin clan's tradition of taking tea, this classic garment's popularity has resurged in recent months, making it the perfect dress for any Khajiiti gathering.

name: Peryite Skeevemaster
description: When collaborating with rats, heavy and concealing clothes are a must. This outfit, which includes full facial coverage, grants you an inscrutable yet formidable appearance.

name: Phaer Mercenary Armor
description: Well-worn armor used by mercenaries stationed in Phaer.

name: Pirate First Mate's Outfit
description: The crew before the mast will heave to and follow your orders when you're geared up as the ship's First Mate. Display your rank and your nautical tattoos at one and the same time with this sea raider's outfit!

name: Pirate Sash and Bandolier Garb
description: Wear this full pirate rig along with a fierce scowl, and no one will dare lay a hand on your booty. Suitable whether you're swaggering into a dockside tavern, sharpening your cutlass at the gangplank, or just hanging around the port looking dangerous.

name: Pirate Swab Outfit
description: Ready for piratical action? You will be in this basic sea rover attire, which gives you plenty of opportunity to show off your buccaneer body art. Avast, and prepare to repel boarders!

name: Pit Daemon Outfit
description: Wear the Outfit of the Pit Daemons, those infernal dirty fighters of the no-holds-barred Battlegrounds!

name: Priest of the Green
description: In Valenwood they're called Spinners; in High Rock, Vicars of Jephre. Wherever they go, the traveling priests of Y'ffre the Storyteller are respected as holy defenders of nature and the natural world.

name: Priestess of Mara
description: Show your devotion to the Goddess of Love and Nurture with these Priestess of Mara vestments. Across Tamriel, even cultures that don't regard Mara as a major Divine recognize her as the patroness of marriage, invoked at every mortal wedding.

name: Prince Irnskar's Gala Regalia
description: Prince Irnskar's outfit radiates the loyalty and courage befitting the Nords. Though perhaps not what one might traditionally wear to a gala, rumor has it the prince himself hunted the beasts to make his cowl.

name: Queen Ayrenn's Diamond Gown
description: Don this gown, and feel the sense of grace that washes over you. Skillfully tailored with the finest silks money can buy, and adorned with diamonds and a woven belt, this stunning gown could truly only have been made for an Elf queen.

name: Queen's-Eye Spymaster
description: You wish to maintain a low profile and yet exude competence, sexy coolness, and undeniable predatory intimidation all at once, yes? Then this one advises investing in a Queen's-Eye Spymaster costume and flipping a coin in the tavern's dark corner.

name: Quendelunn Veiled Heritance Garb
description: A protective outfit worn by Veiled Heritance agents in Quendeluun.

name: Ragebound Harness
description: "Some say rage dances within like fire, consuming all before it. For some in the Karth River valley, this fire is a source of strength. A remorseless flame that I see burns within you. Now, let's get you geared up."—Mage Baxold, Ragebound Scholar

name: Ranger's Crocskin Overkilt
description: "Durable, flexible, mudproof, and stylish" says the latest missive from designer Jaxa the Hermit delivered by his mute daughter. "What more could a Saxhleel want from a Crocskin Overkilt? Glowing torchbug buttons? Actually, that's not a bad idea."

name: Rawhide-Laced Riften Jerkin
description: Jork the Tailor-Thane says "Summer may be short in Riften, but when it finally comes the Nords greet it with open arms. And how better than in this patterned sleeveless jerkin, accented with rawhide laces?"

name: Red Rook Armor
description: Armor worn by the Red Rook brigands as they rampaged across Glenumbra.

name: Reeve's Formal Apparel
description: No one has more respect for their Ceremoniarchy and its functionaries than the High Elves: dignity and a high self-regard are the watchwords of an Altmeri Reeve. This outfit represents the Summerset administrator in all his glory!

name: Regalia of the Orsimer King
description: With a nod to tradition but clearly fashioned with the new sensibilities of a reinvigorated Orsinium in mind, the crown and armor of the Orsimer King makes a definite statement about strength, unity, and honor.

name: Regalia of the Scarlet Judge
description: This regalia has been passed down through generations of vigilante heroes, each cloaked in mystery and intrigue. With it comes the heavy burden of upholding justice in Vvardenfell, no matter the cost.

name: Renegade Dragon Priest
description: Sure, Dragon Priests were evil overlords who ruled mortals in the name of tyrannical Dovah, but what a fashion sense they had! Now you can adopt the appearance of the Renegade Dragon Priest from Scalecaller.

name: Rimmen Fountain-Side Loungewear
description: Famed for their clear water, the fountains of Rimmen provide a place for locals to gather and catch up on the news of the day. If you seek a moment of refreshment, wear this elegant yet comfortable garb as you dangle your feet in the cool waters.

name: Robes of Truth and Law
description: "Know the truth and observe the law. Seek wisdom from the wise. And start right here with me."—Pilou Mouriou

name: Royal Courier
description: A courier's life is fraught with danger. Bandits and political agents lie in wait to intercept royal missives. A courier's clothes often have hidden pockets where they can slip important documents and keep them from the wrong hands.

name: Royal Court Jester
description: This jovial jester garb, including mask and bell-cap, could even make a zombie smile.

name: Rumare Waterfront Casual Wear
description: Though inspired by the raffish attire of roustabouts on the Imperial Waterfront, this casual outfit is made of the finest materials, and according to designer Diocletia, it's a superior choice for daytime wear in any of the Imperial City's six districts.

name: Sadrith Mora Formal Attire
description: "The use of red star shells marks this clothing as valuable—and extremely rare. So, if you're ever gifted with this outfit by a Telvanni, prize it highly and wear it well. And come back to Sadrith Mora if you need repairs."—Ralys Givyn, Tailor

name: Sailor-at-Arms
description: High Isle seafarers often take posts on escort ships, hoping to hone their martial skills and slake their thirst for combat on the open seas. If that describes you, this Breton-designed garb should serve you well!

name: Sand-Kissed Salwar Ensemble
description: Designer Sar'aq says "It's hot in the Alik'r Desert; in our environment, women prefer light clothing that lets cooling breezes reach the skin. But comfort and refinement are in no way incompatible!"

name: Satakalaaam Imperial Armor
description: Well-fitted armor from Imperial troops deployed to Satakalaaam.

name: Sea Drake Garb
description: Loose-fitting garb worn by the band of pirates known as the Sea Drakes, who plagued the waters around Stros M'kai.

name: Sea Viper Armor
description: Sea Viper crews wearing this armor formed an alliance with the Veiled Heritance in Greenshade.

name: Sentinel Vest and Salvar
description: "To those who do not live in the desert heat, it seems strange that we wear long sleeves and trousers" says Sar'aq of Sentinel "but really, nothing is more practical than a long, billowing pair of salvar breeches."

name: Servant's Outfit
description: The symbol of the Iron Wheel is worked subtly into the fabric of this simple servant's outfit.

name: Servant's Robes
description: Robes worn by the servants of Headman Bhosek on Stros M'Kai.

name: Seventh Legion Armor
description: Battle-tested armor worn by Imperial legionaries assigned to Hallin's Stand.

name: Seyda Neen Jodhpur Ensemble
description: "Don't think, just because they're involved in trade, that the folk of House Hlaalu don't know how to dress" says Davon's Watch couturier Voldsea Arvel. "This grand new outfit I designed for them combines practicality with genuine House Dunmer class."

name: Sheogorath Costume
description: "Sheogorath, whose sphere is Madness, and whose motives are unknowable." If you know the Daedric Prince called the Madgod, Sovereign of the Shivering Isles, Fourth Corner of the House of Troubles, then you already know this is the costume for you.

name: Shimmerene Soiree Gown
description: Swirls of flowing dresses, wafts of floral scents, dazzling lights, stirring music, and more set the stage for the Shimmerene Soiree! Toast to the continued success and prominence of this High Elf city-state in perfect praxis with an equally perfect gown.

name: Shrike's Nocturnal Frock
description: Do you like to keep to the shadows, yet long for a striking look of your own? Any admirer of the Prince of Night and Darkness will appreciate this eye-catching costume.

name: Shrouded Armor
description: This distinctive armor of the Dark Brotherhood marks those assassins who have been welcomed into its secretive order.

name: Siegemaster's Uniform
description: An experienced siegemaster might wish to observe any unusual defenses by surveying them firsthand. This gear provides protection while doing so.

name: Singing Skald
description: Set yourself apart from common tavern strummers and strut into your shows like a brightly plumed cockerel, fully prepared to captivate the senses with a brilliant display of song and dance. In this flashy regalia, all eyes and ears will be on you alone!

name: Sisei Flowering Dress
description: Early in the year, Argonians don colorful garments and invite Blackwood visitors do the same. Will you join them in their celebration of this season of growth, romance, and renewal?

name: Sixth House Robe
description: We do not acknowledge these garments, and we shall not speak of them, nor of the House we do not name.

name: Skald's Damask Jerkin
description: This damask twill jerkin is a favorite this season for skalds across Skyrim, and you'll see them strumming in it from Riften to Solitude. "Pair it with a warm tunic underneath for maximum versatility" says designer Jork of Windhelm.

name: Soiree in Camlorn Evening Suit
description: Lady Eloisse says "The highborn Breton prefers clothing that is elegant but austere, harkening back to the High Rock tradition of knightly orders, militant but chivalrous. Bright metallic points highlight the buckles and trim."

name: Solitude Stevedore's Jerkin
description: "The Nord stevedores who work the docks below the great stone arch of Solitude have a style all their own" says Jork the Tailor-Thane of Windhelm. "They take what they like from travelers of Tamriel and make it their own. Now you can, too!"

name: Song of the Night Ensemble
description: A Redguard lady's formal wear, like this ensemble by Sar'aq of Sentinel, is made of light fabric designed to be both beautiful and impressive, a constant reminder of the wearer's heritage and grace. As Sar'aq says "Glamor is for all of us!"

name: Soul-Shriven Armor Outfit
description: When the Soul-Shriven arrive in Coldharbour, some are garbed in cast-off armor taken from the dead.

name: Soul-Shriven Leather Outfit
description: When the Soul-Shriven arrive in Coldharbour, some are garbed in cast-off leathers taken from the dead.

name: Soul-Shriven Ragged Clothing
description: When the Soul-Shriven arrive in Coldharbour, they are garbed in cast-off rags taken from the dead.

name: Spirit of Memories
description: While mortal bodies fade, memories live on.

name: Star-Made Wolfshead
description: Even if your background isn't Imperial, if you admire history's greatest warriors, you'll want to honor Pelinal Whitestrake with this costume from Whitestrake's Mayhem, the celebration that commemorates his deeds.

name: Steel Shrike Uniform
description: This loose uniform worn by the Steel Shrikes of Malabal Tor.

name: Stillrise Ritecaller
description: "The few Kothringi that survived the tumultuous events at Stillrise Village now serve the Ideal Masters. So if you see this garb, flee."—Orranvir

name: Storm Lord Outfit
description: Wear the Outfit of the Storm Lords, those triumphant tempest terrors of the no-holds-barred Battlegrounds!

name: Stormfist Uniform
description: The standard uniform worn by Stormfist warriors, who pledge loyalty to the Nord Fildgor Orcthane.

name: Strid River Fisherfolk
description: "Don't mess with the fisherfolk of Strid River. They cut down pirates without remorse if bothered by them. That rugged garb they wear hides more than hooks, too. And you'll never see them coming if they don't want to be spotted."—Clotylda Emard

name: Subterrane Excavator
description: Spelunk in luxury! This mining gear is practically a home away from home when you're excavating precious underground resources—if you like living in your clothes!

name: Summit Lord's Silken Robes
description: For the stylish town Orc, Borzighu the Tidy Tailor of Orsinium has decided the watchwords this season are "restrained elegance." As he puts it "Strut your Orcish heritage with style!"

name: Tavern Maid
description: An outfit both pretty and practical for working the common room of the local tavern.

name: Telvanni Master Wizard
description: Lesser mages are often surprised to find that the usual apparel of a Telvanni Master Wizard is more stately than ostentatious. The truth is, Wizard Lords such as Divayth Fyr have no need of gaudy display. Their power lies elsewhere.

name: Telvanni Wizard-Lord Robe
description: The Wizard-Lords of Great House Telvanni measure themselves by magical power rather than by ostentation or display, so the design of their robes is relatively simple and restrained. Don't be fooled: these are the garments of powerful sorcerers.

name: Thieves Guild Leathers
description: The Thieves Guild of Abah's Landing distributes a set of protective garb to its members. The many buckles are carefully secured to prevent jangling, and scuffed to avoid reflection in the desert sun.

name: Thrafey Debutante Gown
description: "Still tasting victory after overcoming our challenges, new blood? Eager to dance among those you can now call equals? Garb yourself in this fine accession gown. It hides blood well."—Archblood Delyna

name: Timbercrow Wanderer
description: Known for striking quickly and quietly from stealth, Timbercrow wanderers serve as scouts and assassins for their clan. They prefer to keep their garb simple and light to remain unfettered by the chains of civilization.

name: Toxin Doctor
description: When you specialize in venoms and poison-making, you invest in special protective garb to keep from being poisoned by your own experiments—or else! And if your clients are just a little intimidated by your creepy attire, all the better.

name: Traveling Merchant
description: Merchants need to look presentable, and those who travel require protection from the elements. With this outfit, you can travel through Tamriel and beyond knowing that you have met both requirements!

name: Treasure Hunter
description: The serious treasure hunter knows it's really all about the gear. Whether you're exploring subterranean catacombs, ancient ruins, or a shattered shipwreck, when you run into an obstacle, you want to have the right tool at hand.

name: Tree-Minder
description: This patterned robe of leathers and feathers resembles those worn by those Argonians who commune with the Hist.

name: Treethane Ceremonial Dress
description: "Some occasions call for formal wear" says Stitchmaster Moneriel of Elden Root. "You may have to attend an important event, but you can still turn heads from trunk to treetop in my thousand-beaded ceremonial dress!"

name: Treethane's Mosaic Jerkin
description: The thousands of small shiny particles that decorate the Treethane's Mosaic Jerkin may appear at first glance to be of turquoise or other precious stones, but they are actually the iridescent carapaces of deep forest beetles.

name: Trinimac's Penitent Knight
description: A mix of metal and leather melded with the hide of a great brown bear, fashioned to honor Trinimac, the warrior god.

name: Tsaesci Akaviri Assassin Outfit
description: This costume represents the armor worn by the assassins who accompanied the Tsaesci Akaviri invasion.

name: Unknown Akaviri Assassin Outfit
description: This costume represents an Akaviri assassin's outfit of mysterious and unknown origin.

name: Upriver Striped Sash-Kilt
description: Be the best-dressed lizard in the xanmeer in this striped reed-fiber kilt with over-and-under shoulder sashes! Alternating panels of mud-brown and sandbar will say "Do you wallow? So do I!" to every Argonian you meet.

name: Valenwood Spinner
description: The Priests of Y'ffre in Valenwood wear outfits like this one, of leather, wool, bone, and antlers.

name: Vampire Noble
description: Rule over the night with deadly elegance in this sleek ensemble of figure-hugging apparel. The long coat clings as close as your own shadow, and every layer flows as freely as arterial spray from your prey. Just take care not to get blood on your ascot.

name: Vanguard Uniform
description: The official uniform worn by militant members of House Indoril.

name: Vengeance Day Dress
description: "Malacath's Vengeance Day is coming up soon, and you'll want to look your best for it!" says Borzighu of Orsinium. "Being Orcs, naturally we think about revenge every day, but Vengeance Day is still our favorite!"

name: Vested Interest Banquet Garb
description: You'll turn heads when you walk into the banquet hall in this ensemble of shining sateen, topped by a sharply tailored jacquard vest. "Who says casual can't be stylish?" says designer Sar'aq of Sentinel. "Not I!"

name: Vinedusk Vigilant
description: Among the Vinedusk Rangers lurks an even more dangerous force: assassin-scouts who move quietly through forests, dealing with any who pose a threat. Sometimes called "tree ghosts" they wear custom-made gear that works with their preferred combat styles.

name: Vulkhel Guard Marine Armor
description: Sturdy armor worn by the Vulkhel Guard Marines.

name: Wayrest Suede Doublet Ensemble
description: "There's no reason why everyday wear has to look frumpy! A man likes to look good when he's at his trade, and what looks better than a suede doublet over velveteen breeches?" says Lady Eloisse, Couturier of House Manteau.

name: Wedding Dress
description: This white confection is perfect for exchanging Rings of Mara—or delving dungeons with the Undaunted.

name: Wedding Suit
description: Formal yet undeniably dapper, this season's wedding ensemble will be gracing grooms at nuptials across Tamriel.

name: West Skyrim Scout Outfit
description: This costume replicates the armor worn by the scouts of Western Skyrim, in the holds of Haafingar, Hjaalmarch, and Karthald.

name: Whisperweft Gala Wear
description: "A Redguard lady's clothing can be elegant and ornamental, while still light enough to keep the wearer cool during the heat of the day" according to Sar'aq of Sentinel. "In this attire, you'll float through the room like a zephyr!"

name: Windcaller Garb
description: "Fleet of foot though wolves may be, the wind moves faster. It flows into places even insects cannot reach. Thus the Skaal witch who masterfully calls upon it gains the title of Windcaller, Blessed of the All-Maker."—Skaal Shaman Rik

name: Winterborn Hunter's Costume
description: This hunter's costume is clothing of the savage Winterborn, a clan of raiders from the Reach who have invaded Orsinium.

name: Winterborn Shaman's Costume
description: This shaman's costume is clothing of the savage Winterborn, a clan of raiders from the Reach who have invaded Orsinium.

name: Winterborn Warrior's Costume
description: This warrior's costume is clothing of the savage Winterborn, a clan of raiders from the Reach who have invaded Orsinium.

name: Wizard About Town
description: Whether you're running errands or consulting with a scholar, you should look wizardly and impressive while doing so. With these fashionable robes, you'll always look the part in the eyes of your colleagues.

name: Wood Elf Vanguard
description: Scouts wearing this Wood Elf outfit blend in with the forest, becoming almost invisible.

name: Xanmeer Doyen's Worship Robe
description: "Corset of kagouti-leather, full skirt of dank-cotton, beaded-shell vambraces and bird-skull pauldrons: everything a Xanmeer Doyen needs when welcoming worshipers into the Arboreal Reverie. The Hermit's outdone itself this time" says Jaxa-Kel.

name: Za'ji's Dragonguard Uniform
description: Looking for an outfit that displays your alliance with the Dragonguard but leaves room to wiggle? This costume is made for you! Approved (and worn) by Za'ji himself.

name: Za'ji's Sailing Apparel
description: "Say what you want about Za'ji, but he has style. His uniform gets more elaborate every time I see him. You can always tell when he's visited a city since there's usually more than one person wearing something inspired by him."—Puurri, Dragonguard

name: Crimson Berries of Bloom
description: One of four Legendary Crimson Berries.

name: Crimson Berries of Budding
description: One of four Legendary Crimson Berries.

name: Crimson Berries of Growth
description: One of four Legendary Crimson Berries.

name: Crimson Berries of Ripeness
description: One of four Legendary Crimson Berries.

name: Abyssal Tomeshell
description: "Love books, do you? What if they had tentacles and an eye? The gift of flight? Like them as much then? Yes? Oh, delightful! Here, befriend my beloved Philosophicus Aeternum—Philo for short. Expand its knowledge of Nirn."—The Archivist of the Lost

name: Albinoscript Fangtome
description: Fangtomes know not the importance or content of the books they inhabit. In the event that your rare first editions or vital academic texts have gained a tenant, simply befriend the tome via ample spine massages and a gentle ruffling of its pages.

name: Banekin
description: Though unwilling to fight, this Daedric minion will follow you loyally—for now.

name: Chaosball Cohort
description: "Look, some might call it cheating to play with a ball that follows you around, but it's not like you asked it to! It's perfectly safe. Fine for a regulation game. I think. Might get confusing with two balls on the field, though."—Carrier Clairene

name: Coldharbour Ocular Observer
description: Not all of Molag Bal's eyes are as vigilant as the Prince would like, it would seem. This one exhibits open curiosity about the world! The blinking certainly is creepy, though.

name: Companion Revelry Tomeshell
description: "Look, I know tomeshells need a place to live too, but that's one of the rarest volumes in the archive! Sure, it looks flashy now, but Mora knows what state the book will be in whenever this one decides to move on."—Cipher Caldaafin

name: Daedrat
description: This scurrying vermin from Oblivion would be lost in the vastness of Nirn without a loyal companion and guide. Even a Daedric rodent needs a friend.

name: Daedric Scamp
description: A foul-smelling Daedric minion, who will follow you loyally, though it won't fight for you.

name: Daemon Chicken
description: Is this just a dark fowl, mere poultry of sinister visage—or does it hail from realms beyond Nirn, mayhap from the Deadlands of Mehrunes Dagon or the Ashpit of Malacath? Dare you ask yourself the dread question: Which came first?

name: Deadlands Daedrat
description: The fiery red of this daedrat's fur indicates its origin: the Oblivion plane called the Deadlands. How it got here and why it's following you are both questions you'd best find the answers to, and soon.

name: Deadlands Scorpion
description: With pincers resembling Dagon's spires and a ferocious multibarbed stinger, these Deadlands natives see most creatures as prey. If you let a softshell baby ride your shoulders until it molts, however, you might just have a friend for life. Might.

name: Discord Dremnaken Runt
description: Dremnaken runts do not take kindly to acts of aggression. They include chin scratches and head pats in this category, more's the pity. In fact, it's best you avoid even the gentlest of eye contact.

name: Dremnaken Runt
description: This Dremnaken may be the runt of its pack, but it is still prepared to follow its leader into danger. It uses its armor to show other Dremnaken that it is every bit as fierce as they are, despite its diminutive size.

name: Fiendroth
description: Who doesn't want to be followed around by a hulking, armored Daedric bug with steel mandibles and a venomous stinger? It eats nothing but the cries and lamentations of your enemies, so it's an easy keeper. Friendly, too—in its way.

name: Ghostly Daedrat
description: "A daedrat I killed ended up following me home as a ghost. Now I use it to keep my relatives from staying with me."—Theldyn Faden, Explorer

name: Grisly Banekin Mummy
description: Complete with wrappings and a creepy mask, the Grisly Banekin Mummy will accompany you on all your journeys, causing boundless horror among all who see it!

name: Jackdaw Daedrat
description: The planes of Oblivion are infinite in their variation—and so are their vermin. The Jackdaw Daedrat is a bony Daedric rodent that likes to collect shiny things like your jewelry, and nip and nibble at things it shouldn't, but at least it's cute, right?

name: Larval Yaghra
description: The young of most creatures are cute, even adorable. That's not really true of the Larval Yaghra. If you have one of these following you, you're either telling the world you don't give a Daedric damn what they think, or you're a Sea Sload in disguise.

name: Lustrated Daedrat
description: "The forces of Nocturnal's attempted invasion of the Colored Rooms were inadvertently accompanied by some Evergloam Daedrats, which afterward were rounded up, Lustrated for purification, and then banished to Nirn." —Sapiarch Galaadil

name: Magma Scamp
description: Scamps are lesser Daedra used as servants and menials by a number of different Daedric Princes. The Magma Scamps are servants of Mehrunes Dagon, and can be summoned from his Oblivion plane of the Deadlands.

name: Mind-Shriven Scamp
description: "The Mind-Shriven Scamp is an unusual specimen. Generally you find them among other mind-shriven creatures, but some addled folk have started including them in their entourage. Peculiar, at best."—Warlock Aldaale

name: Molag Bal Illusion Imp
description: Why would a mage train an imp to cast a seeming of the God of Schemes? Who knows? But this tiny Dark Father, this diminutive Prince of Pain, this undersized Lord of Lies is almost cute. Almost.

name: Moss Spine Daedrat
description: "We found daedrats eating our ceremonial supplies in the cellar last Midyear. Now the damned things have gone green, and the Archdruid says they're a bridge from Galen to Oblivion? Draigh!"—Callice Marence, formerly of Daggerfall

name: Nightflame Larval Yaghra
description: Never again want for a nightlight with this enchanted, flaming larval yaghra at your side. Just beware that while it does keep the darkness at bay, prolonged exposure to its horrible legs and beady little eyes has been known to increase nightmares.

name: Scorion Pyreling
description: "Though I agree these pyrelings are fiery and intimidating, I can't believe they acted like ticks on Dragons, as one scholar who shall remain nameless stated in my presence. No, instead I think they are variants native to the Deadlands."—Vi Aspblade

name: Skein Scorpion
description: Knights of the Spider Cult, known as Deathweavers, often disdain the cultists' usual Daedric Spider companions, preferring Skein Scorpions to present a more warlike attitude.

name: Skein Shalk
description: The giant crimson beetles that scuttle through the gloom of Mephala's Spiral Skein are said to use their pointed probosces to drink the blood of whatever they catch. True or not, it's a fine gruesome story for cultists to tell about their Daedric pets.

name: Skein Spider
description: It should surprise no one familiar with Mephala, the Webspinner, that spiders are among the most common denizens of the Spiral Skein, the Daedric Prince's Oblivion realm. They're not exactly affectionate pets, but they are fiercely loyal.

name: Skein Wasp
description: When Mephala populated the Spiral Skein with "improved" versions of Tamrielic invertebrates, she outdid herself with the Skein Wasp, a giant menacing insect guaranteed to give any mortal the shivers!

name: Skeletal Pack Wolf
description: When the Two Moons are full, the undead wolf pack rises from the grave, point their canine craniums at the sky, and try to howl—but the only sound is a dismal rattling in their bony throats.

name: Skeletal Pony Guar
description: Shouldn't an animated skeleton always be a thing of fear and revulsion? This necromantic Pony Guar might change your mind about that!

name: Skeletal Senche-Leopard
description: Is Necromancy always wrong? Not even death can stop this loyal senche-leopard from stalking to adventure at your side!

name: Slate-Skinned Daedrat
description: "The cold blue glowing eyes and markings of the Slate-Skinned Daedrat stem from their diet: corpses touched by Molag Bal. Those brave enough to research or even thwart the Lord of Brutality often study these creatures for insight."—Phrastus of Elinhir

name: Stonefire Scamp
description: This gibbering, foul-smelling Daedric minion will follow you loyally, though it won't fight for you.

name: Undaunted Porter Scamp
description: "Ah, yes, the Undaunted. That they have decided to train Scamps to wear a pack is, shall we say, a prodigious undertaking. I look forward to seeing how much gear goes missing."—Warlock Aldaale

name: Wickerfright Banekin
description: "Witches refused to share the grisly secrets of the Wickerfright summoning ritual until now. Upon appearing, its wooden countenance twists into an eerie smile—a frightful expression, indeed!"—Warlock Aldaale

name: Blessed Rubedite Metal Enamel
description: A bottle of reddish-gold metal enamel for use on enchanted armor. A component required to morph a Soulfire Dragon Illusion into the Daggerfall Paladin costume.

name: Captured Dragonflame
description: A bottle containing a mysterious, ever-burning flame. A component required to morph a Soulfire Dragon Illusion into the Daggerfall Paladin costume.

name: Sanctified Metalworking Tools
description: Tools blessed by Akatosh and Zenithar both for the etching of armor. A component required to morph a Soulfire Dragon Illusion into the Daggerfall Paladin costume.

name: Black Iron Bit and Bridle
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into a Dagonic Quasigriff mount.

name: Black Iron Stirrups
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into a Dagonic Quasigriff mount.

name: Smoke-Wreathed Gryphon Feather
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into a Dagonic Quasigriff mount.

name: Dawnwood Berries of Bloom
description: One of four Legendary Dawnwood Berries.

name: Dawnwood Berries of Budding
description: One of four Legendary Dawnwood Berries.

name: Dawnwood Berries of Growth
description: One of four Legendary Dawnwood Berries.

name: Dawnwood Berries of Ripeness
description: One of four Legendary Dawnwood Berries.

name: Vial of Bubbling Daedric Brew
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into a Deadlands Firewalker personality.

name: Vial of Scalding Daedric Brew
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into a Deadlands Firewalker personality.

name: Vial of Simmering Daedric Brew
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into a Deadlands Firewalker personality.

name: Rune-Scribed Daedra Hide
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into a Deadlands Scorcher skin.

name: Rune-Scribed Daedra Sleeve
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into a Deadlands Scorcher skin.

name: Rune-Scribed Daedra Veil
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into a Deadlands Scorcher skin.

name: Abecean Ratter Cat
description: The Abecean Ratter is famed from Hegathe to Woodhearth as a prime rodent-catcher.

name: Alcaire Blue Cockeral
description: The cockerels of Alcaire Castle uphold their noble duty and make as much noise during daybreak as possible. Their screeching continues well into the morning, waking any lucky enough to miss out on their earliest morning calls.

name: Alik'r Dune-Hound
description: The Dune-Hound is the loyal dog of the Redguard hunters of the Alik'r.

name: Alliance War Dog
description: War Dogs can be found in the armies of all three Alliances, mainly in the capacity of aides to the military police. They are as loyal to their masters as they are savage to their enemies. (Appearance is specific to your character's alliance.)

name: Anthorbred Avalanche Dog
description: With this loyal dog at your side, you have a companion who can help you make it through even the most treacherous of avalanches in Pale Pass and other mountainous areas even if it has to pull you out from under a pile of fallen snow and detritus.

name: Arenthian Skewbald Pony
description: A reliable companion on the roads of Reaper's March. Especially popular amongst skooma smugglers that require work out of the caves along the River Strid.

name: Ascadian Umber Sheep
description: Legends claim the Red Mountain's first eruption not only gave brown sheep their current hue, but also imbued them with the fortitude to thrive despite hardship. Knowing their sheep remain placid while in danger, many Dark Elves believe these tales.

name: Belle
description: This gentle giant embodies kindness and loyalty, and her loving spirit will run alongside you forever.

name: Big-Eared Ginger Kitten
description: The Big-Eared Ginger, a favorite shipboard pet, is just about the most playful kitten in Summerset. Its over-sized sound catchers enable it to hear every tiny motion within range before it pounces upon it.

name: Big-Eared Ginger Mouser
description: The Ginger Mouser is a favorite barn cat of grain farmers all across central Tamriel, not just because it keeps the storage bins rodent-free, but also for its affectionate personality and goofy good looks.

name: Biscuit Bear-Dog
description: Hunters often rely on the services of a loyal dog to protect them as they retrieve their kills. This breed not only ensures that their hunter remains well-guarded, but also provides quiet companionship.

name: Black Cat
description: This black cat knows things you cannot know, and sees things you cannot see. But that is the nature of all black cats, is it not?

name: Black Mask Bear-Dog
description: This variant of the Bear-Dog is a favorite of the Markarth Watch—and of the thieves who attempt to evade them. The Watch uses them to sniff out trouble, while the outlaws employ them to keep an eye out for the Watch!

name: Black Morthal Mastiff
description: Bull Mastiffs from Morthal in Skyrim are fearless and tireless hunters inured to the hardships of the frozen marshes. The black ones are particularly popular with mages and alchemists.

name: Bleakrock Black Sheep
description: The superstitious Nords of Solitude seek out wool originating from the black sheep of Bleakrock, claiming its dark color fends off evil intent. True or not, these darling sheep love to curl up next to their keepers and help them fall asleep.

name: Blueblood Frog Hound Pup
description: "Don't let the eyes fool you. This pup is a master manipulator. It'll have you believing it's never eaten a day in its life while there's still a frog leg hanging from its mouth. By Julianos, it's hard to resist though."—Scholar Vilia Ceno

name: Bravil Retriever
description: The Bravil Retriever loves the water and is a favorite hunter's companion from Anvil to Gideon.

name: Breton Terrier
description: Originally bred to find and kill rats on the docks of the Iliac Bay, the Breton Terrier has found a place in the hearts and minds of many Tamrielics due to its joyful and wriggly behavior.

name: Bristlegut Piglet
description: This cross between a domestic pig and a Skyrim boar is as loyal as it is adorable.

name: Bruma Spotted Pig
description: "Absolutely not. We can't keep it! Pigs are livestock, nothing more. Don't give me that look. All right, I'll admit it's very cute. And soft. Still, though, we can't keep it. We'll find it a good home."—Overheard in Bruma

name: Catwell
description: The cat's eyes seem to speak, saying "Jolly good to see you! We appear to have a small blight of rodents. Dreadful crawling things. Scuttling everywhere. Hmm, skittering blights. I knew a good joke about that. What? Oh, yes. Lovely day for a hunt!"

name: Chorrol Retriever
description: These playful golden canines happily accompany their people on journeys near and far, making friends with anyone they meet along the way. The downside to this endearing show of trust is, of course, that they're not the best guard dogs.

name: Cloud Spring White Sheep
description: Both the fleecy white sheep and their doughty shepherds enjoy the clear water of Cloud Spring in High Rock. Though dangers abound, the sheep avoid the worst of it, making the rumors of their ability to sense and avoid peril seem plausible.

name: Copperback Bear-Dog
description: The Copperback variant of the Markarth Bear-Dog is renowned for its responsiveness to training, but keep an eye on it, or will get into all sorts of mischief. Especially keep an eye on its eyes, which are two different colors!

name: Covenant Breton Terrier
description: The blue and silver of the Daggerfall Covenant decorate this adorable Breton Terrier, who wants to sniff all the sniffs while you go to war in Cyrodiil. For King and Covenant!

name: Cream and Coffee Sheep
description: Rarer than their alabaster cousins in High Rock, these spotted sheep are beloved for their gentle demeanors and extra soft wool. Many inexperienced farmers can't resist their sweet faces, and these sheep have been known to grow fat on extra treats.

name: Cropsford Hen
description: The Cropsford Hen is a beloved staple of many Cyrodilic farmsteads since just one hen will staunchly protect the entire coop against foxes. Children in Cropsford say the hens herd them into the coop whenever a hawk is circling.

name: Crusader's Coin Chicken
description: Easily identifiable by their flaming red feathers, this aggressive barnyard fowl has been used as an alternative to a guard dog by knights on crusade. Their loud crowing is nearly impossible to sleep through.

name: Dominion Breton Terrier
description: So many wiggles in this Breton Terrier! And wearing the Aldmeri Dominion colors of yellow and silver? Such a good dog! The best dog! For the Queen!

name: Dragontail Goat
description: The brown Goats of the Dragontail Mountains are stronger than they look. There's a saying in Hammerfell: "Hits as hard as a Dragontail ram!"

name: Druadach Mountain Dog
description: Bred to withstand the winters in the Druadach Mountains, these dogs are favored among the Timberclaw Reach clan. They show deep tenderness to their clan or family members while protecting their territory with ferocity.

name: Gideon Trail Dog
description: Trails through the thick marshlands outside Gideon change with every passing storm. Hunters in the city bred these dogs to be light enough not to get stuck in the muck and trained their noses to detect new paths of sure footing.

name: Gray Morthal Mastiff
description: Bull Mastiffs from Morthal in Skyrim are fearless and tireless hunters inured to the hardships of the frozen marshes. The gray breed are quite popular with rogues, thieves, and (incongruously) priests.

name: Great Daenian Hound
description: The Great Daenians are gigantic hounds bred as protectors and companions by the Beldama Wyrd coven. Despite their size and strength, they are surprisingly gentle except when roused to the defense of their masters.

name: Greenhill Farmdog
description: Originally from General Thibaut's hunting pack, these dogs later gained a reputation as fierce defenders of Greenhill's livestock and grain. If you're looking to keep rats out of your bags plus gain a loyal companion to hug, this handsome dog is for you.

name: Haunted House Cat
description: If one lives in a house haunted by spirits of the departed, acquiring a Haunted House Cat to keep the ghosts company will distract them from haunting you. The fact that it can see the spirits of the dead doesn't keep this cat from being sweet and sociable.

name: Heartland Butcher's Dog
description: Families along the Niben River bred Butcher's dogs to protect their homesteads. The dogs earned their name generations later when the farmers realized they were more likely to watch the ribs and roasts than the front door.

name: Heartland Coon Cat
description: "Angry squirrels ruined this one's wares last season, but also called forth this little savior. A hunter of rodents, moths, and other pests. Azartah takes saving when offered."—Azartah of Cropsford

name: Housecat
description: This green-eyed feline is a distant relative of the Alfiq Khajiit.

name: Iliac Spotted Goat
description: Ask an Iliac Bay native what they'd miss most about their home and the answer might be the sight of tree-climbing spotted goats. Fortunately for these goat-lovers, the creatures now bleat their way from the bay to climb all manner of trees in new homes.

name: Imperial War Mastiff
description: Mastiffs are the most common breed used by the Imperial Legions as battle dogs. The Imperial War Mastiff in particular is the mascot and symbol of the storied Second Legion, headquartered in peacetime in the vicinity of Bruma.

name: Jerall Rescue Dog
description: When merchants don't arrive through the passes of the Jerall Mountains as expected, groups of searchers head out with these well-trained dogs to find them. More than a few winter caravans have these friendly dogs to thank for their lives.

name: Karth Winter Pup
description: When the Karth Winter Hound has puppies, it even softens the Briarhearts of the Reachmen. Who's a good barbarian pup-pup, then? Is it you? It IS you!

name: Karthspire Coney
description: Some speak of Reach clans that keep these little bundles of fluff as companions—and hunt down any who harm them. Regardless of veracity, these creatures love to be cuddled, often sleeping in the crook of their companion's necks.

name: Knights of the Flame Pup
description: "When Sir Byric's flames razed the ground outside our walls and the Reachfolk hurled stones at our walls. I stood tall at my post, knowing that our smallest knights padded the ramparts alongside me."—Sir Hughes, Alcaire Castle

name: Mage's Sentry Kitten
description: When it's a kitten, the Mage's Sentry Cat is so adorable, it's said that some sorcerers enchant them to stay that age always.

name: Mages Guild Sentry Cat
description: These short-haired, large-eared cats are a common sight in Mages Guildhalls, where it's said their keen senses enable them to detect all manner of intruders, even those that are magically concealed or from realms of Oblivion.

name: Majestic Alpine Cat
description: These cats of Skyrim are used to harsh conditions with little respite. As a result, they're quite hardy, known for their large size and thick, gorgeous fur. They're prized by local villages for their mousing abilities and teeth-rattling purrs.

name: Markarth Bear-Dog
description: Fierce and courageous fighters, the hunters of Western Skyrim use small packs of these dogs to pursue bears. The Bear-Dogs track, corner, and harry the bears until the hunters can arrive with their spears.

name: Menevian Coachdog
description: Commonly seen trotting alongside carts and coaches in Stormhaven, these perceptive dogs serve as deterrents to bandits and other road hazards. Within recent years, they've become popular in other parts of Tamriel, including Blackwood and the Rift.

name: Merle Paddock Hound
description: "Some say that dogs of this breed don't have a mean bone in their bodies, but if you set them up to guard horses or other creatures, you'll see one fierce guardian. Also great at rounding up livestock."—Piet

name: Milady's Cloud Cat
description: White cats are sacred to Dibella, the Lady of Love, and all white cats are said to be her representatives in the animal kingdom. A House of Dibella will typically have three or four milk-white cats within its walls.

name: Morthal Bear-Dog
description: It's the prestige of the mastiffs of Morthal that give the city's resident breed of bear-dog license to be a bit more silly. Whether watching over children or facing intruders, someone's bound to get a licking.

name: Mottled Sheep
description: "Her calm presence keeps our patients at ease. Sometimes I ask them about the patterns and shapes they see in her coat, and their answers give me insight into their state of mind."—Mender Teliel

name: Necrom Ghostgazer Cat
description: The Necrom Ghostgazer is the favored feline companion of Telvanni wizards. They not only keep the skeevers down, but they can "see" intruding demons and spirits.

name: Nibenese Pony
description: Because these ponies love flowers—to the point of nudging and nickering at any picking them—Nibenese folk started stabling them amid gardens as guardians. Their gentle grace in such a colorful setting make them superb companions for beauty lovers.

name: Nightmare Great Dane
description: Template Description

name: Ninendava Sacred Goat
description: The goats that come from the ruin of Ninendava in Cyrodiil are no mere domestic livestock. They have long been used in certain forbidden Daedric rituals—and have even been known to lead mortals through those arcane rites.

name: Orcrest Rathound
description: Resourceful scavengers and the bane of all street chefs, rathounds are a favorite among beggars. Survivors from Orcrest say the Rathounds and their uncanny ability to sense danger led a canine exodus from the city before it fell to the Knahaten Flu.

name: Pact Breton Terrier
description: Who would not want such a cute Breton Terrier trailing behind them, garbed in the red and black of the Ebonheart Pact? Perfidious fools from other alliances, that's who! Blood for the Pact!

name: Pale Pass Mountain Hare
description: Enterprising merchants seek out and capture these delightful little creatures, calling them either "bunnies" or, if the buyer prefers accuracy or a certain level of decorum, Pale Pass Mountain Hares. So cute!

name: Piebald Cat
