description: Bretons have a strange practice of letting piebald cats loose in the secret passages of their manor homes. It stems from an ancient, noisy infestation of Sheogorath's never-there beetles. It took years, but the clever felines eventually killed them all.

name: Pink Pearl Pig
description: Pining for a perfect pet? Perhaps you're a person who'd prefer a pleasantly playful piglet, pearly-white, pretty, and partial to paladins and protectors!

name: Pony Guar
description: A favorite household pet in Morrowind, the Pony Guar is a glutton for affection.

name: Powderwhite Coney
description: Though one Reach clan claims their ancestors bring them messages via these snowy bunnies, the creatures seem mundane enough. That said, it couldn't hurt to have someone's extremely cute and cuddly ancestor helping you, right?

name: Psijic Domino Pig
description: Originally bred on the Isle of Artaeum, the black-and-white Domino Pig is so smart it can count to five and learn to recognize its name.

name: Riverwood White Hen
description: A hardy domestic chicken found all along Skyrim's White River, said to have been originally bred in the old town of Riverwood. Owners grow extremely attached to them, and become outraged if they're harmed.

name: Saarthal Shepherd
description: "Any Nord can be proud with a canine like this at their side. Our ancestors tamed them ages ago. Ever since, they've been helping us watch our flocks, scare predators away, and keep unruly children from getting underfoot."—Farmer Eoeilif

name: Sable Tenmar Stray
description: Originally bred by Tenmar Khajiit, these wily strays made their way to Senchal and now roam several port cities. Captains love having them on board ships to sniff out and kill vermin, plus help keep the crew warm on cold nights at sea.

name: Sanguine's Black Goat
description: A goat bred to take part in Daedric rituals? Nonsense. It's just a goat. Isn't it? But why does it look at you like that? And did it just whisper? No. It's just a goat!

name: Scruffy Skyrim Paint Pony
description: Hardy and good-natured, the faithful Skyrim Paint Pony wants to be near its master regardless of the weather, leaning into the wind even in a tundra blizzard.

name: Senchal Harbor-Mutt
description: Covered in golden fur and possessing a sharp sense of smell, this mutt becomes loyal to any who feed it and treat it with kindness. Are you the benefactor who will take this dog away from its life scrounging on the docks of Senchal?

name: Senchal Striped Cat
description: The Senchal Striped is a cat that is as cunning as it is elegant. It's both cursed at and admired for its ability to get into places it doesn't belong.

name: Shadowghost Pony
description: It's said that to catch a Shadowghost Pony, one should seek out a cemetery on a dark night during Witches Festival and wait quietly near the grave of a child. Bring a carrot or sweet apple.

name: Shezarr's Chicken
description: Some claim this breed of bird from Cyrodiil's heartland has a deeper connection to Shezarr than the name. This is likely due to their escape artist reputation, which finds them "being misplaced" quite regularly.

name: Shornhelm Shepherd
description: This hardy dog was bred for herding sheep in the rugged terrain of Rivenspire.

name: Silent Moons Sheep
description: Docile and hardy, these sheep were first tamed near Whiterun. Their thick wool is woven into cloaks and blankets, protecting the wearer during harsh winters. Nord children sometimes bed down among the flock, enjoying the sheep's warmth.

name: Silsailen Tortie-Calico Cat
description: Named for the small Auridon town where they were first bred, many needed homes after a Veiled Heritance attack. Some are still looking for a new place (and person) to plant their claws.

name: Silver Daenian Werewolf Tracker
description: The werewolf hunters of the Silver Dawn rely on the courage and keen noses of these great High Rock hounds to help them track Tamriel's lycanthropes to their lairs.

name: Silver-Gray Mouser Cat
description: Though they originally hail from Senchal, these mousers have recently started showing up in other locales. Having one at your side not only exhibits your charity toward street cats, but also helps ensure you sleep free of pesky mice!

name: Skingrad Guard Mastiff
description: "The training of one's canine is tantamount to the importance of military maneuvers. Neglecting a Legion canine weakens the entire unit. Like watering grapes in the field, proper care yields the fruit of loyalty."—Legion Recruit Training Manual

name: Sooty Breton Terrier
description: A popular song in Camlorn tells of a white Breton Terrier who wiggles himself into a pile of ashes. Different singers offer rhyming suggestions on how to clean the terrier, but by the time the chorus is reached the terrier never gets the stain out.

name: Sovereign Sow
description: Freed at last from her terrible captivity, and rightfully wedded to Jester King Jorunn, the Sovereign Sow can trundle along at your side to share in your adventures. Who would not want a companion of such royal blood and stately countenance?

name: Sphynx Lynx
description: The discovery of this "lynx" created waves in noble circles when certain of their number realized they could have a feline around without succumbing to fur-based allergies. Now you see them everywhere.

name: Tan Morthal Mastiff
description: Bull Mastiffs from Morthal in Skyrim are fearless and tireless hunters inured to the hardships of the frozen marshes. The tan variety is a favorite with scouts, hunters, and trackers.

name: Tu'whacca's Sphynx Cat
description: "These fastidious cats bring the blessing of Tu'whacca and hold a place of honor within their chosen homes. Further, they often start sleeping with any who near death, and thus we venerate them as guides to the Far Shores."—Tanandra, Scholar-Errant

name: War Veteran's Hunting Dog
description: "I love hunting with my dogs, but I can't understand why they try to pull my boots off after each hunt. Maybe it's a quirk of the breed?"—Ushataga

name: West Weald Retriever
description: "He's just as smart and loyal as any Legion mastiff! And twice as affectionate! Although he has a habit of not actually retrieving his ball if it's under a bush, or in a puddle, or just not easy to see. But that's all right."—Legionary Audania

name: White-Gold Imperial Pony
description: The White-Gold Imperial Pony was said to have made its debut as the birthday present for a noble's daughter, though which family claims this prestige is still hotly debated throughout Cyrodiil.

name: Whiterun Mottled Goat
description: Known for both their stubbornness and their ability to climb on structures at the worst possible times, the Whiterun Mottled Goat picks a favorite person and tries to follow them. Affectionate? Only if you find gentle headbutts to be so.

name: Whiterun Wolfhound
description: The hunting dog of the Nords of Skyrim, known to face down sabre cats for their masters.

name: Windhelm Wolfhound
description: Descended from royal hunting dogs, Windhelm Wolfhounds are known as steadfast companions.

name: Winterhold Chestnut Pony
description: Every child in Winterhold asks for one of these ponies at some point, and a very lucky few will receive one. Their small stature is perfect for young riders, and even older adults cherish them as cheerful and hardy pets.

name: Winterhold Wolfhound
description: North of Windhelm in Skyrim, where the snow on the heights never melts, the Nords' great Wolfhounds have lighter and fluffier fur coats. In addition to barking, they even howl a bit like the wolves they pursue.

name: Witch-Tamed Bear-Dog
description: Few Reach witches make the effort to invest eldritch magic into unborn pups, train them to draw attention without fear, and decorate them with eerie skeletal bone markings. All it takes is one look to either fear this canine or love it beyond reason.

name: Woodhearth Brown Rabbit
description: Some Wood Elf spinners claim Y'ffre granted these bunnies as part of the Green Pact, scholars contest that Second Empire Imperials brought them when establishing Woodhearth and, well, nature took its course. These hoppy hares make great fuzzy friends!

name: Wrothgar Buck Goat
description: The Orcs of Wrothgar have a hardy breed of goats well-suited to the area's rugged terrain and changeable climate. Each goatherd particularly prizes his herd's master Buck Goat; these tend to be both intelligent and pugnacious, good animal companions.

name: Molten Key
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into the Doomchar Plateau.

name: Profane Pedestal
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into the Doomchar Plateau.

name: Scorching Pillar
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into the Doomchar Plateau.

name: Searing Column
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into the Doomchar Plateau.

name: Unholy Tablet
description: A component required to morph an Unstable Morpholith into the Doomchar Plateau.

name: Delver's Druid Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Kasorayn, the last Druid King.

name: Dreamer's Druid Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Kasorayn, the last Druid King.

name: Geomancer's Druid Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Kasorayn, the last Druid King.

name: Slayer's Druid Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Kasorayn, the last Druid King.

name: Soothing Druid Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Kasorayn, the last Druid King.

name: Bal Sunnar
description: Time itself swirls in chaos behind the walls of Bal Sunnar, a hidden Telvanni outpost on the outskirts of Stonefalls. Ally with Saresea of the Psijic Order to end this temporal tumult, restore the timeline, and safeguard the causality of Tamriel.

name: Bedlam Veil
description: When the Blind Path invades Bedlam Veil, Fa-Nuit-Hen calls on brave warriors to repel the invasion and discover what the cultists so desperately seek.

name: Black Drake Villa
description: Under the ruins of the once-opulent Black Drake Villa, a grand library holds treasures and ancient tomes from across Tamriel. Gather your companions for a race against time to recover a mysterious book before dark forces burn everything to ash.

name: Bloodroot Forge
description: Deep in the Jerall Mountains lies the long forgotten ruins of the Bloodroot Forge, an ancient place of power rekindled after centuries of dormancy by Dreadhorn Reach clan to fuel their campaign of conquest.

name: Castle Thorn
description: After years of isolation, the mysterious Lady Thorn now amasses a dread army within the walls of her ancient castle. Gather your allies, storm the fortress gate, and stop the Thorn Legion before it marches on Western Skyrim.

name: Coral Aerie
description: On an oft overlooked little islet among the Summerset Isles, big trouble is brewing. Help the cagey Captain Kaleen lead a daring rescue of one of her former crew from the dissidents of the Ascendant Order and recover what they stole.

name: Cradle of Shadows
description: The Argonians of the Dark Brotherhood need your help against a cadre of rogue assassins who threaten to hurl all Black Marsh into bloody chaos. Fight your way into the Cradle of Shadows to uncloak the secrets of the twisted Silken Ring!

name: Depths of Malatar
description: Centuries ago, the Empire made an ill-fated foray into the ruins an ancient Ayleid city. Follow in their footsteps with the treasure hunter, Tharayya, to discover what they sought and why they disappeared in the Depths of Malatar.

name: Earthen Root Enclave
description: The Firesong Circle, unseen in the wider world for years, now threatens a tender peace between the Druids. Laurel seeks help to protect the resting place of a legendary sacred seed. Can you soothe Air, Root, and Stone, and survive the fury of the Firesong?

name: Exiled Redoubt
description: In the wake of a great tragedy, the nobles of Albus house devoted themselves to bloody revenge. Journey deep into an underground West Weald stronghold with Lucilla Caprenia to put an end to the Albuses' crusade.

name: Falkreath Hold
description: Long a symbol of Nord strength, the embattled city of Falkreath has endured countless conflicts with the wild men from the Reach. Until now. Besieged by the mighty Dreadhorn minotaur and Reachman alliance, the final fate of Falkreath is all but sealed.

name: Fang Lair
description: Venture into the Fang Lair dungeon, put an end to a necromancer threat, and face off against a fearsome reanimated Dragon!

name: Frostvault
description: After millennia buried under the ice, the lost Vault of Mhuvnak is once again within the reach of the people of Tamriel. Join the treasure hunter, Tharayya, on a daring expedition into the ancient Dwemer Frostvault and reveal the secrets buried there!

name: Graven Deep
description: An abandoned Dwemer facility sits atop an uncharted island in the Abecean Sea. The prefect place for an adventure! Join Dhulef of the Mages Guild as he investigates mysterious storms, shattered ships, and the dark stirrings of Necromancy at Graven Deep.

name: Icereach
description: Fierce, unnatural storms swirl around the frozen island of Icereach, sinking ships and lashing the coasts of Skyrim. Fight your way through a frigid ruin and put an end to the unholy ritual at the eye of the storm!

name: Lair of Maarselok
description: The corruption of the Dragon, Maarselok, creeps out from his lair, threatening all Grahtwood. Help the forces of Elden Root defend the Green and end the Azure Blight with an unlikely ally: the forest spirit, Selene.

name: Lep Seclusa
description: Smoke rises from the sea outside of Hew's Bane as the forgotten island of Lep Seclusa burns. Help Sister Chana Nirine and Khafdeed reclaim their island from the army of a former emperor and protect Lep Seclusa's treasured Elder Scroll.

name: March of Sacrifices
description: In the realm of the Hunting Grounds, compete with fierce Hircine worshipers in the March of Sacrifices to win the favor of the Daedric Prince. Victory in the hunt will reward great prizes, but more importantly, there are mortal souls at stake!

name: Moon Hunter Keep
description: A vicious pack of werewolves, led by the mighty Vykosa, has crushed the wolf hunters of the Silver Dawn and occupied their citadel of Moon Hunter Keep. Now you must retake the keep and defeat the Werewolf Lord and her feral followers!

name: Moongrave Fane
description: A clan of vampires have captured a Dragon at Moongrave Fane and plan to drain its blood to gain its power. You must venture deep within the jungle temple to stop these vampires and the lost Dragonguard that leads them.

name: Oathsworn Pit
description: Help Bazrag bestow Malacath's legendary revenge on the Wood Elves who sought to slaughter the Oathsworn in their ancestral training grounds.

name: Red Petal Bastion
description: For centuries, the honorable Knights of the Silver Rose prosecuted crusades against the servants of Oblivion. Now, they wield their Daedric plunder almost indiscriminately. Invade Red Petal Bastion and uncover the truth behind the once noble order's fall.

name: Ruins of Mazzatun
description: Venture into Mazzatun, the "Puzzle City" of the Xit-Xaht tribe of Argonians, who have been forcing other Lizardfolk to work as slave labor on a project that has driven their masters mad! Can you free them in time?

name: Scalecaller Peak
description: Fight your way through cultists in the Scalecaller Peak dungeon and stop them from unleashing a terrible disease upon Tamriel!

name: Scrivener's Hall
description: The walls between realms sunder in Scrivener's Hall, a library in the mountains south of The Rift. Join Keshargo, Scribe of Mora, as he struggles to retake the enigmatic archive and return his order to their rightful place as watchers of the unknown.

name: Shipwright's Regret
description: Join Captain Za'ji's quest to perfect the Perfect Pounce using the secrets of the finest shipbuilders in Tamriel—provided they can still be found in the rolling fog, thick overgrowth, and haunted remnants of the Shipwright's Regret.

name: Stone Garden
description: Deep within the halls of Blackreach, a mad alchemist feverishly perfects his devious creations. Enter the Stone Garden, uncover the dark laboratory's secrets, and put a stop to the heinous experiments at its heart.

name: The Cauldron
description: A fervent new cult has kidnapped innocent Dark Elves, dragging them to a lair deep within a long-abandoned mine. Join two unusual saviors to penetrate the defenses of the Cauldron and stop the Order of the Waking Flame from completing their deadly ritual.

name: The Dread Cellar
description: The Empire kept its darkest secrets hidden in the depths of Black Marsh, far from prying eyes—the Dread Cellar, a torture chamber meant to hold those the Empire wanted to vanish. Explore this forgotten abattoir and learn its secrets, old and new.

name: Unhallowed Grave
description: A group of Nordic graverobbers slaughtered their way into a long-hidden burial ground, intent on stealing ancient remains. Help the sentinel, Shelaria, on her quest for revenge and oust these nefarious plunderers.

name: Timber Mammoth
description: "Behold the mammoth. Bred among the majestic trees of Malabal Tor. Let its strength endow you with courage and its even-tempered persistence carry you safely. And let its beauty uplift your soul."—Overheard at the Baandari Trading Post

name: Admire Me
description: Throw your arms wide to call attention to the fact that YOU are the most awesome being within three provinces!

name: Aerial Escapades
description: Show off your sleek airborne moves!

name: Air the Heir
description: Grant refreshing relief to those around you by waving this graceful fan.

name: Aldmeri Dominion Banner
description: Display your alliance's banner with pride and honor!

name: Alik'r Shrieking Cheese
description: The name says it all! It's cheese, it's from Alik'r, and it shrieks. See for yourself!

name: Alinor Allemande
description: Dance with the courteous grace of the High Elves!

name: Angry Dust Off
description: Been through a bit of an adventure, eh? Time to dust off.

name: Apple Intimidation
description: Stab that fruit! It deserves it. Then enjoy its sweet, sweet deliciousness.

name: Apprentice's Flower Trick
description: You've practiced this for ages, or so it seems. Now let's see your mastery over oh dear. No. That's not it. That's not it at all.

name: Apprentice's Idle Magic
description: "I thought I was kept busy before I became a mage's apprentice. Now, if I'm not learning something new, I have to practice. Every. Waking. Moment. No idle hands for me!"—Hreilund of Shad Astula

name: Arachnophobia
description: Do you feel something? On your back? Is that a spider?

name: Argonian Greeting
description: Displays a typical Black Marsh greeting gesture between tribal Argonians.

name: Arkay's Warding Gesture
description: The world can be an awful, terrible, no-good place filled with undead. Ward them all off with Arkay's help. (Caution: Does not actually ward off undead.)

name: Arrow to the Knee
description: Express all the angst and agony of taking an arrow to the knee!

name: Ash Hopper Chomp
description: When prepared with care, an ash hopper's leg provides a savory eating experience that leaves you wanting more. So, what are you waiting for? Chomp down!

name: Ashlander's Fungal Beat
description: Add a sweet beat to any area by pulling out your favorite shroom drum and playing a traditional Ashlander solo.

name: Barkeep
description: Exhibit your mastery over proffering powerful potables in clean containers!

name: Beachside Bask
description: Soak up the glorious sunlight on the beach!

name: Beachside Drink
description: The sun is bright, the sky is clear, and you've nowhere you need to be. Time to relax and enjoy a cold drink on the beach.

name: Befuddled
description: What's going on here? Where am I? Express your total lack of comprehension with this bewildered emote.

name: Begone!
description: This intimidating display is sure to scare off even the bravest birds.

name: Belly Laugh
description: Express your hilarious mockery of another with this over-the-top laugh emotion.

name: Bite Me
description: An obvious request for a vampiric blessing.

name: Blademaster's Conundrum
description: So many blades, so little time.

name: Blademaster's Taunt
description: Confidence and a blade will see you through many of life's most challenging moments.

name: Blow Bubbles
description: Pull out your wand, blow some bubbles, and watch them drift in the air.

name: Boneshaped Handpan
description: Set the tempo for a proper celebration in the Green with this handpan crafted from bone. While the source of the bone may vary, all such instruments resonate similarly, allowing drummers to transition in and out of day-long performances smoothly.

name: Boozy Boot
description: Need to slake a deep thirst? Partake of your favorite beverage the Lonely Troll way by quaffing a boot full of it!

name: Bright Moons Greeting
description: Sweep your hands into a gesture revering the moons, Jone and Jode, with this Khajiiti greeting.

name: Bright Throat Greeting
description: Express your hope for understanding among all beings by using the Bright Throat tribe's greeting.

name: Bull Horns
description: Channel your inner bull.

name: Bumbling Artificer
description: Oh, hey, what's this uh. Oops. You didn't see that. That didn't just happen.

name: Card Conjuring
description: Show off your expertise with Tales of Tribute in a different way—by conjuring a card out of thin air!

name: Cardsharp
description: A dexterous display of deck division and distribution!

name: Carnaval Fan Dance
description: Let the festive frenzy within you burst forth!

name: Carnaval Festive Dance
description: Let the rhythm of Sanguine's everlasting carnaval possess your mind, body, and spirit!

name: Carve Knickknack
description: Just a-carving away, yes, indeed.

name: Cat Contemplation
description: Contemplate the Lunar Lattice like a true Khajiit, thinking deep feline thoughts and totally not taking a cat nap.

name: Celebratory Dance
description: Is it a celebration if there's no dancing? Why bother answering this question when you can immediately show the world your passionate dance moves on any festive occasion.

name: Chaos Ball Boom
description: Riding high on your latest triumph, you slam the Chaos Ball into the ground. Good idea? Maybe not. But it was fun to watch.

name: Chaos Ball Victory Dance
description: You've done it! You have the Chaos Ball! Time to rub your superior play in the opposition's faces!

name: Chatty Hand Puppet
description: Sometimes the only way to have a decent conversation and get a straight answer is to talk to your own hand. Right?

name: Chef Kiss
description: Sublime doesn't even begin to describe the perfection you just experienced. No, for that only a gesture will do—this gesture!

name: Clap Hands
description: Inspired by the music you hear? Clap your hands in time with the beat to show your appreciation!

name: Cliff Racer Catastrophe
description: Locals say that a visit to Vvardenfell isn't a true visit until you've had cliff racers diving at you after flying, flying in the sky, flying so high. Those who have experienced this "welcome" beg to differ.

name: Clippers
description: Soul Gem beats Clippers, Clippers beat Parchment, Parchment beats Soul Gem. Ready? Go!

name: Come Get Some
description: Beckon your loser of an opponent to come get a piece of you—if they dare.

name: Commune with Hist
description: The user enters a brief posture evocative of an Argonian communing with their tribe's Hist tree.

name: Contemplation of Aetheric Arms
description: "None are so blessed as those who, while meditating about Aetherius, gain multiple spirit limbs for a few moments. Alas, while they are impressive to look upon, they do not allow you to accomplish more things."—Scholar Zoellene Ruqueville

name: Crab Pinch
description: That crab seems interested in you. Is it friendly? It seems that maybe—no, no, ouch! It's pinching your finger!

name: Crochet
description: Take some time away from adventuring to crochet using your favorite yarn.

name: Daggerfall Covenant Banner
description: Display your alliance's banner with pride and honor!

name: Day of Lights Spectacle
description: Spread the holiness of the Day of Lights wherever you venture with your own magical light. Whether those around you dance or pray, they'll thank you for wishing their farming and fishing efforts well.

name: Dead-Water Greeting
description: Acknowledge others in the traditional battle-oriented manner of the Dead-Water tribe.

name: Desert Rain Kata
description: Wield a sword in this kata practiced by adepts in the Khajiiti order of Rawlith Khaj.

name: Dragon Call
description: Khajiiti merchants insist that this "Dragon call" can summon the beasts as surely as a duck-call summons waterfowl. While its effect on Dragons remains a matter of debate, everyone agrees that its clatter reliably attracts irritated friends and neighbors.

name: Drink From Horn
description: Dragon Hunters like you deserve only the best beverage in the best container. Drink out of the horn of a Dragon—potentially one that you yourself have slain!

name: Drink From Skull
description: The skulls of your enemies make fine containers for your favorite beverage. Here's to you, skulldrinker. Here's to you.

name: Ebonheart Pact Banner
description: Display your alliance's banner with pride and honor!

name: Egg Scramble
description: How long can you keep a chaurus egg in the air without using your hands? Find out!

name: Elite Seat
description: Take your place on this elegant throne and survey all who seek your leadership.

name: Factotum Dance
description: Express yourself in this clockwork dance with the perfect mechanical precision of one of Sotha Sil's Factotums.

name: Falkreath Frolic
description: Join in on the exuberant folk dance of Falkreath!

name: Feed Bird
description: Take a moment to breathe and feed the birds. There's always a hungry bird somewhere, after all!

name: Feline Hygiene
description: Nothing is more important to a self-respecting Khajiit than proper grooming! Clean those ears and whiskers.

name: Feline's Fancy Juggling
description: Up for your next juggling challenge? Try yarn balls—both fancy and colorful. Just watch out for pouncing feline friends!

name: Festival Beggar
description: Traditionally, the Witches Festival encourages beggars to ask for alms and children to ask for treats. Er, what's your excuse, hero?

name: Festive Bell Ring
description: Ring in New Life with this festive bell-ringing emote!

name: Festive Treats
description: The Witches Festival encourages beggars to ask for alms and children to beg for treats. Now you can oblige them with this kindly behavior. Be generous while you can, for as the witches and haunts remind us, life is short!

name: Fetcherfly Frustration
description: The most rewarding kills are the ones you have to work for.

name: Fight Me
description: These jerks are really asking for it! When you're ready to settle an argument the old-fashioned way, express it with this aggressive emote.

name: Fingers Crossed
description: Cross your fingers and hope for the best!

name: Fire Salts
description: Nothing says spicy like a sprinkle of fire salts!

name: Fire Spinning
description: Amaze and perhaps even hypnotize onlookers with your skills at spinning fire. A perfect complement to knife juggling, fire breathing, and other festival activities!

name: Flip the Bird
description: Show the ultimate in disdain for your adversary by flipping the bird at them.

name: Flower Fling
description: Want to show appreciation for a divine performance? Maybe express your deep adoration to someone? Toss them a flower!

name: Foe Crusher
description: Ah, the sweet victory of seeing your foes die at your hands. Even sweeter? Crushing their skulls into splinters.

name: Forbidden Dinner
description: Consumption of certain kinds of flesh is forbidden to decent mortals in all civilized societies.

name: Frolicking Frog
description: Your best little froggy friend loves hopping around on you. Why not bring them out for some fun?

name: Galenwood Leafshade
description: With this gorgeous leaf, you have access to shade at any time. It's even better at keeping the rain off!

name: Get Out
description: Express your wish for someone to leave your vicinity with this compelling gesture.

name: Gladiator Taunt
description: This unusual emote displays an aggressive "Gladiator" gesture that varies depending upon what kind of weapon the user has equipped. All indicate a warrior who's ready for action!

name: Glimmer Dust
description: Add a bit of alchemy to your day by using this fine powder.

name: Go Quietly
description: To a defeated opponent, express your concern—or lack thereof—by urging them to pass on softly and silently. Aww!

name: Goutfang Kata
description: Master the flow of energy in this kata from the Khajiiti order of Vrin-Thak.

name: Guar Stomp
description: Do the Guar Stomp! Rahrr! Wave your tiny hands! Grahrr! Stomp your reptile feet! GUAR!

name: Handy Pocket Scrib
description: "Keep a kwama scrib in your pocket. Always. No, don't ask why. Trust me on this. Just make sure to let it out once in a while."—Arsyn Herandus, Necrom Kwama Farmer

name: Happy Face
description: Happy Face: an exaggerated emote from the theatrical House of Reveries on Summerset Isle.

name: Hiss
description: Whether you're indicating your need for extreme personal space or simply making your displeasure known, hissing is a versatile and expressive tool.

name: Hist Greeting
description: Perform the greeting of the Hist to those you meet.

name: Horrifying Egg Hatch
description: Is this a chaurus egg? About to hatch? Nope!

name: I See You
description: Put your opponent on notice that you see EXACTLY what they're up to.

name: I Shall Remember This!
description: Yeah, that thing you just did? It's going on the list.

name: Iceblossom Summoning
description: Show off your skill at cryomancy by crafting a flower from ice.

name: Jester's Jig
description: Show your inner jester by dancing this joyful jig! Ah, the mirthful merriment.

name: Jugglin' Pumpkins
description: Among the hard-bitten warriors of the Undaunted, no feat of dexterity is more admired than the Autumnal Ornamental Gourd Triple-Toss, also known as "Jugglin' Pumpkins." Do you like hearty applause and sincere adulation? Try it!

name: Karthwatch Banner
description: Brandish the banner of Karthwatch. Long stand the Tower!

name: Key Harp
description: Play High Isle's favorite instrument, the key harp, and entertain your audience with your skills.

name: Kick the Dirt
description: Taunt your contemptible opponent by kicking some dirt at them.

name: Kiss This
description: When words aren't strong enough to express your disdain, encourage them all to "Kiss this!"

name: Kiss the Frog
description: There are various fairy-tale reasons for kissing a frog. Argonians prefer to taste them, to savor what they call "amphibian brandy."

name: Knife Savant
description: Battle isn't the only place for sharp edges! Amuse yourself and your friends by showing off skillful knife tricks.

name: Knightly Bow
description: Time spent among nobles requires knowledge of etiquette—or at least knowledge of how to bow properly. If you prefer more martial forms of respect, this knightly bow may become your favorite.

name: Leaning Scholar
description: Expert scholars learn whenever and wherever they can. Leaning against a wall while reading? Easy!

name: Let There Be Lichen!
description: Wave your favorite glowing fungus in the air.

name: Line in Sand
description: Exuding contempt, you draw a line in the sand, and dare your opponent to cross over it.

name: Lost in the Woods
description: You're totally lost. In the woods. We can tell.

name: Make Cheese
description: You've mastered the art of making fine cheeses. Show off your enviable skills by using the cheese press!

name: Marshmallow Toasty Treat
description: Toast your marshmallows and eat the ooey-gooey result. Tasty!

name: Memorial Toast
description: Pour out a libation to those fallen heroes who walked your path with you—or who came before you.

name: Mirrorball Trickery
description: Mesmerize friends and strangers alike with your ability to manipulate the mirrorball.

name: Mirrormoor Glass Harp
description: As a skilled player of the Mirrormoor glass harp, you know how to bring audiences to tears with your resonant performances.

name: Miser's Muse
description: The feel of coins in your hands delights your senses, stoking your avaricious imagination.

name: Missing Sweetroll
description: Look for your missing sweetroll. Where did it go? This is important to know!

name: Mistletoe
description: This emote requests a festive and seasonal public display of affection. Use with care!

name: Mistletoe Posterior
description: A cheeky request for a rude public display of affection!

name: Morthal Banner
description: Flourish the banner of Morthal. For Hjaalmarch!

name: Muscle Flex
description: Show off your mighty thews for all to admire!

name: Night Mother's Touch
description: We know.

name: No Dice
description: Maybe you want to comically refuse an offer or bemoan an unlucky result. Or maybe you actually have no dice. Either way, this emote has you covered.

name: Offer Weapon
description: Kneel and offer up your arms to one worthy of your trust. This gesture varies depending upon what kind of weapon the user has equipped.

name: On Your Mark
description: Signal that it's time to start with this emote. Ready? Set. Go!

name: Orb Juggling
description: Some street performers mastered the art of making a crystal orb look as if it floats—but it's merely a trick that they can pass on to you.

name: Own the Throne
description: You own it. Now show it. That throne is yours!

name: Pale Lord's Throne
description: Oh, life. Or death. Whichever. It matters not, really, as long as you have power over both. As a Pale Lord, you can grant either to those who kneel before you.

name: Pantomime Tug-of-War
description: Imitate an obnoxious mute comedian who imitates pulling on a nonexistent rope to imitate an invisible game of Tug of War!

name: Parchment
description: Soul Gem beats Clippers, Clippers beat Parchment, Parchment beats Soul Gem. Ready? Go!

name: Pedlar Beckoning
description: No merchant beckons a customer with more charm and enthusiasm than a Baandari Pedlar!

name: Pet Plant
description: Your plant is such a precious little leafy thing! You love it so much, and it loves you, and you love each other! So much love!

name: Petal Presentation
description: Give your favorite person a delightful flower.

name: Plant Yourself
description: Need to take a break? Why not conjure up a chair for yourself and sit. You deserve a nice respite.

name: Play Esraj
description: Perform rich music with a traditional Khajiiti instrument! Favored among string players in Rimmen, the esraj is played with a bow.

name: Play Glass Armonica
description: By necessity, all compositions for these intricate instruments are relatively new. Dwarven musicians are vexingly unavailable for consultation. Still, bards at the college in Solitude find it an exciting challenge. What music can you coax from it?

name: Play Netch Bagpipes
description: "Netch bladders are perfect, just perfect. Most folk don't see their potential. But I do! Just add a few pipes, some reinforcement, and a little tuning here, give one a whirl. It's an experience!"—Serana Hlaalu, Inventor

name: Play Pan Flute
description: Fauns aren't the only creatures who can play pan flutes. Perform your own musical pieces with this bucolic instrument.

name: Play Qanun
description: Play the qanun with a virtuosity that could make homesick Khajiit weep for Elsweyr.

name: Play Ragnar the Red
description: Perform "Ragnar the Red" on a lute. Thrill your audience with your skilled string rendition of this piece!

name: Play Solstice Rattlers
description: Shake these rattlers made from Solstice sea urchins, and you'll have folks dancing to the beat in seconds!

name: Play Tiny Violin
description: This emote allows you to fully express just how ahem sad you find something—no words needed!

name: Polish Dragon Trophy
description: Dragon Hunters often polish a trophy from their past battles to help them focus before the next battle. This Dragon trophy is yours to focus upon. Perhaps polish it a little? It's got a speck right there. No, no. There.

name: Ponder Poorly Drawn Map
description: "Huh. Wait. No. Maybe this way? No? Who drew this so-called map?"—every adventurer ever

name: Pop the Cork
description: It's time to celebrate! Pop open that sparkling cider and enjoy the moment.

name: Potion Peddler
description: "Are predators menacing your barnyard? Well, the Potion Peddler has an elixir for you! In seconds, my potion can increase the size of your rooster. Then you can watch him chase all those pesky foxes away! "—Notice plastered on a Skingrad wall

name: Psijic Cosmic Starburst
description: Is that a new sun? A falling star? No! It's an exhibition of your psijic power. Glorious!

name: Psijic Glowglobe
description: The sages of the Psijic Order employ glowglobes for a variety of purposes, including to provide illumination when studying scrolls and tomes late into the night. How this one wound up in Sunhold is anyone's guess.

name: Pyromancer's Quandary
description: "Ever played with magical fire? I mean, really played with it? Not just your standard yellow-orange flames. We're talking colors. But which colors? So many choices. Even I can't decide sometimes."—Thagbrugug, Budding Pyromancer

name: Rage of the Reach
description: Sometimes you just need to let all the rage out. All of it.

name: Regent's Wave
description: You've perfected the wave used by nobility!

name: Ritual Casting
description: Exhibit your mastery of magical manifestations! Looks magnificent, yes? But what does the ritual do? Oh, that's up to you, of course.

name: Rolling Pin
description: Express your emotions with a rolling pin, the best baking implement for angry rants!

name: Round of Applause
description: Be ready to support (or admonish?) your friends with a very literal round of applause.

name: Sad Face
description: Sad Face: an exaggerated emote from the theatrical House of Reveries on Summerset Isle.

name: Sailor's Sextant
description: Never leave shore without your trusty sextant. This navigation instrument plays an important role in journeys by sea.

name: Salty
description: Need a touch of salt? Sprinkle away! Need more? Why not keep sprinkling?

name: Sapphire Heraldry Horn 1
description: Announce the beginning of festivities by playing a jaunty tune on this gleaming horn, originally used at the Sapphire Tourney.

name: Sapphire Heraldry Horn 2
description: Announce the beginning of festivities by playing a jaunty tune on this gleaming horn, originally used at the Sapphire Tourney.

name: Sapphire Heraldry Horn 3
description: Announce the beginning of festivities by playing a jaunty tune on this gleaming horn, originally used at the Sapphire Tourney.

name: Sapphire Knighting
description: Re-enact the knighting ceremony held at Castle Navire, just as the Knight Commander does it. Your opinion of who is and is not a knight is somewhat less binding than hers.

name: Scarecrow Pose
description: Ready to fend off pesky scarecrows without the slightest provocation or not?

name: Scorching Chaos Ball
description: Ooh, ouch, too hot to handle! Quick, pass along the Chaos Ball before it burns your hands!

name: Self Reflection
description: Yes, take a nice look at yourself—you are stunning!

name: Showtime
description: It's Showtime! No more delays—wave your hands to tell others it's time to bring it on!

name: Siegestomper
description: What happens when those other alliances dare take your keep? Show them by stomping all over their puny defenses, yeah?

name: Sit and Drink
description: Rest your weary feet and slake your mighty thirst! You deserve it.

name: Sitting Scholar
description: Long considered the best way to do research, sitting grants the advantage of allowing your body to rest a bit while you exercise your mind.

name: Skaal Maul Dance
description: While training, Skaal warriors learn dances with their weapons of choice. Those who focus on the maul perform the dance together on the fifth day of Last Seed to celebrate a maul warrior's victory over the Corrupt Man, a pawn of the Adversary.

name: Skingrad Noble Snack
description: Discerning taste—you possess it. Especially when it comes to grapes. Table grapes. Wine grapes. All grapes—but most of all Skingrad's grapes. Come, enjoy a snack!

name: Skull Ponder
description: "It is well to ponder the inevitability of death, for then we must consider how best to use what life we're given, yes?" —Chaplain Jorden, Priest of Arkay

name: Slice Food
description: Slice, dice, and chop your ingredients with style.

name: Solitude Banner
description: Display the banner of Solitude. By the wolf!

name: Sommelier Swirl
description: Is your wine too cloudy? Has it gone bad? Give it a swirl and see!

name: Soul Gem
description: Soul Gem beats Clippers, Clippers beat Parchment, Parchment beats Soul Gem. Ready? Go!

name: Souvenir Conch Shell
description: The soothing sounds of waves crashing on the shore emanate from this High Isle conch shell when you hold it up to your ear. Ah, memories of sunny days amid the surf.

name: Spicy Soup
description: Clear up those sinuses with a nice bowl of zesty soup. Taste the heat!

name: Spyglass
description: Scan the horizon for distant shores with your trusty spyglass. Better to know the lay of the land than go in unprepared, yes?

name: Standing Scholar
description: When scholars are faced with a queue, they pull out a book and get to work. Every moment is meaningful—especially when you're trying to solve a historical puzzle or figure out your next alchemical experiment.

name: Stargazer
description: Ready for some restful time staring at the stars? Stretch out and start looking for your favorite constellation with this emote.

name: Stomp Grapes
description: After growing the appropriate grapes and harvesting them, vineyard workers must crush them and collect the resulting juice. Why not join these blessed folk in making glorious wine!

name: Street Food Juggle
description: Effortlessly juggle Argonian delicacies, and perhaps even indulge in one while you do?

name: Summon Bat
description: Bats are cute, yes? And you want one hanging from your finger, of course. Only monsters don't want to let bats hang from their fingers. You're not a monster, are you?

name: Sword Dance
description: According to the Way of the Sword, the blade must become an extension of the body. Display a Redguard's weapon-mastery with this stylish display!

name: Syrabane Living Statue
description: Stand majestically before an audience as the living statue of the Warlock God! Just remember not to fidget. You're a statue now, after all.

name: Ta-Dah!
description: Ta-Dah!: an exaggerated emote from the theatrical House of Reveries on Summerset Isle.

name: Tame Lightning
description: The power of lightning crackles between your fingers. Impressive!

name: Teatime
description: Invite your friends (or enemies) to join you in a lovely spot of tea!

name: Teeba Dribble
description: Put your mastery of the Argonian teeba on full display with this stylish dribble.

name: Teeba Ready Position
description: Show that you are prepared for a teeba kick-off with this ready stance.

name: Teeba Trick
description: Show off your skill and make teeba a spectator sport!

name: Teeba Warm-Up
description: Warm up for a rousing game of teeba-enoo, a popular Argonian pastime.

name: Tentacular Tome
description: "If a book sprouts tentacles and flies off, take that as a sign to find another book to read. And if it's required reading for your education, well, it's fine to say a tomeshell ate your studies. Won't be the first time."—Tinos Guls, Student

name: Throw Rotten Egg
description: Convey your utter disdain for that which offends you by hurling a rotten egg at it. And hey: stay classy!

name: Tipsy Topple
description: Victory or loss, a flagon of ale cures all!

name: Tracker
description: Carefully you examine the traces of your prey's passage. No doubt about it: they went this way!

name: True-Sight Viewing
description: The mystical art of Scribing requires a certain way of viewing the world. Thankfully, you possess the tool and the talent to see things as they truly are.

name: Trumpet Solo
description: You're not afraid to show your skill with a trumpet. Just the opposite, in fact.

name: Two Thumbs Up
description: Ask not who has two thumbs up—it's you.

name: Uh Never Mind
description: Now you have the ideal reaction for those moments when the point flies right on past someone else (never you, of course).

name: Varkenel's Hat Trick
description: "Varkenel did not pull the first vvardvark out of his hat. Why do you let this charlatan keep performing this trick when you know it's historically inaccurate? I agree it's cute, but accuracy matters!"—From a letter sent to Captain Aresin of Daggerfall

name: Wait the Great
description: Dignity. Aplomb. Poise. Unceasing imperturbability. These traits suffuse your very being as you attend to the needs of others.

name: Wall Pantomime
description: (Silent scream.) "Let me out! I'm trapped behind an invisible wall! Help! No, really—invisible walls! Get me out of here! Isn't this convincing? Just look!"

name: Wargame Ballista
description: Set yourself against your yard war foes with this portable ballista. As you take aim, just remember that it's a game, not an actual war.

name: Wargame Trebuchet
description: Let the games begin! With this portable trebuchet, you can wage a yard war and toast to your victories over the ensuing feast.

name: Warm Hands
description: There's a bitter wind blowing in off the Sea of Ghosts—better warm your hands!

name: Wash My Hands of This
description: Oh yeah, you're totally done with this. Whatever "this" is.

name: Wash Your Damn Hands
description: No. Seriously.

name: Wayrest Party Incident
description: Everything's set for a perfect Wayrest gathering. The tea? Steeped exquisitely. The cups? Cleaned and set on a shining tray. The attendees? Ready to share the latest news and—oh dear. Someone just spilled the tea.

name: Where's My Drink?
description: Lost your drink, eh? Well, where did you last have it? Check there.

name: Whispering Claw Kata
description: The Khajiiti order of Ziz Kurah often practice this kata to find balance within themselves. Now you can do the same.

name: Wickerman Mishap
description: It's that glorious time—that moment when you can burn the wickerman. But that burning smell is you!

name: 10-Year Lion Guard's Steed
description: "She's been my faithful steed through every battle. Never lost her footing even once. There were plenty of close calls, mind you, but whenever I thought we were finished, she'd find some narrow path forward, and here we are."—Captain Morel

name: Adamant Dwarven Horse
description: Though Dwemer constructs are made mostly of so-called Dwarven Metal, some rare animunculi have parts forged from a super-hard whitish alloy known to blacksmiths as Dwarven Adamant. It's one of the rarest materials on Nirn.

name: Akaviri Potentate Charger
description: "Label your fact from fiction, Mirannah! 'The barding on Potentate horses shimmers due to a geas of loyalty Versidue-Shaie instilled in the materials.' No. It's simply magic. But 2E 5 for their first use? Feasible."—Honorata Ancrus, Eyevea

name: All-Maker's Horse
description: The harmony of the All-Maker dwells within the chest of this steed. It breathes in the breath and breathes out the wind. In its wake does the earth move, the waters flow, and the sun shine.

name: Alliance War Horse
description: It's no surprise the Three Alliances compete to breed the strongest and most majestic chargers for their armored cavalries. Appearance is linked to your character's alliance. Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.

name: Ancient Dragon Hunter Horse
description: As the Dragon threat spreads, the need for veteran Dragon Hunters increases. These gold-barded horses can help you reach your prey quickly.

name: Arena Gladiator Horse
description: Ready to rule the arena? With the Arena Gladiator Horse as your steed, you'll do so in flashy style. Each one has received special training from former gladiatorial champions that makes it a practical and dashing choice.

name: Arenthian Skewbald Horse
description: "This one holds no love for Colovians, you see. But they did bring one good thing to Arenthia: their horses. Fine steeds, truly. And such fetching colors, no?"—Trader Zetisha

name: Ashen Fang Lair Courser
description: Sometimes, when necromancers reanimate a creature, they overdo it and imbue the undead entity with an excess of dark conjuration. In the case of the Ashen Courser, this residue of mystical power manifests as a cloud of grave dust and ash.

name: Auroran Twilight Warhorse
description: Like their mistress, the Daedric Prince Meridia, Aurorans have magical control over color and hue, so when they need a mount in Tamriel after dark it's no surprise that they conjure Warhorses that are as dark as night itself.

name: Auroran Warhorse
description: When one of Meridia's Auroran Knights manifests in Tamriel, and needs a mount, the knight has the ability to instantly summon a Daedric Warhorse from the Colored Rooms. Curiously, if the knight is banished to Oblivion, the mount sometimes stays behind.

name: Auroran Zenith Warhorse
description: It's said that when Meridia's Aurorans need mounts in Tamriel they conjure these shining Warhorses out of pure light. Perhaps so, but they're certainly solid enough to support a heavily armed warrior at the charge!

name: Azure Blight Wild Hunt Steed
description: Though the Dragon Maarselok's blue-limned scourge illuminates this conjured steed, never fear! The magic that summoned it contains the blight, keeping the Green safe—but given its penchant for biting, tip the stablemaster extra for its keep.

name: Baandari Pedlar Steed
description: The well-traveled Baandari Pedlars lend their style to this horse's tack, creating a look any lover of rich hues would die for. Today it can be yours—with no need to die!

name: Bay Dun Horse
description: This energetic mount is well-liked by battlefield scouts.

name: Black Fredas Soot Stallion
description: Calamity and mischance seem to follow in the hoofprints of this dark charger—but not for its rider! Gallop into battle on the back of this Soot Stallion and curse your opponents with all the ill luck of Black Fredas!

name: Bloodshadow Wraith Steed
description: An Exemplar mount is a mystical manifestation of its form's ideal concept, It is also extraordinarily sensitive to the emotional valences of its rider. If the rider engages in too much bloodthirsty killing, their Exemplar may become a Bloodshadow Wraith.

name: Bonds of Battle Destrier
description: These black-and-gold barded destriers carry their riders with distinction as they sweep across Cyrodiil, serving as but one symbol of goals and experiences their dauntless combatants share. Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.

name: Bonfire Wicker-Steed
description: Woe to any who ride this fiery steed without its consent! Sanctified by ashes from the funeral pyres of venerated witches, this wicker steed blazes a path across Tamriel and beyond, reminding any mortals who see it of their own short lifespans.

name: Brown Paint Horse
description: Favored by farmers and traders, this muscular horse is strong and patient.

name: Chaurus Egg Chaser's Horse
description: Trained with special care, a chaurus egg hunter's horse requires an even temper, a smooth gait, and the ability to navigate through dark passages with equanimity. This steadfast mount will break few—if any—of your prized eggs!

name: Coalsmoke Forge Horse
description: Originally bred by a family of Breton blacksmiths, the Coalsmoke Forge Horse's strength allows them to work for long hours. Just make sure you provide them with a salt lick—they love them.

name: Cursebound Horse
description: Glorious and deadly. Majestic and haunting. This well-armored steed serves its master faithfully, though its nightmarish appearance once inspired rumors of a ghoulish nature in the area around Cragwallow.

name: Cursebound Lichsteed
description: An iniquitous blend of magic created this unhallowed mount. From its baleful glow to the corrupt lanterns that drift about it, this steed serves liches, necromancers, and other wicked beings with undying loyalty.

name: Daggerfall Dapple Horse
description: The Daggerfall Dapple is a hardy horse breed that comes from the Farwatch region of Glenumbra between Daggerfall and Camlorn. Known for its endurance, it's a favorite of long-distance riders.

name: Dapple Gray Palfrey
description: Elegant and intelligent, this breed of horse is a favorite among the nobles of Cyrodiil.

name: Dark Opaline Steed
description: The result of a boastful Khajiiti mage's bizarre transmutation ritual, the Dark Opaline Steed shimmers with blues and purples, and waves of colorful light trail behind it. Course through any environment while looking stylish and almost ephemeral!

name: Dawn's Avenger Destrier
description: This grieving steed of the Silver Dawn lost its rider—and its purpose. Now, it seeks a new companion. As long as you ride in search of worthy foes, this proud warhorse will heed your call.

name: Deepsea Corsair Summoned Steed
description: Some Sea Elves are so connected to the ebb and swell of the ocean that the water itself responds to their call. This magical steed was created by a renowned sea witch celebrating their sixth century on the waves.

name: Dragonscale Barded War-Horse
description: "Dragons are a pain in the tailbones, yes? But their scales make such superb steed armor! The Dragonscale Barded War-Horse may be the sharpest mount this one has ever seen!" — Master Groom Zarbi'dahuz

name: Dragonscale Solar Horse
description: "I have been fortunate enough to have personally glimpsed a Solar Horse on an Anequine morning, and I say with conviction that it must be a creature of Magrus, the Cat's Eye, and no other." —Moon-Bishop Hunal

name: Dread-Aurelian Charger
description: With their glowing yellow eyes and flashy golden barding, these veteran steeds serve their Dragon-slaying riders with nobility and style. Be sure to keep some sugar cubes handy—they have a taste for sweets that rivals the Khajiit!

name: Dwarven Horse
description: The ancient Deep Elves made animunculi of many kinds, imitating nature with mechanical constructs. The Dwarven word for mount was "vamidium" but their equine automata are more commonly known as Dwarven Horses.

name: Dwarven War Horse
description: This loyal horse has been trained for warfare, and will stick with you through every kind of conflict. As a bonus, it comes outfitted in ancient Dwarven horse armor. Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.

name: Ebon Dwarven Horse
description: Though most ancient Dwemer automata are constructed primarily of the so-called Dwarven Metal, some rare and special animunculus mounts use a preponderance of Ebony. Creations like the Ebon Dwarven Horse are especially durable.

name: Egg Hunter's Horse
description: The many multicolored eggs of Tamriel are valuable for their differing alchemical properties, and this makes the Egg Hunter's job a profitable one, especially in the spring.

name: Elder Dragon Hunter Horse
description: With Dragons on the loose in Elsweyr, a modern cadre of Dragon Hunters have sprung up to hunt them down. Their mounts are sturdy and fearless.

name: Embermould Warhorse
description: "Seeking to meld fire with fungi, Ahzidal created the first Embermould Warhorse. Formed from char morels often used in stews, this mount can light a rider's way on the darkest winter nights."—Halund Greycloak

name: Fang Lair Courser
description: In Fang Lair, not even ancient warriors' steeds are safe from reanimation by necromancers! Though to be fair, if you're looking for "grimly impressive" this is the mount for you.

name: Flame Atronach Horse
description: It was the master summoners of the Direnni who first discovered that a conjurer could impose any desired shape on a Flame Atronach—even that of a horse. Direnni mages mounted on flaming horses first appeared at the Battle of Glenumbria Moors.

name: Forge Master's Charger
description: Though some claim these fiery steeds first sprang from the Earth Forge, others make a case for the fires of Morkuldin's Descent taking that honor. None can quench the blaze of this incandescent horse!

name: Frost Atronach Horse
description: All the strength of a standard frost atronach, with all the nobility and grace of the equine form! Create a spectacle by riding into your favorite town on this mighty steed.

name: Frost Draugr Charger
description: Now seen well outside Skyrim, these skeletal horses once served among Ysgramor's soldiers and were honored after their deaths—or so says one of the epic ballads found in Solitude's Bards College. Dare you ride a steed of such provenance? Of course!

name: Frost Mare
description: With its icy gaze and steaming breath, the frigid Frost Mare seems carved from the very glaciers of Skyrim.

name: Frostbane Horse
description: The ancient Nords who came to Skyrim with Ysgramor worshiped animal totems, and adorned their mounts with symbolic hair-knots and hide strips meant to protect their livestock from the frigid climate. These "Frostbane" talismans are still in use today!

name: Galvanic Storm Steed
description: The Galvanic Storm Steed fuses the power of a Storm Atronach from Oblivion with the bloodline of the Yokudan Chargers, the famous war horses of the Redguards, to create an incomparable mount.

name: Gloomspore Horse
description: "Using giant lichen while creating Gloomspore Horses caused unexpected results. Dauntingly beautiful, these mounts often twitch with nervous caution. So you'll never have to worry about an ambush. Just hold on tight!"—Mage Naleldil

name: Grand Joust Destrier
description: "A knight's mount is the extension of her body. Four more legs to push her forward. Two longer ears, to warn her of danger. And a large heart to pump courage through her veins."—Gwenifyr Dufort, The Meaning of Chivalry

name: Grand Nibenese Stallion
description: Though some claim these horses are bred purely for show, the Grand Nibenese Stallion serves as more than just a good luck charm in Leyawiin. They possess a keen intelligence and even temperament—maintaining their composure, even on crowded streets.

name: Gray Yokudan Charger
description: These chargers are descended from the great gray war-horses of the Ra Gada.

name: Grinning Terror Steed
description: "I can't pick a favorite from the Grinning Terrors, but this ominous horse kissed by madness appeals to me on a visceral level. Perhaps because they enjoy spreading the viscera of unwelcome riders about with their hooves."—Mother Regrets

name: Grisly Horse Mummy
description: Make an entrance with this mummified mount! With its ancient wrappings and hallowed barding, this ghastly horse adds the perfect touch of eeriness to any spooky procession or gathering.

name: Guild's Pride Charger
description: The envy of treasure-seekers throughout Tamriel, this sure-footed steed serves as both a sturdy companion and an enduring reminder of what fellowship and camaraderie can achieve. Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.

name: Harrowstorm Destrier
description: The first destrier born from a harrowstorm spurned its original rider and galloped away before any present could capture it. This pattern continued for a time, leading many to wonder where they went. Some say they must find new riders—for good or ill.

name: Hermitage Servitor
description: "Someone made this. I reached out to Apocrypha, to a place of pure thought and potential. And when I withdrew, this hideous unblinking monstrosity stepped from the shadows. It will not leave. It will not stray. Why? WHY?"—Final notes of Iratian Cipius

name: Holdbreaker Warhorse
description: Enterprising siegemasters need to move quickly when working to overthrow a fortification. Whether you plan to conquer Castle Alessia, take over Fort Warden, or overwhelm Chalman Keep, the Holdbreaker Horse is a valuable addition to your stable!

name: Hollowjack Rider Horse
description: Every Witches Festival, the haunted legend of a hidden Rivenspire hollow once more comes to life—if you can call it that—and horse riders across Tamriel are cursed to gallop headless through the night on dark and frantic steeds.

name: Hollowjack Wraith-Lantern Steed
description: Conventional wisdom holds that these bizarre and eerie Skull mounts are just horses imbued with a haunting illusory appearance—but some whisper that they aren't from Tamriel at all, but summoned from the Hollowjack half-world or demiplane.

name: Horse-Lizard Steed
description: "Sometimes Argonians want to travel a long way for a long time, and how do people do that? On mounts! And so useful lizards become Lizard Steeds of proven shapes, and then Argonians can ride, tall in the saddle and proud!" —Ukaspa of Lilmoth

name: Icereach Wicker-Steed
description: A bloodied Daedric dagger used by a spurned lover. The tears of a victim tormented by Molag Bal. When used in a wicked Icereach coven ritual, they help shape a wicker mount that is worthy of bearing everyone's worst nightmare: you.

name: Imperial Horse
description: Impetuous and fierce, this all-purpose Imperial steed yields only to a capable master.

name: Imperial War Horse
description: When the Empire of Cyrodiil was at its height, the Imperial Legion Cavalry rode these chalk-white chargers into battle beneath the red diamond banner. Riding Skill does not affect this mount's appearance.

name: Iron Atronach Horse
description: The magic-wielding knights of Zenithar's Crucible prize these molten steeds above all else—even their arms and armor! To this day, no force has weathered the charge of an Iron destrier.

name: Jade-Crown Dragonslayer Horse
description: The epitome of Dragonslaying mounts, this steed has not only braved dangers that would make lesser heroes cringe but serves as a worthy mount for one of your stature and experience. The fact that it has green glowing eyes makes it even more noteworthy.

name: Jouster's Charger
description: "Though these fellows work the tilt-yard like a dream, they're trained to the field, too. You never know when you'll need a finely barded steed to get you across those fancy sunflower fields you see around High Isle."—Perien Jerrick, Castle Navire

name: Jubilee Steed
description: "The Imperials do love their regalia, don't they? Even I have to admit it's a rather dashing look, for a horse. Anyone who comes in astride that steed is certain to make an entrance."—Abelle Gernand of Kvatch

name: Khaj Necromancer's Steed
description: Many masters of the art of necromancy find this horse suits their taste exceedingly well, especially since it possesses no fear of the undead that often surround necromancers. It calls to you, does it not?

name: Khenarthi's Windwalker
description: "Don't be fooled by lesser steeds. These horses seem to ride Khenarthi's winds when treated with respect. Act as if the God of Winds gifted you with this noble creature herself, as this one does, yes?"—Huzdargo, Senchal Stablemaster

name: Kvatch Outrider's Warhorse
description: Originally bred by Kvatch for speed, these pale horses became the favored mounts of outriders during the rivalry with Skingrad in the First Era. Since then, though their numbers vary from few to many, they've continued to serve with honor and distinction.

name: Lambent Shadowmane Courser
description: "Imbued with the spirits of those turned away from Sovngarde, this dark courser emanates tendrils and spines of those lost souls. Dare you walk with it along its path of shadows and regret, taking on some of its burden?"—Clever Woman Moritra

name: Legendary Dragon Horse
description: Hunters riding these valiant steeds are often the first on the scene of a Dragon attack. With its ornate, jade-accented barding, and its fierce loyalty to its rider, this steed is a must-have for any veteran Dragon Hunter.

name: Legion Zero Charger
description: Battlemages within the perfidious Legion Zero conjure these powerful warhorses out of thin air using forbidden Daedric magic. The sight of this otherworldly charger inspires both fear and awe on the battlelines.

name: Legion Zero Destrier
description: By forcing their steeds to consume the Blood of Coldharbour, the traitorous soldiers of Legion Zero created a war horse unlike any other. Adorned with fearsome barding and their sullen red colors, this is truly a mount to be feared.

name: Lucent Guardian Horse
description: Bartered in the great merchant stalls of Fargrave, this horse has been trained and tested against everything the Daedric Realms have to offer. It responds to the slightest nudge from its rider, plunging into even the most bizarre battle with no hesitation.

name: Luminous Meridian Charger
description: "Meridia's charger manifests wherever vile darkness gathers. In 298 1E, it blazed out of the sunrise and into Cath Bedraud where the righteous flames of the Sunfire reduced a nest of bloodfiends to ashes."—Terendra Vocula, Priest of Inner Luminance

name: Maligraphic Mount
description: "I'm not going to say that you need to ride this beast. But when the Prince of Secret Knowledge hands you the reins, are you really going to turn them down? I know I wouldn't!"—Filer Xess

name: Masqued "Unicorn" Steed
description: Is that the famed and incredibly-rare creature of legend, the true Unicorn from Hircine's Oblivion realm of the Hunting Grounds? Well, no, it's a horse with a horn attached to its forehead. But the effect—it's just so magical!

name: Midnight Steed
description: A luxurious black steed, often considered a point of pride and distinction by Tamrielic jockeys, cavalry, and couriers.

name: Mind-Shriven Horse
description: With its equine psyche stolen by Daedric magic, the mind-shriven horse is a docile yet terrifying mount.

name: Nebulous Star-Born Steed
description: "The glow emanating from this celestial horse soothes and energizes me at the same time. Odd, given its origins in Spellscar. Sitting astride this mystical mount can make even the most wretched pauper feel like a master mage."—Madadi, Celestial Scholar

name: Nenalata Ayleid Horse
description: "The Nenalata horses bore the brunt of the cargo work whether trained for battle or not. To allow them to rest, their riders would often walk alongside them for a time. Oiobaun, though, carried his rider the entire way."—Beredalmo the Signifier

name: New Moon Horse
description: "I would ride this steed with great care. Its barding? The stuff of nightmares. Perhaps I intend that pun. Perhaps not."—Jonnet of the Sunwalkers

name: Night Frost Atronach Steed
description: This chilling steed was created from a Frost Atronach that was conjured into the shape of a horse. Perfect for an adventurer visiting a warmer climate, this steed can help you stay cool even in extreme temperatures.

name: Nightmare Courser
description: The origin of this horrific mount is obscure, but some see the hand of Mehrunes Dagon in it.

name: Noweyr Steed
description: The thief-god Rajhin is said to have stolen these enchanted purple steeds from somewhere in Oblivion, but when his worshipers are asked where he got them, they just laugh and say "Noweyr!"

name: Order of the Lamp Destrier
description: Selectively bred for generations by the Mages Guild and the Order of the Lamp, these steeds possess remarkable stamina and agility. No expense is spared in their training, and they are equipped with armor rivaling that of the finest knights in Tamriel.

name: Palomino Horse
description: Handsome, strong, and swift, the palomino is favored by couriers and sportsmen.

name: Pellitine Mustang
description: The small equines of the subtropical Pellitine forests have subtle vertical stripes for camouflage under the canopy. They've been crossed with the larger Anequine Mustang to create a striking striped mount, the favorite of the First Corinthe Hussars.

name: Piebald Destrier
description: Staunch and vigorous, this patterned war-horse is known for its courage and tenacity.

name: Plague Husk Horse
description: A zombie horse is fearsome enough—but a Plague Husk Horse, wreathed in a glowing miasma of toxic infection, is a truly terrifying mount!

name: Planemeld Courser
description: This steed's blue markings glow, indicating its exposure to the energies of the Planemeld. Its glimmering eyes possess a frightening intelligence that seems unnatural for a horse.

name: Potentate Cloudracer Courser
description: "Yes, 2E 30 seems right for the first Cloudracer steed, but Mirannah of Gwylim's notes about them being spectral fall into fiction. While their creation is a mystery, I suspect magic is involved."—Honorata Ancrus, Eyevea

name: Psijic Escort Charger
description: Though the Psijics are not a combat order, the monks do concede a need for protection when venturing beyond Artaeum, and when their fighting escorts need to be mounted, they conjure up these impressive warhorses for them.

name: Psijic Horse Exemplar
description: Psijic Exemplar mounts theoretically represent the ideal forms such creatures can assume, at which point they transcend the physical and incarnate the mystical. One look at the noble Horse Exemplar, and you know it's true.

name: Psijic Spectral Steed
description: When Psijic monks (or their favored allies) call up a Psijic Spectral Steed, they're really summoning the spirit of a Psijic Horse Exemplar, brought back to the world of the living and made tangible by a supreme act of Conjuration.

name: Ragebound Steed
description: "Studies into ragebound breeds trace their lineage to Hircine and the Reach. Legend says the Lord of the Hunt gifted the first Ragebound Horse to a tribe after witnessing them chase down a vampire. On foot. In the dark."—Beastmaster's Practical Bestiary

name: Rahd-m'Athra
description: When the dro-m'Athra ride from the Dark Behind the World, they go mounted on these dread steeds: the Rahd-m'Athra! Are they spirits from the Dark Moons, or tangible creatures of evil?

name: Reefborn Charger
description: "The hues on these reefborn steeds—wondrous, yes? Instead of flowing manes on these so-called equines, colorful coral grew. Just don't try to feed them apples. They prefer to feed on algal blooms."—Saissula, Stablemaster

name: Refulgent Mirrormoor Steed
description: "Many strange and wonderous things hail from Mirrormoor. Perhaps this creature walked here along the threads of fate to assist you on your journey."—Keeper Adiir

name: Riverhold Chestnut Horse
description: The people of Riverhold have bred these horses for generations. The result is a line of bright-eyed and faithful steeds, eager to please with their rich chestnut coat. On the road, few horses are steadier or more reliable.

name: Sadrith Mora Spore Steed
description: Softly spoken words cut apart those who claim a mere Telvanni mage crafted this spore steed. The correction—an archmagister brought this russet and amber glory into being—gently flays the soul of the ignorant s'wit. As it should.

name: Sanguine Revelry Steed
description: The scent of flowers precedes this cream-colored steed's arrival. White-and-merlot barding features the grinning silver-and-gold visage of Sanguine, Lord of Revelry. Will you let the promise made by its illusory roses and wine entice you into merriment?

name: Saturalia Ice Steed
description: Tales tell of a mercenary abandoned by her lord during a storm. Her frozen lips begged for help. Sanguine heard her pleas, forming the ice into a steed. Come Saturalia morn, the crimson blood of that lord drenched the snow and evergreen boughs.

name: Scorching Horse-Lizard
description: "It is hard to start a campfire in the damps of the deep marsh, yes? Not when you have a Scorching Horse-Lizard! With one of these as your mount, you will never again have to eat cold eel stew!" —Ukaspa, Stablemaster of Lilmoth

name: Shadowghost Horse
description: Shadowghost Horses are never bred, only found, and then only on misty nights when both moons are dark. Then they are summoned from beyond by hooded Shadowghost Wranglers, roped and saddled and broken for riding by ordinary mortals.

name: Shellback Warhorse
description: Argonian heavy troops are informally known as Shellbacks—so inevitably, their heavy cavalry mounts are called Shellback Warhorses. They are among the strongest breeds known.

name: Siegemaster's Warhorse
description: Like the holds and keeps that prevent enemies from vanquishing them, this warhorse is fortified to prevent foes from taking it down quickly. Join forces with this prodigious mount to besiege opposing forces and take over their holdings!

name: Silver Dawn Argent Charger
description: Werewolf hunting is a dirty and largely thankless business, but when a Silver Dawn member mounts their resplendent Argent Charger, they feel like the hero they really are. Sure, it's showy, but as a defender of society against the vicious, you deserve it.

name: Skeletal Horse
description: Behold the Skeletal Horse! Mortal races are not the only creatures that can be re-animated by necromancers. The best part: no need to muck out the stable.

name: Skyterror Dragonslayer Horse
description: Dragon Hunters, take heed! This mount has received elite training that enables it to fearlessly stand fast even in Dragon breath. Some claim that the final, secret test of these mounts is what imbues their eyes with a blue glow.

name: Snow-Blanket Sorrel Horse
description: This handsome breed of horse is native to the Colovian Highlands of Cyrodiil, and is a common sight from Chorrol to Bruma. The Snow-Blanket Sorrel is known for its intelligence and high spirits.

name: Sorrel Horse
description: A hardy, well-rounded, and dependable beast.

name: Soulrazer Steed
description: "I thought my salvation was at hand. That someone came for me here in this abyss. I was wrong, it was unnatural—a saddle with no horse beneath it. A form but no soul. Death itself would've been more kind."—Torn page in the cell of Vignac Ence

name: Star-Born Guardian Horse
description: All Star-Born horses are children of the Steed. Impatient and in a rush, these creatures are difficult to tame. Any time spent earning their trust is always recovered the second they're allowed to canter down an open road.

name: Steed of the Afflicted
description: Ride like the Bringer of Disease and Pestilence that you want to be! This mount features a saddle with the Peryite cult symbol upon it, giving those who spot you a chance to fear their imminent and loathsome doom.

name: Storm Atronach Horse
description: Summoned from the plane of Levinace, the Storm Atronach Horse is a Daedric mount of majesty and terror, ready to appear in Tamriel whenever called to your service.

name: Su-Zahleel Horse-Lizard
description: "Lizard-steeds are a gift from the Hist. They have dependable backs and dry scales. You know, we only realized how entwined our roots were when we trekked back from Mazzatun. These beasts kept us off our aching feet."—Skeexalttul, Su-Zahleel Ambassador

name: Sungold Bay Thoroughbred
description: This steed's sunny disposition matches its vibrant multihued coat, making it an excellent horse for a new rider—or one who regularly ventures into treacherous situations. Herds often race the Gold Coast waves, manes flowing freely and tails high.

name: Surfglow Courser
description: As swift as the waves at high tide, this steed's gallop is unmatched. With its glowing mane and shining tail, night riding on this Surfglow Courser is the most sublime experiences known to equestrians.

name: Symphony of Dawn Charger
description: "The Lady of Infinite Energies lent me a steed to hasten my way to Garlas Malatar. A creature of golden light, gleaming barding, a symphony of blades, and an aura reminiscent of the Colored Room, the charger tested my endurance."—King Narilmor's Journal

name: Treasure Hunter's Horse
description: Stolid, careful, sturdy, and long-suffering, the Treasure Hunter's Horse is resigned to a life of being ridden into crumbling ruins by a reckless master who's searching for wealth but often finds only danger.

name: True Ghost Horse
description: Not a spectre, not a zombie, not a horse of a spooky color—the True Ghost Horse is the actual shade of a deceased mount, returned from beyond the equine grave.

name: Valiant Sovngarde Charger
description: "It's said that when a worthy Nord seeks a glorious end, Sovngarde will send them a fleet steed to spirit them to their final battle, but pay no mind to skalds who sing of a horse of many legs."—Clever Woman Moritra

name: Varen's Revelry Courser
description: A steed worthy of an emperor, this courser represents the finest traits of Imperial equestrian skill. Steady and strong with an incredibly smooth gait, this mount could help its rider fell countless kingdoms.

name: Viridian Iron Steed
description: Scholars disagree on whether these iron atronach steeds took on the aeonstone hues during the summoning ritual intentionally or after by mistake. Motives aside, riders magically summon these mounts, creating an impressively explosive visual impact.

name: Vitrine Dwarven Horse
description: "A horse-shaped Dwarven mount constructed of Ebony, Adamant, Dwarven Metal, and Glass? Sure, why not? The Dwemer could build almost anything, and seemed determined to prove it." —Herebane, Nord "Scholar of the Vanished"

name: Wasseek Horse-Lizard
description: Only the Wasseek-haleel would breed such a colorful and sweet-natured horse-lizard. Ideal for those times when you're wandering through Murkmire, looking for trouble to quash.

name: Welkynd-Born Courser
description: "Pregnant mares imbued by a welkynd stone in a lengthy ritual may bear these steeds, my sources say. Additionally, as the Nenalata evacuated, they took with them glowing barding that bolstered these steeds' tirelessness."—Beredalmo the Signifier

name: White Mane Horse
description: A rare, highly sought cross between a midnight steed and a Skyrim ice-horse.

name: White Spotted Courser
description: Bred for speed and battle, the White Spotted Courser holds a special place in the hearts of war historians due to their prominence as cavalry mounts in the Battle of Dragon Wall.

name: White-Gold Imperial Courser
description: Created after years of extensive breeding, the White-Gold Imperial Courser is said to be the most beautiful horse in all of Tamriel. With its almost ethereal beauty, these horses are owned by only the wealthiest riders.

name: Whiterun Mountain Charger
description: With barding featuring Whiterun's heraldry, this indomitable horse remains sure-footed in the snowy mountains of Skyrim and beyond. Majestic!

name: Whiterun Windsteed
