description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Medium Shoulder Mane
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Mid-Parted Shoulder-Length
description: A classic traditional look, popular with every race on Tamriel (if they have hair instead of spines).

name: Midhair Center Crest
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Mini-Pony with Braids
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Misanthropic Lycanthrope
description: You remain untamed and unruly, as does your crowning glory: your hair. Even better? You're not afraid to show it.

name: Modest Dual Crests
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Multi-Spined Skull Crest
description: This menacing look is a favorite of surly teen-aged Argonians in the more unsavory parts of Gideon.

name: No Hair Style
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Pact Veteran's Battle Crest
description: Going to war may mean donning a helm, but beneath it an honored Pact warrior is entitled to wear this official Alliance Battle Crest, which keeps hair under control while still looking superb.

description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Pony Mullet
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Ponytail with Braidlocks
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Portside Shave
description: Shaved to port, with a radical comb-over to starboard. You look like you mean business, soldier.

name: Pulled Back Curl Cluster
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Quadratic Web Crest
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Ragged Royal Page Cut
description: Bangs with ear-length sides is the hallmark hairstyle of Royal Pages across Tamriel. This variant is a little wilder, for a page with rage.

name: Right-Parted Cropped
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Roostertail Frills
description: What could seem more adventurous than looking like you're always marching into a stiff headwind? Big frills for big thrills!

name: Rotmeth Hangover Bed-Head
description: You probably shouldn't have had that last flagon, but Daedra take it! Life's too short to worry.

name: Seafarer's Crowning Trim
description: The wind-swept waves of the Sea of Ghosts is no place for bare heads, fanciful hats, or a loose shaggy mane. Keep your locks bound as tightly as your sails with these ropy braids and horker-tusk charms and you'll have no fear of the harshest gales.

name: Shaved Warrior Ponytail
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Shaved Warrior Topknot
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Short Back-Pulled Pony
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Short Dreadacles
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Short Imperial
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Short Mane
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Short Mane with Ponytail
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Short Mussed Wave
description: With a head of hair this awesome, who needs braids, beads, or wraps? Those curls are strictly au naturel.

name: Short Tight Curls
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Short-Spiked Crest
description: If you've always wanted to look like the teeth of a circular saw were erupting from your cranium, this is the style for you. Get serious.

name: Shorthair Center Crest
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Shorthair Fuzz Crest
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Sidelong Sweep
description: Nord sea raiders from the coasts of Skyrim first popularized this style, a visible demonstration of its wearer's commitment to going all-in. Not for the cautious.

name: Sideswept Bun
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Six-Spike Parietal Array
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Small Averted Spines
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Spiked Frisee
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Spiky Cranial Cluster
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Spiky Sweptback Updo
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Sweetroll Dreads
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Tall Dual Web Crests
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Tallhair Center Crest
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: The Adoring Stand
description: By Azura, by Azura, by Azura! Destined to be a Grand Champion with more admirers than you know what to do with? Maybe you're just hoping your hero will notice you. This bold hairstyle is just what you need to get your adventures started!

name: The Casual Rascal
description: Everyone knows somebody who wears this head of hair: they may lead you into mischief, but you know you'll have a good time.

name: The Heroic Poet
description: Oh, you romantic devil, tossing off quatrains and epigrams as you charge into battle to defend the underdog! You know who you are, and this is your hair.

name: The New Recruit
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: The Spines of Welcome
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: The Standing Flame
description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to conjure a small Flame Atronach and have it perch atop your head like a standing hairdo of fire? Wonder no more! The Standing Flame is here for YOU.

name: The Standing Wave
description: Do you stand tall and proud, adventurer? Then so should your hair! Add to your already impressive height with The Standing Wave, the hairdo that's sweeping the Fighters Guild.

name: The Tousled Bard
description: What could be more romantic than a Khajiiti singing poet—with hair to match?

name: Tight Braided Crown
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Tight-Curled Hair Helmet
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Titanborn's Tresses
description: Many have taken inspiration from the heroics of Lyris Titanborn. From her armor and skill on the battlefield, to the way she wears her hair, many across Tamriel strive to emulate her likeness in any way they can.

name: Topknot Cascade
description: Whether it's a flow of hair or spikes, this stunning style shows the world that you're ready to take it on. No holds barred.

name: Topknot Ponytail
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Triple Web Crest
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Unruly Bangs
description: You're a true wild child whose hair simply cannot be controlled—like your spirit. Go ahead, shake that unruly mop!

name: Warrior Topknots
description: If one topknot isn't enough to express how tough you are, how about two dozen? That'll show 'em.

name: Wavy Triple Braided Updo
description: Inspired by the mesas and buttes of southern Hammerfell, this updo is a striking look for your next semi-formal affair.

name: White River Braids
description: Extravagant White River braids—they're not just for Nords anymore! Long pale tails, first popularized by the Priestesses of Kyne, now available in every salon.

name: Widespread Cranial Spikes
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Widow's Peak Comb-Back
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Wrapped Horsetail
description: Gather your flowing mane into a single towering topknot with the Wrapped Horsetail, a favorite among officers and bandit leaders.

name: Wrapped Pony Dreads
description: One of the standard hairstyles available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Wrestler's Buzz Cut
description: Some warriors just want to keep it short, simple, and serious. Deadly serious.

name: "Clever Man" Wizard Hat
description: In the traveling comedy troupes of Tamriel, the recurring mage character is known as Fantasticus the Clever Man, and he wears the signature broad-brimmed pointy hat that just says "wizard" to the average citizen.

name: 12-Point Antler Skullcap
description: The rank of a Hunter of Hircine is said to be marked by the number of points on his cap's antlers. Plus they're always prepared for a game of ring-toss!

name: 14-Point Antler Skullcap
description: For when twelve points just aren't enough! But watch those low doorways, scout.

name: Abah's Watch Turban
description: Feel dapper yet cool under the desert sun by donning the Abah's Watch Turban, the head-wrapping of the stylish Hew's Bane guards!

name: Abah's Watch Turban with Mask
description: At your next desert soiree, be stylish yet mysterious, intriguing and tantalizing, by combining the Abah's Watch Turban with a feature-concealing mask.

name: Alliance Rider Hood
description: Wear the Alliance Rider Hood and proudly display your army's bold heraldic symbol, whether it's the Eagle, the Lion, or the Dragon! Appearance is specific to your character's alliance. This collectible is not dyeable.

name: Archaic Dragon Priest Mask
description: Dragon Priest Masks came in many variations, but one classic design was more notorious than all the others, the look that Nord historians have come to term the "Archaic" form.

name: Arena Gladiator Helm
description: Tamriel's prestigious and popular Arena Gladiators have an intimidating look all their own. This costume Gladiator Helm enables anyone to adopt their distinctive profile.

name: Arkthzand Anfractuosity Shroud
description: "Though the helm's central focal point seems odd, perhaps it protected a Dwarf from magic meant to affect the mind. Wearing it makes my thoughts feel muffled. Oh, to be a Dwarf and know for sure this helm's purpose."—Mathinn Palard, University of Gwylim

name: Arkthzand Flanged Auspice Shroud
description: "Many feel as if they've already worn this helm once settling it on their head for the first time. Given this and its use of aetherium, we hypothesize that the stone augments some form of Dwarven augury magic."—Mathinn Palard, University of Gwylim

name: Arkthzand Insight Vertex Shroud
description: "Simply looking upon the vertices formed by durable curves and lines makes me feel easy with my thoughts. Perhaps, to Dwarves, wearing this helm helped provide greater insight into whatever puzzle confounded them."—Mathinn Palard, University of Gwylim

name: Ass-Ears Jester Cap
description: Back in the First Era, fools and harlequins used to wear actual donkey ears on their hats as symbols of their profession. Over time the floppy ears have become merely symbolic, but the Ass-Ears Jester Cap is still charmingly goofy.

name: Auroran Commander Helm
description: After Umaril the Unfeathered bound himself to Meridia's realm, he started his "ruin-from-afar" campaigns, sending servants out to deal with his foes. The commanders among them wore these helms to denote their rank within each group.

name: Ayleid Royal Crown
description: A replica of the First Era royal crown of one of the last Ayleid kingdoms in Cyrodiil.

name: Bi-Color Coxcomb Cap
description: Even fools and jesters have a hierarchy—only the best-looking or most aristocratic are entitled to call themselves Coxcombs and wear the coveted Bi-Color Cap! Do you think you qualify?

name: Blackmarrow Necro-Turban
description: Raise the dead in style in your Blackmarrow Necro-Turban, featuring a sinister upper-face half-visor and twin metallo-antlers. Pairs well with zombie mounts and the Fang Lair crafting style.

name: Blooming Bouquet Hat
description: Be the personification of spring itself in the vibrant Blooming Bouquet Hat, bringing colorful cheer wherever you go!

name: Blossom Burst Bonnet
description: Who says a flower garden can't look aggressive? Your enemies will be abashed and taken aback when you bound into battle in your Blossom Burst Bonnet!

name: Bonding Rite Headdress
description: For the Argonian tribes that follow the custom, the Bonding Rite is a significant ceremony that requires an appropriately gaudy headdress to mark its importance.

name: Brass Fortress Rebreather
description: This full-coverage articulated metal mask is like a Brass Fortress for your head, providing maximum protection against both environmental contaminants and walking into low-hanging pipes.

name: Breath of Y'ffre Mask
description: This otherworldly mask evokes the moment when the Breath of Y'ffre gave the entities of creation their names and shapes, and order merged with chaos to birth the Green.

name: Bull Antelope Tricorne
description: The brash and extravagant Bull Antelope Tricorne is a favorite among Minotaur fanciers, Nord berserkers, and the Undaunted, who have little use for subtlety. It's a hat that says "Back off, buddy." (Or perhaps "Let's play ring-toss!")

name: Bull-Heart Skull Sallet
description: This barbaric helm partly made from the skull of a bull is much like those worn by the Bull-Heart Warriors of the Reach in their savage Horned Triumph ritual.

name: Cadwell's Helm of Heroism
description: I say! What a jolly chapeau! That's good, solid Coldharbour iron—and at a pinch, one could use it to stew up a fine mulligatawny. Eh?

name: Camlorn "Lucky Bouquet" Top Hat
description: You're ready for spring in Glenumbra when you wear your Camlorn Sundas Top Hat sporting a "Lucky Bouquet" of flowers and a bright shamrock!

name: Camlorn Top Hat with Buckle
description: Top of Sundas morning to you, in your Camlorn Top Hat with a buckle!

name: Camlorn Top Hat with Shamrock
description: You'll be having the Luck of the Iliac when you wear your Camlorn Sundas Top Hat sporting a bright green shamrock!

name: Carnaval Feathered Headdress
description: The vibrant plumage on this Carnaval celebratory headdress stands tall and bright. Throw your all into revelries, feasts, and dances!

name: Casual Plague Doctor
description: Blights, flus, and plagues may bedevil Tamriel, but even the most dedicated Plague Doctor needs a little casual down-time now and then in order to keep those epidemics in check. Put down that mortar and pestle and head down to the tavern for some ale!

name: Cinder Mask
description: How do the Ashkhans of Vvardenfell keep volcanic dust out of their eyes and ashes out of their lungs? With a deluxe Cinder Mask, crafted from the finest netch leather and guar bone!

name: Colovian Filigreed Hood
description: The fine filigree on this Colovian fur hood helps you stand out in the crowd. Certain to keep your head warm!

name: Colovian Fur Hood
description: A Colovian fur hood, double-stitched and plain.

name: Courtly Crow Mask
description: Ingratiating yourself with the Blackfeather Court is a rare honor for a wingless cur! Display your respect for the corvid court with this flatteringly feathered—and seductively shiny—billed mask!

name: Crimson Garden Flower Hat
description: Everyone will know you have something to celebrate when you're bedecked with a wreath of crimson Narsis Peonies—so vibrant, so vivid!

name: Crow-Heart Skull Sallet
description: Some Reachclans are ruled by Hagravens, and those feathered terrors are protected by a personal guard known as Crow-Heart Warriors. Their fearsome helmets appear to incorporate the skull of a great predatory bird.

name: Crown of Misrule
description: Awarded only to the most mischievous and mirthful pranksters, this jingling gold-like crown is a symbol of great status during the Jester's Festival.

name: Daedric Death Mask
description: Daedra Worshiper, do you dare wear a mask that strikes fear into the souls of ordinary mortals? Then the Daedric Death Mask is for you! For as is graven upon its metal horn bands: FEAR ABIDES.

name: Darloc Brae Beast Mask
description: The face of the ancient Khajiiti warlord known as Darloc Brae, the Golden Beast of Anequina, snarls in bas relief from pictorial walls across Elsweyr. His feral, feline jaw is replicated in this Beast Mask created for the Khajiiti Havoc Dance.

name: Death Grin Skull Mask
description: You'll appear to be Death Itself coming for your enemies when you confront them wearing a Death Grin Skull Mask. Show your adversaries what's in store if they dare to oppose you.

name: Deep Elf Executioner's Hood
description: Ancient engravings tell us that a Dwarven executioner, or "Chun Abakch" always concealed his or her features under a hood of black spidersilk, a material that was also used by the Dwemer for funeral shrouds.

name: Deluxe Mourning Hat
description: This Flatbrim Mourning Hat strikes a balance, sporting restrained decorations that honor the remembrance of the dead without attracting too much attention to the wearer.

name: Dibella's Crescendo Tam
description: Stand out from the crowd with this dramatic tam! Crafted from the finest fabrics in High Rock and blessed by priests of Dibella, this hat promises to give you a pop of eye-catching splendor any bard would envy.

name: Dibella's Doll Mask, Argonian
description: When worshipers of Dibella wish to honor the Lady of Love by engaging in anonymous bestowal of affection, they don an exquisite porcelain Dibella's Doll Mask.

name: Dibella's Doll Mask, Human / Elf
description: When worshipers of Dibella wish to honor the Lady of Love by engaging in anonymous bestowal of affection, they don an exquisite porcelain Dibella's Doll Mask.

name: Dibella's Doll Mask, Khajiiti
description: When worshipers of Dibella wish to honor the Lady of Love by engaging in anonymous bestowal of affection, they don an exquisite porcelain Dibella's Doll Mask.

name: Dread-Etched Dragon Priest Mask
description: Instill dread in those who dare confront you with this Dragon priest mask! Scholars note it once belonged to a cult that claimed to walk within the dreams of Dragons, learning as much as they could from their masters.

name: Dwarf-Style Mage's Hat
description: This Dwarven-themed conical wizard hat and goggles is offered this season by Jork, the famous Tailor-Thane of Windhelm. "If the Dwarves were still around, and if Dwarves had wizards, I bet this is just what they'd wear!" says the irrepressible Jork.

name: Dwarven Crested Hood
description: This is a re-creation of the Crested Hood worn by the light infantry of Dumac's Own Royal Skirmishers at the Battle of Red Mountain.

name: Dwarven Master Miter
description: This is a replica of the headgear scholars of the Dwarves believe was worn by the "Tuathumz" or "central pylon" of their Thought Calling system. The three finials are either broadcast-foci, or convenient tabs for wall hanging.

name: Dwarven Spiked Miter
description: Though the spikes on this so-called "miter" look aggressive, scholars of the long-lost Dwemer believe they actually functioned as "etheric antenna" helping to pull in long-distance "Thought Calls."

name: Dwarven Visor Miter
description: Use of the term "Miter" for this Dwemer headgear is a misnomer, as the Dwarves were a secular race without a priesthood. The originals of these Visors are believed to have magically amplified thought projection, or "Calling."

name: Dwemeri Tonal Attenuator
description: Dwarven tonal architects were careful to wear deflective headgear to protect their ears and thought-organs against harmonic feedback fluctuations. "The Tonal Attenuator is clear evidence that the Dwemer lacked all concept of glamor" —Guylaine Marilie

name: Enigmatic Mood Mask
description: Enigmatic Mood, the mask of a performer whose character might move in any direction at any moment. Expect the unexpected from one clad in this visage!

name: Fashionably Deadly Hat
description: Some ruminate on their impending death when gazing upon this elegant headwear. Others see it as a reminder to live their remaining hours as fully as possible. You, of course, consider it to be one of your favorite accessories for a night on the town.

name: Feathered Bycoket Cap
description: Do you see yourself as a jaunty forest outlaw, plundering the rich and then making fools of the Town Guard as you escape into the nearby woods? Swashbuckle away with a quip, a song, and this devil-may-care Feathered Bycoket Cap!

name: Fibonaccus Spiral Hat
description: The Cheydinhal wizard Fibonaccus was renowned for both his exploit in animating the mermaid statue of Anvil, and for his conical hat that twisted into a spiral. It's said that when Fibonaccus was surprised, the hat would unfurl and stand straight up!

name: Firesong Obsidian Mask
description: The flame of knowledge burns brightly within you, eclipsed only by this obsidian-tempered mask wrought by the Firesong Circle. Though they protect the rites used to shape their magma-born armor, they gift these masks to those who share their love of lore.

name: Flame Atronach Face Visor
description: When seeing a Flame Atronach from the realm of Infernace, one has to wonder—what's going through the mind behind that impassive visage of fire? Now others can wonder the same about you when you wear the Face Visor that emulates that flaming look.

name: Flamebrow Fire Veil
description: By local standards, the Firedancers of central Hammerfell wear scandalously little clothing, which may be why they protect their modesty—and identities—by hiding their faces behind Flamebrow Fire Veils. Hot!

name: Flannel Forester's Hood
description: Just because your headwear serves as woodland camouflage, that doesn't mean it can't be comfy-warm!

name: Floral Skull Fascinator
description: Flowers! For your head! Flaunt your colorful style with this hat, and bring floral joy to everyone around you.

name: Fool's Cap and Masque
description: By tradition, after it's over no one mentions the high jinks that took place during the Jester's Festival, but some shy or reserved folks still prefer not to be recognized during the shenanigans. For them we have the Fool's Cap and Masque!

name: Forester's Hood with Berries
description: It's festival time! Spruce up your woodland hood with some bright leaves and berries.

name: Forester's Hood with Flower
description: A red flower pinned to the left side of your hood means you're on a wild hunt—for shenanigans!

name: Garden Serenade Mask
description: Looping floral choruses adorn the Garden Serenade Mask, promising gentle repose and loving acceptance in an environment free of all conflict and intimidation. Soothing.

name: Graverobber's Appraising Hood
description: "Afraid of spiders—or worse—landing on your head while you're scouting out a tomb? Wear a hood. Even better, wear this hood, which has a lens you can use to examine any treasures you find."—Paurges Aline

name: Graverobber's Mask
description: "Used to be that hacking up crypt-dust was just part of the trade. But times have changed, eh? Take a look at this hood and mask. Won't keep the stink of a rotting skeever out of your nose, but it'll help you breathe a little easier."—Paurges Aline

name: Hedge Wizard's Claw Cap
description: Hedge Wizards, those itinerant folk-mages who cast minor spells for farmers and peasants, garner respect by wearing gear that's just a bit outrageous and intimidating—like the Claw Cap favored by the Hoodoo Tinkers of the Dragontail Mountains.

name: Helm of the Black Fin
description: Breezes tease your feathered crest when you venture forth wearing this helm. Styled after the piece worn by Keshu the Black Fin, this Argonian-crafted headwear exhibits your dedication to this leader's optimistic vision for her people.

name: Hide Your Helm
description: Show your face! Put "Hide Your Helm" into your Hat slot to cosmetically remove your helmet, hat, or hood.

name: Hollowjack Spectre Mask
description: It's a Witches Festival tradition to masquerade as Hollowjack the Hollowjack Spectre, menacing the adults and mock-frightening the timid. If that sounds like fun to you, this mask is just what you're looking for.

name: Icerage Helm
description: "You hear tales about folk wearing these icy helms. Tales where they master deep rage. Ballads about how many foes they've ripped through with their bare hands. I see you've earned one. I would've loved to have seen that fight."—Dushugg of Orsinium

name: Imperial Mananaut Cap & Goggles
description: This fanciful take on the cap and goggles of the legendary Imperial Mananauts, adapted by Diocletia of Skingrad from an old engraving, is this season's must-have item for fashionable wizards of the Mages Guild.

name: Incognito Adventurer's Hood
description: Blend into the crowds of Tamriel's cities and beyond while protecting your head from the environment with this soft-to-the-touch hood. It feels so good you might never want to take it off!

name: Inferno Facade
description: This full-face visor looks as if an Atronach's flaring features had been captured in metal, giving its wearer the otherworldly look of an elemental Daedra from Oblivion.

name: Ironclad Sarcoshroud
description: Scholars debate over when this particular helm design first came into use on Annihilarch's Summit, but all agree on one thing: its imposing horns lead to many a nightmare for those who face its wearer in battle.

name: Jhunal's Owl Mask
description: Wise-Wing the Owl is associated in northern Tamriel with the god Jhunal or Julianos. During the Witches Festival she is said to warn the unwary away from graveyards and witches' covens where they may come to harm.

name: Karthwatch Spangenhelm
description: Tested in battle after battle, the Karthwatch Spangenhelm proved itself as indomitable as Karthald's tower redoubt. With this helmet, you have nothing to fear from the beasts of the Reach whether they walk on four legs or two.

name: Keptu-Horn Skull Sallet
description: The similarity of this traditional Nedic skull helm to the Skull Sallets of the Reachmen is strong evidence of the ancient cultural interchange between the tribes of the Nedes and the clans of the Reach.

name: Madgod's Turban
description: "Though accounts vary as to Sheogorath's appearance, several claim he wears a multihued turban. Would that I could verify this."—Excerpted from Mistress Valaste's journal, circa 2E 579

name: Malefic Standing Collar Hood
description: You know what's great? If you add a standing collar to a hood and half-mask, it suddenly makes you look more dangerous, sinister, and threatening. That's what.

name: Mask of Alkosh
description: You may not be a Dragon, but this mask reverberates with the fierceness and majesty of the king of these mighty creatures.

name: Mask of Bloody Passions
description: This mask only hints at your blood-drenched desires. Revel in your passions and feed with no restraint.

name: Mask of Entangled Paths
description: To attend masked revels in Skyrim and beyond, some vampires wear these masks to hide their natures from their prey. The knotwork design also helps other vampires identify their fellow hunters.

name: Mercymother's Crown
description: Some priests of the Tribunal don this crown during the Festival of Forebearance. Those seeking Mother Morrowind's mercy find its visage comforting. Those who would do the Dark Elf people harm feel something behind the eyes—a terror that they can't name.

name: Mirrorglass Crescent Headdress
description: "One of my seamstresses bought mirrorglass using my funds without permission. Thankfully for her continued existence, she created a gorgeous headdress using them. It keeps hair off your neck while making you look glamorous."—Olarra, Clothier of Fargrave

name: Modest Mourning Hat
description: This Modest Flatbrim Mourning Hat, handsome in its subdued way, is for those who feel it would be unseemly to wear ostentatious headgear during days of remembrance for the dead.

name: Moonshadow Wings Mask
description: The Lepidopterans are a sect of Azura cultists who conceal their features with elaborate butterfly masks. These have recently become a fad among the jaded youth of mainland Morrowind—and now you can wear one, too!

name: Muttonchop Skullcap
description: The Muttonchop Skullcap is formfitting mage's headgear that includes cheek pieces that extend down to the curve of the jaw. Distinguished!

name: Necrom Attire Hood
description: "Evening funerary ceremonies require a certain amount of sophistication along with the expected decorum. You can't go wrong with this hood, which pairs exquisitely with the Necrom evening gown I commissioned for House Redoran."—Selar Ralvas of Necrom

name: Nereid's Seafoam Coiffure
description: Born of waves and foam, saltwater Nereids clothe themselves in whatever materials lay scattered about the sea floor. They're masters at turning coral, pearls, and kelp into stunning headdresses that anyone would be honored to wear.

name: Netch Handler Cap
description: Also called netchimen, netch handlers domesticate and care for the floating fauna, rearing them for food, labor, and even as pets. Recently, handlers in West Gash adopted this hat as a badge of pride and to show their love for all their betties and bulls.

name: New Life Festival Cap
description: Celebrate the turning of the year and the return of Magnus the Sun in this festive New Life cap. With a bobbing ball of fur on the end of its tapering blue velvet wimple, everyone will know you're the life of the festival!

name: New Life Monk's Cap
description: For those who wish to celebrate New Life without tawdry and garish display, we offer this more modest festival hat, well suited to monks, simple merchants, and holy knights vowed to poverty. Because New Life is for everyone!

name: Nighthunter's Cowl
description: "Lord of the Hunt, guide my vision. Let me see through the owl's eyes. Let me find my prey. Let me pierce them with my talons!"—Prayer to Hircine woven into the cowl

name: Nightmare Daemon Mask, Argonian
description: Incarnate the anger of Oblivion itself with this visage of nightmare terror evoking the dreaded Dremora at their most frightening. Daemonic!

name: Nightmare Daemon Mask, Human/Elf
description: Incarnate the anger of Oblivion itself with this visage of nightmare terror evoking the dreaded Dremora at their most frightening. Daemonic!

name: Nightmare Daemon Mask, Khajiiti
description: Incarnate the anger of Oblivion itself with this visage of nightmare terror evoking the dreaded Dremora at their most frightening. Daemonic!

name: Oblivion Explorer's Headwrap
description: Originally created by a now-forgotten Breton whose search for knowledge of obscure magic led him into the Deadlands, this innovative headgear is a must-have for any wandering the unforgiving wilds of Oblivion.

name: Pentarch Vassal's Oathmask
description: With your oath of loyalty to the Gray Host newly given and your mask of office firmly in place, nothing can stop you from working to gain freedom from slavery to a vile master.

name: Plumed Cavalier
description: "You envy my hat, do you? The plume! So sleek! Plucked from a fellrunner named Hasty Hastir before it could haste away. The brim adds intrigue and romance, perfect for one's day off. Don't you agree?"—Akkhiri

name: Plumed Mourning Hat
description: This Plumed Flatbrim Mourning Hat is for those who feel that, while it's important to honor the deceased on the days of remembrance for the dead, that doesn't mean the living have to look dull and dowdy.

name: Plumed Wide-Brim Acorn-Warder
description: "Ever been to Valenwood and seen them huge graht-oaks? The biggest ones have acorns as big as your head. Yes! That big! Heavy, too, with points on 'em. I won't go into those woods without my Wide-Brim Acorn-Warder hat. Save your life."

name: Psijic Skullcap
description: Psijic Order mages—and others who have earned the privilege—may choose to wear these official Skullcaps. They're stylish in an austere way, and keep flyaway hair out of their conjurations.

name: Pumpkin Spectre Mask
description: It's a Witches Festival tradition to masquerade as Hollowjack the Pumpkin Spectre, menacing the adults and mock-frightening the timid. If that sounds like fun to you, this mask is just what you're looking for.

name: Radius Mask
description: Clockwork Apostles who must venture into the frequently-inclement weather outside the Brass Fortress protect their eyes and faces by wearing a Radius Mask of synthetic wool and vitrine. Mysterious!

name: Radius Rebreather
description: Apostles who still have their original, organic lungs may want to protect them out in the Radius by investing in a full-hood Rebreather, which keeps out the storm-blown metallic motes that can lead to "brass lung."

name: Ragebound Mask
description: "You might think the bone of this mask would shatter in a single blow? No, it's tempered. By fire, by blood, by magic. It protects your head while making you look fearsome. And I'm terribly proud of it. "—Mage Baxold, Ragebound Scholar

name: Rajhin's Cat Mask
description: During the Witches Festival, no one perpetrates more cunning and devious tricks than Rajhin the Footpad, the Purring Liar. This mask enables you to adopt one of the many faces of that consummate trickster.

name: Reach-Mage Ceremonial Skullcap
description: Many among the Reach clans believe they can draw power from the trophies of their hunts. Conjure the blessings of the Horned Huntsman with this sacred headdress fashioned from the deadly beasts of the Reach.

name: Renegade Dragon Priest Mask
description: This hood and visor is a replica of the imposing mask worn by Zaan, the renegade Dragon Priest of the Scalecaller cult.

name: Reveries Flowervine Mask
description: This is the mask chosen when an actor of the House of Reveries must represent growth, nature, or an aspect of Y'ffre. Ready to perform your interpretive dance of springtime? Here's the mask you need!

name: Reveries Quarto Mask
description: This is the very face of the Unreliable Narrator. Those who wear the Quarto Mask show not just uncertainty, but unwillingness to commit to any set conclusion. The Quarto is the mask of the Perchance Acorn, of the Eclipse in the Lunar Lattice. Beware!

name: Reveries Red Visage Mask
description: When the Red Visage appears on stage, the production has veered into tragedy, and the final songs will be of fury and remorse. This isn't the mask you wear for happy endings!

name: Reveries Veiled Mask
description: The Face Half Veiled represents a character whose motives and intentions are obscure and as yet unknown. Feeling mysterious? Don the Reveries Veiled Mask!

name: Rootbrim Hat with Berries
description: As the swirling roots and vines symbolize the Wild Hunt, the addition of a sprig of berries represents the taming of chaos by Y'ffre.

name: Rootbrim Hat with Flower
description: The flower added to this hat's wild roots and vines represents the stability that followed the Great Naming.

name: Royal Courier Hood
description: While traveling swiftly toward their goal, a royal courier deals with harsh climates and rough weather conditions, such as Skyrim's snow. With this sturdy hood, a courier gains protection against these hazards so that they can focus on the task at hand.

name: Ruffian's Turban Balaclava
description: When you're doing stealthy work, it pays to be practical. The Turban Balaclava is quiet, shows a low profile, and most importantly hides your features in case there's an inconvenient witness.

name: Sacred Watcher Hood
description: Scholar Leane Ascien spends pages outlining the process to attract a Watcher to wrap around the heads of a Mora follower. The knowledge exchanged and protection granted is a sacred experience, if uncomfortable. When done, the Watcher removes the memory.

name: Sadrith Mora Quilted Snood
description: Once a person reaches a certain station in life, they wish to dress so as to reflect that honor and dignity, if only out of self-respect. The Sadrith Mora Quilted Snood sends the message that you are a person of consequence in the community.

name: Sailor-at-Arms Helm
description: When confronting foes on a ship's deck, you need head protection that fits snugly and provides cushion against potential blows. Luckily, armorer Arienne Mathierry of Gonfalon Bay crafted just the thing for warrior-sailors like you!

name: Savvy Scoundrel's Mask
description: This mask and cloth cap combination became popular with pirates and invaders alike for its ability to hide the wearer's features without sacrificing their threatening appearance.

name: Scarecrow Spectre Mask
description: Folk all across Tamriel know that during the Witches Festival you don't linger near the harvested fields, lest the Scarecrow Spectre come and take your head. Now you can masquerade as this legendary bogeyman!

name: Scavenger Legion Helm
description: "If you see a soldier with a swooping carrion bird on their helm, walk away. They're Imperials, sure, but this band of warriors survives the Cyrodiil warzone using tactics that would make a Dremora blush."—Hingor Netch-Eater

name: Scorched Dragon Priest Mask
description: Braving fiery foes? This mask is made for you. With its dark metal and limber leather, you can wear this knowing that only the most foolish or intrepid would dare try to stare you down.

name: Sentinel Fox Mask
description: Popularized at one of King Fahara'jad's festivities by young Maraya before she came of age, these ornate masks became de rigueur at Sentinel gatherings for many weeks. Some still proudly display them on shelves, while others wear them out of nostalgia.

name: Sideburn Skullcap
description: This formfitting Sideburn Skullcap is popular with mages who want coverage along their temples, but want to keep their jaws and chins free to display beards or other adornments.

name: Siegemaster Close Helm
description: The role of a siegemaster requires valor, quick thinking, and a supreme command of tactics. This helm is often worn by such leaders.

name: Silvenari Felt Bycoket
description: This bycoket is the dashing felt cap worn by the Silvenar's Own Jaqspurs, the famous archers who form the personal guard of the Bosmer "Voice of the People." Under the Aldmeri Dominion, this elite unit has recently been revived by the latest Silvenar.

name: Society Domino Mask
description: Whether you're attending masquerades in High Isle or Daggerfall, this mask and hood provides you with stylish anonymity. Keep one in your pack for those last-minute invitations to another royal gala.

name: Sotha Sil Novelty Mask
description: The Father of Mysteries is known for his striking mask, which represents a union of the organic and inorganic. Followers don this mask as they unravel his esoteric teachings, while travelers to Vvardenfell don it for complex jokes after visiting a tavern.

name: Spirited Soubrette Round Cap
description: Entertain your audiences with flair and verve by donning this flamboyant cap. With its playful plumage and wide brim, this hat promises to command the eyes of the audience while shading yours during sunny spectacles.

name: Stag-Heart Skull Sallet
description: This antlered helm is like those worn by the Stag-Heart Reachmen, a sect that worships the Daedric Prince Hircine in his aspect of Uricanbeg, the Great Stag whose hooves drum the Blood Summons.

name: Sun's Dusk Winter Hood
description: You'll be toasty warm even in Sun's Dusk with this festive furry hood, crowned with a spray of lucky mistletoe that will make you welcome everywhere!

name: Terrorgleam Dragon Priest Mask
description: Those who gaze upon you will despair when you wear this mask. Crafted from only the purest of gleaming metal, it once adorned a cultist who assassinated every single person who impugned Dragons while in her presence.

name: Thicketman Spectre Mask
description: Folk all across Tamriel know that during the Witches Festival you don't linger near the harvested fields, lest the Thicketman Spectre come and take your head. Now you can masquerade as this legendary bogeyman!

name: Traditional Wizard's Cowl
description: When you're a mage, sometimes it's important to be able to peer out with menace and mystery from beneath the drooping rim of your stitched leather Wizard's Cowl. Otherwise, how will the common herd know you're a master of magicka?

name: Tranquil Reverie Mask
description: This mask connotes the serene mind and tranquil heart of one whose emotions are subsumed into the dreams of the House of Reveries.

name: Tusked Dragon Priest Mask
description: This is a replica of what Dragon Cult scholars call the "Tusked" Dragon Priest Mask. Though it's been seen in certain ancient engravings, to date no historian has been able to identify it with a specific ancient Dragon Priest.

name: Upright Antler Skullcap
description: Nothing says "Happy to see you" like the aggressively elevated antlers of this Bosmeri skullcap! First impressions count, and you're sure to impress with this splendid rack on your cranium. For best results, wax the antlers to keep them smooth and shiny.

name: Visage of Bani
description: "Delve deep within to find your darkest fear and use your might to destroy it. Only then will you be truly free, my dear."—Bani

name: Visage of Gohlla
description: "For our skills to flourish, we lend our magic to ice and spite. Each frost-tainted conjuration and ritual we conduct grants us strength and germinates the wicked seed of power within us."—Gohlla

name: Vosh Rakh Ceremonial Mask
description: Every member of the Vosh Rakh religious movement hides his or her identity behind a golden mask of Orcish visage patterned after Trinimac's own auric-tinged skin.

name: Wayrest Canto Chapeau
description: Delightfully frame your face using a jaunty chapeau straight from Wayrest! Enhanced by a feather plucked from one of Elsweyr's terror birds, this hat is as inspiring a performance as the artist wearing it.

name: Werewolf Hunter Hat
description: Werewolves are loathed and hunted all across Tamriel, but the region with the strongest tradition of werewolf hunting is High Rock, where the Order of the Silver Dawn was founded specifically to eradicate the canine lycanthropes.

name: Wild Hunt Antler Skullcap
description: The writhing antlers of this fearsome cap resemble curling claws caught in the midst of a horrific Wild Hunt tranformation!

name: Wild Hunt Rootbrim Hat
description: The curling roots and vines that wrap the rim of this hat represent the swirling power of the Wild Hunt unleashed.

name: Windhelm Fox Mask
description: "After my fox mask did well in Sentinel, I traveled to Windhelm and crafted some in their style. My timing was perfect! It was Fishing Day, and some drunken Nords wanted to fish while wearing my masks. I, of course, joined them."—Nandim

name: Winter Corsage Broadbrim
description: This is the subtlest of this year's New Life Festival Broadbrim hats, accented with a small corsage of winter holly and berries.

name: Winter Garland Broadbrim
description: Feeling like you want a New Life hat that's a bit more festive than one with a mere corsage? The Winter Garland Broadbrim offers a vibrant display of berries and fir crowning your brow!

name: Winter Wreath Broadbrim
description: Not satisfied with a mere garland of fir on your chapeau? Go all-out with the Winter Wreath Broadbrim, which wraps the entire top of your hat in festive New Life greens, holly, berries, and cones. It's a party on your head!

name: Winterhold Blizzard Hood
description: Be prepared for white-out conditions in the blizzards of northern Skyrim—or just radiate squinty-eyed danger in this face-concealing protective hood.

name: Witch's Infernal Hat
description: A hat says much about the person wearing it, so pick yours carefully. For instance, this particular one speaks volumes about how much you love the Witches Festival. (Don't we all?)

name: Witchwise Headdress
description: Reach legends claim the witch Naenra Waerr wore a headdress like this while creating the Umbra Sword. To honor her, Reach witches who pass the final test of wisdom and power set to them by a clan elder gain the privilege to craft one of their own.

name: Xanmeer Doyen's Feather Tiara
description: This gorgeous tiara is replicated from the intricate regalia of the Xanmeer Priesthoods. Wow the crowd and stand out with this beautiful plumage waving above your brow.

name: Z'en Vengeance Kiss-Me-Not Cap
description: When a Wood Elf vows a Vengeance Oath to the god Z'en, they may wear this tusk-encrusted cap as a symbol of having sworn off physical affection until the vendetta is complete. Admittedly, the Kiss-Me-Not is also sometimes worn just as a joke.

name: Abnur Tharn's Key
description: Grand Chancellor Tharn wove elaborate enchantments to mask the haven's location, furthering the protection of the adventuring emperor. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Haven of the Five Companions.

name: Lyris Titanborn's Key
description: Lyris Titanborn insisted on an excess of personal security measures for the Emperor, complete with multiple keys needed to access the haven. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Haven of the Five Companions.

name: Mannimarco's Master Key
description: Mannimarco secretly forged a master key that would grant total access to everything within the haven. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Haven of the Five Companions.

name: Sai Sahan's Key
description: Sai Sahan organized a grueling training regimen for all five of the Companions, much to their chagrin. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Haven of the Five Companions.

name: Varen Aquilarios's Key
description: When the Five Companions set about their quest to recover the Amulet of Kings, Emperor Varen ordered the construction of a haven for the search. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Haven of the Five Companions.

name: Abyssal Cephaliarch's Face Art
description: Librarians possess mixed feelings about any who exhibit the eye-framing swirls of Hermaeus Mora. These curators of knowledge honor erudition among those who seek their tomes, yet they fear the covetousness that can drive agents of the Golden Eye.

name: Abyssal Embrace Face Markings
description: Hermaeus Mora watches through eyes that are dedicated to him. Those devoted to knowledge add to the Library of Apocrypha by dedicating their eyes to the Daedric Prince and painting on more to give him multiple perspectives on their adventures.

name: Aldmeri Dominion War Marks
description: May these Aldmeri Dominion facial marks be the last thing your enemies see before you defeat them in Cyrodiil. For the Queen!

name: Alftand Glacial Face Tattoos
description: Tattoos that replicate the distinctive iconography of Alftand, the only known Dwarven site built partially inside an active, moving glacier.

name: All-Maker's Face Art
description: Skaal artists scribe waved bands, signs of the All-Maker's grace, upon the brows of the worthy. The ink they use combines the All-Maker's six gifts: earth, fauna, flora, sun, water, and wind.

name: Alliance Viper Pit Face Marking
description: "If you see folks with snake markings on their head, chances are they've survived many a fierce battle in Cyrodiil. Poor brave souls. You can tell some are ready to plow fields instead of spill blood."—Naire of Bruma

name: Ancient Dragon Face Marks
description: The additional markings that Ancient Dragon Hunters receive on their faces cause the entire tattoo to shift to a golden outer glow.

name: Anequine Oasis Eyes
description: "Though many dispute whether Khenarthi, S'rendarr, or another spirit grants these jade-green eyes to blessed individuals, all agree on one thing: Those who discover and share the location of an oasis to those in need earn them."—Sulema, Initiate Scholar

name: Apocrypha Corrupted Eye
description: "Oh this? Don't fret, mortal. It may look frightening, but the One Who Knows granted it to me personally. With this eye, the secrets of reality are no longer hidden to me. I see the truth behind the words on the page, and I am grateful."—Cipher Lielle

name: Archival Access Face Tattoos
description: Please the filers of the Infinite Archive, and they may just grant you a facial tattoo to commemorate your time beyond the stacks. Who could pass up an ink-themed tattoo that uses archival ink and makes your eye color pop?

name: Aristocratic Astrologer Face Art
description: "I asked the artist who will ink my face to use some aetherial dust in the ink when she mixes it. So, not only will a tasteful flourish enhance my visage, but a bit of wonder will forever be a part of me. I cannot wait."—Grandee Husni

name: Assorted Smaller Scars
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Automaton Face Tattoos
description: Some say the Mundus is naught but a great Mechanism, and we are but animunculi, like Dwarven automatons, turning like gears in some universal clockwork. But some mortals are just motorheads, you know? These machine-inspired face markings are for them.

name: Ayleid Face Ruinmarks
description: This triangular light blue facial marking shows off your love of all things Ayleid—plus lends authority to your tales of Ayleid ruin exploits! Who would dare refute even the most audacious of your stories with this symbol on your brow?

name: Azure Eyes
description: "Some claim those who ventured to Moonshadow, Azura's realm of blinding beauty, leave with these glowing blue eyes, but I think they're just the result of meddling with too much magic."—Bivale Saryoni, Scholar

name: Azure Sky Blue Lip Tint
description: Sky Blue Lip Tint always makes a bold statement! That statement being either "I'm a cheerful free spirit" or "I'm a psychotic killer" depending on the face that's wearing it.

name: Bards College Skald Face Marks
description: "Paint Dibella's beauty in gentle strokes upon your cheek so that all will know your muse and feel her touch when you caress the hearts of your audience."—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Battle-Scarred Visage
description: The life of a fighter is fraught with danger, whether it be battling to the death in the Arena district or dealing with ambushes on the road. Scars, and proof that you have the skills to survive, are the mark of a hirable adventurer.

name: Black Ballista Face
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Bleeding Right Eye
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Brow, Cheeks, Chin
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Brows, Red Strokes
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Cheek & Chin Bars
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Cross with Right Top Bar
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Cross, Cheek Diagonals
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Eye Pools, Red Crossbar
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Eyeliner and Lips
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Eyeliner, Blue Lips
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Forehead, Blue Strokes
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Forehead, Green Strokes
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Mask, Lips Sealed
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Paint Domino Mask
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Pointy Paint Pattern
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Radiant Paint Smears
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black Sacrament Mass Face Marks
description: Enacting the Black Sacrament is said to leave a mark upon the soul. Some few choose to make that soul mark visible for all to see.

name: Black Scoops with Pendants
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Black and Red X Domino
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Blackwood Carnaval Face Paint
description: Every region celebrates Carnaval a little differently. In Blackwood, locals indulge in elaborate face and body painting while festivities rage on. The bright colors are said to draw the gaze of Sanguine himself.

name: Blessed Life-Tree Face Markings
description: The mysteries surrounding the ancient ruins of Ayleid civilization are many. How you returned from your last Ayleid endeavor with the markings of the blessed life-tree on your face remains one of them.

name: Blood Fangs and Eye Shadow
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Bloodmoon Eyes
description: "When the blood moon rises over Hircine's Hunting Grounds, when true bloodlust has gripped his faithful, when the thrill of the chase is at its peak, it is said the Lord of the Hunt will mark his hunters forevermore."—Tales from the Hunt, translated

name: Bloodmuzzle
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Bloodred Sunken Eyes
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Bloodrune Face Markings
description: Join the ranks of the brutal Draugrkin graverobbers with these Bloodrune facial markings. These skilled plunderers paint their faces in a ritual that imbues their markings with a metallic sheen, allowing them to easily recognize one another in dark places.

name: Bloody Muzzle, Cheeks & Brow
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Bloody V Face Cradle
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Bloody Zigzag Cheeks
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Blue Ballista Face
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Blue and Coal Skull
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Briarheart Face Scarification
description: "Feather and claw. Marked for a Briarheart, eh? What called you? Reachfolk dreams? Daedric nightmares? A persuasive witch? All of these and more? It matters not to me. I simply want a chance to examine your facial ink."—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Bright-Throat Algae Face Tattoo
description: Cheerful face daubings in the Bright-Throat style, in colorful green algae dye.

name: Bright-Throat Chalk Face Tattoo
description: Cheerful face daubings in the Bright-Throat style, in sharp white chalk dye.

name: Bright-Throat Woad Face Tattoo
description: Cheerful face daubings in the Bright-Throat style, in colorful blue woad dye.

name: Bright-Throat Yolk Face Tattoo
description: Cheerful face daubings in the Bright-Throat style, in colorful hackwing egg-yolk dye.

name: Brow Shield, Cheek Chevrons
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brow and Snout Scars
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brown Brow & Cheek Chevrons
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brown Brow, Cheeks, Chin
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brown Cheek and Chin Bars
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brown Concentric Paint Rings
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brown Diagonal Cheek Bars
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brown Pointy Paint Pattern
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brown Radiant Diagonals
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brown Scoops with Pendants
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brown Vertical Eye Smears
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Buoyant Armiger Face Tattoo
description: Proven warriors of Lord Vivec and the Tribunal are entitled to display these striking facial tattoos.

name: Burn-Scarred Nose and Chin
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Carnaval Alluring Eyes
description: "A splash of gold never hurt anyone. And you've just got to do something to make yourself noticed tonight, darling."—Lyra Ignatius, Priestess

name: Carnaval Feathered Gaze
description: The burning passion within shines through your eyes. Feel your worries run down your face like teardrops of sin. That's what Carnaval is really all about.

name: Cathay Baandari Face Brand
description: During the Baandari Ritual of Pathkeeping, the highest ranked Baandari present bestows deep vermilion and brilliant white dots and crescents on a respected littermate. These marks acknowledge that the peddler lives by the Way of the Baandari.

name: Central Black Lip Smear
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Chalk and Coal Scale Skull
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Chalk and Coal Skull
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Chalky White Lips
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Chevron Head Paint
description: What is a chevron but a standing wave in the River of Life? Stay moist with this head tattoo.

name: Chevron Headwrap
description: Adorn your cranium with the standing waves in the River of Life.

name: Chittering Chaurus Face Markings
description: When mixed into tattoo ink, the insectoid eyes of the chaurus lend the substance a sting that makes gaining Chittering Chaurus facial markings an especially painful process. Yet the pain is part of the experience, or so both artists and recipients claim.

name: Claw-Scarred Brow and Nose
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Climbing Briar Face Tattoo
description: The Climbing Briar's twisting shoots symbolize your indomitable life force, while its thorns proclaim you are willing and able to defend yourself against all adversaries.

name: Clockwork Apostle Face Imprints
description: The striking Imprint Tattoos some Clockwork Apostles display on their faces are inspired by the mechanomagical circuitry of Sotha Sil's Fabricants and Factotums.

name: Coldharbour Corruption Eyes
description: "Legion Zero is coming with their glowing blue eyes to force that odious sludge down my throat. I can hear them. My only hope is that the transformation is not too painful."—Scrap from the journal of Tatius Nerva

name: Concentric Blood Rings
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Conjurer's Eyes
description: Success in Conjuration requires tremendous willpower and fierce, unshakable focus. Mages who delve deeply into the art of summoning often develop otherworldly features. These violet eyes are a testament to your dedication to the arcane.

name: Copper Bug Leg Tattoos
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Covenant Warrior Face Tattoos
description: Proven warriors of the Daggerfall Covenant are entitled to display these striking face tattoos denoting their heroism.

name: Crimson Flame Lipstick
description: Crimson Flame is a lipstick for the passionate, whether your passion is romance, adventure, or singing heartfelt bard songs in the local tavern on Loredas Night.

name: Crimson Trickster Face Paint
description: The Crimson Trickster hides his face with painted smiles and eerie grace. Two-thirds red and one-third white, this comic face is quite a sight! If mischief is what brings you glee, this paint will suit your revelry!

name: Cycle Behind the Stars Face Art
description: Khajiit believe the guardian of the winds, Khenarthi, embraces their souls and takes them to Llesw'er once they finish their true path of the moons. Some ease the grief of a loved one's absence by wearing face art symbolizing the wind guardian's embrace.

name: Daggerfall Covenant War Marks
description: You've donned your battle regalia. Now add these Daggerfall Covenant facial paints and confront your enemies in Cyrodiil. For King and Covenant!

name: Dagon's Aspirant Face Markings
description: "To worship Dagon is to enact his will in the world. When the victims of our great work crawl from the ashes and gaze upon your face, they will see only the face of Lord Dagon." — Fenrold, Priest of Dagon

name: Dark Eyeliner
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Dark Moons Headwrap
description: To show the Dark Moons on one's features often indicates defiance of social conventions.

name: Dark Red Lip Dye
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Darloc's Golden Eyes
description: "Darloc Brae, warlord that he was, conquered much in his life. Those with a fiery spirit and peerless martial skills sometimes possess the same molten eyes that blazed from the Golden Beast of Anequina's visage."—Sulema, Initiate Scholar

name: Dead-Water Blood Face Tattoos
description: When the fierce Dead-Water tribe goes to a formal declaration of conflict, the warriors daub themselves with red dye that resembles smears of blood.

name: Death Dealer Facial Markings
description: "I've been told this tattoo makes my cheekbones stand out. Bah. Who has need of pretty cheekbones? No, this tattoo honors the blood I shed defeating the deadliest foes in Tamriel."—Margretha

name: Death Grin Face Tattoo
description: This grim design is often worn by members of groups usually in opposition to each other: necromancers such as the Worm Cult, and the priests of Divines who guide souls to the afterlife such as Arkay, Xarxes, and Tu'whacca.

name: Deep Black Sunken Eyes
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Defensive Rune Face Tattoos
description: "Julianos, god of all that is known to be true, guide my eyes toward the answers I seek. Let me cast my spells successfully. Through your power, may my lessons be everlasting."—Ritual prayer to Julianos

name: Dominion Warrior Head Tattoos
description: Proven warriors of the Aldmeri Dominion are entitled to display these striking head tattoos on skull and jawbone.

name: Double Diagonal Face Warpaint
description: Warpaint? Yes! Fierce! Two slashes—right across the face! Back off, civilized sweetrolls. Barbarian warrior here! Savage! Warpaint! Coming through!

name: Double-Scarred Left Eye
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Draco Aerius Face Markings
description: Before body artists place Draco Aerius facial markings on someone, they wash the face with a concoction called "Dragon's Blood."

name: Dragon Cult Face Tattoo
description: Skyrim's Dragon Cult was exterminated two eras ago, but its powerful symbology lives on in the banners of the Ebonheart Pact, and in these bold draconic tattoo sets.

name: Dragon Vassal Face Markings
description: In ancient times, mortals wishing to express their utter devotion and fealty to the Dovah were known to wear these Dragon Vassal Face Markings.

name: Dragon Wings Face Markings
description: The Dragon Cult of the ancient Nords is long gone and forgotten—or is it? These Face Markings show the wearer's devotion to the Dovah worship of old.

name: Dragonbone Chain Face Marking
description: The bones of the Dovah have a powerful symbolic significance to worshipers of the ancient Dragon Cult, who created this Dragonbone Chain tattoo set.

name: Dragondancer Facial Markings
description: "Dancing among the Dragons. Wounding. Killing. It's not a job for the faint of heart. Whatever your motivation, and whatever your hunting methods, this facial mark expresses your resolve to destroy those creatures known as Dragons." —Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Dragonsmoke Face Markings
description: "All will see your fierceness plainly as it is now writ upon your face in Dragonsmoke."—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Drakes and Daemons Duel Face Art
description: Fire Drake or Pit Daemon? No one will doubt your commitment to glory on the Battlegrounds when you wear this face paint. May the best team win!

name: Dreadhorn Face Tattoo
description: The Reachmen of the Dreadhorn clan revere Minotaurs for the brute strength and savagery, a regard evinced in their barbaric but strangely beautiful sets of tattoos.

name: Dreadsail Face Tattoo
description: The Dreadsail adopted a tradition from Red Bramman's crew whereby anyone who has survived swells eight sailors high tattoos a gust of wind on their cheeks. This tattoo has even been used as a letter of recommendation when signing on to a new crew.

name: Dreamstrider Face Art
description: "Do not talk to me of dreams. I've seen your dreams. Your nightmares. I've walked—and flown—alongside you through tragedy and awe. Vaermina's gifts let me see much. Look here. She also marked my face. Today, I choose to show her art."—Tredyn Ildram

name: Dremora Kyn Face Tattoo
description: When the Dremora go to war, the Kyn adopt special geometric face markings that display their commitment to victory over dishonor. With these tattoos, mortals can look just as fearsome as Dremora.

name: Dremora's Kiss Purple Lip Tint
description: For the truly exotic, tint your lips with a color not found naturally on Nirn, only in the swirling depths of Oblivion. Dare you declare yourself a denizen from beyond the realm of mortals?

name: Druidic Knotwork Face Tattoos
description: "Use ash, root earth, or sea ink. Loop the sign of the united circles upon your face and look over the splendor of the forests and sea foam with clarity. Let Y'ffre guide your eyes to all he creates."—Ritual blessing of the Draoife high priests

name: Dwarven Centurion Face Tattoos
description: An impressive set of face markings inspired by that giant mechanical guardian of Dwemer ruins, the Dwarven Centurion!

name: Dwarven Geometry Face Markings
description: These geometrical face markings emphasize the lost Dwemer's obsession with numerical precision, and make their wearer look as tough as a Dwarven mechanism.

name: Dwemer Face Markings
description: Scholars speculate that the design of this facial marking indicates both leadership and inherent power. Whether the wearer already possessed these traits or wanted them is still up for debate.

name: Eagle Plume Face Tattoo
description: The Eagle: symbol of the Aldmeri Dominion and totem of the High Elves, expressing their soaring ambition to be pre-eminent in whatever they choose to pursue. This tasteful Face Tattoo displays one's allegiance to that ideal.

name: Ebon Dwemer Face Marking
description: Some studying Dwarven lore argue that the ebon pigments in this facial marking were present in the golden variant, but that the wearer's actions made the marking change from gold to black. Others claim this is a fanciful story.

name: Ebonheart Pact War Marks
description: Prepare yourself for battle across Cyrodiil with facial paints that exhibit your alliance with the Ebonheart Pact. Blood for the Pact!

name: Elder Dragon Face Marks
description: Blue pigment enhances the Dragon horns of this facial tattoo, creating a dramatic visual impact.

name: Eldertide Face Ink
description: The symbolic representation of tide, waves, and ripples form a disjointed but notable path across the temple, brow, and cheekbones in this traditional Eldertide marking. Friendlier druids say the symbols represent the ocean as the purest path to Y'ffre.

name: Enchanting Cherry Blossom Visage
description: Painting a sprig of blossoms from Auridon's fair shores on your cheek ensures the petals of your own elegance will bloom in the eyes of all who see it.

name: Eye of Shalidor Face Markings
description: "I see Shalidor's eye on your brow—you passed the final test set before you then. Well done! I shall make all the library's resources available to you at this point."—Librarian Nalinale, College of Winterhold

name: Eye-Briar Gemmed Tattoo
description: This begemmed Eye-Briar face tattoo gives one a barbaric beauty that's both wild and sophisticated, at home in the big city or around a wilderness campfire.

name: Eyes of S'rendarr
description: Mercy, compassion, and charity radiate from your eyes as clearly as the moons shine in the evening sky. Were you blessed by S'rendarr the Runt, or did your actions and words grant you this glow?

name: Eyes of Sanguine
description: "Revel in the moment as you've never done. Fix the passionate excess in your mind, then let it go to fully enjoy the next moment. And the next. Some say that with practice, you can see the debauchery of Sanguine gleaming from your eyes."—Seducer Trilvath

name: Eyes of Sithis
description: It's said those who enact the will of Sithis with perfect clarity will one day see the Night Lord himself. What that sight may do to the viewer is never discussed.

name: Eyes of Umaril
description: "Some say that Umaril the Unfeathered can work through mortals, making their eyes glow. You see someone with yellow radiance in their eyes? Think twice before pummeling such folk."—Globura of Gonfalon Bay

name: Eyes of the Prophet
description: "Weep, my child, for you have been blessed with a great and terrible gift. You alone know what is to come. Many are the seers whose words fall on deaf ears, only for calamity to strike. Pray for the present, and grieve for tomorrow." —Wise Woman Asani

name: Eyes of the Scamp
description: "Mix the sweat from your last kill with that of a Scamp. Then pray to Mehrunes Dagon. Might be that he grants your eyes a guise of sorts. Scamp's eyes, they call it. Good favor is what I call it."—Golor the Banekin Handler

name: Eyes of the Xivilai
description: The cunning madness of the Xivilai gleams in your eyes as you pursue your latest endeavor. Will you succeed because of, or in spite of, this new luminescence you've earned?

name: Fabulous Diamond Eyes
description: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, so they say. Although the soothsayers probably didn't mean it to be quite so literal.

name: Face Art of the Five Companions
description: "Upon their brow the marks of heroism are borne. Let these symbols show all the peoples of Nirn that this bearer is a bringer of light and justice, and that no evil shall flourish where they go."—The Seer's Adoration, translated

name: Face Imprint of the Psijic Order
description: Many monks of the Psijic Order proudly display their commitment to the Old Ways and the Eleven Forces with arcane facial imprints.

name: Face Soul-Mark of the Sapiarchs
description: The pursuit of perfection is brutal when the Sapiarchs are involved. They may look elegant, but these markings are a sign the bearer suffered in the application. Remember this—and the cost of conformity.

name: Fargrave Soullattice Face Marks
description: Any who seek to find loopholes in the Stricture of Fargrave know better than to do so when they see these Grasp-favored facial designs nearby. You may not be of the Grasp, but giving shady Daedra pause while in the Bazaar? Worth the marks!

name: Feral Favor Face Tattoo
description: "The horns of the Lord of the Hunt are no ordinary antlers. They are not for petty shows of strength or even deterrence. They are true weapons of the hunt, and they have been used to gore and rend as much as any spear."—Tales from the Hunt, translated

name: Fire Cyclone Face Markings
description: Impress your friends and strike fear into your enemies with these dazzlingly vibrant face markings. Be warned! This look can only be pulled off by the most bold and daring adventurers in Tamriel.

name: Firesong Face Art
description: "Burn your eyes and see through the smoke to the True Way. Submit your mind to the flames and be remade in the essence of nature's bliss. Y'ffre will keep your path bright and your heart's fire will never dim."—Prayer said during the festival of Y'ffelon

name: First Cat's Pride Tattoo
description: "Your body knows much it doesn't tell. With artistry, we can call forth the First Cat's Pride so that you may guide others in Alkosh's path. They will see the golden fire on your body and follow."—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Five Red Rings
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Floral Skull Face Tattoo
description: This Skull Face Tattoo with a Floral design is worn by those who wish to honor the dead through a day of special remembrance—or just want to look coolly intimidating.

name: Forsaken Sacrifice Face Markings
description: "Nords are known for leading short, but vigorous lives driven by passion. Those with Giant sacrificial markings on their faces? The fire of life burns brightest in those with looming shadows cast over them."—Fadile Senoril

name: Fortune's Anvil Face Markings
description: Popular among the more zealous smiths of Blackwood, the anvil facial tattoo makes one's commitment to labor and commerce clear to everyone—especially Zenithar, the Provider of our Ease.

name: Frigid Impact Face Marking
description: The ice within which you contain your emotions is strong, but your rage is stronger. Express your fury with these cracked ice facial markings.

name: Frigid Ritual Face Markings
description: The symbol of the Icereach coven reminds people not to cross you and yours. If they do, well, the consequences are theirs to suffer.

name: Gargoyle Facial Flair
description: Express your inner gargoyle with this fierce facial flair. The gargoyle's horns are yours now. Will you use their power to intimidate gravely? Or frivously? Why not both?

name: Geometric Brow Scars
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Ghost Goblin Face War Paint
description: Certain Goblin tribes instill fierce recklessness in their warriors by encouraging them to think of themselves as already dead, chalking their forms before battle with what their adversaries refer to as Ghost Goblin War Paint.

name: Glenmoril Wyrd Face Markings
description: Favored among the Markarth Sisters, these blood-red markings signify one who fiercely defends the natural world while walking among the wilds and cities alike.

name: Gloomlurker Face Markings
description: "Look, I'll tell it to you straight: Don't mess with Gloomlurkers. They spent too much time in ruins and put some ritual markings on their faces after killing what they fear most. You poke them and they become your greatest fear."—Gloor the Glowerer

name: Gold Lips and Eyeliner
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Golden Eye Gaze
description: The glint of gold tempts many. Wear this at your local Carnaval party to draw a greedy gaze.

name: Grave Plunderer Facepaint
description: "People act like what we do is amoral, but you retrieve a trinket from their long-dead grandpa, and they're all smiles. Just don't forget to mark yourself as one of us before you start work, or we might mistake you for draugr!"—Paurges Aline

name: High Isle Mariner's Face Tattoos
description: "Want to earn respect from High Isle sailors? Laugh in the face of a mast-shearing storm between here and Amenos, plus feed a few pirates to the fishes, and I'll ink your face so that all know your spirit."—Florent Renaudin, Tattoo Artist

name: Highmane's Hero Face Marks
description: The Dragon King of Cats gilds his champions so their endurance and dedication may be seen by all. Those who bear this mark have borne great responsibility upon their shoulders and risen to heed the call.

name: Hircine's Chosen Face Marks
description: "Hircine called you—I see it upon your face. Your scars tell the story of the kill, as does the Huntmaster's scarlet marks. Tell me. Was it fun?"—Garlor of Orsinium

name: Hircine's Hunt Face Markings
description: After hunting some of the most threatening prey within Hircine's grasp—perhaps even under the Blood Moon—that Daedric prince's scarlet sign of approval now scores your face. Any who would become your quarry would do well to think twice.

name: Hoardwalker Face Marks
description: Seen from Outlaws Refuge to the soirees of affluent merchants, these shimmering gold facial marks carry with them the promise of more riches to come—if you dare seek out treasure hoards.

name: Horror Within Face Markings
description: Each time you look in the mirror, these markings seem to stare back with the judgment of your secret, inner demons. Did they just blink?

name: Hrokkibeg's Claw Face Marks
description: "You may meet the Mighty Bear, who is invoked as Hrokkibeg. He embodies the Totem of Claw and Fang, and comes seeking solitude, peace from labors, and renewal of the Burning Spirit Within. Beware, for if you rouse him you will be torn asunder."

name: Hunting Grounds Face Tattoo
description: When you wear the thorn and briar tattoo of the Hunting Grounds, you may be pursuer or prey, hunter or hunted, but either way you display your devotion to Lord Hircine, Master of the Great Hunt.

name: Inferno Ink Face Markings
description: Though once reserved for summoners of Flame Atronachs, these face tattoos can now be worn by any adventurer bold enough to try their daring look.

name: Inkwing Death Crow Face Tattoo
description: The fearsome Death Crow tattoo is a favorite of Reach clans, smugglers, pirates, and worshipers of Nocturnal.

name: Karthwatch Guardian Face Tattoo
description: Upon their one-year anniversary of service guarding the border of the Reach, members of the Karthwatch garrison have an informal tradition of getting a knotwork band tattooed across their foreheads to signify that they held the line.

name: Karthwolf Face Tattoo
description: Many of the Reach clans along the Karth River worship Hircine, the Father of Manbeasts, and take the savage Skyrim wolves as their totems. These tattoos evoke that heritage.

name: Ket Keptu Face Marks
