description: Only the fiercest and most skilled warrior-smiths of the Ket Keptu earned the right to bear these two-toned face tattoos. Do you craft your own weapons and wield them in battle? If so, wear these marks proudly.

name: Knights of St. Pelin Face Marks
description: "Envying my friend's wing tattoos, are you? If you want your own, join the Order of Saint Pelin. Once you've made your vows and served honorably alongside us, you may just earn your own wings. It's bloody work, though. You up for it?"—Sir Falbalg

name: Lambent Guar Face Markings
description: Under the light of the moons, after swearing an oath to defend the land, those chosen for the honor receive softly luminous facial markings. Maintain the favor of the land, and the marks continue to glow.

name: Large Black-and-Blue Domino
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Black Triangle Smear
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Cheek Diagonal Scar
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Cheek-Chin Diagonal Scar
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Diagonal Snout Scar
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Eye Diagonal Scar
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Eye Topographic Spiral
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Side Half-Brown Smear
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Side Half-Chalk Smear
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Side Half-Coal Smear
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Side Half-Green Smear
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Side Half-Red Smear
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Legendary Dragon Face Marks
description: Many Dragons have fallen before your might. Many respect your prowess in combat. And with these green-glowing markings, even those unfamiliar with Dragon hunting will suspect your ferocity.

name: Lunar Lattice Headwrap
description: Acknowledge the rule of the Moons Jone and Jode over all things Khajiiti with the Lunar Lattice markings.

name: Maddening Mishap Face Markings
description: Who needs goggles when you're as skilled as you are at alchemical experiments? Huh. Maybe we spoke too soon .

name: Mages Guild Sigil Makeup
description: Inspired by the Mages Guild, these markings use ingredients mixed into ink by an alchemical master. An illusion-working around the eyes finishes this mystical effect.

name: Magicka Everlasting Face Marks
description: Apprentices in the Mages Guild bond over stories of the day they fully understood the concept of "everlasting magic." Some go so far as to have a distinctive sigil with a background pattern tattooed on their faces.

name: Many Small Healed Scars
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Mask of Black Triangles
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Mask of Copper Triangles
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Meridian Radiance Face Tattoos
description: "The Light of Meridia bursts into your chest and then seems to come alive, coiling and burning throughout your body and head, illuminating you from within." —The Sayings of Valasha

name: Meridian Sunburst Face Tattoos
description: Celebrate the brightest light of all the Lady's Infinite Energies with these glowing Meridian Sunburst Tattoos.

name: Meridian War Burst Face Markings
description: Before battle, warriors consecrated to Meridia often paint their faces with these energetic "War Burst" markings.

name: Midnight Rising Makeup
description: "The midnight sky knows me. Its stars and moons lend meaning to my life. The tenebrous interstices reflect nothing back at me. So, any significance I give to it is both true and false. Does that answer your question about my facial art?"—Rendorien

name: Mirrormoor Eyes
description: The shimmering, glistening glow of Mirrormoor is stunning to behold, though few have seen it and remember the experience.

name: Mirrormoor Memory Face Marking
description: Mere mortals were never meant to remember Mirrormoor. And yet, its power emanates across the Threads of Fate, leaving some marked by this forbidden knowledge.

name: Mirrorscribe Face Markings
description: "Those who seek the truth must learn to bear its scars. What was constrained to ink and parchment may shatter the mind when brought forth from the shelf. All writing inevitably links author and reader, for all time, for good or ill." —Cipher Ascien

name: Mirrorweb of Memories Face Art
description: Some scars lie on the skin, easy to see and understand. Other are subtle, hidden by the trial of time. But some scars lie deeper still, only revealing themselves when the cracks begin to manifest on what was once a perfect mirrored surface.

name: Mirthless Mirror Face Paint
description: Not all is glee and merriment as we live through our years. Wear purple and white upon your face to symbolize our tears.

name: Morag Tong Face Tattoo
description: Proven allies of the Morag Tong are entitled to display these striking face tattoos denoting their service to the group.

name: Morag Tong Writ Count Face Art
description: When a Tong assassin runs out of room to count their kills on their body, they will elect to record new kills upon their face. Watch for these markings in seedy Vvardenfell alleyways, and run.

name: Morthal Champion Face Markings
description: A rite of passage among Morthal's guard involves surviving a night out in the marshes in the buff. Those who return bear this mark of their bravery. The rest bear only the weight of the crushing mire.

name: Mycoturge Face Markings
description: "The crossed mushroom stalks on my face indicate my expertise with crafting mage towers. Precision and accuracy meet at that spot. You need both to build a lasting tower for a mage and their extraordinary number of books."—Mycoturge Anisi Farano

name: Mystic Magicka Flow Face Tattoos
description: The mystic monks of the Psijic Order claim that Magicka flows through mortals in specific physical channels, and they can delineate these channels as tattoos to help mages focus their spellcasting.

name: Namira's Icky Black Leg Tats
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Necrom Armiger Face Markings
description: "Lord Vivec, heed my prayer. With your blessing, I traveled to Necrom. To tell my father's spirit of an oath kept, duties done. My honor as a Buoyant Armiger upheld. As my father smiles down upon me, the Dead Keepers scribe upon my flesh."—Armiger Relura

name: Necromantic Sigil Face Tattoos
description: Do you dare to wear the serpentine Necromantic Sigil that displays your dedication to the arts of undeath?

name: Netchspot Abstraction Face Marks
description: "Strokes of golden joy embracing rings of azure and bronze. These call attention to the spark of enduring happiness within you. You already love the idea of it, I can tell. Make it a reality."—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: New Moon Cultist Face Tattoo
description: The Cult of the New Moon demands much, and you've given it and then some. Show off your affiliation with this stylized flame facial tattoo.

name: Night Mother's Embrace Face Art
description: The Night Mother still weeps for her children. It is this sorrow that gives death meaning and drives her assassins into the darkness.

name: Nightmare Nest Face Art
description: "What you call reality is drudgery. We truly live only during the hours of sleep, when the Weaver of Dreams welcomes us into her many-layered nest of truth. See my face? This art marks that I'm hers. Live your true life. Join us."—Dreamdelver Marbruk

name: No Head Marking
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Nocturnal Indigo Lip Tint
description: Indigo Lip Tint is a popular way for worshipers of Nocturnal to do honor to the Mistress of Shadows. And it's not just for Nocturnal cultists: on the right face, dark blue lips can be strangely compelling.

name: Nocturnal Outlaw Face Tattoo
description: You stand strong in the darkness, listening to its wishes. You are a Nocturnal Outlaw, and none should ever doubt your abilities. Remind them with this striking facial tattoo.

name: Nose-Radiant Blood Smears
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Oak's Promise Face Marks
description: With its rich green hues and distinctive shape, this marking is a natural for those who appreciate and protect the living world around them.

name: Obnoxious Mute Face Paint
description: In recent years, irritating voiceless street performers with painted faces have begun appearing in all the plazas and market squares of Tamriel, begging for coin while pretending to be trapped in invisible boxes. Are you obnoxious enough for Mime Time?

name: Ode to Clockwork Face Art
description: Upon seeing these marks, some focus on how they enhance the cheekbones. By contrast, Assistant Maren of the Library of Vivec notes the connection to the Father of Mysteries. As if he caressed the recipient's face, leaving behind symbols of inspiration.

name: Old Salt Face Tattoos
description: Your tears taste like the salty waves you brave. Your muscles endure like the anchor that holds your ship fast at sea. And the moons dictate both the tides and your schedule more often than not. Honor these aspects with an artistic facial tattoo.

name: Pact Warrior Face Tattoos
description: Proven warriors of the Ebonheart Pact are entitled to display these striking face tattoos denoting their heroism.

name: Paint Mask plus Cheek Smears
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Path of Valor Face Markings
description: "The road to Sovngarde requires bravery. Courage. Perseverance. And much death, including yours. Wear the symbol of this path upon your face—to warn others that you stand your ground in even the most desperate plights."—Gerda Swift-Sword

name: Plague Dragon Face Stains
description: The followers of Peryite express their reverence through many means, including face stains that hint at their pestilent inner selves.

name: Planemeld's Master Face Art
description: Reverence for the Lord of Lies prompts some to adorn their temples with the horns of Bal. Terrifying in their simplicity, they should deter assailants. But some swear they can see the Lord of Schemes himself staring back from within.

name: Prankster Purple Face Paint
description: The prankster prances, filled with glee, as she plays tricks on all you see. With purple markings on her face, she'll bow to you with careless grace. Pray join her in her fancies free, and live life with frivolity!

name: Pride of Alkosh Face Marks
description: "The act of venerating Alkosh with ritualized facial art is an ancient Pride of Alkosh practice. In Elsweyr, we brought it back only recently." —Mo'khu, Moon Priest

name: Purple Paint Cheek Slashes
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Raconteur Red Face Paint
description: The raconteur tells stories bright to help you shine through darkest night. His voice will change from friend to foe, and back again to vanquish woe. Please join him in his quest for light by taking on the red and white.

name: Radiant Blue Strokes on Black
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Radiant Red Strokes on Black
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Radiant Ritual Brow Scars
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Rajaska's Snarl Face Tattoos
description: Namiira can grant power to those who fall, but at the cost of corruption to the soul and everything someone once was. Some rare few could help a Rajaska back to the light, but the knowledge of this ritual was lost long ago.

name: Reach Rebel Face Markings
description: Those oathbound to Arana wear their stark white and carmine red facial tattoos with pride fueled by inner rage. Even the fiercest clans of the Reach think twice before confronting those displaying these marks.

name: Red Ballista Face
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Bleeding Right Eye
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Block Scale Lines
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Brow Dots & Eye Lines
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Bullseye Face Paint
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Concentric Face Rings
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Diamond Face Stainwork
description: Resembling the glass forged in the fires of an artisan's workshop, this marking is painted on the brow of anyone who's been tempered by the flames of the empire's collapse. The marking may wash away with rain, but the vow remains.

name: Red Eye Mask with Drips
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Magicka Eyes
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Over-Nose Blood Bridle
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Paint Brows and Goatee
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Paint Diagonal Slashes
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Paint Double Square
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Paint Face Tentacles
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Paint Radiant Strokes
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Slash Eye Accent
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Sunken Eye Smears
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Zigzag Domino
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red and Black Death Mask
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Regal Eagle Wing Face Tattoo
description: The noble eagle is the symbol of both royal family of the High Elves and of the Aldmeri Dominion which they lead. Show your loyalty to this Alliance and its leaders with these eagle wing tattoos.

name: Riften Rogue Face Markings
description: They say you're bolder than a starving skeever, deadlier than a rutting troll, and quieter than the fallen dead—you had to be to earn this tattoo from the artist-thieves in the Riften Ratway.

name: Right Brow Scar
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Right Cheek-Chin Diagonal Scar
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Right Diagonal Snout Scar
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Right Eye Scar
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Right Side Half-Blue Smear
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Right Side Half-Coal Smear
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Rivet Scars: Cheeks and Forehead
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Rose of Tamriel Face Marks
description: "My mother wasn't pleased when she saw what I had inked on my scales. She would've preferred a rendition of the Hist or something from the Black Marsh. But I just like roses more."—Paints-with-Mud, Murkmire

name: Royal Purple Lipstick
description: By ancient High Rock tradition, the deep Royal Purple color has been reserved for the use of Breton kings and queens, a custom that may date back to the Direnni Hegemony. Now any mortal can wear a monarch's lip color!

name: Saint Kaladas Face Markings
description: Thorns and angles, ancient Nibenese symbols of grace and precision, often appear in shrines and votives to Saint Kaladas. Wearing them on the face shows true dedication to one's craft.

name: Saliache Scholar Face Markings
description: One does not need a background in Ayleid history to identify the origins of these facial markings, but only those with a vast knowledge of the Saliache Elves will truly appreciate the meaning of their design.

name: Sanguine's Indulgence Face Marks
description: "S'razar's mind felt seared by the wisps of flame. And yet they also soothed. It made the blood on his claws taste like wine. A voice allured S'razar. Sangiin called to him!"—S'razar, Carnaval Partygoer

name: Sanguine's Rose Red Lip Tint
description: This is a lip tint that proclaims its wearer's dedicated commitment to passion, whether as a follower of Sanguine, of Dibella, or of the earthy side of Morwha. Pucker up, adventurer!

name: Scarred Right Brow and Cheek
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Scarred Right Eye
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Scars, Cheek and Left Eye
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Scrawl of the Arcanist Visage
description: Scholars endlessly dispute the concepts hidden among text fragments of The Arcanist's Path. Ancient secrets? Troves of forbidden knowledge? Or, as claimed by one notable arcanist, the particular ingredients for an herbal tea blend?

name: Scrying Eye Psijic Face Tattoo
description: The Psijic Order has its eye on you—literally! These tattoos show that Mysticism enables you to see beyond the mundane and into the arcane.

name: Senchal Brigand Face Tattoo
description: The call of a lawless life sings in your head each evening. Maybe you'll help someone who's struggling. Maybe you'll steal an arrogant mer's coin purse. Whatever the case, your chosen path is reflected by your choice of facial tattoo.

name: Serpent Scale Face Marking
description: These ophidian tattoo markings are favored by those who revere Serpents, Dragons, and other mystical reptilians.

name: Serpentine Interlace Face Tattoo
description: This design symbolizing the intertwining of all life forms is popular with wyresses, Wardens, Y'ffre-worshipers, and all those who feel a special connection with Nature in Tamriel.

name: Shadow Stripe Headwrap
description: Head markings that resemble the mottled shadows of light filtering through the Elsweyr jungles.

name: Shadows of Blackwood Face Marks
description: Popularized by the legends of the Argonian tribes of Black Marsh that tell of heroes with trees on their cheeks, this face marking shows that you heed the Hist's wisdom. Join the ranks of famed heroes and carry Blackwood with you on all your adventures.

name: Shagrath's Favor Face Marks
description: Rarely do those gently gathered within Shagrath's web ever leave. Dreams of whispersilk strands tug upon the heart of her prey. And those few that escape gain a webbed brand on their visage.

name: Shattered Chivalry Face Tattoo
description: The delicious energy of Daedric artifacts tantalizes, looking for ways to corrupt more deeply. The first taste tickles the senses, creating cravings for more at any cost—and inevitably leaves its chaotic stamp on the faces of those who feast.

name: Shattered Mirror Maze Face Marks
description: "After a time, I found myself in the wending, ever-coiling hallways of a labyrinth. Despite the crepuscular atmosphere, I saw carved meter and verse 'pon the walls. The words crept behind my eyes. Beneath my skin. As you can see." —Scribe Maylen

name: Sheogorat Face Branding
description: Not all who visit Cheesemonger's Hollow return the same. Sometimes those who escape remember nothing of the experience and must forever puzzle over how these cheese and butterfly tattoos showed up on their faces.

name: Skald's Face Branding
description: Traversing northern waters exposes ships to dangers not found in warmer seas such as restless spirits. Skalds brave these challenges fearlessly, marking their brows in defiance of the unquiet dead.

name: Small Diagonal Snout Scar
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Soulburst Face Soulmarkings
description: "A great cry rose up across all of Nirn at the time of the Soulburst. None who felt it were ever the same, and those who saw it were forever marked by that day."—The Forlorn Soul, translated

name: Spiderkith Eyes
description: Those who wrap themselves in Mephala's web and help spin her secretive plots sometimes develop the keen night-eyes of her spiderkith. Ideal for navigating the complex strands of the Spiral Skein, but easily blinded by the light.

name: Spidermouth Scars
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Spoked Skull Face Tattoo
description: This Skull Face Tattoo with a hard-edged Spoked design is worn by those who wish to honor the dead through a day of special remembrance—or just want to look coolly intimidating.

name: Spore Savant Face Marks
description: "The twists and turns of a magister's mind become more pronounced the longer they bend their will to spore crafting. Perhaps it's the organic ebb and flow of the fungus? Flora flows into fascinating function. But you know that, yes?"—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Squarejaw Headwrap
description: Square the spiral with a cranial display of mystical tattoos!

name: Stone-Nest Orator Face Paint
description: Bear the sigils of the ancient past upon your temples. And may the secrets of the Builders one day be revealed to you.

name: Stonelore's Legend Face Paint
description: Instead of looking to recreate the mountains or symmetry of stones, Stonelore Druids developed a pattern of looping swirls and harsh line breaks. They paint it in charcoal and ash around one eye to represent the ever-watchful gaze of Y'ffre.

name: Stormsurge Face Markings
description: Artists in Shimerene paint the bodies of explorers with paints made from crushed shells. The designs are said to focus the explorer and help them sense the sea's temperament to avoid disaster.

name: Subtle Blue Eye Shadow
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Freckles
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Natural Makeup
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Subtle Red Eye Shadow
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Sul-Xan Prophet Face Markings
description: The Sul-Xan designed their markings to emulate the elaborate stonework of the xanmeer pyramids. Painting lines on their cheeks and chins before battle ensures that they will remain steadfast and resolute, no matter the danger or the cost.

name: Sul-Xan Raider Face Markings
description: Sul-Xan tattooists often fall into a bloody reverie when applying face paint to their warrior kin. Acidic dyes make their frenzied artistry dangerous for the eyes, but those who lose their sight in throes of chaos are doubly blessed!

name: Sunken Eyes with Insect Legs
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Swaying Skeleton Face Art
description: The Vaermina cult leader Larul first wore this facial design while presiding over a lich-making ritual. Her gleeful laughter still echoes in the damp caverns of Kingscrest Cavern. Yet, in the waking world, she is nowhere to be found.

name: Tenmar Leopard Face Marks
description: Those wishing for extra camouflage within Tenmar need only replicate the coloration of the Tenmar leopards upon their faces.

name: The Aurbic Eye
description: Mystical markings for your facial features to emphasize your anima essence.

name: The Black Drake's Face Warpaint
description: "When Durorach allied with the Tagh Droiloch coven in 2E 527, the witches added asp oil to the soot paint the Blake Drake used. Warriors fell into a battle frenzy whenever they applied the soot mixture."—Holwin, Scolar of Reach Studies in Haafingar

name: This One Would Like a New Nose
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: This One's Very Worn Nose
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: This One's Worn Nose
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Thorns of Ecstasy Face Marks
description: As the first roses of the season bloom, Sanguine's followers gather in candlelit gardens to caress each other's faces with ink—tracing a rose-shaped path of pain and pleasure along both brows and cheeks.

name: Thrall's Arterial Map Face Marks
description: When you're a thrall, it's helpful to ensure that every single vein in your body is visible so that those feeding off you can find the best sources of blood.

name: Threads of Mirrormoor Face Art
description: All destinies may be changed, as the children of Mirrormoor know all too well. They wear glimmering threads upon their skin, to remind themselves that fate and the future are of one's own making.

name: Touch of the Draoife Face Marks
description: With a few strokes of mystic ink, the druid council imparts their blessing. The Draoife's auguries foretold of this moment, though they remain silent on what glorious purpose you may yet fulfill.

name: Triptych Motion Face Markings
description: The bands and arches of this distinctive pattern accentuate a face's brow and cheekbones, making a sneer or a battle cry all the more distinctive.

name: Trophy of Balorgh Facial Tattoo
description: "Yeah, so, if you're going to decorate your face, you wanna do it right. This face marking? Balorgh'd say it's right."—Yarzurgakh

name: Twilight Wings Face Tattoo
description: Are you "under the wing" of a Daedric Prince? You may want to display your affiliation with these winged Daedric Twilight Face Tattoos. Soar above other mortals and swoop down upon your prey!

name: Umbral Snarl Face Markings
description: The Huntsman selects prey for his games carefully, for weakness makes for poor sport, but few are wily and tenacious enough to survive the honor. Those who do carry these umbral markings along with their scars.

name: Unfeathered Battle Visage
description: "The confrontation between the Star-Made Knight and Umaril the Unfeathered will fade into memory unless we keep it alive. Pelinal freed many from oppression. I hope, by inking my face, to invite conversations about this topic."—Lucius the Earnest

name: Unkindness of Ravens Face Art
description: Stylized raven art exists in several Tamrielic cultures. Artist-Adept Aimira, who created this tattoo, wanted something minimalist to draw attention to the eyes. "I pulled on the themes I used in the body art. The overall effect is fierce, is it not?"

name: Uricanbeg Antlers Face Tattoo
description: Adherents of the Great Stag aspect of Hircine often show these Antler Bracket Face Tattoos.

name: Uricanbeg the Stag Face Tattoo
description: Hircine the Hunter appears in his Uricanbeg aspect as the Great Stag, and is honored by his worshipers with the display of this distinctive face tattoo.

name: V-Y-Y Black Paint Strokes
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: V-Y-Y Brown Paint Strokes
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Verdant Skull Face Tattoo
description: This Skull Face Tattoo with a Verdant leafy design is worn by those who wish to honor the dead through a day of special remembrance—or just want to look coolly intimidating.

name: Vertical Black Fang Strokes
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Vertical Blue Strokes on Black
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Vertical Eye Mask Smears
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Vertical Red Eye Smears
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Vertical Red Strokes on Black
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Veteran of the Infinite Face Art
description: "Be mindful of wandering too long in the Infinite Archive, mortal. Even the most experienced scholar cannot comprehend all the dangers and delights of this place. And I really don't have time to go looking for you."—Filer Eru

name: Viridian Valor Face Markings
description: "The Bosmer have no qualms about stamping the 'opulence of life and growth' on their cheeks; it is a way to pay homage to their beloved Green. I say they're uncouth to wear such markings. We are flesh, not leaf."—Former Scholar Andania of Alinor

name: Warrior-Poet Face Tattoos
description: Decorate your epidermis with writhing, sinuous, barbed fingers of mystic energy evoking the imagery associated with Lord Vivec, Tribune and Warrior-Poet of Morrowind!

name: Warrior-Poet Skull Tattoo
description: "Colorful and intimidating. Truly, these markings bring the fire of the warrior-poet to your spirit as well as to your face."—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Werewolf Claw Face Scars
description: Those who've run afoul of the Followers of the Manbeast, Lord Hircine, may bear the crimson scars of their encounter for the rest of their lives. Badge of honor? Symbol of devotion? Trophy of a battle well-fought? That's for you to judge.

name: White Highlight Lip Dye
description: One of the standard face markings available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Whiterun Windracer Face Markings
description: "Windracers, sworn to protect Whiterun, learn their way around town without relying on vision. After they survive their first night battle, they gain facial markings to note their skill and courage."—Gerda Swift-Sword

name: Whorls of the Dark Dream Visage
description: "I saw the woman with the glowing lavender tattoos again. She wasn't smiling, so I asked her to. At first, she stared. A dreadful stare. Then she smiled. I only just now woke from the ghastliest nightmares I've ever experienced."—Relur Uveran's Journal

name: Wild Vines Face Tattoo
description: The sprig-and-leaves face tattoo known as the Wild Vines denotes a follower of the nature deity called Y'ffre or Jephre.

name: Windcaller Face Markings
description: "May the skies smile upon you, caller of the winds. We recognize the delicate mark of your office upon your face and know the path you chose to walk with your creature companion holds darkness and great deeds. Let us help?"—Nona the Wise of Solstheim

name: Winged Brows
description: Wings on your brows express your reverence for the divine spirits of the wind.

name: Wings of Darkness Face Tattoos
description: "Each of us has deep darkness within us. And we choose what to do with that darkness. You? You need reminding of that. Winged darkness, yes, to give you strength as you fly through shadowed times."—Artist-Adept Aimira

name: Wolf of Solitude Face Markings
description: Some call these markings the fangs of Solitude because those who bear them tend to go for the throat with reckless abandon. Fierce!

name: Wyrd Root Face Tattoo
description: The Bramblevine face tattoos betray a dedication to the darker side of nature magic.

name: Wyrd Sight
description: The most dedicated champions of the forest receive visions from their Wyrd Sight, a gift from the Sisters. As to what those visions are, well. It depends on the champion.

name: Xivilai Cruelean Linework Visage
description: "I have yet to gather the courage to ask the Xivilai about the markings upon his face. There appear to be dual blades over his eye. Perhaps to aid in seeing through his enemies' feints?"—Lady Finalore, kidnapped noble from the Court of Alinor

name: Xivilai Gleamwoe Linework Visage
description: Inspired by their devotion to Xivilai warriors, Gleamwoe cultists in Shadowfen trickle pigment carefully down their cheek and add more dripping lines with every high-ranking noble they kill.

name: Xivilai Rubyfire Linework Visage
description: For many mortals, marking the forehead with a tattoo or war paint is a reminder to fight with deadly intention. Daedra are very different, so it should be no surprise that Xivilai with forehead markings favor savagely headbutting their enemies.

name: Xivilai Vilegilt Linework Visage
description: Xivilai value independence and prowess over all else. What better way to show individual prowess than a smear of gold to add strength to a jawline and accentuate the murderous glint in an eye?

name: Xivilai Weltwine Linework Visage
description: Said to borrow the marking from Xivilai in the service of Molag Bal, members of the Icy Harvester cult adorn their faces with paint that looks like dripping bruises to show that they embrace the sting of pain.

name: Y'ffelon's Face Brand
description: Dating back to the era shortly after Druid King Kasorayn's passing, this vibrant forehead marking depicts the eruption of Mount Firesong. Used in placating rituals, those bearing this paint were supposedly safe from the wrath of the volcano.

name: Ysgramor's Chosen Face Marking
description: Add vibrancy to your presence with the blue markings that once graced those who battled at Ysgramor's side.

name: Zyggazag
description: Let the zyggazag on your features display your arcane connection to the Mystic Geometries of the Aurbis!

name: Ahz-m'Athra
description: Yahareni sought to survive by any means necessary when the Knahaten Flu struck Orcrest. Death won, and Namiira gained their corrupted soul. Now, freed from the Dark Behind the World by a foolish mortal, they seek an equal to walk beside them in darkness.

name: All-Maker's Senche-raht
description: Unlike other Senche-rahts, Thryn has accepted many riders in its time, though only a few have lasted beyond one battle. This is due to Thryn's habit of testing its rider's mettle with daring maneuvers and wild risks—all in the name of a good story.

name: Anchorborn Welwa
description: Born in the blasted wastes of Coldharbour, Molag Bal's ferocious welwa pursue their prey with terrifying tenacity. It is said that only the chains of the Dark Anchors themselves can hold the beasts back once they've scented their quarry.

name: Ardor's Devotion Senche-raht
description: "Why the flowers? Because this one finds them beautiful, that's why. Charging into battle together does not mean we can't enjoy their colors. And a battlefield littered with petals is a sight to behold."—Mathi-jo

name: Atmoran Snow Ursauk
description: Though fearsome in appearance, these ursauks make staunch companions when properly socialized. Their thick fur and hardy constitutions allow them to thrive even in the harshest environments, especially those in the northern reaches of Tamriel.

name: Aurielic Quasigriff
description: Taken from the nest almost as soon as it breaks through its shell, this quasigriff is pampered and preened as befits a creature sacred to Auriel. Its golden feathers are used as fletching by archers in Balfiera.

name: Azuredoom Wrathsteed
description: "The sight of this welwa's claws sparks something in my imagination, showing me different scenarios where those icy talons end my life. It's beautiful. In a horrible, gruesome way. I wonder if it can be tamed?"—Pyn Bossard, Welwa Researcher (Deceased)

name: Baysong Quasigriff
description: Unlike their mainland cousins, the quasigriffs of the Systres Archipelago have vibrant, sea-tinted feathers. Admittedly, Irastimil Direnni never intended to create such colorful creatures. Noble Bretons adore them and travel about High Isle on their backs.

name: Carnaval Welwa
description: When kept on a tight leash, welwas can make for a showstopping mount during Carnaval. Riders must be careful not to partake too much in the festivities, or their control of the fearsome beast may slip. What happens next is up to Sanguine.

name: Cursebound Senche-raht
description: Once known as the toughest Baandari thief in the Stitches, Abahayda ran afoul of a terrible curse in the Ashen Scar. She seeks a companion who will help restore her former life and vigor. Is that you?

name: Cursebound Senche-raht Darkfang
description: Zarnor, seeking to quench his insatiable curiosity, took part in experimental rituals that twisted and marked him. Though he still seeks to satiate his ceaseless desire for knowledge, he does so to free himself from servitude to loathsome masters.

name: Dagonic Quasigriff
description: "Burning ash and feathers dark, sharpened claws and rage—these hew close to the Razor Prince, or so explains a sage. Yet ere chaos warped this beast, Direnni crafted well. The Deadlands taints it with fell heat, impossible to quell."—Qilik the Skaafin

name: Dremnaken Wrathsteed
description: "Dremnaken are fearsome creatures with crushing footpads and jagged teeth that promise only pain. Anyone who can strap armor onto one's back and ride it into battle should be doubly feared. That's only logical." Nororlie, Alinor Daedrology Society

name: Druid-Bound Ursauk
description: "I prefer the company of animals over people. Communing with the Evergrowth provides a calming respite from the need to speak. This ursauk, for example, has proven most personable. And now, it needs a rider."—Druid Dolvasie

name: Dunewalker Senche-raht
description: The Dunewalkers once roamed deserts beyond Elsweyr, seeking knowledge amid the sands of other lands. Mighila seeks to return to that tradition, hoping to bring back information on how to definitively vanquish the Dragons. Will you assist her?

name: Duskfall Welwa
description: Using knowledge gained from the forbidden book Occaecium Beluaria, followers of Hermaeus Mora transformed a welwa into a multi-hued, darkly shimmering steed. He allows his most experienced agents in Tamriel to use them for overland tasks.

name: Fargrave Walker Welwa
description: Even the most well-traveled adventurer should tread with care when entering Fargrave. This haunting welwa has an uncanny sense of direction that allows it to traverse the many planes of Oblivion with ease.

name: Glimmertarn Ursauk
description: "We choose some of our guardians based on their overwhelming presence, like this ursauk. While riding it, I swear that the marrow in my bones resonates with her growls."—Rolmanoril of Glimmertarn

name: Goutfang Senche-raht
description: After spending many years in a Vrin-Thak adeptorium, this powerful Senche-raht decided it was time to work with someone who regularly goes toward danger. She prefers to learn by watching, however.

name: Grudge-Rock Welwa
description: These petulant welwas hail from Wrothgar and more than live up to their name. Hardened by their difficult landscape, the creatures delight in punishing their riders for the smallest slight, whether it's a late feeding or a slightly too-tight saddle.

name: Hoardhunter Ursauk
description: Gallivant across any terrain, seeking your next treasure, with this massive, gilded ursauk. Not only does it bear the blessing of Sai, or so its breeders claim, but its gear contains one element from another successful treasure-seeker's hoard.

name: Inkfur Ursauk
description: "Tales say Grahtwood's ancient oaks called these black-furred ursauks from the deep woods. But why? Every reason this one hears is different! Guards for a sapling grove. Help with a werewolf problem. Or maybe for bear hugs."—Zhiraz, Traveling Farmhand

name: Iron Orc Welwa
description: Iron Orcs labor hard and long, fight until their dying breath, and train mounts to do the same. So, if you're lucky enough to ride one of their welwas, expect to be pushed to your own limits as your mount keeps going despite all obstacles in its path.

name: Jerall Deserter's Tharriker
description: War deserters that huddle for warmth around bitter campfires in the Jerall mountains found common cause with these wild tharrikers. The wild magic that created them allows for rapid adaptation to the snowy slopes of their new home.

name: Kynareth's Quasigriff
description: "This quasigriff may look fearsome, but she's been touched by Kynareth herself. While astride, you'll never feel the sun's brutal burn, and all wind will be at your back. The skies be blessed."—Priestess Belklina

name: Lucent Guardian Senche-raht
description: Chirhazi has fought more Daedra than most know exist. She's become accustomed to the protective armor necessary for such battles and willingly allows her partner to be her eyes.

name: Midnight Cantor Senche-Raht
description: After spending years expelling dro-m'Athra from Nirn, M'aar decided to follow a new path. Now they hope to explore as much of the Mundus as possible before venturing to the Gates of the Crossing.

name: Mystical Quasigriff
description: This beast has been touched by the deep magic, connecting to the power between the worlds. It carried a draught of creatia back with it to Nirn, glimmering with potential in every feather and bone.

name: Nagahide Welwa Ravager
description: As stablehands across Tamriel can attest, the ravager comes by its name honestly, destroying anything that moves between it and its master. Scholars speculate that the blue Hist of Dead-Water Village brought forth this green-hided breed.

name: Quasigriff
description: A product of wizardry and selective breeding, these chimeric steeds descend from Summerset gryphons. According to creator Irastimil Direnni, their wingless frame kept upkeep costs low, while maintaining superiority over the upstart Bretons' clumsy steeds.

name: Queen's Claw Senche-raht
description: A scholar studying Mnemoli the Blue Star as well as a Whispering Claw warrior, this Senche-raht serves Queen Khamira with both brain and brawn. He volunteered to travel with you, lending you speed and steady companionship.

name: Reaper's End Quasigriff
description: Having been created through selective breeding and magic, quasigriffs have a penchant for absorbing any excess magicka they're exposed to. This stock was raised within the penumbral realms of Evergloam, as you can see.

name: Sagacious Psijic Senche-raht
description: Aloof and strangely mournful, there's no question Pirzbi wields powerful magic. Some say their innate ability and keen intellect have become an obstacle for those who wish to partner with them. Perhaps you will find success where they did not.

name: Sanguine Gargoyle
description: "Feed the stone with blood and wine. Feel the magic binds entwine. The Prince of Revels loves to take. The Prince of Revels bids you wake."—Stone Waking Sacrament of Sanguine, fragment

name: Senche-raht
description: Largest of all the furstocks, or "breeds" of Khajiit, the Senche-raht is fully intelligent, and in combat often serves simultaneously as warrior and mount.

name: Shackled Titan
description: "This titan failed the Dark Lord once, and paid the price for it. After he ripped off its wings, Molag Bal bound it to his dark will, making it a useful—if grounded—mount for his more faithful servants."—Worm Cultist Valoel

name: Speckled Welwa
description: This savage welwa so interested members of the College of Sapiarchs that they brought several to Sil-Var-Woad for study. To help endear them to the public, an enterprising conservator trained them to saddle and "lent" them out into the wild.

name: Spellscar Quasigriff
description: The unchained potential that emanates from the Spellscar twists and changes everything it touches. Who or what drew a quasigriff to Craglorn is still a mystery, but these esoterically beautiful beasts add something new and transcendent to Tamriel.

name: Spotted Duneracer Senche-raht
description: Years of winning racing competitions finally bored Hazazkheran, so he ran messages for the queen for a time. Alas, even that grew predictable. Now he wants to poke his whiskers into all the hidden corners of the world—perhaps with you.

name: Sul-Xan Fleshripper
description: Through an Argonian ritual imbued by the Razor Prince's chaos, this former welwa mount seethes with both fury and destruction in conflagration-touched form. Only the strong-willed can control this beast. Perhaps that's you?

name: Sunset Welwa
description: "Reptilian welwa are particularly prized among the Argonians. This could be due to their perceived connection to the Hist, or simply the fact that their scales allow them to wallow in the marsh alongside their masters."—Black Marsh Rider's Guide

name: Umbral Striped Senche-raht
description: When this beautiful beast lost their rider while traversing a labyrinth, this banded Senche-raht left to seek mystical help to get back inside. Since their efforts often lead them into peril, Nushaben hopes to find a partner for the long journeys ahead.

name: Voidmother's Welwa
description: "Come closer, Namira's chosen. Take a good look at this spectacular welwa. The Spirit Queen wishes to reward you with it. Of course, journeys with this steed will lead you into further efforts for your queen. Small price to pay, yes?"—Voidmother Della

name: West Weald Tharriker
description: "We subdued this one and trained it a bit. Poor beast, fresh from the Recollection grow pits. Doesn't know what it is or where it came from. Maybe it will take to you. Just mind the tail, now."—Fausta Arius, Legion member

name: Whispering-Claw Senche-raht
description: Feanirr witnessed the demise of her proud adeptorium, not to war, but to a sickness faster and stealthier than all but her. Since then, she lives only in the moment, knowing that at any moment something deadlier than her could catch her by the tail.

name: Worm Cultist Senche-raht
description: Legend says that Mannimarco himself indoctrinated this Senche-raht to the way of the Anchorite. It's unknown if Zalzagh knows whether this is true, or if they have any recollection of life before joining the Worm Cult.

name: Academ's Mora Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Hermaeus Mora.

name: Delver's Mora Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Hermaeus Mora.

name: Filer's Mora Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Hermaeus Mora.

name: Seeker's Mora Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Hermaeus Mora.

name: Slayer's Mora Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Hermaeus Mora.

name: Blessed Honeycomb
description: Gently harvested from apiaries on the grounds of Dibellan monasteries by the hands of serene priests. A component required to morph a Passion Dancer Blossom into the Hoardhunter Ursauk mount.

name: Gilded and Dyed Saddle
description: A specially-crafted saddle made of oiled leather and plated metal fixtures, sized for an enormous mount. A component required to morph a Passion Dancer Blossom into the Hoardhunter Ursauk mount.

name: Sorcerous Golden Ink
description: A bottle of magical golden ink used to dyeing fur or skin into magical patterns. A component required to morph a Passion Dancer Blossom into the Hoardhunter Ursauk mount.

name: Acolyte Deras Arelas
description: Told to go "find yourself" by a Tribunal superior, Deras traveled enough to find all but himself. Now he seeks a quiet meditation spot. After adding Deras to your home, you can set him on a path.

name: Adusa-daro
description: Adusa-daro lives by a code of honor, vigilance, and restraint—the latter being of particular concern for a vampire. Will you invite her in? After adding Adusa-daro to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Alchemy
description: Need some mirth and mystery in your home? Invite Alchemy, a renowned performer from the House of Reveries, to stay with you. After adding Alchemy to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Arox the Mutilator
description: Kneel before the mighty Arox and he might just offer to crush your enemies for you! But, as a daedrat. Not his former much bigger self. After adding Arox to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Ashur
description: As an assassin in the Morag Tong, Ashur takes his work deathly seriously. Invite him to stay and you need never worry about uninvited visitors. After adding Ashur to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Azandar
description: Azandar al-Cybiades is a consummate researcher and peerless arcanist. Just ask him! After adding Azandar to your home, you can set him on a path. You and your guests can also talk to him. Trust us, he's got plenty to say.

name: Barbas
description: Barbas, Clavicus Vile's faithful companion, loves being a talking dog. Why he wants to stay with you is for him to know and you to never find out. After adding Barbas to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Bastian Hallix
description: Stalwart and true, Bastian Hallix personifies the best traits of High Rock nobility. But in a world of greed and broken vows, can a righteous man persevere? Call this companion to your side and prove that Tamriel still needs virtuous guardians.

name: Biro-dar
description: Don't let Biro-dar's appearance deceive you! He's not your average scholar. In fact, he makes for an entertaining and trouble-prone guest. After adding Biro-dar to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Brahgas
description: Brahgas loves playing Tales of Tribute but needs a break to shake off some bad luck. Perhaps a fellow player like you can put him up for a bit? After adding Brahgas to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Captain Isara Davaux
description: Ghostly Isara may think she's still part of the All Flags Navy, fighting their ancient foes, but that just makes her a hauntingly novel guest. After adding Isara to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Captain Kaleen
description: The inimitable Captain Kaleen seeks some shore leave before setting sail for her next job. If you've a bunk for her, she'll gladly take it. After adding Captain Kaleen to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Caska
description: Caska the Senche-raht serves as the first mate on The Perfect Pounce, and she loves time off to pursue other interests—perhaps in your house! After adding Caska to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Clan Mother Tadali
description: Get ready for a visit from Clan Mother Tadali! She'll share her wisdom with you if you share your sunbeams with her. After adding Tadali to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Crafty Lerisa
description: As her name implies, Crafty Lerisa possesses a cunning that keeps her alive. Right now it's telling her to sit tight—perhaps in your home? After adding Crafty Lerisa to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Dhulef
description: Grab your favorite beverage and settle in for pithy tales from former pirate, current Mages Guild member, and Stonelore druid friend Dhulef. After adding Dhulef to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Druid Ryvana
description: Mysterious and kind, Druid Ryvana welcomes the chance to teach others about the wisdom of the Stonelore Druids. What teachings has she for you? After adding Ryvana to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Duchess Elea Dufort
description: With her grand tour under way, Duchess Elea Dufort hopes to see more of the world beyond High Isle and the Systres Archipelago. Have her visit you! After adding Elea to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Elsbytte
description: The Nord explorer Elsbytte and her faithful mammoth Muffins roam the wilds of Tamriel in search of adventure. Invite them to stay awhile! After adding them to your home, you can set them on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with Elsbytte.

name: Ember
description: A talented Mage and former street kid, Ember is a chaotic, earnest, notorious troublemaker. In short, she's a certified disaster. Call this companion to your side for a bit of chaos and help her fuel her endless curiosity for mystic knowledge.

name: Erilthel
description: Erilthel's quest to become Lady Twilight, Tamriel's greatest thief, brought her to your door until her teacher, Seeks-the-Dark, finds her again. After adding Erilthel to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Fennorian
description: Although arcane investigator Fennorian of House Ravenwatch also happens to be a vampire, he's one of the good ones. Dare you invite him home? After adding Fennorian to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Filbert Cienne
description: Ready to learn more about Peryite, the Prince of Pestilence? Then Filbert's ready to visit and share his knowledge. After adding Filbert to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Heiruna
description: Oh, the ignominy of being an agent of justice trapped inside a small floating doll! Now Heiruna intends to plot vengeance—in your retreat. After adding Heiruna to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Hezehk
description: Fresh from Madam Whim's in Fargrave, this irrepressible Skaafin immediately imparts a surprisingly upbeat atmosphere to your abode. After adding Hezehk to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Hildegard
description: When this fledgling Dark Brotherhood assassin isn't using her werewolf abilities to complete contracts, she reflects on her dual nature. After adding Hildegard to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Historian Phedre
description: Phedre loves history. A lot. Give her a place to study, and her gratitude nears "eternal"—as does her wish to share what she learns. After adding Phedre to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Hroltar the Boaster
description: The Undaunted, Hroltar, may frown upon modern convenience, but this Reach native is quick to make himself at home in your abode. After adding Hroltar to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Imperial Legionary Larina
description: A series of defeats in the Three Banners War led veteran Larina to take some leave to recuperate before her next battle in Cyrodiil. Will you give her a place to rest? After adding Larina to your home, you can set her on a path.

name: Isobel Veloise
description: Brave, forthright, and just a little dorky, Isobel Veloise is a knight errant sworn in your service. Call this companion to your side and lead her forth in search of glorious tales, wrongs to right, and delicious candy sweets.

name: J'baanluk
description: No job is too small for this Pahmar-raht resistance fighter. That said, he needs a place to rest before his next efforts against his oppressors. After adding J'baanluk to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Jakarn
description: Thief though he is, Jakarn promises not to steal from your house if you allow him to stay. But as to your heart? Well, that's a different matter. After adding Jakarn to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Javinus Tirnendo
description: Javinus Tirnendo left the Order of the Waking Flame, a cult dedicated to Mehrunes Dagon. Now he seeks refuge from his former allies. Will you help? After adding Javinus to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Jester Anglidor
description: This Jester's Fest performer brings all the joy and frivolity of that holiday to your home—perfect for when you wish to host a friendly gathering! After adding Jester Anglidor to your home, you can set him on a path and interact with him.

name: Keldora
description: Keldora left her adventuring life behind to fulfill her dream of overseeing and organizing a connoisseur's mead collection, though she possesses expertise in all forms of alcohol. After adding Keldora to your home, you can set her on a path.

name: Keshu the Black Fin
description: War hero and governor of Gideon, Keshu seeks to better the Saxhleel people while searching for peace and good companionship for a time. After adding Keshu to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Kor
description: Hunter, Dark Brotherhood assassin, big brother—Kor is all this and more. Invite him into your abode, and he'll share observations about his life. After adding Kor to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Larry, Duke of the Dance
description: Granted to the winner of the 2020 Tamriel Together Sweepstakes. After adding Larry, Duke of the Dance to your home, you can set him on a path.

name: Lucilla Caprenia
description: Trained in the Battlespire, Lucilla Caprenia made a decision that altered her future. As she ponders her next steps, invite her into your abode! After adding Lucilla to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Lyranth
description: What do you really know about the mysterious Dremora Lyranth aside from her affiliation with Coldharbour's Foolkiller clan? Listen and maybe learn. After adding Lyranth to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: M'aiq the Liar
description: The Khajiit called M'aiq the Liar travels widely, speaking foolishly—or wisely, depending on whom you ask. Host him before deciding, yes? After adding M'aiq to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Makes-Many-Soups
description: A chef of many soups, but perhaps only one at a time, the Argonian Makes-Many-Soups seeks to add her culinary creativity to your abode. After adding Makes-Many-Soups to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Mel Adrys
description: Vampire hunters such as Mel Adrys travel widely in pursuit of their quarry, and they need places to rest between hunts. Care to host this Dark Elf? After adding Mel to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Mirri Elendis
description: The inquisitive adventurer, Mirri Elendis, might just unravel the deepest secrets of the Dark Elves provided she can fend off her family's latest blunders. Call this companion to your side and uncover Tamriel's greatest mysteries together!

name: Mizzik Thunderboots
description: With no mysteries for this Khajiit of action to solve, he's at loose ends. Perhaps he can discover some curious doings around your abode? After adding Mizzik to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Narboth
description: The blacksmith, Narboth, dedicated her life to her art after fulfilling an oath to Malacath. Now she seeks a worthy patron. After adding Narboth to your home, you can set her on a path.

name: Narsis Dren
description: Self-proclaimed expert adventurer and prolific author Narsis Dren needs some time away from his exploits to write his next thrilling book. After adding Narsis to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Necrom Guard Miraso
description: After a Necrom ancestor spirit persuaded her to see more of the world, Miraso decided to accomplish this by taking on jobs in private residences across Tamriel and beyond. Will you take her on? After adding Miraso to your home, you can set her on a path.

name: Prince Irnskar
description: Son of Jorunn the Skald-King, Prince Irnskar often feels as if he lives in his father's shadow. Hoping for a respite, he came to visit you. After adding Prince Irnskar to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Relic-Apprentice Marafar
description: With her initial Daedric studies finished, Marafar hopes to uncover more secrets as she assists Artaeum's Relicmaster. Will you host her efforts? After adding Marafar to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Rigurt the Brash
description: The Nord diplomat Rigurt travels around Tamriel to learn about other cultures while demonstrating his own brand of Nord culture. Welcome him home! After adding Rigurt to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Scruut
description: Divergences in fate's threads draw Scruut's attention. Yet, this mighty Watchling seeks your company until the Great Eye summons her. Coincidence? After adding Scruut to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Sereyne
description: An outlaw with a talent for magic but a thirst for alcohol, Sereyne wants a cozy place to drink her troubles away. Perhaps you can provide? After adding Sereyne to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Sharp-as-Night
description: Sharp-as-Night is more than a mysterious mercenary with a forgotten past. With your help, he's learning what it means to look out for others. Call this companion to your side when you need to get the job done with a hardened survivalist watching your back.

name: Sister Gellenna
description: Gellena left the Icereach Coven to see firsthand what they loathed about other cultures—and to consider what scores she needs to settle. After adding Gellena to your home, you can set her on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with her.

name: Skordo the Knife
description: This Orc mercenary usually keeps busy, but now he wants some actual quiet time. Not to reflect, though—his well-used gear needs some attention. After adding Skordo to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Solitude Guard Jorn
description: A man of few words, Jorn stood guard over Solitude's bank until a recent illness laid him low. Now, his position filled by another, he needs work—perhaps a guard position in your home! After adding Jorn to your home, you can set him on a path.

name: Squire Caw
description: Is your home bedecked in shiny treasures? Did you leave carrion out in the sun? Regardless, Blackfeather Court's most nettlesome squire noticed! After adding Squire Caw to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Stefan Mornard
description: With both knightly skills and druidic lore in his repertoire, Sir Stefan Mornard makes for a deadly foe—and a courteous houseguest. After adding Sir Stefan to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Stibbons
description: The long-suffering Stibbons, Lady Laurent's servant, needs a break. He chose to seek you out, desperate for the peace your home provides. After adding Stibbons to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.

name: Tanlorin
description: Brash, energetic, and covered in magical tattoos, Tanlorin hopes to make High Elf society better for outcasts like them. One toppled warmonger at a time. Call this companion to your side and root out corruption across the provinces of Tamriel.

name: Za'ji
description: Captain Za'ji of the Perfect Pounce sails the seas from Elsweyr to High Isle. Now, though, he hopes to bunk with you while his ship is being refit. After adding Za'ji to your home, you can set him on a path, plus you and your visitors can speak with him.×

name: Zerith-var
description: The world has changed much since his day. Zerith-var, necromancer of the Order of the Hidden Moon, knows he has been sent to this time for a reason. Call your tamiit to your side to seek Azurah's twilight path together.

name: Icebreath Berries of Bloom
description: One of four Legendary Icebreath Berries.

name: Icebreath Berries of Budding
description: One of four Legendary Icebreath Berries.

name: Icebreath Berries of Growth
description: One of four Legendary Icebreath Berries.

name: Icebreath Berries of Ripeness
description: One of four Legendary Icebreath Berries.

name: Bristleneck War Boar
description: Originally from Solstheim, this tempestuous boar exists in two modes: hungry and hungrier! Given that it can carry gear, though, providing it with its favorite fungi is a small matter.

name: Explorer's Pack Donkey
description: A donkey might not be the most glamorous pack animal, but it's certainly the hardiest and most sure-footed, toting heavy loads through desert, mountains, and tundra without complaint though it will give you a dirty look, and might nip if you turn away!

name: Mournhold Packrat
description: Are you the kind of adventurer who simply Must Loot Everything? Being followed around by the Mournhold Packrat, an actual cargo rodent, tells the world that you're an Acquisitionist who's not going to leave behind a single spoon!

name: Exalted Icon of Logic
description: A smaller version of the shrine associated with Julianos, sometimes carried by the faithful as portable reliquaries. A component required to morph a Stonewisp of Truth and Law into the Logical Rune Extraction customized action.

name: Flawless Prism
description: While common prisms serve as curiosities, particularly flawless examples can focus light and magicka alike into potent streams of energy. A component required to morph a Stonewisp of Truth and Law into the Logical Rune Extraction customized action.

name: Jhunal's Magnificent Extrication
description: A tome containing the incantations and somatic diagrams for a unique spell of extraction so that a wizard need not dirty their hands. A component required to morph a Stonewisp of Truth and Law into the Logical Rune Extraction customized action.

name: Luminous Berries of Bloom
description: One of four Legendary Luminous Berries.

name: Luminous Berries of Budding
description: One of four Legendary Luminous Berries.

name: Luminous Berries of Growth
description: One of four Legendary Luminous Berries.

name: Luminous Berries of Ripeness
description: One of four Legendary Luminous Berries.

name: Alik'r Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Alinor Eye Crest
description: Once granted only to those who performed a service to the nobility of Summerset, this crest later saw wider use during the Alinor-Lillandril skirmishes of 2E 320. Those fighting for Alinor wore them to help them identify fellow skirmishers.

name: Alloy Circlet
description: This simple, metal alloy circlet, based on Clockwork Apostle designs, is sure to impress with its air of elegance and refinement.

name: Ancient Dragon Hunter Coronal
description: As Dragon Hunters grow more experienced, taking on tougher or more numerous foes, they earn their next coronal piece.

name: Anthor's Shadow Crown
description: "Crafted in Mount Anthor's shadow, this bronze crown rested upon the head of the master of hidden arcane knowledge within Winterhold: Shadow. Some claim it never saw use outside secret meetings, but I doubt this. Crowns proclaim status."—Taleon Mythmaker

name: Aurelian Osprey Coronel
description: Ospreys are known for their precision, ruthlessness, and endurance. Wealthy mariners in Summerset believe wearing one of these bejeweled raptors gives them the insight of a seafaring predator.

name: Azure Brow-to-Temple Circlet
description: This exquisite metal circlet features a bright blue azure proudly mounted on the wearer's brow.

name: Baandari Luck Circlet
description: The Baandari Pedlars, like all traders, love the gleam of precious metals. This stylish circlet allows them, and now you, to express this affection in a flashy manner.

name: Barred Feather Horns
description: Julianos' avian companion, Wise-Wing, is usually represented as a barred owl, so wearing barred owl tail-feathers often bespeaks devotion to the God of Wisdom.

name: Beaded Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Beaded Skull Chaplet
description: Barbaric the early Nords may have been, but they knew how to adorn themselves in fierce finery. The Beaded Skull Chaplet is a prime example.

name: Bird Skull Brow Bauble
description: "Yes, I like to wear a skull on my skull. More skulls are always better than fewer, are they not?" —Adzi-Loh

name: Blood Scion Razorguard
description: Elegantly deadly, this gold head adornment captures the graceful menace of vampiric prowess. Each exquisite blade on the razorguard receives the blessing of the Blood Matron, granting it—and its wearer—prestige among even the most ancient vampires.

name: Braided Strip Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Brazenheart Circlet
description: This stylized circlet is popular as a courtship gift for young Clockwork Apostles, though some of their older peers regard it as too gaudy. Now you can make up your own mind!

name: Carmine Monocle
description: After years of working with lenses and hues, one of Telenger's former students discovered a way to make red lenses that did not fade over time. This monocle features such a pristine carmine lens.

name: Carnaval Beaded Veil
description: Some Carnaval participants prefer to add a little mystique to their revels. Beaded veils and masks are sure to catch the eye of a stranger while concealing the wearer's identity from any who might not approve of the night's activities.

name: Carnaval Dancing Tiara
description: A flash of brilliant metal at your brow will be a perfect festival accent. Dance until dawn!

name: Cherry Blossom Anadem
description: Enchanted to fare well in foul play, the faux cherry blossoms in this anadem frame your facial features with the fragrance of flowers—a foolproof flourish for your Jester's Festival frivolities!

name: Chimer Half-Mask
description: "Did the High Velothi craft this mask to emulate Vivec, or did the Master of Morrowind take a liking to a Chimer artisan's work and mirror that in his appearance? Best not propose the latter within the hearing of any Dark Elves."—Ancemen of Auridon

name: Companion's Coronet
description: Two scowling Dragons hewn in the Atmoran style grant the wearer of this coronet an imposing air of historical and visceral authority.

name: Covenant Lion Circlet
description: Proven heroes of the Daggerfall Covenant may wear upon their brow this silvery circlet with a central, roaring lion.

name: Covenant Lion Coronet
description: Argonian heroes of the Daggerfall Covenant may wear upon their brow this silvery coronet with a central, roaring lion.

name: Crimson Begonia
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Crimson Flower Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Crone's Wicker Coronal
description: Before the Kairian coven split and lost members to the Icereach, its seedswoman grew a coronal each year to crown their leader. After wearing it for a year and a day, this leader gifted it to a dark champion, recognizing a kindred and twisted soul.

name: Dagon's Thorns
description: The lone surviving member of a now-forgotten Reach clan woke up after a night spent at a shrine to Mehrunes Dagon with this thorny crown upon her brow and a grim purpose. Those who follow her earn a similar adornment after trials best not spoken aloud.

name: Dark Passions Circlet
description: "Some claim a cursed jeweler crafted this circlet, transferring the affliction to his final creation. Now, only vampires may wear it without succumbing to insatiable bloodlust."—Nalana, Advisor to House Tamrith

name: Dawn's Eye Crown
description: "Its gold, along with its variant of the College of Winterhold's eye, symbolize leadership over both mundane and arcane mysteries. In short, Dawn mastered both magic and people to uncover secrets, leading Shadow and Shroud."—Taleon Mythmaker

name: Dead-Water Tooth-and-Tusk Tiara
description: The Dead-Water Tribe of Naga Argonians are a spiky lot to begin with, and when they want to look tough, they just pile on more spikes. This trick works for just about anyone, really.

name: Deep Elf Goggle-Horn
description: Scholars of the vanished Dwarven race theorize that this device augmented Dwemeri vision by adding an elevated "third eye" that added time-perspective to depth perception. We just like the way it looks!

name: Dominion Topaz Circlet
description: Proven heroes of the Aldmeri Dominion may wear upon their brow this silvery circlet, adorned with a single, central yellow topaz.

name: Dominion Topaz Coronet
description: Argonian heroes of the Aldmeri Dominion may wear upon their brow this silvery coronet, adorned with a single, central yellow topaz.

name: Dragondancer's Circlet
description: "This bit of metal on my forehead is more than just flashy jewelry. It represents the act of rending scale and wing in an act of sublime mercy—of killing a Dragon."—Klatinja, Dragondancer

name: Drakes and Daemons Mask
description: This vibrant mask makes for a colorful addition to your Battlegrounds gear. Whether you're a Fire Drake or a Pit Daemon, wade into battle bearing the colors of your chosen banner!

name: Dremora Deceiver's Diadem
description: Draw attention away from your hands—and perhaps your mischief—with this impressive ornament. Though once worn only by Dremora as a sign of status, these flashy diadems now grace the heads of cunning thieves and bold Daedra-slayers alike.

name: Dwarf-Style Brow Shields
description: These high-concept Dwarven adornments are like pauldrons—for your face! If anyone asks you what they're for, just waggle your brows, smile, and say "Bthun nchuan."

name: Dwarf-Style Sun Goggles
description: When your entire civilization lives in subterranean cities, you devise high-quality goggles to protect your eyes from the blinding sun of the surface world! Dress to impress with these stylish bronze shades inspired by the long-lost Dwarves of the deeps.

name: Dwemer Crown
description: With its lustrous gems and geometric patterns, this antique crown features the distinctive style of the Dwarves. Adorn yourself with both history and mystery by wearing this crown to the next Antiquarian's Circle gathering!

name: Dwemeri Monocular Contrivance
description: It's said that the original ancient device this was based upon enabled the Dwarves to see the tonal composition of reality. Fake out your friends by telling them that this replica enables you to see through their clothes!

name: Eight-Fang Nose Chain
description: You're a member of the Undaunted—you don't need a reason.

name: Elder Dragon Hunter Coronal
description: Presented to Dragon Hunters after they have helped slay their first Dragon, this crescent is crafted from the slain Dragon's bones by the Huntmaster.

name: Elven Infinity Half-Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Eternal Hunger Coronal
description: This metallic tiara, with its central, stylized Dragon head, its mouth ever-gaping in Eternal Hunger, was popular in the lower-level clergy of the Dragon Cult, according to scholars of those ancient times.

name: Eyevea Evoker's Flair
description: "Each piece of this ornate head jewelry represents a trial that I passed to gain the title of Evoker. You may not see Eyevea-trained evokers like me wearing these every day. But for formal occasions? Just the thing."—Evoker Triann

name: Fancy Eye Patch
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Galenwood Mask
description: "Guided by a druid's artistry, this mask is birthed from earth and stone. This gives it form. Then air and water tease out weakness, leaving behind a formidable symbol of the True Way."—Druid Julisa

name: Gemcutter's Spectacles
description: Why depend on others to tell you the worth of your finds? Set yourself up with these spectacles, and you can determine the value of gems you discover yourself!

name: Golden Brow Wing
description: A golden wing on the forehead bespeaks an Argonian who looks up from the mud to behold the sky.

name: Goldenwing Circlet
description: A circlet of beaten gold influenced by the winged chevrons worn by the Nord priesthood of Kyne.

name: Grave Elegance Mask
description: Combining Daedric elegance with the protection of the wearer's eyes and identity, this mask makes you as mysterious as Oblivion itself.

name: Great Stag Brow Antlers
description: Of Lord Hircine's five famous aspects, the best known is undoubtedly his appearance as the Great Stag, with an impressive span of antlers jutting from his brows. Now you can pay tribute to the Great Stag with these cosmetic Brow Antlers.

name: Hakoshae Festival Laurel
description: "Our best artisans crafted this jeweled laurel based on my research of past Proving Festivals. It is our hope that by wearing these laurels, we can become closer to our honored ancestors."—Magnate Feina-Darak

name: High Vampiric Headdress
description: "During one of their infrequent moots, vampires of Iliac Bay honored their leaders with this haunting crownlet. Once adorned, they fed until only fellow vampires remained within screaming distance of the gathering."—Nalana, Advisor to House Tamrith

name: Hopesbud Coronal
description: The gems of this coronal glitter even when the night is dark and the winter drags on. The headpiece serves as a reminder that hope sleeps beneath the snow, ready to flourish for anyone with the strength to wait for the thaw.

name: Horned Brow Plate
description: Feeling Daedric? Get Oblivious with the Horned Brow Plate—now with faux rivets!

name: Ice-Blue Begonia
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Imperial Moonstones
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Jarl Crown
