description: Crafted from horker leather and metal reworked from weapons, this circlet marks your lofty status among the Nords.

name: Jawbone Blades
description: You'll get the respect you deserve down at the Staymoist Tavern when you walk in sporting these aggressive Jawbone Blades. Look out, dryskins!

name: Jester's Deadly Headband
description: It seems you've been impaled. Tragic and hilarious in equal measure.

name: Keizaal Coronet
description: "Dragons call the lands of Skyrim 'Keizaal,' and thus we shall name this coronet, which only the worthiest of a Dragon warrior-priest's servants may don."—Azhidal

name: Knower's Eye Hairpin
description: Keep your hair, fur, or feathers untangled and well-coiffed! All with a distinctive hairpin bearing the visage of Hermaeus Mora. While it may not utter dark secrets into your ear, its glint may attract someone who can share intriguing mysteries with you.

name: Lavender Begonia
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Leather Band Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Legendary Dragon Coronal
description: As they reach the zenith of their prowess, Dragon Hunters gain the final piece of this famed coronal. Let the weight of countless slain Dragons weigh heavy upon your brow!

name: Magicka Brow Medallion
description: Though inspired by the iconography of the Psijic Order, the Magicka Medallion is a fine adornment for anyone with a commitment to the arcane arts, whether as an independent spellcaster or a member of the Mages Guild.

name: Malign Ambitions Crown
description: "As you feel the crown's weight, let the clang of steel, the scent of ash, and the taste of blood fill your mind. Now stand, Razor-pledged. Let your ambition guide you along Dagon's path."—Disastrix Zansora

name: Mayhem Victor's Laurel Wreath
description: As a Star-Made Knight, this victor's laurel wreath will sit lightly on your brow, informing everyone you meet of your legendary triumph. Hail and kudos!

name: Mechanist Tiara
description: This is a replica of the impressive tiara awarded to Clockwork Apostles when they reach the rank of Mechanist. Congratulations, Gear-Champion!

name: Mercymother's Coronet
description: "House Indoril reverentially marks the Fast of Forebearance in honor of the Healing Mother. Several coronets are fashioned in her honor and rewarded to those who have lived up to her name during this ecclesial holiday."—Mage Tolendir Gals

name: Metalwing Half-Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Mirrormoor Masque
description: Don this scintillating mask and add a touch of exquisite mystery to any gathering. Light dances and sparkles as it reflects from the multitude of shards on this meticulously constructed ornament.

name: Miscarcand Monocle
description: "I'd heard about the Ayleid city of Miscarcand, but I thought it to be a bard's fancy made up for songs at the Fertile Respite. Right up until this bit of sparkle came across my counter. Will wonders never cease."—Louna Maborel

name: Molag Bal Masquerade
description: Some would argue that bearing the image of Molag Bal for something as trifling as a masquerade is borderline folly, but to the mask-loving revelers of Tamriel, the Prince's iconic silhouette is simply too good to pass up.

name: Monarch Hairpin
description: "Sheogorath tortured butterflies. Did you know that? If one wants to rest on my head, then so be it. As far as I'm concerned it could use a break. Besides, I think my new friend is rather fetching, don't you?"—Duchess Carmyne, Hegathe Palace

name: Morag Tong Spatter Lenses
description: Naryu Virian says "When you take out a target, these Morag Tong-style goggles will keep spattering blood out of your eyes, so you can see your way clear to make your escape when the local guards come after you!"

name: Morthal Jarl Circlet
description: Supple mammoth leather forms the basis of this commanding circlet, which convincingly imitates that worn by the Jarl of Morthal. The metal focal point integrates Morthal's heraldry, adding a hint of flair to this handsome band—and to any who don it!

name: Mycoturge Fascinator
description: Mycoturges who achieve a certain level of mastery in their craft may don this fascinator, which they must first craft from bloodtooth toadstools. If it thrives for a full season of wear, they gain recognition as a master mycoturge.

name: Nchuleft Tonal Visor
description: This omnigatherum based on designs discovered in the Dwarven ruin of Nchuleft combines the Brow Shields and the Goggle Horn into one mighty upper-face visor that'll have you saying "Thuabtharng btham!"

name: Nibenese Laurel Coronet
description: Wear the haughty golden laurels of the Nibenese aristocracy with this Coronet and look down your noble nose at lesser mortals!

name: Nightshade Hair Comb
description: So beautiful. So deadly. That describes both you and this floral head flair, does it not? Plus you never know when you'll need a bit of alluring poison close at hand.

name: No Major Adornment
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Pact Dragonclaw Circlet
description: Proven heroes of the Ebonheart Pact may wear upon their brow this majestic circlet surmounted by silvery Dragon claws.

name: Pact Dragonclaw Coronet
description: Argonian heroes of the Ebonheart Pact may wear upon their brow this majestic coronet surmounted by silvery Dragon claws.

name: Prize-Hunter's Patch
description: Had your eye on the prize a bit too much, eh? Well, cover up that wound with this stylish patch.

name: Queen Ayrenn's Aldmeri Circlet
description: Naturally, the Queen of the High Elves is no stranger to tiaras, but don't mistake this circlet for mere adornment. Forged with precious metals, Ayrenn's circlet is unyielding in its strength—much like the queen herself.

name: Red Diamond Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Sacred Rhombus Circlet
description: Clergy in the Dragon Cult below the Priest level adorned themselves with the tall pointed diamond symbol known as the Sacred Rhombus, a design said to be symbolic of a Dragon's scales.

name: Saliache Aetherial Tiara
description: "A self-described Saliache artist-warrior described how she wore this stunning tiara to shapeshifting exhibitions to assist in transformations. While I can't garner the same results, it catches the light and draws eyes at gatherings."—Savre Longleat

name: Scarab Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Scholar's Half-Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Scholar's Spectacles
description: "I've seen the whole world, but my eyes aren't what they used to be. Thanks to your spectacles, I'll be able to see a bit more of it before I'm forced to settle down."—Letter of thanks written by Lady Arabelle Davaux to Lorb, Glassblower

name: Seastone Browplate
description: Set with a rare aquamarine worn smooth by tides, this imposing metal browplate features waves reminiscent of rough waters. Some claim a spirit from the Sea of Ghosts haunts the gem, imbuing it with a faint chill.

name: Shaman's Bird-Bone Circlet
description: Sometimes you just feel barbaric, and then only wearing a naked bird-skull on your forehead will do.

name: Shimmerene Soiree Circlet
description: Before the Interregnum, this elegant circlet graced the brows of High Elves who attended the Shimmerene Soiree, a gala held by the Canonreeve to honor that city-state. Now artisans sell it to any who wish to be appropriately garbed for this festivity.

name: Shrouded Crown
description: "Silver may glint in darkness, but the master who wears this crown often blackened its gleam while pursuing worldly agendas in hidden spaces. All that is a romantic way of saying that a spymaster earned this badge of office for Shroud."—Taleon Mythmaker

name: Sightless Master Blindfold
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Six-Spike Tail Trim
description: They'll give you plenty of room to yourself in the mud wallow when you show up wearing your dangerous-looking Six-Spike Tail Trim. Erect the spine of passive aggression!

name: Skaal's Brow Band
description: "You never walk alone under the All-Maker's gaze. The fur and leather in this band are a reminder that all are One. Meanwhile its gentle pressure on your head can keep you grounded to unbroken earth."—Skaal Shaman Rik

name: Snowcrystal Tiara
description: Let your grace and style shine with this glistening tiara. Perfect for Evening Star galas, royal balls, and days when you just want to sparkle.

name: Spellsword Coronet
description: The light glinting off the metal of this ornate coronet might be the only warning an enemy has before you strike them down with your arcane might. Never underestimate Breton magic!

name: Sporty Tail Tuft
description: You'll swing your tail to the Two Moons Dance with pride when it's tipped with the so-sleek Sporty Tail Tuft. Clan Mother approved!

name: Stallion-Liege Brow Medallion
description: After Sai Sahan freed Leyawiin from its Longhouse occupation, Leyawiin honored those who aided him with a special medallion. Each year since, the city awards these Nibenese-style head ornaments to its bravest defenders.

name: Star-Brow Diadem
description: This elegant tiara simultaneously evokes the heavenly stars that are the source of all Magicka, and the horns of the Dragons whom the ancient Nords worshiped. Perhaps the ancient Atmorans weren't as barbaric as they're depicted!

name: Star-Made Circlet
description: "And upon the Star-Made Circlet there shall be Three Diamonds in remembrance of our Glorious Empire's Foundation: One Diamond for Alessia, One Diamond for Morihaus, and One Diamond for Pelinal, also called Whitestrake."

name: Star-Made Diamond Diadem
description: "But Al-Esh thought it meet to retain the Laureled Diadem for her own Imperial Brow, and it was set with Twin Red Diamonds, one for Herself and one for Belharza to Come, who was even then Quickening."

name: Star-Made Sword Coronet
description: "And the Paravant gave each to Pelinal and Morihaus a coronet surmounted by a sword, for they were the living weapons of Empire, AE ALTADOON, and no mortal could stand before them."

name: Steadfast Society Ball Domino
description: "To offset the suffering caused by the Three Banners War, some of us host gatherings to raise funds for our healing centers. Each event sees the biggest donor receiving a mask embellished with an Imperial red diamond. I adore mine."—Estayne Justal

name: Studded Leather Brow Band
description: This metal-studded Leather Brow Band is as practical as it is decorative. After all, a barbarian warrior might have a little too much mead, miss the doorway a bit, and BANG. Best to have a bit of protection for the old noggin, am I right?

name: Talon Veil
description: The so-called "Talon Veil" is worn by Cat-Folk who have passed the dangerous initiation rites of a Khajiiti hunting club.

name: Temple Spike Torc
description: This broad metal forehead torc features aggressive spikes rising from the wearer's temples.

name: Third Eye Ruby
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Third Eye Topaz
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Thrafey Debutante Circlet
description: "Let lesser vampires scuttle about in the shadows. A true child of Lamae Bal knows the value of light and fashion. Wear this circlet, and you'll attract the gaze of every aristocrat at the ball—easy prey, eager for domination."—Archblood Delyna

name: Tiara Half-Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Tooled Turquoise Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Victory Brow
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Warlock's Veil
description: While the missing moon makes its presence known, mages gather materials to craft these veils. A solemn ceremony under the light of the Ritual constellation affixes the enchantment that allows the wearer to see while the veil covers their eyes.

name: Weald Arbor Headdress
description: No West Weald harvest festival is complete without seeing these colorful autumnal garlands on joyful celebrants. Some even claim these headdresses bless the wearer with plenty during the upcoming winter.

name: White Flower Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Windcaller's Circlet
description: Blessed stalhrim nestles protectively between wolf embellishments in this arresting circlet. Those who call upon the winds and train wolf guardians to serve the Skaal proudly wear this piece.

name: Wire Cage Half-Mask
description: For the strong and untamed spirit, the spiraling wires of this jewelry half-mask express the inner power that no cage could ever contain.

name: Wolfcrown of Solitude
description: Solitude's silver wolf dominates this replica of the crown worn by High King Svargrim, making it perfect for those who wish to look both regal and fierce. Legends claim the crimson elements represent the blood shed in defense of hearth and kin.

name: Wolfsbane Ear Posy
description: For many, the Wolfsbane Ear Posy is just a simple adornment—but for members of the Order of the Silver Dawn, it serves to identify those who are secret members or sympathizers of that society of Werewolf hunters.

name: Woven Strip Circlet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Cold Iron Gauntlet
description: A gauntlet lined with leather tanned from the hides of the unworthy. None shall escape your iron grasp! A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Master of Schemes personality.

name: Grim Iron Mask
description: Smiles are a sign of weakness. One true masters of the world cannot afford. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Master of Schemes personality.

name: Tyrant's Soul Gem
description: Which of the innumerable tyrants that Tamriel has known wound up trapped inside this crystal prison? It matters little; their power will be added to your own. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Master of Schemes personality.

name: Bottled Skin Dyes
description: Two bottles of ink used for semi-permanent dyeing of the skin in Dibellan festival rites. A component required to morph a Passion Dancer Blossom into the Meadowbreeze Memories skin.

name: Ground Jade Lily Powder
description: The ground powder of dried jade lily petals, mixed with skin dyes to cause the ink to glow slightly. A component required to morph a Passion Dancer Blossom into the Meadowbreeze Memories skin.

name: Pressed Silver Leaves
description: Sanctified silver pressed into extremely thin leaf-shaped wafers for application to the skin during Dibellan festival rites. A component required to morph a Passion Dancer Blossom into the Meadowbreeze Memories skin.

name: Accursed Gray Reliquary
description: Not all reliquaries contain sacred remains or serve as memorials for departed family members. Some harbor evils that were meant to be forgotten—bury them once and for all!

name: Aether-Traveled Varla Stone
description: Wonders exist within this particular Varla Stone, or so you've been told. But can you access them? Maybe it just needs a little shake—whoa! Is it full of stars? Or merely projecting them?

name: Agonymium Stone
description: While concentrating on this stone, pain breaks you into slivers of individualized torment. Seconds later, you reform. Impressive? Definitely. But dare you repeat the excruciating experience?

name: Almalexia's Enchanted Lantern
description: A light dances within the glass of the lantern, waiting to be released.

name: Anchorite's Carved Bone
description: Let the power of Molag Bal wash over you. All shall know your might, your power. Don't they know who you are?

name: Antiquarian's Eye
description: Allows you to Scry for Antiquities. When used within a Dig Site, indicates the direction to the nearest possible Antiquity location.

name: Antiquarian's Telescope
description: "When looking for your dig site, use your telescope—unless you love baking under the desert sun or freezing your arse off in snow-covered valleys for weeks on end because you chose to eyeball it instead."—Ugron gro-Thumog, Antiquarian

name: Apple-Bobbing Cauldron
description: As a reminder that death awaits even the mightiest, at the Witches Festival heroes and adventurers are invited to humble themselves with juvenile games like bobbing for gorapples. Open wide!

name: Archaic Lore Tablets
description: Invoke these Tablets of Archaic Lore and they glow with the wisdom of ancient knowledge!

name: Astral Aurora Projector
description: Create a breathtaking aurora effect with a device once known to add wonder to the Direnni halls on Balfiera. So sparkly!

name: Battered Bear Trap
description: The trap goes snap.

name: Blackfeather Court Whistle
description: Use near a corpse to call the Blackfeather Court to feast.

name: Blade of the Blood Oath
description: Perform a blood oath as the Bane of the Gold Coast to receive the Blade of the Blood Oath.

name: Blizzard Globe
description: Sometimes you just need to chill out. This blizzard-creating memento can help with that!

name: Blossom Bloom
description: This eternally blooming flower once graced the boudoir of a Dibellan high priest. Gifted to you for services rendered, you may now command it yourself.

name: Bone Colossus Illusion Gem
description: Create a rattling bone colossus illusion that momentarily matches your own movements, and cow any who dare oppose you!

name: Bone Digger's Trinket
description: Bones await your call when you use this trinket.

name: Bone Dragon Summons Focus
description: With this memento, for just a moment, you conjure the awe-inspiring illusion of the rise of a dreadful Bone Dragon.

name: Bonesnap Binding Stone
description: A strange Ayleid stone from the Bonesnap Ruins.

name: Boomerang Blunder
description: Until you master the art of the Valenwood boomerang, expect to break a few things. Potentially including someone else's nose.

name: Box of Forbidden Relics
description: Perform the Black Sacrament after completing all of the Black Sacrament contract achievements to receive a Box of Forbidden Relics.

name: Breda's Bottomless Mead Mug
description: This wooden mug always seems to have just enough mead in it for one more toast. While no longer necessary for earning extra experience during New Life Festival, you can still keep it around for quaffing.

name: Bright Moons
description: Let images of Jone and Jode orbit you as you take up a position of prayer.

name: Brittle Burial Urn
description: Show the strength of your emotions by destroying this hapless urn! Beware the consequences .

name: Butcher Haefal's Accursed Knife
description: This knife is the greatest of all time! Sharp, well-balanced, keeps its edge, changes you into a goat. And around here, nobody notices extra goats.

name: Cadwell's Chaotic Portal
description: Summon Cadwell

name: Cadwell's Surprise Box
description: Surprise boxes are fun! Why, you never know what will pop out. But wait. Is that Cadwell?

name: Campfire Kit
description: Set up a crackling fire and start warming up with fellow group members using this handy Campfire Kit.

name: Chains of the Ice Witch
description: The Icereach Coven hoarded countless magical items on their cursed isle—these chains for instance. What happens when you invoke their power? Let's see

name: Cherry Blossom Branch
description: This enchanted branch is forever blooming with vibrant cherry blossoms to pluck as one pleases.

name: Clockwork Obscuros
description: As a souvenir of Sotha Sil, pop up your personal projected image of the sphere of Clockwork City.

name: Coin of Illusory Riches
description: Remind yourself at any time what you went into thieving for!

name: Corruption of Maarselok
description: That sickening blue glow you picked up while adventuring in the Lair of Maarselok? Yeah, it's all over you. Just remember what Selene taught you, and you'll be rid of it in seconds!

name: Crimson Bone Hammer
description: Crafted from an executioner's block and a bone, this unsettling hammer picked up at the Spire of the Crimson Coin requires quenching before use against a certain bloodmage's phylactery. Why not quench it again for old time's sake?

name: Crow's Calling
description: Summon a member of the Blackfeather Court for a friendly visit. Watch out for droppings!

name: Cursed Reach Doll
description: A dark curse from the Dragon cult still lingers around this adorable little doll. Is it safe to handle? Perhaps brandish at your friends? There's only one way to find out.

name: Daedric Unwarding Amulet
description: Every adventurer needs a tool that works against Daedric wards! Just hold this amulet up, invoke the magic, perhaps shield your eyes, and voila! The ward is not unwarded? Well, it's showy at least!

name: Daedroth Illusion Gem
description: Need to get a word in edgewise? Or want to show off? Become the center of attention by creating an illusory daedroth that briefly mimics your own gestures. None dare ignore this fiery, clawed, and toothy illusion!

name: Dark Lady's Headrest
description: Blessed—or cursed—by Vaermina, this pillow looks comfortable, but acts as a summons to dreadful nightmares. Dare you rest on it?

name: Darkswarm Talisman
description: "All you have to do is hold this close to your chest and listen to your heartbeat. It summons so many friends. So wondrous. So dark. I love it!"—Naifaha the Dread Dreamer

name: Dhulef's Bubble Ward
description: "Ever visited the bottom of the sea? I overheard a Redguard talking about doing just that with some spell he's working on. A warding trinket, maybe. It's like walking in a bubble, I guess."—Enri Coulon of the Ancient Anchor

name: Dibella's Sweetroll Stack
description: Share a delightful stack of gooey-sweet baked goods with your best friends. Or taunt your worst enemies with them—you have sweetrolls and they have none!

name: Discourse Amaranthine
description: A minor volume from Apocrypha.

name: Dragon Flight Illusion Gem
description: Use this enchanted gemstone to cast a brief illusion of a flight of Dragons.

name: Dragonhorn Curio
description: Crafted with great care, this Dragonhorn replica celebrates your past triumph with Sai Sahan against Vahlokzin. Simply blow, and a wave emanates from it. It does not, however, affect Dragons.

name: Draoife Old Growth Sigils Basin
description: "This basin served many druids, yet now you possess it. How came you to such a gift? No, don't tell me quickly. Let's linger over this tale. I'm sure it's a good one."—Druid Antoine

name: Dream Amulet of Argon
description: When invoked, this creates a brief, ephemeral image of the Remnant of Argon.

name: Dreamer's Chime
description: Even choked with ash, this bell recovered from the Forgotten Wastes emits a haunting tone and glows when struck.

name: Dust of the Conqueror's Flame
description: Remember well the green flame used by Orpheon the Tactician, who sought an Elder Scroll and failed due to your efforts.

name: Dwarven Puzzle Orb
description: Warning: for thousands of years, everyone who has ever fiddled with these ancient Dwarven Puzzle Orbs has died. It's true that sometimes they seem to have died peacefully at an advanced age, but still.

name: Dwarven Tonal Forks
description: There's something strangely soothing about the subtle vibration and crackling sparks emitted by these Dwarven Tonal Forks. So very soothing. In fact, you'd like to see them, feel them again. Right away. And for a long time.

name: Dwemervamidium Mirage
description: This enables its possessor to temporarily assume the appearance of wearing a suit of Dwemervamidium, or steam-assisted semi-mechanized heavy Dwarven armor. It's genuinely awe-inspiring, albeit only briefly.

name: Echo of the Abolisher
description: "While it won't cut a path to Mirrormoor, this echo of the sword crafted by Boethiah nonetheless looks impressive. Just watch where you swing it."

name: Echonir Examination
description: Forged by Hermaeus Mora, the Echonir collects remnants of ancient memories and shows them to you. Perhaps a closer examination is in order before the Lord of Secrets reclaims it.

name: Echonir Fragment
description: This fragment of the Memory Stone created by Hermaeus Mora may not have the powers of the fully intact version, but it can play with your vision for a time.

name: Enchanted Saturalia Tree
description: Deck a Saturalia tree with ornaments and lights. Join your group members, and let the fun of the New Life Festival begin!

name: Everlasting Snowball
description: Ready for a snowball fight? To use this collectible, add it to your quick slot and then pick a target. Note: Hitting a guard with a snowball will count as a Petty Crime.

name: Fargrave Occult Curio
description: With this strange bit of bone from exotic Fargrave among your belongings, you need simply gesture and focus your will to cause your hands to glow. Neat trick, eh?

name: Festive Noise Maker
description: Whoop it up to celebrate whatever Tamrielic festival is going on or just make a nuisance of yourself in the tavern common room with this Festive Noise Maker!

name: Fetish of Anger
description: A small, dark stone, hot to the touch.

name: Fiery Orb
description: This memento briefly summons a flaming orb of the very stuff of the Plane of Infernace.

name: Fighter's Guild Blade Barrel
description: "When you have a barrel full of blades nearby, you'll never be caught flat-footed!"—Old Fighters Guild Motto

name: Finvir's Trinket
description: This bauble casts an otherworldly light upon its owner.

name: Fire-Breather's Torches
description: Quite a harmless, but earnest, display of largesse and lung capacity - feel free to spew fire everywhere!

name: Flame Eruption
description: There's angry, and then there's conjuring-an-erupting-volcano-in-the-floor angry.

name: Flame Pixie
description: Conjuring a tiny Flame Atronach from Oblivion for a few moments really warms up the room!

name: Floral Swirl Aura
description: Invoke a temporary aura of the Wild Hunt: use this memento to cause spectral leaves to swirl around you while flowers bloom at your feet.

name: Full-Scale Golden Anvil Replica
description: Using its focus item, summon one of Divine Zenithar's many symbols: a golden anvil. Perfect for when you're sharing tales of triumphs gained through honest toil.

name: Fungimancer's Prayer-Beads
description: When invoked, you can use these prayer-beads to form a circle of glowing mushrooms around you.

name: Ghastly Visitation
description: "A classic mage prank: hide an enchanted pebble on someone, then trigger the magic. An illusion springs up, ranging from silly to frightening. A common gag is the appearance of a dark entity of the most frightening sort!"—Scholar Thaegara

name: Ghost Haven Caravel
description: The stories of the Ghost Haven caravel still make the rounds at taverns and campfires on High Isle. With this astounding illusion device, you can recreate the caravel's appearance to add evocative detail to every story you tell.

name: Ghost Lantern
description: When you go looking for spirits of the restless dead with the Witches Festival Ghost Lantern, you don't find them—they find you!

name: Glanir's Smoke Bomb
description: Poof!

name: Gold Dragon Hand Projector
description: This miniature Psijic Projector briefly displays the glowing illusion of a Gold Dragon hovering over the hand of its user.

name: Gourd-Gallows Stump
description: Given a nice, ripe Witches Festival pumpkin, you could carve it, cook it, or do any number of creative things with it. But who are we kidding? You know what you want. Smash that gourd!

name: Gryphon Feather Talisman
description: An enchanted feather from the gryphon Sunnawel, the living symbol of Sunhold. With this item you can, for a few moments, at least, rule the air! Summon a miniature windstorm and blow your troubles away.

name: Guardian's Frozen Shard
description: A glacial fragment from the body of one of the timeless guardians found in the Coral Aerie. It freezes anything it touches.

name: Haunted Mirror of Introspection
description: You vanquished the dangers lurking within the Exiled Redoubt, and now you own this haunted mirror souvenir. Does the spirit of Docent Domitius linger within it? Or is this a new poltergeist?

name: Hidden Pressure Vent
description: Rkindaleft's pressure release system was, and is, unusual.

name: Hoard of the Schemers
description: This war chest? It's all yours now, and you're not afraid to defend it! Schemers seeking to retrieve it best beware if they try anything.

name: Hunter's Carved Bone
description: "The nacreous waters of the Bowl of the Hunt await the bone's holder. Look deeply. Beyond your skin. Feel it? The hunt howls through blood and bone and sinew. Now, sing your wolf-song to begin your journey as one of Hircine's chosen."—Witchmother Gretis

name: Illusory Salamander Stone
description: A hidden fire burns within this gem. With a quick invocation, you can draw it out to create the illusion of charging salamanders in a stunning display of magic.

name: Impartial Decision Coin
description: Made too many decisions today already? Pull out your trusty Impartial Decision Coin, give it a flip, and see what comes of it—no further rumination required!

name: Incarnate Illusion Gem
description: Use this gem to create the illusion of a ruby-hued incarnate and direct its movements with your own! It's sure to startle even the most unflinching spectator.

name: Inferno Cleats
description: Burn your way through town and country, literally, with these alchemical augments to your footwear! The flames last only for a few moments, so you can reassure any who feel you've become a fire hazard.

name: Iterative Onyx Glyphic
description: An ancient relic of Hermaeus Mora, the Onyx Glyphic is resonant with eldritch power and temporal forces. Best to hand it off to someone you trust. You know, like yourself.

name: Jester's Festival Joke Popper
description: What's this? A tiny cask? How intriguing! What can it possibly contain? Maybe if I shake it near my ear I can hear—Oh!

name: Jester's Scintillator
description: Celebrate Jester's Festival in scintillating color.

name: Jubilee Cake 2016
description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. It's a festival for your taste buds!

name: Jubilee Cake 2017
description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. It's a festival for your taste buds!

name: Jubilee Cake 2018
description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. It's a festival for your taste buds!

name: Jubilee Cake 2019
description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. It's like a sweetroll mountain, a festival for your taste buds!

name: Jubilee Cake 2020
description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. Savor its darkly rich flavor—decadence for your taste buds!

name: Jubilee Cake 2021
description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. Relish its luscious flavor—tantalizing to your taste buds!

name: Jubilee Cake 2022
description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. So zesty with a touch of heat—wake up your taste buds!

name: Jubilee Cake 2023
description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake is the perfect pastry to celebrate any special occasion or awesome anniversary. Its secret ingredient is an unfathomable enigma, giving it a complex flavor profile!

name: Jubilee Cake 2024
description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake calls upon his prodigious experience to provide you with a celebratory taste that somehow encapsulates ten years of adventuring in Tamriel and beyond.

name: Juggler's Knives
description: These trusty knives are weighted to be poor for throwing in combat, but excellent for catching and juggling.

name: Justal's Falcon
description: A well-trained raptor.

name: Kick Ball
description: Kick a sports ball like an Argonian!

name: Kyne's Tablet of Storms
description: Study this stone tablet that calls upon the might of the Warrior Goddess and Mother of Nords, Kyne.

name: Lena's Wand of Finding
description: A gift from a fellow student of Shad Astula.

name: Lodorr's Crown
description: The metal is warm to the touch.

name: Lover's Quandary Flower
description: They love me they love me not.

name: Malacath Helm Haunt
description: Look at you! So scary when wearing Malacath's helm. Oh, oops. Maybe you weren't meant to wear it for long? You cannot use this if you have a polymorph equipped.

name: Malacath's Wrathful Flame
description: A relic of the Cult of Malacath, useless in combat but very impressive.

name: Malkhest's Accursed Mirror
description: No amount of time spent in the Infinite Archive can prepare you for that moment when you pick up an everyday item and suddenly change into a murder-glass monstrosity!

name: Maormer Ocean Pearl
description: This perfectly smooth, aquamarine pearl is supposedly the essence of the ocean itself. Holding it makes you feel at one with the sea.

name: Mariner's Nimbus Stone
description: Whether by magic or blessing, you've discovered a wondrous stone that shows the world just how attuned you are to the sea.

name: Meln's Soul Gem
description: With the soul of Meln the Mouthless tucked away in your rucksack, you'll never be at a loss for advice, commentary about the world, and other tidbits he decides to (over) share with you.

name: Meridian Possession Prism
description: Invoking this crystal prism briefly exalts the user with the luminous feeling of being possessed by the Lady of Infinite Energies.

name: Mezha-dro's Sealing Amulet
description: A strange amulet used by Mezha-dro to seal tears in Oblivion.

name: Miniature Dwarven Sun
description: Lighten the darkest places with your own handheld sun!

name: Mire Drum
description: Of the many instruments used by the Argonians of Murkmire, the drum is the simplest and most common.

name: Mostly Stable Juggling Potions
description: You're pretty sure that these potions won't explode when tossed about, but a little uncertainty adds to the excitement, right?

name: Mud Ball Pouch
description: A seemingly endless supply of mud balls, ready for tossing at unsuspecting targets.

name: Murderous Strike
description: Command a magically-murderous crow to crash down upon your enemies in a suicide strike. This Memento is used on other players.

name: Murkmire Grave-Stake
description: Like most adventurers, you're probably worried that no one will remember you when you're gone. Create your own momentary memorial with the Murkmire Grave-Stake! Because you deserve it, hero.

name: NOT IN USE
description: Turns your world black-and-white, and summons a ghost that everyone can see. NOT IN USE

name: Nanwen's Sword
description: A polished but cheap prop, property of the counterfeit Ayleid king.

name: Nascent Netherroot Brew
description: Summon a small—hopefully harmless—harrowstorm using this very early version of the Icereach Coven's netherroot brew.

name: Neramo's Lightning Stick
description: The artificer Neramo rewarded you with this Dwarven electrified cane as a memento of your adventure in the ruins of Nchuleftingth.

name: Nirnroot Wine
description: A unique wine that is never tasted and never runs out but always gets you drunk.

name: Orb of Magnus
description: Vampirism and sunlight just don't mix. Hide from the oppressive light of Magnus with this memento.

name: Painter's Easel and Canvas
description: Explore your artistic side with this sturdy easel and canvas. Whether you're interested in painting dramatic landscapes or prefer to depict nature, these items should serve you well.

name: Phial of Clockwork Lubricant
description: The lubricant used in clockwork maintenance is particularly well known for its immediate efficacy—and its difficulty to clean up.

name: Plant Parley
description: You've answered the eternal question of "Who's a good plant?" by claiming that title for your own plant.

name: Playful Prankster's Surprise Box
description: What's in this delightfully bedecked box? It's a surprise, of course. Crank it open and find out!

name: Plunder Skull Blunder
description: Some plunder skulls have treats. But this one seems to have a spider? And a bat? And even a ghost? Maybe this skull possessed—or is possessed by—only tricks. Best put it away quickly.

name: Prism of Moribund Sapience
description: A replica of the cursed Daedric relic once gifted to the powerful portal mage Dreynis by an envoy of Sheogorath. Though only a facsimile, some say it has some of the same insanity inducing properties as the original.

name: Prismatic Banner Ribbon
description: This enchanted Ribbon briefly unfurls a Prismatic Banner over the head of its user.

name: Psijic Celestial Orb
description: When you use this brief Psijic illusory enchantment, you seem to be scrying a globe of the night sky! The appearance of this relic is based on the Order's researches into the entirely UN-celestial Abyssal Pearls.

name: Psijic Scrying Talisman
description: The spellcasting monks of the Psijic Order are the acknowledged masters of the art of magical scrying, with distinctive gestures and visual effects. Use of this memento enables one to simulate such farseeing.

name: Psijic Tautology Glass
description: Display your mastery of time, or maybe just your contempt for punctuality, by summoning a mystic hourglass—and then shattering it! It's strangely gratifying. In fact, once you start, it's hard to stop.

name: Questionable Meat Sack
description: There's a lot of meat in here.

name: Reliquary of Dark Designs
description: The mage that crafted the illusion produced by this replica reliquary meant for it to demonstrate the proper use of the real thing.

name: Remnant of Meridia's Light
description: A beautiful remnant of Meridia's power. No Lightless Oubliette required.

name: Replica Tonal Inverter
description: Recall your bravery as Vivec's Champion with this replica of the Tonal Inverter, an invention which creates sound waves that temporarily disrupt the flow of energy within magical devices.

name: Riften Leafpile
description: You haven't lived until you've thrown yourself into a Riften-style leafpile. Start by making the pile. Then throw yourself into it. Praise Kyne!

name: Rind-Renewing Pumpkin
description: Showing off your adventurer's deft dexterity with a deadly blade, you swiftly carve a Witches Festival pumpkin into a hollowjack lantern. Impressive!

name: Ritual Circle Totem
description: Form a prayer circle for you and three of your boon companions, then watch your prayer take form in spectacular visual displays.

name: Sands of the Lucent Citadel
description: A vial of Fargrave sand and a touch of magic work together to form this sand model of Lucent Citadel.

name: Sanguine's Goblet
description: The goblet is never quite empty.

name: Sapiarchic Discorporation Lens
description: You know those moments when you just wish you could simply disappear? With the High Elven magic of the Sapiarchic Discorporation Lens, you can! .All right, maybe it IS just a temporary illusion, but it's a damned impressive one.

name: Scalecaller Frost Shard
description: Use this memento to put a chill in the heart of your adversary by conjuring a brief magical ice cyclone before you. (It's also handy for chilling your drink.)

name: Scalecaller Rune of Levitation
description: Use this memento to briefly hover ominously, eyes glowing, like a menacing ancient Dragon Priest.

name: Sea Sload Dorsal Fin
description: This Sea Sload body part radiates with mind magic and simulates a Sea Sload mind trap without most of the debilitating effects.

name: Skeletal Marionette
description: Be the life of your party with this cute little skeleton marionette! It dances! It prances! It hangs from strings, ready for you to make it move! (Creepy skeleton voice not included.)

name: Snow Cadwell
description: Go beyond building a snowman. Build a snow Cadwell with this memento!

name: Soul Crystals of the Returned
description: Scholars dispute the origin of these hovering soul crystals. Some believe the lich Vastarie first brought them back from Coldharbour. Others claim Mannimarco returned these souls to Tamriel. Regardless, you know the means to summon them. Dare you do so?

name: Spellcrafted Sand Stronghold
description: Though it may start as simple sand, this material magically forms into a miniature stronghold worthy of the loftiest—if minuscule—sand rulers.

name: Storm Atronach Aura
description: Clothe yourself in the Aura of the Storm with this memento of Daedric summoning!

name: Storm Atronach Transform
description: Assume the semblance of a mighty Storm Atronach with this transformation memento! Just be sure to hold onto your rocks.

name: Storm Orb Juggle
description: Do you want to juggle a Storm Atronach's internal organs? Dumb question—of COURSE you want to juggle a Storm Atronach's internal organs.

name: Summoned Booknado
description: The pages of the Book of the Aggrieved resist being read—to the point where they often flutter into the air and threaten handlers with innumerable paper cuts as they swirl in a booknado!

name: Surprising Snowglobe
description: Chill out for several moments by shaking this exquisite snowglobe.

name: Swarm of Crows
description: Call down a swarm of crows to surround you in a menacing aura.

name: Sword-Swallower's Blade
description: This trusty blade is unworthy of combat, but harmless when swallowed.

name: Temperamental Grimoire
description: Most books share all sorts of knowledge with their readers. Some, however, don't have "sharing" in their index. They do have fire though. Lots of fire.

name: Temporary Candlefly Lantern
description: After gathering candleflies, Breton families set them out to light their annual summer reunion dinner. Once they savor a last bite of dessert, they release the flies back into the evening sky, causing a cloud of gently bobbing lights to drift away.

name: The Pie of Misrule
description: Does this taste funny to you? Formerly used to obtain an experience boost during Jester's Festival, but no longer needed! For that purpose, that is. You should still eat it, because pie is delicious.

name: Thetys Ramarys's Bait Kit
description: Ready to summon a cliff strider? Thetys Ramarys, breeder extraordinaire, created a kit you can use to attract them. Just toss the bait quickly if you want to keep your fingers.

name: Throwing Bones
description: Peer into your future with these augury bones! Give them a toss and read the portents that await.

name: Token of Root Sunder
description: A small seed given by Root Sunder.

name: Tome of Forbidden Appetites
description: Ask not what's for dinner, for it may be your face! Especially if the piquantly profane Tome of Forbidden Appetites has anything to say about it.

name: Twilight Shard
description: This rough-hewn crystal star pulses with brilliant Daedric energy—using it produces a dazzling tribute to Azura.

name: Ulfsild's Tome of Legends
description: Archmage Ulfsild penned many tomes as she researched the origins of magic. One such, the Tome of Legends, may delight you with its accompanying illusions. Care to know more? Crack open the tome!

name: Umbral Projector
description: Want to relive the horror of watching a harmless shadow become a bloodthirsty killer? This mechanical marvel will let you do just that—without the harmful effects, of course.

name: Unstable Emerald Glyphic
description: An ancient relic of Hermaeus Mora, the Emerald Glyphic is resonant with nameless and antiquarian forces. It's worth careful study. Just be careful not to learn something you were not meant to know.

name: Vaermina's Shadow
description: Not all dreams are sweet. Vaermina takes special pleasure in reminding mortals of their deepest fears when they least expect it.

name: Void Shard
description: A remembrance of your times traversing void portals, this void shard still creates interesting visual effects even if it can't help you move through breaches in reality.

name: Vossa-satl
description: This memento enables one to play the bizarre Argonian vossa-satl, or Frog-Pipes. Party in the swamp!

name: Wall of Life Brush
description: The artists of Black Heights honor their lives through their paintings on the Wall of Life. Now, to commemorate their practices, you can paint a tree in mid-air.

name: Werewolf Behemoth Sigil
description: When your rage and bloodlust cannot be contained in your usual meager mortal form, then it is time to become the Werewolf Behemoth.

name: Wild Hunt Leaf-Dance Aura
description: Invoke a temporary aura of the Wild Hunt: use this memento to cause mystical leaves to dance and twirl around you.

name: Wild Hunt Transform
description: Invoke the power of the Wild Hunt with this transformation memento. By bough and by leaf, a spriggan you'll be!

name: Wilting Weed Killer Phial
description: Never again suffer the indignities of a weed-filled garden! This potent phial contains a defoliating decoction that hastily rids you of any and all corrupting creepers.

name: Winnowing Plague Decoction
description: "The Peryite cultists have aninteresting world view. For instance, some will carry around that bottle and—no, don't open that!"—Dar'ava

name: Witch's Bonfire Dust
description: With a flick of your wrist, show the world and fellow group members that you are an initiate of a witch's coven, creating bonfire flames that dance in hues of purple and green.

name: Wooden Grave-Stake
description: What a wonderfully decorated stake you've recovered from Murkmire! But, oh dear, you do realize you took that from a grave? Perhaps you should return it. Now. Before the grave's inhabitant seeks you out. Or is it too late.

name: Wyrd Elemental Plume
description: Use this wyrd memento to invoke elements of wind and air into a swirling vortex

name: Yokudan Totem
description: A weathered sandstone sculpture.

name: Bound Pickaxe Strike
description: "Why demean myself just because I need samples for an experiment? Minerals are so filthy. Better to let a bit of mystic ephemera do the heavy lifting."—Anendir the Enchanter

name: Druidstone Mine
description: The ores of High Isle sometimes need a little extra nudge. Luckily the Green provides, or so secondhand tales at Gonfalon Bay's Ancient Anchor claim.

name: Hroldan Hammer Mining
description: The Nords of Hroldan started using their martial hammers for mining after a bloody skirmish involving miners and Reachfolk. Vowing to never again be caught flat-footed, they perfected this method over time and shared it with Nords throughout Skyrim.

name: Lunar Oregathering
description: "May Azurah bless you. And moon's light shine forth as you work this ore."—Adept Lakjo

name: Meteor Mining
description: "Well this is just ostentatious. Instead of doing the hard work of mining you want to, what. Summon a meteor to do it for you? Ridiculous!" —Telenger the Artificer

name: Mini Siege Mining
description: An Alliance siege smith recuperating from a bout of fighting in Cyrodiil took on the task to build a better mining pick. When that didn't work out, they went with what they knew.

name: "Chained Wrath" Piercings
description: This intimidating facial jewelry, a favorite with adherents of the Daedric Prince Boethiah, conveys the idea that its wearer seethes with barely contained fury that might erupt at any provocation.

name: Adventure-Ending Arrow
description: Why am I not out adventuring? Just look down. There's an arrow, right there in my knee. The healer says I need to leave it be. But my adventuring days are behind me. Does that answer your question?

name: Amberleaf Earring
description: "Upon the felling of the maples, Y'ffre wept. Her amber tears glistened before dropping onto the leaves, encasing them in lamentation-given-form. Picking one up, she said, 'Wear these in memory of this day.' And they did."—Grove-Death of the Maples

name: Ancient Dragon Hunter Piercing
description: In a solemn ritual, the Huntmaster pierces the Dragon Hunter with further Dragon bones, recognizing that the recipient has achieved a new level of skill in killing Dragons.

name: Baandari Cheek Chain
description: Featuring a moon motif, this cheek chain is a popular ornament among the Baandari Pedlars and those who adopt their vivid style.

name: Baandari Luck Veil
description: Dancers among the Baandari Pedlars wear this tassel-laden veil that chimes and jingles with every move. Now it can be yours for a song or a dance!

name: Balfieran Nose Studs
description: During the year after Ryain Direnni's purchase of Balfiera, those attending celebratory gatherings wore these nose studs. Decades later, to claim they attended these parties, various mer commissioned tweaks to unadorned portraits to add the decoration.

name: Belly Dancer Veil
description: This pearl-encrusted, beaded veil masks the features of those ritual belly dancers who perform in Hammerfell and Tamriel's south.

name: Blue Chin Studs
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Bright Lady's Baubles
description: Inspired by a famous statue of Meridia, these earrings feature fine details that can please any devotee of the Lady of Infinite Energies. May her light shine on all your endeavors.

name: Carnaval Emerald Earrings
description: Leave your modesty at the cathedral. Sanguine celebrates excess. The flashier, the better.

name: Chaurus Egg Ear Studs
description: When a chaurus is sighted, Blackreach hunters rally to deal with the potential threat. The first to confirm a kill wins the right to wear these ear studs. But are they actual miniature eggs or simply skillful replicas?

name: Coral Snake Nose Ring
description: When you want your left nostril to say "I am elegant but dangerous" this is the accessory you're looking for!

name: Crescent Earrings
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Dangling Triple-Chain Earrings
description: Wrought from fine precious metal by master jewelers, these exquisite earrings add a flash of shining beauty to anyone's ears.

name: Dead-Water Jaw-Fin Fringe
description: It's said that a warrior of the Dead-Water tribe saw the impressive sideburns on a Breton general and decided it was a look that could be improved upon with Jaw-Fins. Wise decision.

name: Double Disc Earrings
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Doubling Diamond Earrings
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Dragondancer's Cheek Cord
description: "Those of us who relish the thought of having warm Dragon blood wash over us as we perform our killing dance? We are called Dragondancers. And we have earned this trinket on our face by shedding that blood."—Klatinja, Dragondancer

name: Dwarven Sprocket Earrings
description: On Vvardenfell, home to so many Dwarven ruins, treasure hunters scavenge the ancient sites for whatever they find that might be useful. Some Dark Elves in Balmora have built a cottage industry out of making jewelry from the parts of old Dwemer mechanisms.

name: Ear Lobe Stinger
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Ear-Runes
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Effigy Earrings of Saint Vorys
description: Forcefully express your will—by wearing golden earrings that honor both Saint Vorys the Immolant and, by extension, your ancestors. The design features the emblem of House Telvanni's patron saint.

name: Elder Dragon Hunter Piercing
description: Crafted from Dragon bone, this piercing indicates that the Dragon Hunter wearing it has slain at least one Dragon.

name: Fierce Pierce Facial Rings
description: Every barbarian warrior needs rings for the nose, brow, and ears—Fierce Piercings indeed! But keep the rings small so it doesn't give an adversary something to yank upon.

name: Floral Droplet
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Greymoor Ruby Earrings
description: These earrings feature gemstones bathed in the ichor of heretic vampires, set into an insignia cast from the silver instruments used in their executions. Only members of the Gray Host's upper echelon wear them.

name: Head and Cheekbone Studs
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Heart's Rend Earrings
description: Show everyone how you deal with affairs of the heart. Pierce with a dagger and dangle from a chain.

name: Imperial Twist Earrings
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Kris Earring
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Double Brow Studs
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Left Nostril Rings
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Legendary Dragon Piercing
description: The jagged piercings of a legendary Dragon Hunter memorialize not only your past triumphs, but all the bloody victories yet to come. Dragons beware!

name: Lucent Earrings
description: "Mother found some gorgeous topaz earrings in her jewelry box last night. The note she wrote to accompany them said 'Gift from Fargrave.' Fargrave? And gift from whom? That said, they looked stunning with her new gown."—Journal of Frugo Donze, Clothier

name: Magicka Ear Clasps
description: The design of these gilded Ear Clasps was inspired by the diagrams of Magicka flow in the Psijic Order's "Book of the Eleven Forces."

name: Magicka Nasal Rods
description: These facial adornments are not only fancy accessories for mortals of all persuasions, they also illustrate the Psijic Order's understanding of the arcane concept known as "transpontine circumpenetration of the limen."

name: Moon-and-Star Earrings
description: With a design that harkens back to Nerevar's Moon and Star ring, these earrings are worn by the leaders of Ashlander tribes. They believe the iconic symbol wards off the words of false incarnates and keeps them from successfully corrupting the tribe.

name: No Minor Adornment
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Nose Pincers
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Nose Ring and Earlobe Studs
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Nose Ring and Head Stud
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Nostril Ring and Chin Stud
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Pearl Drop Earring
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Quarter-Moon Earrings
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Quicksilver Teardrop
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Red Diamond Earrings
description: "Of course it's not the real thing—but it's a very good replica. Master jewelers studied illustrations of the Amulet of Kings to get the shape just right. What I wouldn't give to be able to see the original in person!"—Diocletia of Skingrad

name: Sabre Cat Brow Spike
description: Though Sabre Cats aren't native to Black Marsh, Argonians have long admired their fangs. They import them to use as adornments.

name: Sabre Cat Ear-Fang
description: The sabre-teeth of northern Tamriel's great hunting cats make truly imposing earrings!

name: Sacred Antler Earring
description: The Sacred Antler Earring is a subtle but elegant tribute to the Great Stag aspect of Lord Hircine, though it's also worn by nature worshipers of other faiths.

name: Scarab Earrings
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Single Crescent
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Six Brow Rings
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Solstheim Earrings
description: Skaal tales suggest the symbols on these earrings were already on trees and rocks discovered when the first Nords came to Solstheim. The All-Maker moves in mysterious, and sometimes fashionable, ways.

name: Soul Harvester Earrings
description: Much like successful merchants who save the first coin they earned, those who master the use of soul gems creatively showcase their practice morpholiths. Eldil Helothren first made wearing them as earrings fashionable among Necrom mages.

name: Splendid Seabird Earring
description: Abecean pirates string together beads, shells, and colorful feathers to create earrings. The bead's color is specific to each crew. The crew members of the Storm Snapper use blue beads and string the tail feathers of the Chain Skua into their jewelry.

name: Three-Hoop Earrings
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Topaz Nose & Ear Rings
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Triple Diamond Earrings
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Triune Loops
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Two-Loop Earrings
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Wing-Lobes
description: One of the standard adornments available at every Tamrielic salon.

name: Anchor Chain Fragment
description: A piece of broken chain of cold, black iron used by the legions of Molag Bal during the Planemeld. The first of three components required to create the Molag Bal Illusion Imp. This pet can be further transformed with additional ingredients.

name: Dark Anchor Pinion
description: A miniature replica of an Anchor Pinion used by the forces of Molag Bal during the Planemeld. The second of three components required to create the Molag Bal Illusion Imp. This pet can be further transformed with additional ingredients.

name: Effigy of the Dominator
description: A frightening effigy of Molag Bal. Its burning eyes bore into you hungrily. Is he watching you even now? The third of three components required to create the Molag Bal Illusion Imp. This pet can be further transformed with additional ingredients.

name: Mossheart Berries of Bloom
description: One of four Legendary Mossheart Berries.

name: Mossheart Berries of Budding
description: One of four Legendary Mossheart Berries.

name: Mossheart Berries of Growth
description: One of four Legendary Mossheart Berries.

name: Mossheart Berries of Ripeness
description: One of four Legendary Mossheart Berries.

name: Black Fredas Pillion Walker
description: Double trouble approaches when this pitch-black steed rides into town. With more than enough ill-tidings to go around, this Black Fredas steed is living proof that misery loves company.

name: Dark Brotherhood Crew Steed
description: The steeds of the Dark Brotherhood are conditioned to run blindly ahead in the darkness, fully trusting their riders. When the situation demands it, the horses will even run with multiple riders clinging to them on all sides, never flinching or faltering.

name: Duo-Dynamo Argent Spider
description: "Need a mount that won't eat you out of house and home? For two? Well, this argent Dwarven spider mount can manage both! And don't worry about it losing its shine—it'll gleam until the end of times."—Devbarth the Stablemaster

name: Duo-Dynamo Burnished Spider
description: "Want a distraction? If you need to head overland to your mark, take your partner with you on a shiny Dwarven spider, make a showy arrival to draw eyes away from your third, and then get to business. Never fails someone. Not me."—Dahnadreel

name: Duo-Dynamo Dwarven Spider
description: "Clearly the Dwarves liked to travel in pairs now and again, so they built this two-seated animunculi for that purpose. My partner and I adore using it on market day!"—Delyna Ulvel

name: Grand Pillion Draft Horse
description: Ride in style with a close friend or partner on this sturdy Skyrim-bred draft horse! With its pillion saddle crafted from genuine horker leather, this horse possesses strength to take two riders without breaking a sweat.

name: Hew's Bane Pillion Palfrey
description: Smuggler crews in Hew's Bane first trained these palfreys to bear two riders. Originally, the training was just a cover story to hide their illicit work. But they quickly found having a mount that could hold two extremely useful for heists.

name: Mara's Pledge Mare
description: In some towns, pledging oaths before Mother Mara is accompanied by a lavish gift. Legends describe a steed exchanged at Bravil, white as fresh snow and adorned with spring's first flowers. And thus a tradition was born that has survived until today.

name: Nightmare Pillion Courser
description: "Beware lone roads and moonless nights. Beware the haunted hooves. Beware the burning-coal eyes and the fiery trail that follows each dogged step. Most of all, beware of the path of the steed's terrible riders."—Folk Legends of Tamriel

name: Seaghost Pillion Moose
description: "I've always preferred moose to elk or horses. In battle they're more reliable, they're cussed strong, and for overland travel they can't be beat. Plus, their noses are just so soft!" —Yvon Serielle, Daggerfall

name: Skingrad Pillion Courser
description: "The first pillion mount in Skingrad came about when two of Rislav's siblings wished to ride with fewer guards about. 'Two guards per horse,' they were told. Thus they created the first battle-hardened pillion mount."—Richon Charchere, Stablemaster

name: Spiritwalker Pillion Elk
description: "Calmer than horses and more dependable than camels, elk are the preferred mount for traversing Tamriel's forests. Their regal bearing gives the rider plenty of visibility, without attracting too much attention."—Steady Hooves: An Elkback Journey

name: Wayrest Vanner Pillion Steed
description: Bred by savvy Wayrest stablehands to handle heavy loads, these horses can carry more than one rider. The saddle, crafted by leatherworker Amal, provides both riders with stability while making for an easy ride on the animal.

name: Emerald Indrik Feather
description: The first of four Legendary Indrik Feathers. Nascent Indriks have the ability to evolve when fed the proper berries.

name: Gilded Indrik Feather
description: The second of four Legendary Indrik Feathers. Nascent Indriks have the ability to evolve when fed the proper berries.

name: Onyx Indrik Feather
description: The third of four Legendary Indrik Feathers. Nascent Indriks have the ability to evolve when fed the proper berries.

name: Opaline Indrik Feather
description: The fourth of four Legendary Indrik Feathers. Nascent Indriks have the ability to evolve when fed the proper berries.

name: 10-Year Anniversary Golden Wisp
description: Celebrate the 10-Year Anniversary by dancing in the golden light of this summoned wisp.

name: 10-Year Anniversary Monkey
description: This well-dressed monkey is lively and cheerful, even in the grimmest of dungeons. Gilded and gussied up as a 10-Year tribute.

name: 10-Year Anniversary Mudcrab
description: This mudcrab is a frisky little crustacean pal who's at home in the water or out of it. Gilded and gussied up as a a 10-year tribute.

name: Abecean Ratter Cat
description: The Abecean Ratter is famed from Hegathe to Woodhearth as a prime rodent-catcher.

name: Abyssal Bunny
description: "I wished for ears that could listen to dreams. He gave them to me. How lonely was I that I needed to be part of your most private wonders? Now I wander a forest of waking horrors. Please, take care of him. It was my fault."—Note found in Jasper's basket

name: Abyssal Tomeshell
description: "Love books, do you? What if they had tentacles and an eye? The gift of flight? Like them as much then? Yes? Oh, delightful! Here, befriend my beloved Philosophicus Aeternum—Philo for short. Expand its knowledge of Nirn."—The Archivist of the Lost

name: Akaviri Potentate Bear Cub
description: "The cubs trained into steeds by the Potentate in 2E 23 proved so successful that this practice continues today. Seeing one melted my heart—that tail tassel! In their training barding, they walk through Leyawiin's streets each week."—Mirannah of Gwylim

name: Akaviri Potentate Guar Calf
description: "The Potentate first mounted up on guar steeds in 2E 27 under the Red Mountain's shadow, but they trained guar calves to the saddle just outside Mournhold. One barded calf demanded nose-pats from me when I visited—I couldn't resist."—Mirannah of Gwylim

name: Akaviri Potentate Pony
description: "In 2E 5, companies using the new enchanted barding designed by Versidue-Shaie's battlemages received their orders: hunt and kill Reman loyalists. Though initially only horses, ponies and more earned the special barding and training."—Mirannah of Gwylim

name: Akaviri Potentate Sabre Cat Cub
description: "Before heading to Skyrim in 2E 7, the Potentate had to train sabre cat cubs to the saddle. Watching these cubs pounce while wearing their training barding all these many years later almost made me lose my composure and squeal."—Mirannah of Gwylim

name: Akaviri Potentate Wolf Cub
description: "Talking with the trainers of the wolf riders that Versidue-Shaie established in 2E 4 allowed me to see the armored pups at play. I adored how they bonelessly stretched on the ground. Hard to believe they grow to be so fierce!"—Mirannah of Gwylim

name: Alabaster Jerboa
description: Need some happiness in your day? The Alabaster Jerboa is your answer. Its hopping and air-dancing acrobatics can bring a smile to even the grumpiest Dark Elf.

name: Albinoscript Fangtome
description: Fangtomes know not the importance or content of the books they inhabit. In the event that your rare first editions or vital academic texts have gained a tenant, simply befriend the tome via ample spine massages and a gentle ruffling of its pages.

name: Alcaire Blue Cockeral
description: The cockerels of Alcaire Castle uphold their noble duty and make as much noise during daybreak as possible. Their screeching continues well into the morning, waking any lucky enough to miss out on their earliest morning calls.

name: Alik'r Dune-Hound
description: The Dune-Hound is the loyal dog of the Redguard hunters of the Alik'r.

name: Alinor Ringtail
description: "Cute little thing, isn't it? 'Course, what I care about is that a Ringtail, properly trained, can get into places no one else can, and carry out small items in their cheek pouches. Lost goods, as it were, or misplaced valuables. Right?" —Fenaanaral

name: Alliance War Dog
description: War Dogs can be found in the armies of all three Alliances, mainly in the capacity of aides to the military police. They are as loyal to their masters as they are savage to their enemies. (Appearance is specific to your character's alliance.)

name: Amaranthine Pocket Watcher
description: "My notes indicate these vibrantly hued watchers once inhabited the ruins of Zaintiraris until an unfortunate explorer set them free. Given their color and origin, I suspect Sheogorath holds some sway over them. Also unfortunate."—Warlock Aldaale

name: Amber Ash Hopper
description: Native to the upper Ashlands and the slopes of Red Mountain, the perky Amber Ash Hopper is a favorite pet of Dunmer expatriates, as it's relatively low maintenance (it digs its own hole in the ground), and it reminds the Dark Elves of home.

name: Amberdust Wamasu Hatchling
description: "I found the wamasu that resisted my care. It bit my hand. It's blue! Well, more of a tealish color. Did the druid's magic affect the creature? Or was it some other factor? I think I'll release more of them!"—Valerine Cadiou, Master Beast Tamer

name: Ambersheen Vale Fawn
description: Its amber-gold glimmer creates a warmth that one stablemaster states "Can get you through chilly nights under the Skyrim stars." All it takes to keep one of these vale fawns at your side is a lick of honey now and again.

name: Ancestor Moth Swarm
description: "The Ancestor Moths that accompany some mystically-attuned mortals are more than mere insects—they are animated by the loving spirits of the dearly departed, and may grant wisdom and awareness to those they visit." —Sister Terran Arminus

name: Ancestral Haj Mota
description: In Telvanni lands, haj mota sometimes lay their eggs in broken catacombs or abandoned cemeteries. The hatchlings acquire a coating of green grave-mold on their shells and become sensitive to the presence of ghosts.

name: Anchorborn Pony
description: "Now, I says to my friend, look at all this dark anchor debris. No one's using it. No one owns it. And I look at his pony, this sickly little thing, and I say, why not make ourselves something nice?"—"Innovator" Delan

name: Ancient Dragon Hunter Wolf
description: This wolf senses the impending arrival of Dragons, making it an excellent pet for veteran Dragon Hunters.

name: Anthorbred Avalanche Dog
description: With this loyal dog at your side, you have a companion who can help you make it through even the most treacherous of avalanches in Pale Pass and other mountainous areas even if it has to pull you out from under a pile of fallen snow and detritus.

name: Apocryphal Bookwyrm
description: Some claim these curious Daedric wyrms from Apocrypha devour books to vouchsafe the knowledge for their master. Others believe cultists of Hermaeus Mora use these creatures to hunt tomes long thought lost. Perhaps you know the truth?

name: Appleback Salamander
description: Brigands in Wayrest tried to use these creatures to help them harass nobles of that town, but after that plan backfired on them, they sold their stock. Lucky for you, these fiery salamanders receive loyalty training before being sold now.

name: Arctic Fennec Fox
description: The Arctic Fennec is native to the snowy shores of Skyrim's Sea of Ghosts, and the local Nords, when they spot one romping in the drifts, respond with the traditional oath of "Shor's Ears!"

name: Arenthian Skewbald Pony
description: A reliable companion on the roads of Reaper's March. Especially popular amongst skooma smugglers that require work out of the caves along the River Strid.

name: Ascadian Cliff Strider
description: This bluish breed of Vvardenfell aerial reptile, known as the Azure or Ascadian Cliff Strider, is prized by flying-lizard fanciers as the prettiest and most ornamental of its species. Bonus: its screech terrifies crying babies into silence.

name: Ascadian Umber Sheep
description: Legends claim the Red Mountain's first eruption not only gave brown sheep their current hue, but also imbued them with the fortitude to thrive despite hardship. Knowing their sheep remain placid while in danger, many Dark Elves believe these tales.

name: Ashbone Echalette
description: Even at this small size, this echalette is rather vicious. It's not afraid to use its tiny tusks to ram perceived threats, other echalettes, or really anything that moves. It's not a very effective tactic, but it is strangely cute.

name: Ashen Cliff Strider
description: Natives of the Ashlands of Vvardenfell, these flightless, winged reptiles use their pale coloration to hide amidst that barren terrain. They can be trained, however, and follow their owners almost anywhere.

name: Ashen Scar Fellrunner
description: Prized for their striking plumage, Ashen Scar fellrunners are also highly intelligent. They bond quickly with their caretakers but are known to be quite ornery when stared at for too long. It's best to avoid eye contact when possible.

name: Ashen Scar Jerboa
description: "The Jerboas, you say? Ah, yes, the little jumping skeevers with the so-big ears. There are many in the Ashen Scar, and if you catch one when it's small, it makes for a pleasant, fuzzy friend. I had one when I was a kitten!" —Shuzirri of Riverhold

name: Ashsorrow Vvardvark
description: These ashen vvardvarks are much adored by Ashlander children. Their long tongues hungrily searching Morrowind's volcanic vents for food make for an entertaining sight.

name: Atmoran Bantam Guar
description: "A fur-less, cold-blooded reptile with icy blue eyes that comes from the frozen, far-north, and in-all-likelihood legendary continent of Atmora? Bah. I refuse to believe it." —Phrastus of Elinhir

name: Atmoran Chub Loon
description: According to Nord legend, in its native land of Atmora this Chub Loon is much larger, as tall as two warriors and with a squawk that starts avalanches. It took mighty Ysgramor a day and a night to wrestle one down from Shivering Glacier. What, you doubt?

name: Atmoran Snow Bear Cub
description: When a cub, the young Atmoran Snow Bear is a lap-clambering cuddle bug, a friendly fuzzball whose demeanor is completely at odds with the fierce reputation of adult Snow Bears. Enjoy them while they're still small!

name: Aurora Firepot Spider
description: Feeling festive? Let this little firepot spider follow you around! With its adorable alchemical light show, you're bound to brighten up anyone's day—including your own!

name: Aurulun Fledgling Gryphon
description: Spring blossoms nod their heads as if recognizing kin in this Elf-pampered companion. Some caretakers claim these gryphons provide a sense of ease to those who care for them—and pain for those who seek their demise.

name: Autumnal Indrik
description: As the weather chills and leaves take on fiery hues, the spirit of this young indrik begins to stir. When a paladin of Jephre performs an act the God of Song and Forest finds worthy, it takes its shaky steps into the world.

name: Ayrenn's Fledgling Gryphon
description: "This wondrous gift from the keepers of the Royal Menagerie tickles me so much. I hope this adorable breed finds warm hearths and caring hearts wherever they land."—Queen Ayrenn

name: Azure Fledgling Gryphon
description: The Gryphons that nest on the highest pinnacles of Eton Nir, the tallest mountain on Summerset, have a distinctive bluish tint to their plumage. Some sapiarchs call this sky-blue camouflage, but the Priests of Auri-El see in it a touch of the Divine.

name: Baby Netch
description: Once this young Netch calf imprints on a master, it will follow him or her anywhere, floating along and tootling happily.

name: Badger Ruff Echalette
description: Most Echalettes are docile and fawn-like, but not the Badger Ruff breed, which are strangely fierce and irritable. They're so ornery they've been known to chase away inquisitive Sabre Cats.

name: Bal Foyen Nix-Hound
description: Who says a giant, aggressive, blood-sucking insect can't make a loveable pet? Not the Dark Elves of Bal Foyen, who breed them as trackers, watch-hounds, and netch-deflators.

name: Bal Ur Cliff Strider
description: "Everyone told me not to explore Bal Ur. Yeah, Daedric, blah blah whatever. What's worse? Striders there go for the head in droves. Gorgeous colors, though, all red and black, so I trapped and started training them. Won't crack your crown now!"—Skorg

name: Balfiera Senche Cub
description: Bred for their lithe frame and large eyes, these senches excel at tracking prey through the dark underbrush of Balfiera. The Direnni Hegemony fell, but their senches prowl on, hunting during the night and sharpening their claws during the day.

name: Balmora Constrictor
description: "Don't mind my new friend. She's very gentle as long as nobody gets handsy. I love her emerald scales, too, don't you? A little bit of joy on days when I bring her to help me with customers."—Milesa Relavel

name: Banekin
description: Though unwilling to fight, this Daedric minion will follow you loyally—for now.

name: Bantam Guar
description: According to the calculations of the sages of the Cult of the Ancestor Moth, the Bantam Guar is the cutest creature in all Tamriel.

name: Barnacle-Back Coral Crab
description: While many crustaceans struggle to remove clinging barnacles, the Barnacle-Back Coral Crabs appreciate the company. Some naturalists believe the crabs welcome their guests' sharpened shells as an added protective layer. But maybe they're just gregarious!

name: Bear-Lizard Cub
description: Though the adult Bear-Lizards can be quite intimidating, even fearsome, the roly-poly lizard cubs are disarmingly cute. (For reptiles, that is.)

name: Belle
description: This gentle giant embodies kindness and loyalty, and her loving spirit will run alongside you forever.

name: Bergama Fennec Fox
description: The Ash'abah revere Fennec Foxes for leading lost children back to the tribe. Scholars say that it is more likely the foxes are seeking out the nearest watering hole, which is usually where the tribes are anyway.

name: Big-Eared Ginger Kitten
description: The Big-Eared Ginger, a favorite shipboard pet, is just about the most playful kitten in Summerset. Its over-sized sound catchers enable it to hear every tiny motion within range before it pounces upon it.

name: Big-Eared Ginger Mouser
description: The Ginger Mouser is a favorite barn cat of grain farmers all across central Tamriel, not just because it keeps the storage bins rodent-free, but also for its affectionate personality and goofy good looks.

name: Biscuit Bear-Dog
description: Hunters often rely on the services of a loyal dog to protect them as they retrieve their kills. This breed not only ensures that their hunter remains well-guarded, but also provides quiet companionship.

name: Bitter Coast Cliff Strider
description: Thetys Ramarys of Balmora says "I love our Bitter Coast Striders, but feel bad that they can't fly very well. So I'm selectively breeding them into a strain that, one day, will dominate the Vvardenfell skies, pursuing its prey for great distances!"

name: Bitter Coast Wasp
description: "My family thinks wasps are the worst, but one of these solitary fellows helped me stave off a cliff strider attack. It started following me after it nibbled on a strider I'd killed. I guess it likes to eat them."—Gellius Nuncius, Wanderer

name: Black Bear Cub
description: The Black Bear Cub is both playful and affectionate, and is so adorable it's quickly forgiven for whatever trouble it gets into.

name: Black Cat
description: This black cat knows things you cannot know, and sees things you cannot see. But that is the nature of all black cats, is it not?

name: Black Heights Squirrel
description: "Debassi is enamored by this critter's festive coat! Reds brighter than the blood splats on Black Heights' roads! But Debassi is sure this is not blood. He's seen enough robberies to know!"—Debassi, Traveling Merchant

name: Black Mask Bear-Dog
