description: Ever notice how everyone in Tamriel keeps a journal? Now you can show the world that you're making your own scholarly record of your adventures and the deeds of those around you. Perhaps the pen IS mightier than the sword.

name: Swashbuckler
description: You've braved dangerous waters and seedy back-alleys. Now, on land or sea, your telltale swagger marks you as someone who's comfortable in all manner of deadly environments!

name: Telvanni Magister
description: "We have one rule that governs the actions of every member of House Telvanni—there are no rules. We are ambitious, curious, devious, and, yes, power-hungry. For the mage with the most power wins, and the winner is always right."—Magister Gothren

name: Thief
description: "If you're going to sneak, for the love of Tava don't do it half-heartedly. Hide! Be furtive! Lurk like you mean it! Because I'm done bailing you out of the Abah's Watch lock-up." —Zeira of the Thieves Guild

name: Treasure Hunter
description: The serious treasure hunter knows it's really all about the gear. Whether you're exploring subterranean catacombs, ancient ruins, or a shattered shipwreck, when you run into an obstacle, you want to have the right tool at hand.

name: Worm Wizard
description: There's just something about Worm Anchorites, those creepy necromancers of the Worm Cult, and the sinister way they act. It's almost as if dealing with the undead has an unhealthy effect on one's personality.

name: Zombie
description: Graargh URR agg rhhh HAAAGH gug gug gug. RrrrrRRrrrrawww! GHORF blafffft urgl! Sneg?

name: Crematory Ash
description: An urn of cold ashes pilfered from Coldharbour and magically sealed to prevent the escape of any detritus — or wailing ghosts. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Planemeld's Master markings.

name: Incandescent Brimstone
description: Blazing with cold-fire, it is unclear whether the source of this stone is Coldharbour's blighted substrata or the remains of some Daedric creature. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Planemeld's Master markings.

name: Seething Censer
description: Anything placed within this black iron censer is "burnt" to ash in cold-fire, dissolved by a frigidity so unnatural that it is akin to a furnace. A component required to morph a Molag Bal Illusion Imp into the Planemeld's Master markings.

name: Bone Harvest
description: There's more to necromancy than harvesting bodies and playing with bones. Living things such as plants and herbs have a place in the practice—although that doesn't mean necromancers can't gather the materials with their own grim flair.

name: Fate Strand Harvest
description: "Strands of fate form the tapestry of life, and more. Pluck a few, my child, and shape the moment as you will. What you gather today will garb or nourish you tomorrow."—Witchweaver Koirah

name: Grovetender's Sweep
description: The druids of the Systres often use a blessed sickle to harvest plants and herbs. Why not give it a try yourself?

name: Gyrfalcon Gather
description: When trained, the High Isle gyrfalcon can spot and retrieve plants for the handler. Druids claim this is Y'ffre's will.

name: Malacath's Harvest
description: "Never underestimate any foe. And that includes the wilds of Wrothgar. Even the plants put up a fight here, which is why I use my ancestor's sharpest dagger and pray to Malacath with each sweep."—Ghaz of Orsinium

name: Murkmire Harvest
description: Harvest from nature with the care of the Argonians of Murkmire.

name: Personal Plant Thief
description: In seconds, this well-trained prairie dog can pilfer flora you need for your crafting. Be careful, this charming little rogue might steal your heart!

name: Accursed Death
description: Become one with death, allowing it to flow from within you and change your very appearance. This Polymorph will also override any currently equipped Personality

name: Armor of the Unfeathered
description: "Scholars of the topic once gathered to re-enact the battle between Pelinal Whitestrake and Umaril the Ayleid sorcerer-king. Thankfully, their well-crafted illusion magics live on to this day. Care to daunt the dauntless by donning it?"—Stephen Surilie

name: Azure Blight Spriggan
description: The otherworldly blue glow of the Azure Blight radiates from the cracks in your illusory bark, screaming "danger" to anything that lays eyes on you. Though your corrupted appearance is a false one, the menace becomes you.

name: Bloodroot Spriggan
description: Like the vines choking the Bloodroot Forge, your boughs share Hircine's thirst for prey. Bathe your roots in the blood of the fallen and feel it course through the crimson arteries of the predator that you are.

name: Boneman
description: "We die. We pray. To live. We serve."—The Boneman's Oath, The Book of Life and Service

name: Cadaverous Assassin
description: "Yea, those brothers and sisters who have spoken the Litany of Blood may thereafter walk as Cadaverous Assassins, striking fear of loathsome death into the hearts of all who behold them."

name: Clockwork Curator
description: It seems that permanent residence within a titanic factotum wears heavily upon one. A vacation, then, may be better for the soul in the end. This Polymorph will also override any currently equipped Personality

name: Draugr
description: This guise makes the wearer appear to have withered flesh beneath ancient Nord armor—perfect for lurking in tombs.

name: Dread Anka-Ra
description: When Emperor Tarish-Zi returned out of the mists of the past, his ancient warriors rose from the dead to serve him as the stony Anka-Ra, undead that seemed hewn from rock itself. It could be a good look for you.

name: Factotum
description: Adopt the perfected form of a Factotum and move with clockwork precision. This Polymorph will also override any currently equipped Personality Alters the /idle /sleep /bow. /twiddle /wave /hammerwall /hammerlow, and /dance emotes

name: Glass Atronach
description: Spin an illusion to appear as a scintillating glass Atronach, native of the realm of Mirrormoor. Those razor-sharp edges reflect how dangerous you truly are.

name: Harrowing Reaper
description: Terrify your enemies. Don the guise of the dreaded harrowing reaper! It's time to reap what they sowed!

name: Iron Atronach
description: Not content to simply summon iron atronachs, some mages weave powerful illusions to assume the shape of these molten behemoths! Harden your heart and embrace the iron!

name: Lich
description: "Want to look like a lich without all the bother of manipulating your own soul? Illusion's your friend! Just work magic from this school and before you can say "Mannimarco's a s'wit" you're a figure of necromantic majesty."—Othreloth Hlaalo, Illusionist

name: Maelstrom Baron
description: The Barons-Who-Move-Like-This are paragons of the martial arts styles of Oblivion. They are also psycho-magical projections from the mind of Daedric Demiprince Fa-Nuit-Hen, his concept of perfect masters of combat.

name: Minotaur
description: Though you may not truly be a Minotaur, you can take on challenges in the name of Morihaus and bring further honor to his name.

name: Molag Bal Illusion
description: Assume the fearsome visage of the Prince of Schemes. Ride to war atop the Shackled Titan to terrify your enemies. The battlefield is yours to dominate!

name: Pumpkin Spectre
description: A Pumpkin Spectre is like a horrific figure from a skooma-induced nightmare! And with this costume, the wearer can take on the semblance of these dread monsters.

name: Reaper's End Scarecrow Spectre
description: "Harvest's reaping brings out all sorts of ill-omened beings. I avoid that nonsense by looking like a scarecrow spectre animated by amethyst flames. An illusion, yes, but yours if you can handle the terror you'll inflict."—Othreloth Hlaalo, Illusionist

name: Scarecrow Spectre
description: The dark magic that makes a spectre animate a scarecrow is thought to be related to those spells that create lurchers from spriggans. Wherever they come from, this costume enables the wearer to appear to be one of these Scarecrow Spectres.

name: Shade
description: While you may not actually become a nightmare straight out of a necromancer's fever dreams, you can certainly fool onlookers by taking on the guise of a shade. Just try not to do any cutesy things while drifting around. Ruins the immersion.

name: Shadowsilk Goblin
description: Feel left out? Alienated? Alone? Adopt the form of a Shadowsilk Goblin, and you might* find that sense of belonging you crave among these creatures! Fleas not included, but easily attainable. *Might is no guarantee. They may try to eat you instead.

name: Skeleton
description: This guise causes the user to take on the appearance of a living skeleton.

name: Solstheimstone Incarnate
description: Invoke the icy fury of the frozen north with this Daedric seeming. Even the fiercest foes will freeze in their tracks when confronted with an incarnation of a Solstheim blizzard.

name: Soulrazer Knight
description: While the origin of the Soulrazer Knights is shrouded in mystery, their power and dogged determination are legendary. Assume their guise and watch your enemies run in terror at the sight of your unnatural glow.

name: Storm Atronach
description: With lightning in your blood and thunder in your heart, the mere appearance of a storm atronach sunders enemy lines. Take charge of the battle with this polymorph, and see why so many fear the oncoming storm.

name: Sylvan Spriggan
description: Befriend your fellow woodland creatures as you dance under the forest's boughs, swaying gracefully in the guise of a sylvan-born spriggan, and unleash nature's fury on those who intrude upon the Green.

name: Tidal Wave Incarnate
description: Gather the power of Daedric energies within you, then explode with lightning in the form of a cobalt-blue Incarnate. Channeling the power of a tidal wave, you'll make quite an impact on your friends.

name: Vampiric Soulrazer Knight
description: The Soulrazer Knights of High Isle were intimidating enough on their own—before a vampire twisted that power to suit their needs. Now, you too can burn with a glorious, bloody purpose.

name: Voskrona Guardian
description: Mystically take the shape of an unstoppable Argonian temple guardian! It may not solve all of your problems? But it will at least create new ones.

name: Werewolf Lord
description: Wear Hircine's Gift with pride as the leader of the lycanthrope pack with the Werewolf Lord polymorph. Time to howl!

name: Winterborn Spriggan
description: The quiet desolation of snow-laden forests instills a sense of undisturbed peace. Take on the aspect of stoic winter spriggans that preserve this unmolested tranquility.

name: Witches Fest Skeleton
description: Granted via the Witches Fest.

name: Wraith-of-Crows
description: Pay homage to Nocturnal the Night Mistress by assuming the appearance of her horrific half-bird servant!

name: Xivkyn Augur
description: Xivkyn with exceptional mystical talents are subject to the horrific mental intrusions of the God of Schemes, shattering their mind and making them conduits for his dark visions. The Augurs are chief among these ravaged sorcerers.

name: Xivkyn Dreadguard
description: The dreadguards are the armor-clad shock troops of Molag Bal—utterly loyal, fearless, and bereft of the pedantic attitudes of the lesser Dremora-kyn.

name: Xivkyn Tormentor
description: Tormentors are those among the Xivkyn schooled in the anatomies of both mortals and Daedra, studying the arts of inflicting pain over several lifetimes of men and mer.

name: Pure-Snow Berries of Bloom
description: One of four Legendary Pure-Snow Berries.

name: Pure-Snow Berries of Budding
description: One of four Legendary Pure-Snow Berries.

name: Pure-Snow Berries of Growth
description: One of four Legendary Pure-Snow Berries.

name: Pure-Snow Berries of Ripeness
description: One of four Legendary Pure-Snow Berries.

name: Accursed Recall
description: Something about this entrancing orb feels off. Perhaps give it a try for the sake of knowledge? Just be ready for anything!

name: Bitter Coast Recall
description: The mages of southwestern Vvardenfell were inspired by the smoking vision of Red Mountain on the horizon. If crimson is your color, this variant is perfect for you!

name: Coldfire Recall
description: "The cold-flames speak to me. Will the flames speak to you, too, calling you to a master? Or perhaps you are a master—of bones? No matter. Go where your path leads, as I do. Perhaps we'll meet next in Coldharbour?"—Ymirra, Master of Bone and Scythe

name: Coldharbour Recall
description: "Anchorites bound to the chains of the master travel by the will of Molag Bal alone." —Worm Adept Ivulen

name: Featherdance Carnaval Recall
description: Let the spirit of the Carnaval festival take you away!

name: Frostfall Recall
description: You hoped that aetheric scroll would let you recall faster. Instead this mysticism's gone frostily awry. Pack some warm clothes.

name: Gold Road Recall
description: "If every soldier in my company could tap into the magic of the Weald, I'd have much less to worry about. Making a hasty retreat isn't a sign of weakness. It's a logistical goldmine." —Lieutenant Agrance

name: Legionnaire's Recall
description: "One of the Legion Zero traitors we'd been tracking called forth some sort of circle and vanished before we could ambush him. What foul magics have they learned in their time here?"—Scrap from the journal of Tatius Nerva

name: Mage's Guild Recall
description: "When the guild asks you to blend teleportation and illusion magic, you don't ask why. You set to work on thaumaturgical manipulation. I'm quite proud of how it turned out, really."—Donovan Renoit

name: Recall of the Crusader
description: Let the fire of righteousness kindle within your heart. Let that flame carry you to your next worthy endeavor.

name: Recall of the Galen Wilds
description: Walking through the old growth of the Galen wilds leaves a tangible mark on the soul.

name: Recall of the Outer Darkness
description: Shadows often cloak the movements of assassins. Those who learn the methods of these lethal stalkers may discover hidden paths through deeper darkness, allowing them to travel great distances.

name: Golden Fabric
description: Gold, a color associated with most Divines, symbolizes the value of logic to priests of Julianos. A component required to morph a Stonewisp of Truth and Law into the Robes of Truth and Law costume.

name: Sapphire Fabric
description: A shimmering blue fabric, glistening in the light as though tiny sapphires were somehow woven into it. A component required to morph a Stonewisp of Truth and Law into the Robes of Truth and Law costume.

name: Torc of Wisdom
description: A minor enchanted item, used to quiet the mind during times where intense concentration and detached logic are required. A component required to morph a Stonewisp of Truth and Law into the Robes of Truth and Law costume.

name: Ashen Runegathering
description: With a flourish of your sharp Ashlander blade, you collect a runestone in the manner taught to you by the people of the wastes.

name: Frost Draugr Runegathering
description: "When you bury a dagger to the hilt in more frost draugr than even a skald can count, it gets numbingly cold to the touch and stays that way. Makes them perfect for prying runestones, though you'd best wear gloves."—Brendravald

name: Icefist Runegathering
description: Punching things with an icy fist may not solve every problem out there, but you've figured out a way to gather runestones that takes advantage of this technique. Smashing!

name: Logical Rune Extraction
description: After years of study, several mages faithful to Julianos developed a less labor intensive method to acquire runes. A practical application of wisdom if ever there was one.

name: Reach Witch Removal
description: Claim this tool, inlaid with numerous Reach enchantments and perfect for rune extraction. A hallmark of the Karth River Reach clans.

name: Engraved Glassblowing Tools
description: Blessed and engraved tools for glassblowing. A component required to morph a Soulfire Dragon Illusion into the Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh furnishing.

name: Hallowed White-Gold Ingot
description: A sanctified ingot of specially-prepared white gold. A component required to morph a Soulfire Dragon Illusion into the Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh furnishing.

name: Mysterious Time-Lost Sands
description: Two pouches of sand, one golden and one black. Touching the sands calls forth memories of experiences long ago and those yet to be experienced. A component required to morph a Soulfire Dragon Illusion into the Sacred Hourglass of Alkosh furnishing.

name: Delver's Alessia Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Saint Alessia.

name: Hero's Alessia Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Saint Alessia.

name: Seeker's Alessia Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck that tells the story of Saint Alessia.

name: Shattered Alessia Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Saint Alessia.

name: Slayer's Alessia Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create a Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Saint Alessia.

name: Aureate Anointing Oils
description: Sacred golden oils rubbed on the skin before holy rituals to the Dragon God. A component required to morph a Soulfire Dragon Illusion into the Scales of Akatosh skin.

name: Lustrous Ritual Sand
description: A scattering of pearlescent hourglass sand. A component required to morph a Soulfire Dragon Illusion into the Scales of Akatosh skin.

name: Sacred Scale
description: A single golden dragonscale. A component required to morph a Soulfire Dragon Illusion into the Scales of Akatosh skin.

name: Altered Ornaug
description: This beast is the result of a collaboration between Shad Astula students and Mages Guild apprentices. Rumor is it may be slightly psychic, responding to its rider's commands almost before they're uttered aloud. The color is a nice bonus, too.

name: Amenos Ornaug
description: Though still feared by those traveling to and from Amenos, the ornaug packs native to local waters can serve as loyal steeds if tamed and trained. Or so say the prisoners dreaming of freedom on that prison isle.

name: Buoyant Armiger Ornaug
description: "Exuberance flowed from the emerald ornaug, then it despaired. 'It enjoyed its freedom from the cage, yet lack of purpose brought it low. Perhaps Lord Vivec can grant it one among us.' And so it joined our other three steeds."—Armiger Tharys's Journal

name: Buraniim Isle Ornaug
description: The shallows of Buraniim Isle are rife with a unique subspecies of ornaug. Vibrant and playful, these ornaugs have been known to splash in the surf to attract the curiosity of would-be prey. When the unsuspecting meal draws too close, they strike.

name: Lucent Guardian Ornaug
description: Specially bred to fight Daedra, this ornaug has a jaw that has been left free of armor. Its powerful bite can cut through even Daedroth hide, and its tough scales are resistant to scrapes and cuts.

name: Reefstrider Ornaug
description: Scales the color of High Isle's sky speckle this beast, making it highly sought after by nobles. When domesticated, the Reefstrider joyfully takes its rider across tidepools and shallows, but avoids the deeps—especially in northern climes.

name: Shallowstalker Ornaug
description: The shimmering blues and purples of this ornaug mimic the coral shallows around Galen. If you stumble upon these playful creatures cavorting in the water, move slowly and you may just tickle their curiosity. If they like you, one might even adopt you.

description: Applies to Whirlwind, Whirling Blades, and Steel Tornado. Select in Skills Menu.

name: Aether-Tempered Mystic
description: "There are many wonders in this world, and many mysteries, too. One can never hope to unravel them all. Those who peer too deeply are likely to find themselves changed by the journey."—Mage Gwenieth

name: Amber Plasm
description: Proudly display your victory in Mazzatun with this daub of glowing and magically-infused amber plasm!

name: Arctic Rime Skin
description: "I found the shipwreck locked in ice. The crew were all frozen and frostbitten, and I thought they were dead until they rose, frost-crusted and icy, and picked up their weapons." —Aelfrydda of Dawnstar

name: Ardor's Devotion
description: You have bathed in the pool of Dibella's adoration and come out transformed. Flowers of many pastel hues decorate your form, bringing joy and smiles to those who interact with you.

name: Astral Sheen
description: "Let the power of the stars wash over you, my friend. Your skin will take on an astral gleam. On hazy nights when constellations grow dim, the Star-Gazers may turn their eyes to you instead!"—Overheard in Belkarth

name: Ayleid Ruins Wildgrowth
description: Potent magic lies buried in the roots of the Dawnwood. Ancient Ayleid ruins have been touched by the Green. Verdant, wild, and uncontainable, some resist the pernicious growth. Others embrace this fertile power.

name: Azure Imp Epidermis
description: "Some, shall we say, ambitious sorts came up with a way to look a bit like those azure imps you sometimes see flitting about. No, you don't gain wings, but you'll very likely frighten most people out of their wits regardless."—Divayth Fyr

name: Bargain-Marked Skaafin
description: Whether you hope to travel safely through the Fields of Regret by looking more like a Skaafin or wish to appeal to Clavicus Vile, this skin has you covered—literally.

name: Barkroot Blessing
description: "Some druids seek an understanding of nature by opening themselves to the cycle of the seasons. Rooted, they gain leaves and bark, taking in water and nutrients as would a tree. Or so the druids at the Jaded Ornaug claimed last night."—Aurelienne Broles

name: Black Sacrament Skincarving
description: Some carve themselves in symbols of the Black Sacrament out of devotion to the Night Mother. Others do so because they came to the Dark Brotherhood after performing their own Black Sacrament. Which are you?

name: Blackmarrow Necromancer
description: Feel the uncanny power of Necromancy radiate from your very flesh with the eerie Blackmarrow Skin! It's as creepy as undeath itself, and a great conversation starter down at the tavern.

name: Blood-Drained Thrall
description: Are you the thrall of a vampire? Would you like to show the truth of that to the world? Now you can!

name: Blood-Forged
description: Blood. Nirncrux. Iron. Combined with the unholy rites of the Reachmen at the Bloodroot Forge, the result is a clinker-cracked, glowing-hot skin like no other: the Blood-Forged!

name: Bloodfiend
description: "Whether afflicted by the Rivenspire blood-curse or some other vile vampiric corruption, the result is the same: Victims transform into ravenous monsters. These creatures know nothing but rage and hunger. Appalling."—Nalana, Advisor to House Tamrith

name: Bloodmarks of Malacath
description: Malacath demands utter devotion from his followers. Only the most ardent are rewarded with the chance to bloody their skin in his honor. The scars and wounds are a sign of one's worthiness.

name: Boralis Wolf Pelt
description: "Be wary of spending too long in the wild, traveler. It may be freeing to give in to your more feral instincts in the moment, but too long away from civilization may reveal truths that were better left unspoken."—Widow Granger, Northsalt Village

name: Bright-Throat Scale
description: "Kaoc! That luridly patterned Scale Skin style worn by the Bright-Throats is far too gaudy. Could a serious person appear in public like that? I think not." —Jaxsik-Orrn of the Dead-Water tribe

name: Brineglow
description: Extensive proximity to a certain breed of ornaug may cause these unusual luminescent markings to appear. Or such is the claim of the druids. True or not, they make for great tavern discussions.

name: Cold-Flame Epidermis
description: Fancy Cold-Flame Atronachs, do you? Their frozen blue flames? That rock-hard physique? Well, now you can make those elements your own! Perfect for when you need to give someone the cold shoulder.

name: Crystalfrost
description: "The Crystalfrost skin is a cosmetic Alteration spell that gives a mortal the appearance of a Frost Atronach. Why would a mortal want to look like a Frost Atronach? Don't ask me, I don't even like putting on makeup." —Gabrielle Benele, Mages Guild

name: Culanda-Born Skin
description: "Grant your skin the vibrant hues of Culanda with this luminescent golden enchantment! That's what they promised, these Summerset High Elves, and they delivered—magnificently! People's eyes light up when I enter the room!"—Tarquinius Truptor, Esquire

name: Dagon's Viscerent
description: You'd give anything to Mehrunes Dagon. Offerings of destruction. Of blood. Even your life. Already, you've earned the crimson-fire brand of his viscerents after feeding your epidermis to him bit by bit. Your devotion is bared to all. Glory to Dagon!

name: Dawnwood Tender's Skin
description: A binding mark that signifies a Dawnway follower's resolve in following their Ayleid ancestor heritage.

name: Dead-Water Scale
description: "Not to be overly critical, but in my opinion the shadowy Scale Skin of the Dead-Waters is entirely too austere. Though it is, I admit, simple and elegant." —Xukas

name: Deadlands Brand
description: Do you revel in cataclysmic forces? Is vindication best reflected in ruining all who thwart you? Perhaps you revere the destructive Daedric Prince Mehrunes Dagon. Whatever the case, this ruddy-hued skin reflects your true nature.

name: Deadlands Excoriated
description: "Those who swear loyalty to Mehrunes Dagon and receive his blessing are forever changed. The flensing of the skin to receive the sacred crimson ink, though painful, purifies the recipient for what's to come."—Disastrix Zansora

name: Deadlands Scorcher
description: The glow of the Deadlands has seeped into your very essence, causing your skin to both redden and blacken. The brands of Mehrunes Dagon's realm blaze upon you. Do not fail him.

name: Decayed Zombie
description: Decayed Zombie: the skin condition no amount of Lillandril Moisturizing Lotion can cure! Pairs well with Worm Cult style armor.

name: Do'Krin Ascetic's Henna
description: "To teach within the Order of the Claw, one must first pass the Trials of the Ascetic. In one trial, you must meditate without pause while another designs patterns on your skin with henna. Perhaps next time this one shall pass that trial."—Kansur-jo

name: Dreadhorn Shaman
description: Those who assist in the dark rituals of the Dreadhorn Reachclan must first coat their skin in a chalky whitewash, and then draw scarlet sigils of power upon it in a thick paint mixed of nirncrux and blood.

name: Dro-m'Athra
description: One who wears this skin adopts the eerie appearance of a dro-m'Athra or Bent Cat, an evil ancestor spirit of the Khajiit.

name: Dusky Guarhide
description: Murkmire itself accepts you as its champion, transforming your body to suit the deeper wallows and afford greater camouflage in its murky swamps and marshes. As mud is your mother!

name: Ebony Epidermis
description: Never trust an alchemist with a Daedric scroll—you might end up with skin that's the color and hardness of Ebony! Unless you think that's a good idea, of course.

name: Ethertide
description: "I walked through the waters of the Ancient Darkness. The waves of the Void washed through me. Tread in the nothingness too long and it seeps into you. Mangles you. Twists you into something other than what you were."—Opius Balvel, Oblivion Walker

name: Fabrication Sheath
description: Proudly display your victory in the Halls of Fabrication with this sheath of burnished bronze!

name: Fargrave Walker
description: "Walk the streets of Fargrave. Take in the exotic scents of this fabled city. Listen to the mysteries that whisper to you with every breeze. And, when you're ready, let the Celestial Palanquin claim you as one of its own."—Tirasie Mirel

name: Flesh of the Harrowed
description: The power of the harrowstorm ripples just beneath your skin. Let that energy surge forth and impress—or terrify—all those around you.

name: Fractured Glory
description: Sometimes the most beautiful things are those which have shattered and been pieced back together. Bear your cracks proudly—they are the hard-won trophies of all the things that could not break you.

name: Frosthaunt Glister
description: "Be it icy gales or vengeful souls that drag ye into the Sea of Ghosts, your fate will be the same. To join the reef of frozen dead in the frigid depths. Locked in ice as dark as that abyss for all eternity."—Frig the Stormrider

name: Glimmertarn Glow
description: "Druid chants drift through the air as one of their number drinks deeply of the glowwine. Slowly, the alchemy spreads throughout the body and skin, suffusing it with the amaranthine-hued blessing of the God of Song and Forest."—Book of the Leaves

name: Glowgill Guarhide
description: Skin tone changes, taking on the texture of rough hide. Glowing blue markings. Some attribute these skin changes to the Hist. Riders of these glowing steeds believe that this transition occurs as you increase your bond with your beast.

name: Grace of the Green
description: The forest god Y'ffre's blessings manifest in many different ways. Feel your own connection grow as flowers sprout from the vines weaving underneath your verdant skin.

name: Harvestleaf Lacquer
description: "In my dream, the lava poured down the valley. I called to the winds and the trees to save me, and they answered. A shield from the flames. Their mark has never left me."—Initiate Selyna

name: Hist-Tsoko
description: "Hist-Tsoko are the elder Hists. Rarely, they mark one to carry out a sacred task, and we know to provide aid to them. Sometimes we give words. Sometimes goods. Sometimes distance."—Attributed to Sap-Speaker Kuzei

name: Hollow Void Husk
description: The nothingness inside you—that boundless emptiness—wants out. It craves to swallow all that is not you and make it nothing. It won't fill the void inside you, but letting it consume gives your hollowed body a moment's release from its gnawing.

name: Impish Epidermis
description: Morality is a useless cause with no end other than smug self-satisfaction. Cast that aside and showcase your mischievous nature. You'll know you've succeeded in shirking your former self when your scarred skin pulls tightly across your chest.

name: Infernal Epidermis
description: Look like an ever-burning Flame Atronach from Oblivion with the Infernal Epidermis, a smoking-hot skin of fire, ash, and charcoal.

name: Kyne's Fury
description: Those who anger Kyne must meet her fury. Transform yourself into a living embodiment of her wrath with this skin.

name: Labyrinthian Luminary
description: Originally gifted to students who passed his most difficult tests in Labyrinthian, the mazelike designs that the Archmage Shalidor's magic granted lingers. To this day, worthy newcomers sometimes gain these ornate patterns.

name: Magmaheart
description: "Little stops the patient flow of magma, or so druids have always known. Seeing this quality in you, they whispered words that set your very being aflame. Now, I free you. Go, heart of magma. Burn."—Druid Llanith

name: Maormer Fish
description: It's said that under certain conditions the Maormer, like chameleons, can change the appearance of their skin. Emulate that legendary ability with this blue-scaled Fish Skin.

name: Marshmist Palescale
description: Most Argonians live above ground, where the sun can shine on the leaves of their Hists, but some, strange and reclusive, live in subterranean caverns. Over time their scales grow as pale as marsh mist.

name: Meadowbreeze Memories
description: Spring flows through your veins even as greenery traces itself across your skin, creating white blooming flowers. Thanks to Y'ffre, the scents and sensations of past springs on breezy meadows sweep over you.

name: Meridian Purified
description: "Those who betray their oaths to the Lady of Infinite Energies will be purged of their corruption, lustrated, and purified so they can endure to fulfill their vows. Forever." —Sayings of Valasha

name: Mind-Shriven
description: This costume gives the wearer the appearance of those tragic mortals whose will and mentality have been stolen by Molag Bal.

name: Mireheart Scale
description: Most adventurers who drink corrupted Hist sap die in frothing agony. But for a precious few, the ritual bestows dubious "gifts" such as polished green scales and veins that glow like precious amber.

name: Mirrormoor Metamorphosis
description: "I find peace and soul's release when casting on the 'moor. With oiled skin, reflections spin, mirror's grace implored. A shimmer here, a glimmer there, my form reflects the light. Forever lost, forever found, mirror's fated knight."—Lost in Mirrormoor

name: Mossblood Imp Epidermis
description: "The mossblood imp's coloration lends itself well to walking undetected among the foliage of Valenwood. But perhaps that's not what the mages intended given the provenance of the imp. Unintended consequences abound with imp-related projects."—Divayth Fyr

name: Mystic Magicka Molt
description: Harnessing the power of magicka is an art—one that requires care. This source can be quite volatile at times, leaving arcane energy crackling just below the skin of the unwary user. Anyone can become a conduit if they are not careful.

name: Namira's Bile
description: A life in Namira's service often brings bleak and horrifying side-effects. Praise Namira, the Lady of Decay and the Great Darkness! With eyes awash in pitch black ichor, you shall see her will fulfilled.

name: Ocean Lamellar
description: When threatened, the scales on some Sea Elves lengthen from flimsy scales to broad plates. With wider scales of your own, you'll look ready for the danger of crossing the seas in search of enemies and adventure.

name: Opalescent Epidermis
description: Shimmer with a variety of hues, taking on the colors of the famed opals of Yokuda, with this skin. Perfect for star-strewn celebrations in Sentinel and beyond.

name: Orphan of the Stars
description: "The night sky isn't absent of Meridia's light, lonely one. In fact, it's the place where it can be felt the most keenly, when the smallest mote of luminance stands in stark contrast to the abounding shadows."—Dorathil, Hollow City mage

name: Peryite's Afflicted
description: Join the ranks of Peryite's plague-ridden adherents and enjoy all they have to offer, including a diseased appearance!

name: Preening Peacock
description: "I felt beige. All over. Very beige. People ignored me, and I was sad. Then I got an idea. People pay attention to peacocks. So, why not look more like them? Colorful. Delightful. And very much not beige. My magic worked!"—Entry from an Anonymous Journal

name: Rain's Hand Renewal
description: "After a dry winter, priests of Y'ffre perform a ritual intended to ensure gentle storms arrive. During a successful ritual, leaves appear to grow on the body of a chosen one, who can forevermore call upon this leafy appearance at will."—Richien Thalin

name: Rainsiren Nereid
description: Dance in joyful waters and cavort in turbulent tributaries while flaunting the brilliant blues of the Riversiren Nereid. While you may not choose to live in the waters of Tamriel's rivers, you'll certainly make a vibrant splash wherever you go.

name: Reanimated Vampiric Thrall
description: "Despite the secrecy surrounding Lady Thorn, a vampire, recent rumors suggest her castle teems with activity and ghastly new thralls. Disturbing, if true. I await further details."—Nalana, Advisor to House Tamrith

name: Red Diamond Guardian
description: After the Soulburst, mysterious slate-skinned figures appeared in the Imperial City to fight Daedra. Each one has the Red Diamond encrusted upon their torso. To this day, none know where they come from or where they go after each fray.

name: Reefdweller
description: The colorful inhabitants of High Isle reefs often act differently when land-dwellers approach. To better swim among the local aquatic life, druids imitate them by imbuing their skin with gorgeous blues and greens. Care to try it?

name: Runic Seabrume
description: Enter crashing waves to take part in an ancient ceremony known only to the clever women of Skyrim. Runes bind your blood to the tides, and your skin mirrors the sea's restless waters. To what end? Only time will tell.

name: Sable Man-Beast
description: As a murderous beast who lurks in the darkness, to become the color of shadows is only natural. As natural as the blood of the innocents that drips from your claws.

name: Sanctified Silver
description: Shine with the radiance of the purified Saints of the Asylum Sanctorium with this sheen of silvery skin.

name: Sanguine's Disciple
description: "Nothing brings peace like a glass of wine and a little dancing! Under the skin, everyone belongs to Sanguine! We just bring that to the surface."—Ree-Jaa, Sanguine Disciple

name: Scales of Akatosh
description: Not content to simply bear Akatosh's symbol, some of the Dragon God's most ardent worshipers use magic to adorn their skin with golden scales. Display your devotion to the greatest of the Divines with this resplendent skin!

name: Scales of the Celestial Serpent
description: The honor of being born under the Serpent is a mixed blessing that heralds life's harshest distresses as well as its sweetest celebrations. Embrace being a charge of the Serpent and hold on to all that comes to you in a crushing embrace.

name: Scourger's Scales
description: After performing bloody rites of devotion, Dagon's most zealous cultists earn the right to shed their mortal form. Hours of ritual scourging shears their skin, revealing a coat of crimson scales beneath. Are you willing to endure this metamorphosis?

name: Seaborn Silver
description: The legendary might of the Sea Giants is the envy of any warrior. A superstitious few choose to dye their skin like stormy skies and paint themselves with silver markings in hopes of channeling that power.

name: Shallowbay Nereid
description: "Splash among the fish and flora? Looking like a nereid scaled in hues of coral, pearl, and night? Speak to me no more of this pure joy. This unadulterated bliss. You merely tease, yes. Yet magic, you say?"—Tariran, Seeker of New Experiences

name: Shivering Isles Anointment
description: Butterflies. Glowing pink eyes. The Shivering Isles calls to you. Will you fight the call or bend the knee to the Mad God?

name: Skin of the Anchorite
description: The followers of Molag Bal give themselves over to the Prince's will. For most, this means forfeiting their souls. For others, their sacrifice burns them from the inside out.

name: Slag Town Diver
description: Treasure rests beneath the oily waters in Clockwork City for those with the guts to plumb deeply into its viscous lubricants. Your valiant effort to dredge up valuable scrap gives your skin a slippery, many-hued sheen.

name: Soul-Shriven
description: Donning this costume gives the wearer the guise of one of the Soul-Shriven, Molag Bal's slaves in his Oblivion plane of Coldharbour.

name: Spellscar Sheathe
description: The power of the Spellscar transforms your appearance with its mesmerizing display of colorful light peeking out from under a cracked shell of darkness. Those who recognize this effect may wonder if you're entirely stable—which is exactly what you want!

name: Spiderkith
description: Kissed by spider, Spiderkith, Daedric legend, tale, and myth!

name: Sunspire Ice-Fire
description: The melding of ice and fire might seem out of reach for the average person, but you're not the average person, are you? Show your mastery of Sunspire's Ice-Fire by exhibiting it on your body.

name: Tactician's Gold Lattice Skin
description: "We imbue our skin with the Emperor's Regalia as a declaration of our undying loyalty to Cyrodiil's true emperor, Orpheon! Any that block his path to the throne shall see their own skin stripped and left to rot!"—Orpheon Follower

name: The Taskmaster's Banner
description: "My task list saved me. Yes, I know. Every Peryite priest says that. It's true in my case. So true that I prayed at the bank the moment I found out I'd barely missed a Dragon disaster at home. Now I look like this when I want to."—Slera Cinna, Banker

name: Thief Starskin
description: When the Thief constellation shines brightest, bandits, assassins, and all who favor stealth and shadow breathe a little easier. Some hope for this protection every day, invoking the Thief's blessing on their skin.

name: Varla-Born
description: An ancient, Nenalata Ayleid ritual shaped your form into that of their beloved Varla stones. The shimmering hues and stony striations that make up your new "star" form can bedazzle even the most jaded of observers.

name: Void Pathosis
description: Your soul once drifted through the boundless Void, and though it found purchase on Nirn, it can't escape the relentless pull of its former home. Signs of its vast emptiness creep over you, hollowing out your mortal shell to eventually leave behind a husk.

name: Warrior Starskin
description: Some claim that when the Warrior constellation shines brightly, those born under its sign are assured of victory in battle. Those who seek to win through force of arms often take on the Warrior's mantle during times of great crisis.

name: Woebringer
description: "Those who provide the gift of the Night Mother's Kiss to others tend to dress in dark colors—the better to blend into shadows. But if you unwrap us, you may find the glorious hues of our guild's stained glass writ upon our skin."—Nevusa

name: Xoleel Scale
description: Colorful. Vibrant. Toxic. Those who take part in the sacred Argonian Xoleel Ceremony are transformed into a deadly sacrifice to Leviathans that threaten the Deepmire Hist.

name: Z'Maja's Shadow
description: Z'Maja's powerful magic infuses those it touches with a tinge of shadow. Commemorate your encounter with this darkest darkness by wearing this Shadow Skin.

name: Author's Maormer Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Sorcerer-King Orgnum.

name: Fillia's Maormer Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Sorcerer-King Orgnum.

name: Linyia's Maormer Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Sorcerer-King Orgnum.

name: Murzaga's Maormer Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Sorcerer-King Orgnum.

name: Nhorhim's Maormer Deck Fragment
description: A component required to create the Tales of Tribute deck telling the story of Sorcerer-King Orgnum.

name: Hallowed Hourglass Basin
description: A small golden offering bowl engraved with Dragon imagery and filled with consecrated sand. The first of three components required to create a Soulfire Dragon Illusion. This illusion can be further transformed with additional ingredients.

name: Illuminated Dragon Scroll
description: A vellum scroll upon which prayers to the Dragon God are inscribed. The second of three components required to create a Soulfire Dragon Illusion. This illusion can be further transformed with additional ingredients.

name: Kvatchian Incense
description: Sacred incense burned in the offering bowl that propitiate Akatosh for his blessing. The last of three components required to create a Soulfire Dragon Illusion. This illusion can be further transformed with additional ingredients.

name: Sovereign Brush
description: Part of a set of items used to celebrate the most regal of pigs.

name: Sovereign Fodder
description: Part of a set of items used to celebrate the most regal of pigs.

name: Sovereign Lead
description: Part of a set of items used to celebrate the most regal of pigs.

name: Sovereign Libations
description: Part of a set of items used to celebrate the most regal of pigs.

name: Sovereign Oil
description: Part of a set of items used to celebrate the most regal of pigs.

name: Sovereign Sash
description: Part of a set of items used to celebrate the most regal of pigs.

name: Sovereign Tiara
description: Part of a set of items used to celebrate the most regal of pigs.

name: Spectral Berries of Bloom
description: One of four Legendary Spectral Berries.

name: Spectral Berries of Budding
description: One of four Legendary Spectral Berries.

name: Spectral Berries of Growth
description: One of four Legendary Spectral Berries.

name: Spectral Berries of Ripeness
description: One of four Legendary Spectral Berries.

name: Ancient Anchor Berth
description: Whether the bay's waters are tranquil or rough, you'll always find a spot of calm and warmth within the walls of this cozy inn room in Gonfalon Bay. Services abound just outside the door, making this a convenient berth. Room is too small for dueling.

name: Autumn's-Gate
description: In the heart of The Rift, just outside the lively, small town of Nimalten, you will find this sturdy wooden home, with a large hearth to keep you warm in the Skyrim winter, and a stone wall to keep out the trolls.

name: Barbed Hook Private Room
description: Like every busy port, Skywatch has a seamy underside. A private room at the Barbed Hook offers easy access to the criminal classes—and a quick escape from the nearby docks. Room is too small for Dueling.

name: Black Vine Villa
description: Would you want to live in an old stone house just across a dark jungle stream from a haunted Ayleid ruin? Silly question—who wouldn't?

name: Captain Margaux's Place
description: The famous Breton merchant-explorer Captain Margaux hasn't been seen since her ship the Golden Spriggan sailed off over the horizon into the Sea of Pearls—which makes her house near the docks in Daggerfall available for you!

name: Cyrodilic Jungle House
description: An Imperial, of course, is at home anywhere in Tamriel. This compact house at the Baandari Trading Post in Malabal Tor is a bit of Cyrodiil in Valenwood, and just steps away from the fine food and drink at the Silver Moons Inn.

name: Flaming Nix Deluxe Garret
description: Even if you don't personally have a taste for the famous fire-pit dancing at the Flaming Nix, you have to admit it adds a certain cachet to having a room there. Not to mention an unusual fragrance. Room is too small for Dueling.

name: Golden Gryphon Garret
description: It's only a single room, but the advantage of this inn apartment is its unrivaled location, just steps from the gates of Alinor. That, and the rare prestige of an Alinor address! Room is too small for Dueling.

name: Hammerdeath Bungalow
description: "It may be small, but at least it's gloomy. And if you enjoy beating up on your friends, like I do, it's right next door to the arena!" —Goorguk gro-Murtag, Orcish Realtor

name: Humblemud
description: A mud house is a constant reminder of the impermanence of life, and that we are but standing waves in the river of existence. But one still wishes it to look nice and comfortable, and decorates accordingly. Of course.

name: Journey's End Lodgings
description: Whether taking part in funerary rites or visiting the Dark Elf city of the dead, visitors to Necrom can rest easy within the confines of this spacious room inside the Mourner's Solace Inn. Full privacy—even from ancestral spirits—is guaranteed.

name: Kragenhome
description: This residence might not be in Kragenmoor's best neighborhood, but if you're looking for classic Dunmeri architecture at an affordable price, this town house certainly fits the bill.

name: Mara's Kiss Public House
description: As the least restricted seaport in the Summerset Isles, Vulkhel Guard has visitors from across Tamriel—and you're likely to meet most of them hoisting a mug at the Mara's Kiss Pub. Room is too small for Dueling.

name: Moonmirth House
description: A small elevated house on an idyllic plantation in the mild and hospitable clime of Khenarthi's Roost? This one would find that sweet paradise!

name: Pilgrim's Rest
description: Every year, hundreds of Zenithar's worshipers journey to Leyawiin, desperate for a glimpse of St. Kaladas's architectural marvel: The Great Chapel of Zenithar. This suite offers a welcome respite from the road's perils. Room is too small for dueling.

name: Rosewine Retreat
description: Once a favorite of wine merchants seeking to acquire the area's best vintages, this inn room can serve as a convenient refuge for any hoping to sample Skingrad's best food and drink. Room is too small for dueling.

name: Saint Delyn Penthouse
description: For the city-loving Dark Elf, there's no better choice of residence than the Saint Delyn Penthouse in the heart of Vivec City, on the Waistworks level of the Saint Delyn canton. Room is too small for Dueling.

name: Sisters of the Sands Apartment
description: In Sentinel, the best way to hide out in plain sight is with a private room in the Sisters of the Sands, the town's largest inn. It also has the best food in the city, and is the place King Fahara'jad sends to for take-out. Room is too small for Dueling.

name: Snowmelt Suite
description: Whether visiting the Bards College, seeking an audience at the Blue Palace, or looking to imbibe the best Nord mead around, take advantage of convenient living in the midst of Solitude with this room inside the Lonely Troll. Room is too small for Dueling.

name: Snugpod
description: A perfect graht-oak pod home, grown by a Home Singer from the very roots of Elden Root—compact, comfortable, and convenient to everything. Praise Z'en!

name: Sugar Bowl Suite
description: Those seeking a respite from the heat and bustle of Rimmen's crowded streets can find it in this cozy suite. Easy access to Rimmen's amenities—both legal and illicit—make this the perfect abode for adventurers on the go. Room is too small for Dueling.

name: The Ebony Flask Inn Room
description: The Dark Elves may not worship Dibella, but down at the cornerclubs they show that they still know how to have a good time—in their own special way. Room is too small for Dueling.

name: The Rosy Lion
description: This inn has always had the reputation of being the safest place in Daggerfall for common citizens in search of illicit services to meet their shadier counterparts. Room is too small for Dueling.

name: Twin Arches
description: It may be small but it's solid, and it keeps the sandstorms out. The scenery is magnificent, but if you're in the mood for civilization, it's right outside the south gate of Hallin's Stand.

name: Axiomatic Runestones
description: A complete set of runestones etched with sigils of truth and law, as outlined in the scriptures of Julianos. The first of three components required to create the Stonewisp of Truth and Law. This pet can be further transformed with additional ingredients.

name: Glyph of Law
description: A flawlessly inked, illuminated representation of the glyph associated with the god of wisdom and logic. The second of three components required to create the Stonewisp of Truth and Law. This pet can be further transformed with additional ingredients.

name: Powdered Wisp Remains
description: The luminous dust left behind by the death of the common wisp, sanctified for use by the priests of Julianos. The last of three components required to create the Stonewisp of Truth and Law. This pet can be further transformed with additional ingredients.

name: Storage Chest, Fortified
description: 60 Slots This chest can be placed in multiple homes, and always accesses the same personal storage space. Unlike bank storage, items in this chest do not appear at crafting stations.

name: Storage Chest, Oaken
description: 60 Slots This chest can be placed in multiple homes, and always accesses the same personal storage space. Unlike bank storage, items in this chest do not appear at crafting stations.

name: Storage Chest, Secure
description: 60 Slots This chest can be placed in multiple homes, and always accesses the same personal storage space. Unlike bank storage, items in this chest do not appear at crafting stations.

name: Storage Chest, Sturdy
description: 60 Slots This chest can be placed in multiple homes, and always accesses the same personal storage space. Unlike bank storage, items in this chest do not appear at crafting stations.

name: Storage Coffer, Fortified
description: 30 Slots This coffer can be placed in multiple homes, and always accesses the same personal storage space. Unlike bank storage, items in this coffer do not appear at crafting stations.

name: Storage Coffer, Oaken
description: 30 Slots This coffer can be placed in multiple homes, and always accesses the same personal storage space. Unlike bank storage, items in this coffer do not appear at crafting stations.

name: Storage Coffer, Secure
description: 30 Slots This coffer can be placed in multiple homes, and always accesses the same personal storage space. Unlike bank storage, items in this coffer do not appear at crafting stations.

name: Storage Coffer, Sturdy
description: 30 Slots This coffer can be placed in multiple homes, and always accesses the same personal storage space. Unlike bank storage, items in this coffer do not appear at crafting stations.

name: Antiquarian's Eye
description: Allows you to Scry for Antiquities. When used within a Dig Site, indicates the direction to the nearest possible Antiquity location.

name: Cartoklept Map
description: An old relic with the power to pinpoint the location of Cartoklepts and reveal their coordinates on your map. To reveal Cartoklept locations, the relic must be used in Scrivener's Hall and the Cartoklept must be in the same realm at the time of use.

name: Eye of the Infinite
description: Tho'at Replicanum's presence corrupts much of the archive, but corrupted relics can still be useful. When used within the Infinite Archive, the Eye summons a maligraphic Watcher who will aid you in the archival wings.

name: Fire Rock
description: When used near a friendly strangler, can cause the plant to pull you to its location.

name: Jubilee Cake 2025
description: Chef Donolon's Jubilee Cake calls upon his prodigious experience to provide you with a cake inspired by the tropical paradise Solstice. Eat this cake, once per day, to earn Event Tickets.

name: Relic of the Sentinel
description: This relic's tie to Sentinel Aksalaz allows you to summon forth his visage in a display of frosty power. When used within Black Drake Villa, all party members gain the Icy Vision effect, which reveals hidden treasures within Black Drake Villa.

name: Witchmother's Whistle
description: Use this whistle to summon the Witchmother's Cauldron. During the harvest, drinking the cauldron's brew may have additional effects.

name: Nightmare Stick Horse
description: Ride a stick mount that symbolizes your fiery dreams of all-consuming doom. Complete with flaming mane, tail, and eyes, this thrice-cursed novelty horse makes your stick-riding experience one for the books of burning horror!

name: Novelty Stick Dragon
description: During the Jester's Festival even the lowliest of commoners can pretend to be a mounted knight with a whimsical Novelty Stick steed. Dragons are popular in the Ebonheart Pact.

name: Novelty Stick Guar
description: During the Jester's Festival even the lowliest of commoners can pretend to be a mounted knight with a whimsical Novelty Stick steed. Guars are popular in the Aldmeri Dominion.

name: Novelty Stick Horse
description: During the Jester's Festival even the lowliest of commoners can pretend to be a mounted knight with a whimsical Novelty Stick steed. Horses are popular in the Daggerfall Covenant.

name: Stitchedwell Stick Guar
description: Soul Shriven knights ride only the most finely stitched steeds. As one old knight proclaimed "Don't mind the bit of fray at the bottom there. Or the pesky splinters sticking out of the handle. This guar is a jolly smooth ride!"

name: Bust: Ansuul the Tormentor
description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Sanity's Edge.

name: Bust: Aradros
description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Oathsworn Pit.

name: Bust: Archdruid Devyric
description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Earthen Root Enclave.

name: Bust: Argonian Behemoth
description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Maelstrom Arena.

name: Bust: Assembly General
description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in the Halls of Fabrication.

name: Bust: Balorgh
description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in March of Sacrifices.

name: Bust: Baron Zaudrus
description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in The Cauldron.

name: Bust: Bloodspawn
description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Spindleclutch II.

name: Bust: Bogdan the Nightflame
description: Bronze bust commemorating an Undaunted victory in Elden Hollow II.

name: Bust: Captain Blackheart

name: Deadlands Flint
description: The first of three components required to kindle an Unstable Morpholith. This mote can be further transformed with additional ingredients.

name: Rune-Etched Striker
description: The second of three components required to kindle an Unstable Morpholith. This mote can be further transformed with additional ingredients.

name: Smoldering Bloodgrass Tinder
description: The last of three components required to kindle an Unstable Morpholith. This mote can be further transformed with additional ingredients.

name: Abyssal Tea Set
description: Well-used clay vessels comprising a tea set. The kettle and a set of cups is etched with tentacles and eldritch runes. The whistle of the pot sounds like darkly whispered secrets. Permanently grants the passive "Azandar's Inquisitiveness" to the bearer.

name: Ancient Anticipations Idol
description: Hewn from basalt, this idol merges all three Good Daedra into single grotesque effigy. While some might consider such an object hideous, Mirri regards it as one of her greatest finds. Permanently grants the passive "Mirri's Expertise" to the bearer.

name: Any Race, Any Alliance
description: The ability to play any race in any alliance.

name: Aramril's Training
description: Thanks to Aramril's training, the strength of your Visions improves.

name: Ascendant Outfit Style
description: Unlocks all 7 Ascendant Knight outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

name: Bastian's Julianos Medallion
description: Gifted to Bastian when he was still a boy, this medallion depicts the logician's triangle in polished bronze. The edges have grown dull, the result of frequent use as a worry talisman. Permanently grants the passive "Bastian's Insight" to the bearer.

name: Class: Arcanist
description: Unlocks the Arcanist class for use in character creation. Channel the eldritch powers of Apocrypha as an Arcanist. These spellcasters channel secret runes and abyssal spells to destroy their enemies, heal their allies, and defend against any foe.

name: Class: Necromancer
description: Unlocks the Necromancer class for use in character creation. Masters of death, Necromancers can call upon corpses to serve as undead thralls and weave ghastly spells to both harm and heal.

name: Class: Warden
description: Unlocks the Warden class for use in character creation. Wardens are defenders of the Green, master storytellers whose nature tales become magical reality. They wield frost spells against enemies and summon animals to aid them.

name: Costume Dyeing
description: Unlocks the ability to dye your Costume and Hat Collectibles with any Dye you've unlocked. This can be done at any Dye Station, found in many large cities.

name: Deadlands Gladiator Outfit Style
description: Unlocks all 32 Deadlands Gladiator outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

name: Destozuno's Safety Net
description: Even those who prefer to live dangerously may enjoy gaining 1 additional Thread of Fate. More Threads mean more danger, after all! The additional Thread will not attach immediately. It will be present during your next foray into the Infinite Archive.

name: Divine Prosecution Outfit Style
description: Unlocks all Divine Prosecution outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

name: Dragon Bone Outfit Style
description: Unlocks all Dragon Bone outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

name: Dremora Kynreeve Outfit Style
description: Unlocks all 7 Dremora Kynreeve outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

name: Filer Kor's Truesight
description: To recognize your efforts within the Infinite Archive, Filer Kor grants you access to a third Vision choice.

name: Garland Ring Humming Pick
description: A delicate clockwork gadget fashioned from second-hand materials and made to look like a hummingbird. Its long, thin copper tongue makes short work of even the toughest locks. Permanently grants the passive "Tanlorin's Finesse" to the bearer.

name: Ghostly Gratitude
description: Benevolent spirits indebted to you improve the strength of your Verses.

name: Imperial Race and Outfit Style
description: Unlocks the ability to choose the Imperial Race when creating your character. Also unlocks all Imperial outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

name: Ja'kh's Bell of Bounty
description: A walnut-sized bell ornately carved from jade. Detailed with electrum bezels and embossing, it once heralded the presence of a mischievous and much-loved cat named Ja'kh. Permanently grants the passive "Zerith's Guidance" to the bearer.

name: Knowledge Eater Outfit Style
description: Unlocks all 7 Knowledge Eater outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

name: Luxury Thieves Tools
description: A set of well-made thieves tools set within a leather pouch. One tool is missing, likely snatched by your thieving companion for her own amusement. Permanently grants the passive "Ember's Intuition" to the bearer.

name: Morag Tong Outfit Style
description: Unlocks all Morag Tong outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

name: Scribing
description: Unlocks the Scribing feature for use on characters that have completed the tutorial quest "The Second Era of Scribing." Access to other features in the system comes from completing Scribing quests on at least one character on your account.

name: Sharp's Handmade Fishing Lure
description: A nightwood fishing lure in the shape of a minnow, decorated with a black feather. The illusion enchantment activates with bait and water, enticing fish with writhing flashes of color. Permanently grants the passive "Sharp's Patience" to the bearer.

name: Sigil of the Luminary Dragon
description: Makes Signature Scripts obtainable from daily World Boss rewards, the daily Cyrodiil reward, and daily Fighters Guild quest rewards. Unlocks subsidized Scripts at Mages Guilds across Tamriel. Rarely causes Luminous Ink to be found in treasure chests.

name: Sigil of the Luminary Gryphon
description: Makes Focus Scripts obtainable from daily Delve rewards, PvP Rewards for the Worthy, and daily Mages Guild quest rewards, as well as vendors at the Scholarium and Infinite Archive. Rarely causes Luminous Ink to be found in heavy sacks.

name: Sigil of the Luminary Indrik
description: Allows the purchase of Grimoires and Scripts from Chronicler Firandil at the Scholarium, as well as access to the Scholarium's Training Room. Rarely causes Luminous Ink to be found on enemies.

name: Sigil of the Luminary Netch
description: Makes Affix Scripts obtainable from daily World Event rewards, daily Imperial City rewards, and daily Undaunted quest rewards, as well as vendors at the Scholarium and Infinite Archive. Rarely causes Luminous Ink to be found on harvesting nodes.

name: Skingrad Vedette Outfit Style
description: Unlocks all 7 Skingrad Vedette outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

name: Stendarr's Sweets Vault
description: This pottery effigy has a small cap on top, allowing access to the hollow interior. Within, Isobel has secreted away a delicious assortment of some of her favorite sweets. Permanently grants the passive "Isobel's Grace" to the bearer.

name: Sweeter Deal
description: Some experiences are their own reward. That said, who would pass up unlocking a third Verse choice?

name: Swordthane Outfit Style
description: Unlocks all Swordthane outfit style collectibles and allows them to be applied via the outfit system without an application fee.

name: Tentacular Motivation
description: Hard-earned knowledge, along with a bit of motivation of the tentacular kind, grants you faster movement throughout the Infinite Archive.

name: Akaviri Potentate Bear
description: "Mirannah of Gwylim notes that the first Imperial bear cavalry came into use in 2E 23. Scrawled next to this: '10th Legion steed?' and 'Leyawiin bear parade.' I can verify the date, but the latter two must be fiction notes."—Honorata Ancrus, Eyevea

name: All-Maker's Bear
description: The bears of Solstheim have a deep and ancient connection to the All-Maker. When the time comes to serve as a mount to the Skaal, or so the stories go, they enter the corral as mild-mannered as a cub.

name: Anniversary Fellowship Bear
description: This bear is fiercely loyal to its rider, and it snaps and growls at anyone else who gets too close. It has a gentle disposition with its bonded rider and often snuffles around in search of treats in their pack.

name: Atmoran Snow Bear
description: These fiercely noble Snow Bears are said to have been brought from the legendary frozen continent of Atmora by mighty Ysgramor himself, who deemed them the only worthy avatars of the ancient Nord Bear totem.

name: Badger Bear
description: The Badger Bears of southern Blackwood were nearly extinct in the wild when they were saved by the intervention from an unlikely source, an Imperial noble, when Viscount Glorion of Leyawiin rescued the species by breeding them as mounts.

name: Bear-Lizard Steed
description: "So, it's a Bear. Only it's a Lizard. And you can ride it? Shor's bones! That's all I need to know. I'll take it!" —Celebrated Nord Envoy Rigurt the Brash

name: Black Bear
description: The Black Bear is common across Cyrodiil, but is also seen north into High Rock and Skyrim, where it is considered a warrior's mount.

name: Brindle Bear
description: "I've only seen a wild brindle bear once, and I don't wish to repeat the experience. The creature found me in the woods, bagging up a deer. It growled. I froze. But then it walked right by me. It must have already eaten."—Scarius Barbatus of Kvatch

name: Buoyant Armiger Bear
description: "Vicious, the bear was, all a-rumble with menace, despite its chains. 'Let us please Lord Vivec with this two-toned creature. Its growls show promise in a world filled with craven whispers.' And so it began."—Armiger Tharys's Journal

name: Cave Bear
description: Found throughout Tamriel's northern mountains, the Cave Bear makes a hardy and imposing mount.

name: Cursebound Bear
description: Bears afflicted by a necromancer's curse become baneful, easily enraged beasts. Loyal only to their masters, these transformed ursines show no fear in the face of danger, making them excellent battlefield companions.

name: Dragonclaw Imperial Warbear
description: Very few mounts take to battle as readily as a warbear. This one answers only to the strength of its rider. Between its fierce disposition and ursine defenses, it has little to fear from any foes on the battlefield.

name: Dragonscale Barded Bear
description: Dragonscale bard is just about the heaviest armor one can put on a mount, but bears bred as mounts are so strong they scarcely seem to notice it.

name: Dragonscale Draugr Bear
description: Riders of these draugr bears find the dragonscale barding does an exemplary job. There's exactly as much jouncing as you'd expect riding hard on a skeletal ursine's back. Plus, the frost magic imbued within adds a frisson of chill to keep riders alert.

name: Dragontail Mountain Bear
description: "Don't mind old Honeycheeks, here. He's just snuffling around to see if you have anything tasty on you. Don't worry, he's a strict vegetarian! Although he has been known to swallow a bee or two when he gets deep in a honeycomb."—Beniah Bear-friend

name: Druadach Mountain Bear
description: Originally tamed and bred as mounts by the ancient Grimfang Reach clan, these riding bears became popular among Nords who captured them in raids. Despite their inherent docility, these bears anger swiftly when threatened.

name: Dwarven Bear
description: Scholar of the Dwemer Guylaine Marilie theorized that bear vamidiums were animunculi mounts reserved only for those Deep Elves of high rank or status. "Imagine a noble in full armor on a Dwarven Bear Mount" he wrote. "What could be more impressive?"

name: Flame Atronach Bear
description: When the Empress Hestra led her legions in harrying the Vampire King Styriche and his Gray Host into western Hammerfell, it's said she did so while riding a great Flame Atronach Bear Mount named Fiery Ursula.

name: Frost Atronach Bear
description: Orcish spellwrights rarely call for boons from Daedric realms beyond Malacath's Ashpit. Even so, the lure of a raging bear wrought from rock-hard ice is difficult to pass up.

name: Frostbane Bear
description: The Bear was also one of the ancient Atmoran animal tokens, associated later with the Nord god Tsun, so the Frostbane Bear has historically been one of the most prestigious mounts a tradition-loving Nord could ride.

name: Gloomspore Bear
description: "A fellow named Rigurt requested a 'fortuitudinous' bear mount that 'shines up the face' of a friend. My glowing Gloomspore Bears, with their mora tapinella infusion, barrel through enemies to get a rider to safety. 'Fortuitudinous' galore."—Mage Naleldi

name: Graysmoke Forge Bear
description: In honor of a fallen Warden, a Wayrest blacksmith continues to breed and sell these bears as mounts today. If you happen to notice a Warden watching you as you ride this steed, consider thanking her. She may be the fallen Warden's shade!

name: Grinning Terror Bear
description: "You need more than colorful barding to harness one of these bears—a splash of blood freed by Neb-Crescen and a teardrop from a watcher's eye might bind one to your cause. Might. Otherwise, stand clear. You won't survive their hugs."—Mother Regrets

name: Harrowstorm Bear
description: Tainted by proximity to active harrowstorms, these bears have become hexed abominations—perfect for warriors with cold blood and dark intentions.

name: Hollowjack Rider Bear
description: When the moons rise over the Witches Festival, Jaque o' the Hollow haunts the mounts of mortals, cursing their riders to gallop headless through the night. Even the doughty bear mounts of the Nords are susceptible.

name: Icerage Bear
description: Scrolls from Direfrost Keep indicate that the ice witches first invoked these creatures as vessels to contain their rage and hunt those who had wronged them. Presumably they wanted loyal familiars, but found the bears also make formidable mounts.

name: Iron Atronach Bear
description: Aer, the Conjurer Magnificent, summoned the first of these Iron Bears in 1E 2150. According to her notes, the lumbering, ursine frame matches the atronach's temperament perfectly, making the calling-ritual far easier.

name: Keptu Bear
description: "Long ago, during the annual Ket Keptu hunt, Tula the Skullcleaver and their bear Falk rose above the others in the amount of prey they killed for the shared larder. In celebration, Falk received these markings of Hircine's favor."—Fori, Keptu Scholar

name: Mara's Awe Bear
description: The gifting of live animals is sometimes practiced among Mara's faithful as a sign of a couple's commitment to one another. Though bears are rarely used for this purpose, this one is immeasurably affectionate, with soft fur that begs to be petted.

name: Masked Bear
description: Both swift and strong, the Masked Bear of the Jerall Mountains is a popular mount along the high passes between Bruma and Falkreath.

name: Nenalata Ayleid Bear
description: "During the long journey from Nenalata to High Rock, beloved mounts became saviors. A song, nearly forgotten, details how a bear named Sunnawend saved Ayleids from a watery grave as they sought to cross a rain-swollen river."—Beredalmo the Signifier

name: New Moon Bear
description: "Dark as a starless night, Cult of the New Moon bears move through shadows silently to attack their prey. Never anger one of these." —Jonnet of the Sunwalkers

name: Nightmare Bear
description: Foolhardy warriors travel into the charred Deadlands forests to face off against the ursine horrors that reside there. Lucky adventurers return to their homelands alive, but forever haunted by the sound of red-hot claws digging into ashen dirt.

name: Psijic Bear Exemplar
description: According to Nord legend, bears—like the Nords themselves—originated on the frozen continent of Atmora. And some Nords think that's where the Psijic monks went to find the original model of their Psiiic Bear Exemplar. The Psijic mages aren't saying.

name: Ragebound Bear
description: "Each pelt and bone on this monster of a bear reminds its rider of past battles. Rage turned to an end. Victory ripped from the rider's enemies. You know the feeling, I think. It's in your eyes. Rage. Barely controlled."—Arparnagh of Markarth

name: Reefborn Bear
description: "If you visit Abecean islands, you need to be ready to handle reefborn creatures. The bears, for example, do bear things. Mostly. But watch them near saltwater—they'll roll in it whether you're on them or not."—Saissula, Stablemaster

name: Sai-Sahan's Revelry Ursine
description: "Ah, this is a beast worthy of a hero! Don't worry, faithful Minana here has seen her share of battles and more than earned the armor she now wears. She will be a staunch companion to you, no matter where HoonDing bids you."—Dragonguard Zarina

name: Shoal Bear
description: "It's a strange creature, no doubt about that. I'm not sure if it's a bear that became enchanted too close to the sea, or a magical oceanic construct that just happens to look like a bear. Either way, it's a good swimmer."—Mage Adept Erwan Cottret

name: Skeletal Bear
description: A re-animated Skeletal Bear makes a fearsome mount, and is a favorite of northern Tamriel's necromancers.

name: Snow Bear
description: The Snow Bear makes a superior mount for northern climes, as it's undaunted by even the fiercest winter weather.

name: Soulrazer Bear
description: "We know that a crazed necromancer forged these creatures with his dying breath. They are unrelenting, and never stop even when the Ritemaster commands them. Inexplicably, some of the bears sit calmly at the feet of the apprentices."—Yrssin, Psijic Order

name: Sovngarde Stoutheart Bear
description: "During times of great need, Sovngarde releases some of its heroes back into the world, and legendary beasts to serve them. The stoutheart bear is one such creature. A fearless companion to carry true warriors to battle."—Clever Woman Moritra

name: Star-Born Guardian Bear
description: "Don't let this bear's mesmerizing stars fool you into thinking it's a harmless bit of magical transport. Recall the sway of the Constellations, and understand that this creature embodies that power."—Wheezing Wilren

name: Stonelore Bear
description: Each of the druid circles keeps a different ursine companion. The Stonelore bear was originally bred to help with ambitious construction projects. While druids shaped heavy stone slabs, their bears supported the more fragile components of the structures.

name: Storm Atronach Bear
description: According to Nord legend, in his wars against the Snow Elves the mighty Ysgramor the Harbinger rode a Storm Atronach Bear Mount conjured for him by his personal Clever Man.

name: Sunback Bear
description: A staple of Morthal wardens, these imposing bears trundle near the outskirts of town, serving as extra guards when not in use as steeds or resting. Those who seek to one day become valiant defenders of their town often sneak away to feed them extra treats.

name: Sweetroll Grizzly
description: The rare Sweetroll Grizzly Bears prowl the golden forests of the Rift on the northern slopes of the Jerall Mountains. They're big strong cuddly hug machines—except when they're angry.

name: Tuxedo Bear
description: Though the famed bard Svaknir wrote a hilarious song in which the Tuxedo was mocked as "the Chub Loon of Bears" this magnificent ursine mount has been esteemed by Nord nobles since the early First Era.

name: Wealdspirit Bear
description: "A whole bear? You grew a whole bear? Well? What are you doing with it still? Get out there! Burn a fort to the ground! Make it hit some rocks with its paws! Bask in bear-y devastation!"—Glooredel, Vinedusk Ranger

name: Wild Hunt Bear
description: The Wild Hunt Bear is a forest beast that has lost its Y'ffre-given ability to choose between being plant or animal, reverting to the primal chaos of the Dawn Era.

name: Wind Keep Bear
description: It's no surprise that this unique bear has found a home for itself in the peaceful, rolling hills of Wind Keep. With few natural predators, the beasts are quite docile, and riders appreciate the animal's agreeable nature.

name: Wraithtide Bear
description: "Where mages born from water gather, they enact ancient rites. Together they bind the essence of bear and sea and death, forming it into a mount one of their number may ride. Or so the tales go."—Druid Sandire

name: Voriplasm Trap: Compliance Oil
description: Part of a trap meant to capture, contain, and tame a hapless voriplasm.

name: Voriplasm Trap: Crystal Jar
description: Part of a trap meant to capture, contain, and tame a hapless voriplasm.

description: Part of a trap meant to capture, contain, and tame a hapless voriplasm.
