description: Part of a trap meant to capture, contain, and tame a hapless voriplasm.

name: Voriplasm Trap: Training Salts
description: Part of a trap meant to capture, contain, and tame a hapless voriplasm.

name: Voriplasm Trap: Trigger Wire
description: Part of a trap meant to capture, contain, and tame a hapless voriplasm.

name: Voriplasm Trap: User Manual
description: Part of a trap meant to capture, contain, and tame a hapless voriplasm.

name: Armiger Axing
description: Use an edge sharpened to exacting Buoyant Armiger standards when chopping your next log. After all, you would not wish to disappoint Lord Vivec, would you?

name: Assassin's Chop
description: The Night Mother will forgive a little showing off.

name: Dwarven Sphere Chop
description: Why break a sweat by chopping wood yourself when you can have a Dwarven Sphere do it for you?

name: Karth River Cleave
description: Cleave through wood like a Reach warrior on the Karth River! These worthies use a special handcrafted axe that gives them a burst of pride in their work, and now you can too.

name: Kyne's Cleave
description: "Kyne, follow my arm. Kyne, hear my plea. Kyne, let your thunder roll!"—Commoner's Prayer to Kyne

name: Stonelore Split
description: Trees grant gifts that linger after their passing. Druids recognize this gift as what it is, a blessing from Y'ffre.

name: Grave Stake: Attuned Bonework
description: Necessary parts for a ritual to create and bind your very own grave-stake.

name: Grave Stake: Blessed Carved Wood
description: Necessary parts for a ritual to create and bind your very own grave-stake.

name: Grave Stake: Blooded Pigments
description: Necessary parts for a ritual to create and bind your very own grave-stake.

name: Grave Stake: Consecrated Mud
description: Necessary parts for a ritual to create and bind your very own grave-stake.

name: Grave Stake: Hallowed Leather
description: Necessary parts for a ritual to create and bind your very own grave-stake.

name: Grave Stake: Ritual Instructions
description: Necessary parts for a ritual to create and bind your very own grave-stake.

name: Grave Stake: Sacred Binding
description: Necessary parts for a ritual to create and bind your very own grave-stake.

name: Blackwood
description: A call to arms! The Chamber of Legates in Leyawiin needs help to investigate a threat against former Imperial councilors and the activities of a Mehrunes Dagon cult. Seek the leader of the Ivory Brigade in Leyawiin, the capital of Blackwood.

name: Clockwork City
description: Reports of mysterious shadow assassins draw you into Sotha Sil's Clockwork City to investigate a new Daedric threat. Uncover the secrets of this strange new zone, take on a new 12-player trial, earn powerful new armor sets and items, and more.

name: Dark Brotherhood
description: Your talent for homicide has been noticed and an invitation has arrived—to join the Dark Brotherhood! Come to the Gold Coast, westernmost region of the old Empire, where opportunities abound for intrigue, conspiracy and murder! It's one killer DLC.

name: Dragonhold
description: To the heroes of Tamriel! Sai Sahan, blademaster and former captain of the Dragonguard, requires adventurers strong in heart to help fight back against the rage of Dragons that have invaded Elsweyr. Find Sai Sahan in Senchal, in Southern Elsweyr.

name: Elsweyr
description: The word goes forth! Abnur Tharn, battlemage and former Imperial advisor, requires able-bodied allies to defend the cat-folk of Elsweyr against a rage of Dragons. Only the most brave need apply. Find Tharn in Riverhold, in Northern Elsweyr.

name: Firesong
description: The isle of Galen is threatened by Sea Elf raiders and druid unrest. The Society of the Steadfast seeks adventurers to help House Mornard defend Galen. Report to Lord Bacaro Volorus in the city of Vastyr if you possess courage equal to the task.

name: Greymoor
description: To the heroes of Tamriel! Jorunn the Skald-King has dispatched agents to Western Skyrim to investigate and deal with a threat not only to Skyrim, but to all of Tamriel. Find the Skald-King's agent in Solitude, the capital city of Haafingar Hold.

name: High Isle
description: The Society of the Steadfast calls all able-bodied adventurers to the island of High Isle in the Systres Archipelago to assist in a matter of great import to all alliances. Seek out Lady Arabelle Davaux in the city of Gonfalon Bay for details.

name: Imperial City
description: Daedric forces have taken the Imperial City, and all three alliances vie to take it back. Experience hours of all-new PvP and PvE gameplay, both above ground and below, plus two new dungeons, never-before-seen monsters, craftable item sets, and more!

name: Markarth
description: A dark army marches across Skyrim! Count Verandis Ravenwatch seeks allies in the wild land of the Reach to uncover the true intent of the Gray Host. Find Verandis near Markarth, the primary city in the untamed Reach.

name: Morrowind
description: A dread shadow hangs over Morrowind, portending doom even as Red Mountain shudders and quakes. Travel to Vvardenfell and aid the priests of Vivec in this new region full of prophecy, Dark Elf rivalries, and ancient traditions.

name: Murkmire
description: Travel to Murkmire, the southernmost region of mysterious Black Marsh, and venture into the deep swamps to learn some of the most hidden secrets of the Argonians!

name: Necrom
description: What truths are best left hidden? Discover Necrom and delve into the forbidden secrets of Apocrypha. Fight to preserve reality from Morrowind's Telvanni Peninsula to Hermaeus Mora's realm!

name: Orsinium
description: Come to the homeland of the Orcs in ESO's first new PvE quest content DLC! Help King Kurog rebuild the city of Orsinium, and watch its walls and towers rise due to your deeds. Includes new armor, weapons, a solo challenge arena, and more!

name: Summerset
description: By royal decree, the once-forbidden island of the High Elves has been opened, its Crystal Tower drawing travelers to its light. But dark forces from beyond and below are also interested in the mystic location in the Summerset Isle.

name: The Deadlands
description: Lyranth the Dremora summons those willing to defend Nirn against the gates of Oblivion. The followers of Mehrunes Dagon threaten to unleash a storm of destruction upon the mortal realm. Meet Lyranth in the mysterious Daedric plane known only as Fargrave.

name: Thieves Guild
description: Join the Thieves Guild in Hew's Bane, a never-before-seen area of Hammerfell! Explore Abah's Landing, a decadent port town ruled by corrupt merchant lords, who struggle with the Thieves Guild for power. New stories, delves, world bosses, and much more!
